text: Kuyabanga, cishe. Gqoka izingubo eziningi.
en: Chilly, most likely. Layer up to be safe.
bt: It's cold, probably. Wear lots of clothes.

text: Aandete kan wag. Blykbaar moet dit.
en: Supper can wait. Apparently it has to.
bt: Dinner can wait. Apparently it has to.

text: Daardie skadunet slaan al van ontbyt af soos 'n trom, en niemand kan die TV hoor nie.
en: That shade cloth has been drumming since breakfast and nobody can hear the television.
bt: That shade net has been drumming like a drum since breakfast, and nobody can hear the TV.

text: Die storm is naby. Die huis is nader, hopelik.
en: Storm's close. Home is closer, hopefully.
bt: The storm is near. The house is nearer, hopefully.

text: Modumo wa seaduma o a tla
en: Thunder rolling in.
bt: The sound of [?seaduma] is coming

text: Die Helderberg is helder, die wasgoed hang horisontaal, en Sondag is gereël.
en: The Helderberg is clear, the washing is horizontal, and that is Sunday sorted.
bt: The Helderberg is clear, the washing hangs horizontally, and Sunday is sorted.

text: Selfs die boerboel het die weer nagegaan en weer gaan sit.
en: Even the boerboel checked the weather and sat back down.
bt: Even the boerboel checked the weather and sat down again.

text: Ubusika obulungileyo bokubona iNdlela yeMilky Way.
en: Perfect night to actually see the Milky Way.
bt: A good winter for seeing the Milky Way.

text: Wolke tot op die dakke, en elke verstandige soogdier is binne onder 'n lamp.
en: Cloud right down to the rooftops, and every sensible mammal is indoors under a lamp.
bt: Clouds down to the roofs, and every sensible mammal is inside under a lamp.

text: Esita le ba Cape ba lumela hore ho a bata.
en: Even the Capetonians are admitting it's cold.
bt: Even those of the Cape agree that it is cold.

text: Stoor hierdie een in die geheue-bank.
en: Save this one in the memory bank.
bt: Store this one in the memory bank.

text: Dis 6 uur en die yskas is nou al die gewildste vertrek in die huis.
en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.
bt: It's 6 o'clock and the fridge is now the most popular room in the house.

text: Die Kaapse Dokter maak huisbesoeke.
en: The Cape Doctor is making house calls.
bt: The Cape Doctor makes house calls.

text: Koue plus mooi is 'n eerlike transaksie. Ons vat dit.
en: Cold plus beautiful is an honest trade. We'll take it.
bt: Cold plus beautiful is an honest transaction. We'll take it.

text: Niemand aan hierdie kant van Gqeberha hang vandag wasgoed op nie.
en: Nobody on this side of Gqeberha is hanging washing out today.
bt: Nobody on this side of Gqeberha hangs out washing today.

text: Daardie biere op die rand is vanaand op hul derde eienaar.
en: Those beers on the edge are on their third owner tonight.
bt: Those beers on the edge are on their third owner tonight.

text: Die laaste blok hout is 'n besluit, nie 'n voorraaditem nie.
en: The last log is a decision, not an inventory item.
bt: The last block of wood is a decision, not a stock item.

text: Kushushu ukudlula i-dashboard yebakkie emini.
en: Hotter than a bakkie dashboard at noon.
bt: It's hotter than a bakkie's dashboard at midday.

text: Daardie wasgoedpennetjies is al wat tussen jou en 'n heining vol lakens staan.
en: Those pegs are all that stands between you and a fence full of sheets.
bt: Those clothes pegs are all that stand between you and a fence full of sheets.

text: Stap uitgestel. Die verskoning kan telefonies gebeur.
en: Walk postponed. The apology can happen by phone.
bt: Walk postponed. The apology can happen by phone.

text: Amafu akhona kodwa awenzi lutho.
en: The clouds are here but they're not doing anything.
bt: The clouds are there but they do nothing.

text: Die wolke is hier maar hulle doen niks.
en: The clouds are here but they're not doing anything.
bt: The clouds are here but they're doing nothing.

text: Ungaluchukumisi iqhosha lebhande lokhuseleko. Sithembe.
en: Don't touch the seatbelt buckle. Trust us.
bt: Don't touch the seatbelt button. Trust us.

text: Umuzi waseningizimu ufikile. Ungamenyiwe, njengenjwayelo.
en: The southeaster's arrived. Uninvited, as usual.
bt: The southern homestead has arrived. Uninvited, as usual.

text: Die soort dag wat mense laat 'lekker dag ne' stuur.
en: The type of day that makes people text 'lekker dag hey'.
bt: The kind of day that makes people send 'lekker dag ne'.

text: Die maan loer kort-kort uit om die vulstasie te check. Steeds niks aan die gang nie.
en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.
bt: The moon peeks out every now and then to check on the filling station. Still nothing going on.

text: Die hele dorp se wasgoedpennetjies hou vanaand duim vas.
en: Every peg in the village is holding thumbs tonight.
bt: All the town's clothes pegs are keeping their thumbs crossed tonight.

text: Daar is nie een stukkie skaduwee op hierdie werf wat ná tienuur nog oor is nie.
en: There is no shade on this whole werf that lasts past about ten.
bt: There isn't one bit of shade left in this yard after ten o'clock.

text: Kunamafu kancane.
en: Partly cloudy.
bt: There are a few clouds.

text: Die oggend kom sag in, amper soos 'n verskoning.
en: Morning is coming in soft, almost like an apology.
bt: The morning comes in softly, almost like an apology.

text: Nie 'n luggie nie, anders sou daardie lantern 'n rustiger aand hê.
en: Not a breath of wind, or that lantern would be having a quieter evening.
bt: Not a breeze, otherwise that lantern would have a calmer evening.

text: Ishokoledi eshisayo akusikho isifiso. Yisidingo.
en: Hot chocolate is not a want. It's a need.
bt: Hot chocolate is not a desire. It's a necessity.

text: Joburg-winter: jas in die morning, T-hemp teen twee, jas weer teen vier.
en: Joburg winter: jacket in the morning, T-shirt by two, jacket again by four.
bt: Joburg winter: coat in the morning, T-shirt at two, coat again at four.

text: Kubanda, izululicwebile
en: Cold but clear
bt: It's cold, the sky has cleared (words run together: [?izululicwebile])

text: Meea e matla
en: Gusty winds
bt: Strong winds

text: Leholimo le bonahala le halefile. Ho ka eketseha.
en: Sky's looking moody. Could escalate.
bt: The sky looks angry. It may get worse.

text: Mocheso mohlomong o teng. Palo e sa ntsane e lula.
en: Heat's likely. The number's still settling.
bt: Heat is perhaps there. The number is still staying.

text: Ukuphuza amanzi: yebo. Konke.
en: Water consumption: yes. All of it.
bt: Drinking water: yes. All of it.

text: Veertig verdiepings glas, en elkeen wys dieselfde blou.
en: Forty floors of glass and every one of them is showing the same blue.
bt: Forty storeys of glass, and each one shows the same blue.

text: Esita le Google Maps e na le liphetoho kajeno.
en: Even Google Maps is being vague today.
bt: Even Google Maps has changes today.

text: 'n Ekstra uur in die bed sou die wekker niks gekos het nie.
en: An extra hour in bed would have cost the alarm nothing.
bt: An extra hour in bed would have cost the alarm nothing.

text: Vyf meter sig. Nes jou vyfjaarplan.
en: Five metres of visibility. Same as your five-year plan.
bt: Five metres of visibility. Just like your five-year plan.

text: setofo
en: sunscreen
bt: stove

text: Umva wentamo yakho — loo ndawo uyilibele.
en: The back of your neck. You forgot that bit.
bt: The back of your neck, that place you forgot it.

text: Die pad huis toe vat langer as wat jou honger toelaat.
en: The road home takes longer than your hunger allows.
bt: The road home takes longer than your hunger allows.

text: Vandag se enigste vergadering is by die vlak kant.
en: All meetings moved to the shallow end.
bt: Today's only meeting is at the shallow end.

text: Ha ho motho ea bolelletseng ponelopele. E fihletse feela.
en: Nobody told the forecast. It just arrived.
bt: Nobody announced the forecast. It has simply arrived.

text: Karwas kan onderaan jou lys bly.
en: Car washing can stay at the bottom of your list.
bt: Car wash can stay at the bottom of your list.

text: Die fynbos geniet dit. Jy moet ook.
en: The fynbos is loving it. You should too.
bt: The fynbos enjoys it. You should too.

text: Lehodimo ha le tsebe. Kena klubeng.
en: The sky can't make up its mind. Join the club.
bt: The sky doesn't know. Go into the club.

text: Die Koppe is toe. Die aand is oop.
en: The Heads are closed. The evening is open.
bt: The Heads (hills) are closed. The evening is open.

text: Die lug doen niks besonders nie en is baie deeglik daaroor.
en: The sky is doing nothing in particular and being very thorough about it.
bt: The sky does nothing special and is very thorough about it.

text: Maandag, en die wekker op hierdie plaas het vere en geen snooze nie.
en: Monday, and the alarm on this farm has feathers and no snooze button.
bt: Monday, and the alarm on this farm has feathers and no snooze.

text: 35 in die skadu. In die son tel niemand meer nie.
en: 35 in the shade. In the sun, nobody's counting anymore.
bt: 35 in the shade. In the sun nobody counts any more.

text: Goue uur op die Hoëveld: gratis, en steeds onbetaalbaar.
en: Highveld golden hour: costs nothing, upstages everything.
bt: Golden hour on the Highveld: free, and still priceless.

text: Maandag, en die wind kon dit glad nie bederf nie.
en: Monday, and the wind has completely failed to ruin this.
bt: Monday, and the wind couldn't spoil it at all.

text: Weer só mooi is nie gratis nie. Iewers wag 'n suidooster.
en: Weather this perfect is on loan. The southeaster keeps receipts.
bt: Weather this beautiful isn't free. Somewhere a south-easter is waiting.

text: Yhuu, kushisa nyhani!
en: Jislaaik, it's properly hot!
bt: Wow, it's really hot!

text: Ha ho leru. Ke uena le Sefapano sa Boroa feela.
en: Not a cloud. Just you and the Southern Cross.
bt: There is no cloud. It's just you and the Southern Cross.

text: Die wasgoed kan uitgaan voor jy van plan verander.
en: The washing can go out before you change your mind.
bt: The washing can go out before you change your plan.

text: Natuur pronk en ons is hier daarvoor.
en: Nature's flexing and we're here for it.
bt: Nature is showing off and we're here for it.

text: Highveld winter: sonbrand en verkluiming op dieselfde dag moontlik.
en: Highveld winter: sunburn and frostbite achievable on the same day.
bt: Highveld winter: sunburn and freezing possible on the same day.

text: 'n Kleurverloop só skoon beteken nie een wolk tussen hier en môre nie.
en: A gradient that clean means not one cloud between here and tomorrow.
bt: A colour gradient this clean means not one cloud between here and tomorrow.

text: Akukho mntu uxelele isibikezelo. Sivele safika.
en: Nobody told the forecast. It just arrived.
bt: Nobody told the forecast. It simply arrived.

text: Usuku oluxubene. Asiqinisekile.
en: Mixed bag out there. We're hedging.
bt: A mixed day. We're not sure.

text: Wat ook al nie daar buite vasgemaak is nie, is reeds iemand anders se probleem.
en: Whatever is not pegged down out there is already somebody else's problem.
bt: Whatever isn't tied down out there is already someone else's problem.

text: Gras warm, lug leeg — die soort Sondag wat 'n hele gesin herlaai.
en: Grass warm, sky empty — the kind of Sunday that resets a whole family.
bt: Grass warm, air empty: the kind of Sunday that reboots a whole family.

text: Een nag se ordentlike reën en die oprit het by die watertafel aangesluit.
en: One night of proper rain and the driveway has joined the water table.
bt: One night of proper rain and the driveway has joined the water table.

text: Die wolke het 'miskien' geRSVP en in elk geval opgedaag.
en: The clouds RSVP'd 'maybe' and showed up anyway.
bt: The clouds RSVPed 'maybe' and showed up anyway.

text: Fynbos e e rata. Le uena o lokela.
en: The fynbos is loving it. You should too.
bt: Fynbos [?e e rata] it. You should too.
note: ungrammatical Fynbos e e rata; meaning readable

text: Noord-Kaapse wind huil nie. Hy leun op goed tot hulle meegee.
en: Northern Cape wind does not howl. It leans on things until they give.
bt: The Northern Cape wind doesn't cry. He leans on things until they give way.

text: Jinne, dis ordentlik warm!
en: Jislaaik, it's properly hot!
bt: Jinne, it's properly hot!

text: Winteraand-reël: die tang word gedeel, die vuurplek nie.
en: Winter night rule: the tongs get shared. The spot next to the fire doesn't.
bt: Winter evening rule: the tongs are shared, the fireplace isn't.

text: Jou lewensmaat het 'n onnodige ekstra laag geword.
en: Your partner has become an unnecessary extra layer.
bt: Your life partner has become an unnecessary extra layer.

text: Die Boland word in sy slaap natgelê en môre spog hy daaroor.
en: The Boland is getting watered in its sleep and will absolutely brag about it tomorrow.
bt: The Boland is soaked in its sleep and tomorrow brags about it.

text: Groet die stuurwiel baie versigtig.
en: Shake hands with the steering wheel very cautiously.
bt: Greet the steering wheel very carefully.

text: Iemand ry nou huis toe met die verwarmer op vol en die sitplekverwarmer as bonus.
en: Somebody's driving home right now with the heater on full and the seat warmer as a bonus.
bt: Someone is driving home right now with the heater on full and the seat heater as a bonus.

text: Iewers is daar mense wat nou gaan draf. Sterkte vir hulle.
en: Somewhere out there people are going for a run right now. Strength to them.
bt: Somewhere there are people going for a jog now. Strength to them.

text: Uena oa hosane o tla leboha ka setlolo sa letsatsi.
en: Your future self will thank you for that sunscreen.
bt: Tomorrow's you will say thanks for the [?setlolo] of the sun.

text: Schrödinger se reën. Dit is én is nie.
en: Schrodinger's rain. It both is and isn't.
bt: Schrödinger's rain. It is and isn't.

text: Lug kan nie besluit wat dit wil wees nie.
en: Sky can't make up its mind.
bt: The sky can't decide what it wants to be.

text: Die soort lug wat jou dankbaar laat voel vir gratis goed.
en: The kind of sky that makes you grateful for free things.
bt: The kind of sky that makes you feel grateful for free things.

text: Din
en: Tue
bt: [?Din]

text: Saterdag, en die lug het van oranje na blou gegaan sonder dat een wolk hom gesteur het.
en: Saturday, and the sky went from orange to blue without one cloud interrupting.
bt: Saturday, and the sky went from orange to blue without a single cloud disturbing it.

text: Ubusuku obulungileyo bokubona iNdlela yeMilky Way.
en: Perfect night to actually see the Milky Way.
bt: A good night for seeing the Milky Way.

text: Fog itye indawo.
en: The fog ate the neighbourhood.
bt: Fog [?itye] the place.
note: English Fog left in; inkungu exists

text: Nie 'n sweempie wasigheid vanoggend nie; selfs die berg het vroeg opgestaan.
en: Not a breath of haze this morning; even the mountain got up early.
bt: Not a hint of haze this morning; even the mountain got up early.

text: Teëlvloere is vanaand se skurk. Sit iets aan jou voete.
en: Tile floors are tonight's villain. Wear something on your feet.
bt: Tile floors are tonight's villain. Put something on your feet.

text: Vensters toe, ketel aan, en wag.
en: Windows closed, kettle on, and wait.
bt: Windows closed, kettle on, and wait.

text: Izinhlelo zanamuhla: hlala ngaphandle.
en: Today's plans: exist outside.
bt: Today's plans: stay outside.

text: Wolke vir die sonsondergang, sproeiers vir die wingerd. Die plaas reël sy eie reën.
en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
bt: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vineyard. The farm makes its own rain.

text: Asem soos 'n draak, uitsig soos 'n droom.
en: Breathing like a dragon, view like a dream.
bt: Breath like a dragon, view like a dream.

text: Saterdagenergie: maksimum. Verantwoordelikhede: minimum.
en: Saturday energy: maximum. Responsibilities: minimum.
bt: Saturday energy: maximum. Responsibilities: minimum.

text: Elke straatlig langs die pad skyn vir niemand nie; winternagte maak 'n dorp vroeg leeg.
en: Every streetlamp down the road is lighting nobody; winter nights empty a dorp early.
bt: Every street light along the road shines for no one; winter nights empty a town early.

text: Foon gelaai. Niemand het nog vir jou video gevra nie.
en: Phone charged. Nobody has asked for your video yet.
bt: Phone charged. Nobody has asked for your video yet.

text: Laaste foto. Dit het jy gesê voor jou vingers gevoelloos geword het.
en: Last shot. You said that before you lost feeling.
bt: Last photo. That's what you said before your fingers went numb.

text: Inkungu ayikhathalelanga ishedyuli yakho.
en: The fog doesn't care about your schedule.
bt: The fog doesn't care about your schedule.

text: Die Hooglandlug na reën behoort in 'n botteltjie verkoop te word.
en: Post-storm Highveld air should be bottled and sold overseas.
bt: Highland air after rain should be sold in a little bottle.

text: Sonnig met n spatsel wolke. SA somer in een prentjie.
en: Some clouds. Some sun. South African summer admin.
bt: Sunny with a sprinkle of clouds. SA summer in one picture.

text: Sigbaarheid het uitgeklok. Jy is op jou eie.
en: Visibility has clocked off. You're on your own.
bt: Visibility has clocked out. You're on your own.

text: iToyota idume ngemizamo yokuqala. Uyityala i-wash.
en: The Toyota started first try. You owe it a wash.
bt: The Toyota roared at the first attempts. You owe it a wash.

text: Ys in die kan, waaier op die stoel: die nagskof van 'n veertig-grade-dag.
en: Ice in the jug, fan on the chair: the night shift of a forty-degree day.
bt: Ice in the can, fan on the chair: the night shift of a forty-degree day.

text: Sondagaand, en selfs die wasgoed weier om dit te aanvaar.
en: Sunday night, and even the washing is refusing to accept it.
bt: Sunday evening, and even the washing refuses to accept it.

text: Sneeu op die berg, wasgoed op die draad: koud genoeg om te vries, droog genoeg om te probeer.
en: Snow on the berg, washing on the line: cold enough to freeze, dry enough to try.
bt: Snow on the mountain, washing on the line: cold enough to freeze, dry enough to try.

text: Letsatsi le ho airplane mode.
en: The sun's on airplane mode.
bt: The sun is in airplane mode.

text: Forelweer. Vir die vis is dit lekker. Vir die visserman is dit karakterbou.
en: Trout weather. Lovely for the fish. Character-building for the fisherman.
bt: Trout weather. For the fish it's lovely. For the fisherman it's character building.

text: Nat tussen hier en enige ander plek.
en: Wet between here and anywhere else.
bt: Wet between here and any other place.

text: Izihlangu zakho ziza kuba nosuku olubi.
en: Your shoes are about to have a bad day.
bt: Your shoes are going to have a bad day.

text: Endaweni ethile i-estate agent ithi 'lifestyle'.
en: Somewhere an estate agent is saying 'lifestyle'.
bt: Somewhere an estate agent says 'lifestyle'.

text: Mofuta oa letsatsi o etsang batho ba romele 'letsatsi le letle hey'.
en: The type of day that makes people text 'lekker dag hey'.
bt: The kind of day that makes people send 'nice day hey'.

text: Imvelo ifuna ukukhuluma. Kungcono ulalele.
en: Nature's having a word. Best to listen.
bt: Nature wants to talk. Better listen.

text: Slaaptyd nou-nou. Die hond het nog een versoek.
en: Bedtime soon. The dog has one more request.
bt: Bedtime soon. The dog has one more request.

text: Die front is weg. Die koue het net getrek, nie geloop nie.
en: The front left. The cold just moved in permanently.
bt: The front is gone. The cold has only settled in, not walked off.

text: Plaveisel nat, wolke laag, vuur brand in elk geval — hierdie braai het al erger oorleef.
en: Paving wet, clouds low, fire going anyway — this braai has been through worse.
bt: Pavement wet, clouds low, fire burning anyway: this braai has survived worse.

text: Ingqondo ifikile yaye ize nabahlobo bayo.
en: The cold front is here and it brought friends.
bt: The mind has arrived and has come with its friends.

text: Isichotho
en: Hail
bt: Hail

text: Alles verby die straatlig is 'n gerug tot omtrent nege-uur.
en: Everything past the streetlight is a rumour until about nine.
bt: Everything past the street light is a rumour until about nine o'clock.

text: Die son is op, die straat is leeg, en die wind was eerste hier.
en: The sun is up, the street is empty, and the wind got here first.
bt: The sun is up, the street is empty, and the wind got here first.

text: So 'n skoon naglug is pragtig, en jy betaal daarvoor in grade.
en: A sky this clean at night is beautiful, and it charges in degrees.
bt: A clear night sky like this is beautiful, and you pay for it in degrees.

text: Vyf minute nog. Oukei tien. Oukei tot die son op die bed val.
en: Five more minutes. Okay ten. Okay until the sun reaches the bed.
bt: Five more minutes. Okay ten. Okay until the sun falls on the bed.

text: Matla a Moqebelo: a hodimo. Boikarabelo: bo tlase.
en: Saturday energy: maximum. Responsibilities: minimum.
bt: Saturday energy: high. Responsibility: low.

text: Hlala unamanzi noma ube yi-biltong.
en: Stay hydrated or become a biltong.
bt: Stay with water even if you are biltong.

text: Ho fanyeha liaparo ho ntse ho bolokehile. Mohlomong
en: Washing's still safe. Probably.
bt: Hanging out clothes is still safe. Maybe

text: Isiphepho semathubeni, asikaqinisekiswa. Hlala uqaphile.
en: Storm on the cards, not yet confirmed. Stay sharp.
bt: The [?whirlwind/storm] of the [?semathubeni] has not yet been confirmed. Stay alert.

text: Die mis het die berg opgedrink.
en: The fog drank the mountain.
bt: The mist drank up the mountain.

text: Letsatsi le hlaha le nyamela.
en: Sky's doing the most, but only a little.
bt: The sun appears and disappears.

text: Bonke abanepuli basanda kuba nesithunzi kakhulu.
en: Everyone with a pool just became very popular.
bt: Everyone who has a [?puli/pool] has just got a lot of shade.

text: Izihlalo zemoto ziyabanda. Yonke into iyabanda.
en: The car seats are freezing. Everything is freezing.
bt: The car seats are cold. Everything is cold.

text: Re se re le tseleng ea sefefo sa Highveld… kapa mohlomong che
en: Halfway to a Highveld thunderstorm. Or not.
bt: We are on the path of the Highveld storm... or maybe not

text: Koffie in die een hand, tuinslang in die ander, en die hele dag lê nog voor.
en: Coffee in one hand, hose in the other, and the whole day still ahead.
bt: Coffee in one hand, garden hose in the other, and the whole day still ahead.

text: Een verligte venster vat die hele mis aan, en verloor pragtig.
en: One lit window is taking on the whole fog, and losing beautifully.
bt: One lit window takes on the whole fog, and loses beautifully.

text: Imvelo yenzaukucisha kwayo.
en: Nature's doing its own load shedding.
bt: Nature does its own extinguishing/switching-off (words run together: [?yenzaukucisha]).

text: Die son gaan nou huis toe. Vat sy laaste drie grade saam.
en: The sun is heading home now, taking the last three degrees with it.
bt: The sun is going home now. Taking its last three degrees with it.

text: Kunesithwathwa otshanini. Kunesithwathwa ku-bakkie. Kunesithwathwa esitsheni sesilwane.
en: Frost on the lawn. Frost on the bakkie. Frost in the pet bowl.
bt: There is [?isithwathwa] on the grass. There is [?isithwathwa] on the bakkie. There is [?isithwathwa] in the animal's container.

text: Die hele stad is onder een grys kombers, en iemand het dit pas agtergekom.
en: The whole city is under one grey blanket and somebody just noticed.
bt: The whole city is under one grey blanket, and someone has only just noticed.

text: Maru a tšosa empa mohlomong a a qhella.
en: The clouds are threatening but probably bluffing.
bt: The clouds are threatening but perhaps they won't [?qhella].

text: Imoto yakho ikhona ngaphandle. Endaweni ethile. Cishe.
en: Your car is out there. Somewhere. Probably.
bt: Your car is outside. Somewhere. Probably.

text: Vroeg op. Nie heeltemal uit vrye keuse nie.
en: Up early. Not quite by choice.
bt: Up early. Not entirely by free choice.

text: Mooiste tyd van die dag. Kortste ook. Hardloop.
en: Prettiest moment of the day. Also the shortest. Run.
bt: Best time of day. Shortest too. Run.

text: 'n Lug soos daardie hou die warmte in — die ryp is vanaand van diens onthef.
en: A sky like that keeps the heat in — the frost can stand down tonight.
bt: A sky like that holds in the warmth: the frost is relieved of duty tonight.

text: Izingubo zisaphephile. Cishe.
en: Washing's still safe. Probably.
bt: The clothes are still safe. Probably.

text: Son op jou rug, vrieskas op jou gesig.
en: Sun on your back, freezer on your face.
bt: Sun on your back, freezer on your face.

text: Die mis is dik genoeg om 'n straal kombuislig soos 'n vaste ding vas te hou.
en: The fog is thick enough to hold a beam of kitchen light like a solid object.
bt: The fog is thick enough to hold a beam of kitchen light like a solid thing.

text: Die maste hou vanaand 'n konsert. Geen kaartjies nodig nie.
en: The masts are holding a concert tonight. No tickets required.
bt: The masts are holding a concert tonight. No tickets needed.

text: Phakisha isambreli. Okanye ungaphakishi. Asazi nathi.
en: Pack an umbrella. Or don't. We don't know either.
bt: Hurry up with the umbrella. Or don't hurry. We don't know either.

text: Letsetsa metsoalle. Fumana nama. Re tsamaee.
en: Call the mates. Get the meat. Let's go.
bt: [?Letsetsa] friends. Find meat. Let's go.

text: Die son kom deur die mis teen halwe krag en vol goud.
en: The sun is coming through the fog at half strength and full gold.
bt: The sun comes through the fog at half power and full gold.

text: Selfs die hond het die voorspelling gecheck en teruggegaan bed toe.
en: Even the dog checked the forecast and went straight back to bed.
bt: Even the dog checked the forecast and went back to bed.

text: Iindudumo ezikufutshaneiindonga zachachamba. Intlonipho.
en: Thunder so close the walls shook. Respect.
bt: The [?thunder rumbles] close to the walls [?splashed about] (words run together). Respect.

text: Ayomozulu yo shorty lena. Yimozulu yempahla yangapohantsi.
en: Shorts weather? This is underwear weather.
bt: This is [?shorty] weather. It is weather of clothes of [?yangapohantsi].

text: Die kar se verwarmer is die belangrikste verhouding in jou lewe op die oomblik.
en: The car's heater is the most important relationship in your life right now.
bt: The car's heater is the most important relationship in your life right now.

text: Haeba o ka hare, o etsa phoso.
en: If you're inside, you're doing it wrong.
bt: If you are in the middle, you make a mistake.

text: Het jy 'n tweede paar sokkies vir jouself ingepak?
en: Did you pack a second pair of socks for yourself?
bt: Did you pack a second pair of socks for yourself?

text: Ke kahoo Noa a ileng a haha sekepe.
en: This is why Noah built a boat.
bt: That is why Noah built a boat.

text: Selfs Tafelberg het dit 'n dag genoem.
en: Even Table Mountain's called it a day.
bt: Even Table Mountain called it a day.

text: Imozulu ye-postcard. Wamkelekile.
en: Postcard weather. You're welcome.
bt: Postcard weather. You're welcome.

text: Die berg het sy tafeldoek op en die palm hou die houding.
en: The mountain has its cloth on and the palm is holding the pose.
bt: The mountain has its tablecloth on and the palm holds its posture.

text: Die suidooster het die een oop venster in die hele straat gekry.
en: The south-easter has found the one open window on the whole street.
bt: The south-easter found the one open window in the whole street.

text: Dit is nie meer 'n drankie nie. Dit is 'n strategie.
en: This is no longer a beverage. It's a strategy.
bt: It's no longer a drink. It's a strategy.

text: Sneeu in die maanlig — mooi op die berg, verskriklik in die lug.
en: Snow in the moonlight: beautiful on the mountain, brutal in the air.
bt: Snow in the moonlight: beautiful on the mountain, terrible in the air.

text: Die pad is leeg, elke lig is aan, en die wind het die plek vir homself.
en: The road is empty, every light is on, and the wind has the place to itself.
bt: The road is empty, every light is on, and the wind has the place to itself.

text: Binne is dit ook koud. Hou jou baadjie aan.
en: Cold indoors too. Keep your jacket on.
bt: It's cold inside too. Keep your jacket on.

text: Reën? Moontlik. Sal ek my lewe daar op wed? Nooit.
en: Rain? Possibly. Commitment? Never.
bt: Rain? Possible. Would I bet my life on it? Never.

text: Isibhakabhaka siyayila, asizibopheleli.
en: Sky's drafting, not committing.
bt: The sky is [?forbidding/creating], it does not wrap itself up.

text: Absoluut pragtig daar buite.
en: Absolutely beautiful out there.
bt: Absolutely beautiful out there.

text: Gaste om sesuur. Hersien liewer wat jy hulle belowe het.
en: Guests at six. Best revise what you promised them.
bt: Guests at six o'clock. Better review what you promised them.

text: Die bure bestaan. Glo so. Kan nie bevestig nie.
en: The neighbours exist. Apparently. Can't confirm.
bt: The neighbours exist. Believe so. Can't confirm.

text: Daardie vloer se politoer was nooit vir soveel water bedoel nie.
en: The polish on that floor was not designed with this much water in mind.
bt: That floor's polish was never meant for this much water.

text: Gaste op pad. Niemand het belowe om die oond te gebruik nie.
en: Guests expected. Nobody promised to use the oven.
bt: Guests on the way. Nobody promised to use the oven.

text: Warm genoeg om die venster oop te los. Dapper genoeg?
en: Warm enough to leave the window open. Brave enough?
bt: Warm enough to leave the window open. Brave enough?

text: Faka i-sunscreen, kodwa gcina ihoodie kufutshane.
en: Sunscreen, but keep a hoodie close.
bt: Put on sunscreen, but keep the hoodie close by.

text: Elkeen van daardie parkeerplekke was iemand se plan vir vanaand.
en: Every one of those parking bays was somebody's plan for tonight.
bt: Every one of those parking spots was someone's plan for tonight.

text: Een laaste stop. Maak dit die winkel met 'n dak.
en: One last stop. Make it the shop with a roof.
bt: One last stop. Make it the shop with a roof.

text: Isabiwezimali sesivikelo selanga: siphezulu kunebhili yakho yedatha.
en: Sunscreen budget: higher than your data bill.
bt: The sun-protection budget: higher than your data bill.

text: I-CV yesibhakabhaka isanda kubuyekezwa.
en: The sky's CV just got updated.
bt: The sky's CV has just been updated.

text: Skuif nader. Niemand vra jou om iemand te vergewe nie.
en: Move closer. Nobody's asking you to forgive anyone.
bt: Move closer. Nobody is asking you to forgive anyone.

text: Die lug het toegemaak. Die aand nie.
en: The sky closed. The evening didn’t.
bt: The sky has closed. The evening hasn't.

text: Ryp op die draad, son in die oe, gevoel in nul vingers.
en: Frost on the fence, sun in your eyes, feeling in zero fingers.
bt: Frost on the wire, sun in the eye, feeling in zero fingers.

text: Daardie enjinkap is warmer as wat die meeste panne ooit op die meeste stowe word.
en: That bonnet is hotter than most pans ever get on most stoves.
bt: That bonnet is hotter than most pans ever get on most stoves.

text: Iemand gaan vir 'n week blare uit daardie agtersitplek uithaal.
en: Somebody will be picking leaves out of that back seat for a week.
bt: Someone is going to pick leaves out of that back seat for a week.

text: Selfs jou GPS is verward.
en: Even your GPS is confused.
bt: Even your GPS is confused.

text: Die lug het homself vir die nag afgeskakel; die bakkie stem nie saam nie.
en: The sky has switched itself off for the night; the bakkie disagrees.
bt: The sky has switched itself off for the night; the bakkie disagrees.

text: Ubusika obuhle bokubona iNdlela yoSisi.
en: Perfect night to actually see the Milky Way.
bt: A good winter for seeing the [?Way of the Sister (Milky Way)].

text: Kan ons die plan bespreek met minder buitegoed daarin?
en: Could we discuss the plan with fewer outdoor bits?
bt: Can we discuss the plan with less outdoor stuff in it?

text: Die lug is op mute. Niemand kla nie.
en: The sky's on mute. Nobody's complaining.
bt: The sky is on mute. Nobody complains.

text: Amabhomu eqhwa amancane ayawa. Phakathi yiyo kuphela inhlelo.
en: Tiny ice bombs falling. Indoors is the only plan.
bt: Small ice bombs are falling. Inside is the only plan.

text: uv. e hodimu  thata
en: UV's hectic.
bt: UV. is very high

text: Ilanga lisekhefu letiye. Akukho ETA.
en: The sun's on a tea break. No ETA.
bt: The sun is on a tea break. No ETA.

text: Daardie oë is nie toe oor die son nie.
en: Those eyes are not closed because of the sun.
bt: Those eyes aren't closed because of the sun.

text: Kubukeka kufudumele. Ukuthi kufudumele kangakanani kuyaguquka.
en: Looks warm. How warm is a moving target.
bt: It looks warm. How warm it is keeps changing.

text: Stadig ry is nie 'n voorstel nie.
en: Driving slow is not a suggestion.
bt: Driving slowly is not a suggestion.

text: Vandag se son het opgedaag met attitude.
en: The sun woke up and chose glorious.
bt: Today's sun showed up with attitude.

text: rather use Boemo ba UV bo phahameng
en: High UV
bt: [rather use] UV level is high

text: Daardie sproeier is die hele somer die beste waarde in hierdie tuin.
en: That sprinkler has been the best-value thing in this garden all summer.
bt: That sprinkler has been the best value in this garden all summer.

text: Afrika pronk weer. Dit mag maar.
en: Africa showing off again. Quietly devastating.
bt: Africa is showing off again. It's allowed to.

text: Highveld-mis: skaars genoeg dat almal dit afneem.
en: Highveld fog: rare enough that everyone's photographing it.
bt: Highveld mist: rare enough that everyone photographs it.

text: Ukuhamba kuwo kuziva njengokulwa ne-boss yomdlalo wevidiyo.
en: Walking into it feels like a video game boss fight.
bt: Walking in it feels like fighting a video game boss.

text: Die mis het ingerol, en die strandwag het amptelik die see verloor.
en: Fog's rolled in, and the lifeguard has officially lost the sea.
bt: The fog rolled in, and the lifeguard has officially lost the sea.

text: Sun alibonakali namhlanje.
en: The sun's bunking today.
bt: The sun is not visible today.
note: English Sun left in; ilanga exists

text: Opstaan. Die sokkies gaan nie hulself kry nie.
en: Up you get. The socks won't find themselves.
bt: Get up. The socks won't fetch themselves.

text: Kaapstad is nog aan daaronder; die mis staan net in die pad.
en: Cape Town is still on under there; the fog is just running interference.
bt: Cape Town is still under there; the fog is just in the way.

text: Skoon nag, nat trappe, sigbare asem: die ryp voltooi sy papierwerk.
en: Clear night, wet steps, visible breath: the frost is filling in its paperwork.
bt: Clear night, wet steps, visible breath: the frost completes its paperwork.

text: Hy het elfuur vanoggend ingeklim en dis al die tweede keer dat dit volgemaak is.
en: He got in at eleven this morning and this is the second filling.
bt: He got in at eleven this morning and it's already the second time it's been filled up.

text: Iambrela yophuke nje kwakuvuthuza wind wokuqala. Okwesiqhelo.
en: The umbrella broke on the first gust. Classic.
bt: The umbrella broke at the first gust of wind. As usual.

text: Amper by die huis, het jy gesê, met indrukwekkende selfvertroue.
en: Nearly home, you said, with impressive confidence.
bt: Almost home, you said, with impressive confidence.

text: Een wolk oor die berg is nie weer nie. Die vuur bly aan.
en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
bt: One cloud over the mountain is not weather. The fire stays on.

text: Lesela la Table mountain le aparetse thaba.
en: Table Mountain's tablecloth is out.
bt: The tablecloth (cloth) of Table Mountain has clothed the mountain.

text: Plattelandse wit-geraas: een windpomp, geen af-knoppie.
en: Karoo white noise: one windpump, no off switch.
bt: Rural white noise: one windmill, no off button.

text: Twintig minute se opera, dan maak die seun of niks gebeur het nie.
en: Twenty minutes of opera, then the sun acts like nothing happened.
bt: Twenty minutes of opera, then the boy acts as if nothing happened.

text: Kalm nag, heel waarskynlik. Die lug hou voor om te verander.
en: Calm night, most likely. The sky reserves the right to change.
bt: Calm night, most likely. The sky pretends to change.

text: Niemand se hare gaan dit oorleef nie, en niemand loop nog nie.
en: Nobody's hair is going to survive, and nobody is leaving yet.
bt: Nobody's hair will survive this, and nobody is walking yet.

text: Die avond kom binne op sokkies.
en: The evening is tiptoeing in on socks.
bt: The evening comes in on socks.

text: Slaaptyd nou-nou. Die huis het nog 'n paar laaste opmerkings.
en: Bedtime soon. The house has some final remarks.
bt: Bedtime soon. The house has a few last remarks.

text: Daardie water staan die hele dag in die son en dit is nie koud nie.
en: That water has been sitting in the sun all day and it is not cold.
bt: That water stands in the sun all day and it isn't cold.

text: Ons eise is beskeie. Droë sokkies en tone wat nog voel.
en: Our demands are modest. Dry socks and feeling toes.
bt: Our demands are modest. Dry socks and toes that can still feel.

text: Klaar aangetrek. Wag nog vir die dag om te verskyn.
en: All dressed up. Still waiting for the day to appear.
bt: Already dressed. Still waiting for the day to show up.

text: Kufukufuku kancinci
en: Partly cloudy
bt: A little [?kufukufuku]

text: Welkom-koud vandag. Die soort wat deur drie truie gaan asof hulle nie daar is nie.
en: Welkom-cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
bt: Welkom-cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys as if they aren't there.

text: Die hond dra 'n trui, en dis al die voorspelling wat enigiemand hier nodig het.
en: The dog is wearing a jersey, which is all the forecast anybody here needs.
bt: The dog is wearing a jersey, and that's all the forecast anyone here needs.

text: Die agterkant van jou nek. Jy het dit vergeet.
en: The back of your neck. You forgot that bit.
bt: The back of your neck. You forgot it.

text: Die klippe gaan vannag nog die dag se hitte uitdeel. Verniet.
en: The rocks will be handing out today's heat all night. Free of charge.
bt: The stones will hand out the day's heat tonight. For free.

text: lifofane
en: gusts
bt: aeroplane

text: Die uile oordeel jou skermtyd.
en: The owls are judging your screen time.
bt: The owls judge your screen time.

text: Lieta tsa hao li tla ba le letsatsi le lebe.
en: Your shoes are about to have a bad day.
bt: Your shoes are going to have a bad day.

text: Le letle ka 'nete. Se ke oa le senya.
en: A proper good one. Don't waste it.
bt: It's truly beautiful too. Don't spoil it.

text: Dis so koud, die braai is nou 'n baie duur verwarmer.
en: It's so cold the braai has become a very expensive heater.
bt: It's so cold, the braai is now a very expensive heater.

text: Helderberg e iponahatsa kajeno.
en: The Helderberg is showing off today.
bt: The Helderberg shows itself today.

text: Iikati zabamelwane zithathile.
en: The neighbourhood cats have taken over.
bt: The neighbours' cats have taken over.

text: Jou huisbaas gaan nou-nou weer van jou hoor.
en: Your landlord is about to hear from you again.
bt: Your landlord is going to hear from you again soon.

text: O hopola bethe ea hao mme o tsoile metsotso e leshome le metso e 'meli.
en: You miss your bed and you've been gone twelve minutes.
bt: You remember your [?bethe] and you woke up twelve minutes ago.

text: Cishe imvula. Thatha isambulela.
en: Probably rain. Take the umbrella, settle the argument.
bt: Probably rain. Take an umbrella.

text: Die gras is nat, die lug is koud, en die trui was nie opsioneel nie.
en: The grass is wet, the air is cold, and the jersey was not optional.
bt: The grass is wet, the air is cold, and the jersey was not optional.

text: Ngaphandle kukukhaphele futhi noma kunjalo uhambile.
en: Outside has betrayed you and you went anyway.
bt: Outside [?kukukhaphele] and anyway you have left.

text: Dit is die middel van die sterrestelsel, en dit kom op agter 'n koppie.
en: That is the centre of the galaxy and it is coming up behind a koppie.
bt: This is the middle of the galaxy, and it's rising behind a hill.

text: Die Toyota het met die eerste try gevat. Jy skuld hom 'n was.
en: The Toyota started first try. You owe it a wash.
bt: The Toyota started on the first try. You owe it a wash.

text: Die tuin is iewers daar buite. Ons vertrou die proses.
en: The garden is somewhere out there. We trust the process.
bt: The garden is out there somewhere. We trust the process.

text: Highveld winter: ke moo o aparang dijakete tse pedi ho lata post.
en: Highveld winter: the only place where you wear two jackets to fetch the post.
bt: Highveld winter: that's where you wear two jackets to fetch the post.

text: Die wasgoed is droog voor eerste pouse. Die bries het vroeg begin werk.
en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.
bt: The washing is dry before first break. The breeze started working early.

text: Niemand in hierdie dorp het sedert omtrent die tweede week van Desember 'n stoof nodig gehad nie.
en: Nobody in this dorp has needed a stove since about the second week of December.
bt: Nobody in this town has needed a stove since about the second week of December.

text: Hou jou hoed. Hou jou kind. Hou net vas.
en: Hold your hat. Hold your kid. Just hold on.
bt: Hold your hat. Hold your child. Just hold on.

text: Die verkeer het pas onthou daar is n ding soos reën bestaan weer.
en: The traffic just remembered rain exists. Again.
bt: Traffic has just remembered there is a thing such as rain exists again.

text: I-Afrika iyaziqhayisa futhi. Ngokuzolileyo ngokumangalisayo.
en: Africa showing off again. Quietly devastating.
bt: Africa is showing off again. Quietly amazingly.

text: Gereed om te ry. Jou kar wil 'n woordjie hê.
en: Ready to leave. Your car would like a word.
bt: Ready to drive. Your car wants a word.

text: Die lug het voluit bedonnerd gegaan.
en: The sky just went full Carte Blanche.
bt: The sky has gone completely bonkers.

text: Leeto le fetohile papali ea sehlopha.
en: The commute just became a team sport.
bt: The journey has become a team game.

text: Indalo iyathetha, kungconoukuphulaphula
en: Nature's having a word. Best to listen.
bt: Nature speaks, better to listen (words run together).

text: Vrydag, en teen twaalfuur gaan daardie plaveisel te warm wees om op te staan.
en: Friday, and by noon that paving is going to be too hot to stand on.
bt: Friday, and by twelve o'clock that pavement will be too hot to stand on.

text: Mohlomong letsatsi le chesang. Katiba hase mohopolo o mobe.
en: Probably a scorcher. A hat's not a bad idea.
bt: Perhaps a hot day. [?Katiba] it's not a bad thought.

text: Izibane zesitalato zizama ngako konke ezinako.
en: The streetlights are trying their best.
bt: The street lights are trying with all they can.

text: Welkom, Sasolburg, Kroonstad: koue belt e etsa koue thing ya yona.
en: Welkom, Sasolburg, Kroonstad: the koue belt is doing its koue thing.
bt: Welkom, Sasolburg, Kroonstad: the cold belt does its own cold thing.

text: Dit is die lug se prestasie-oorsig. Hy het geslaag.
en: This is the sky's performance review. It passed.
bt: This is the sky's performance review. It passed.

text: Kaggelweer het opgedaag sonder om eers te vra.
en: Fireplace weather showed up without even asking.
bt: Fireplace weather showed up without even asking.

text: Mhlawumbi sicacile isibhakabhaka. Ifestile yakho inegunya lokugqibela.
en: Probably clear. Your window's the final say.
bt: Maybe the sky is hidden. Your window has the final authority.
note: hidden vs clear; sicacile may mean clear

text: Die lug herinner wij wie die baas is.
en: The sky's reminding us who's boss.
bt: The sky reminds [?wij] who the boss is.

text: Daardie baadjie probeer wegkom vandat hy op die fiets geklim het.
en: That jacket has been trying to leave since he got on the bike.
bt: That jacket has been trying to get away since it got on the bike.

text: Daardie kan is al twee keer weer volgemaak, en dis nog nie eers behoorlik donker nie.
en: That jug has been refilled twice and it is not even properly dark yet.
bt: That can has already been refilled twice, and it's not even properly dark yet.

text: Hy het sesuur ingeklim en is nie van plan om uit te klim nie.
en: He got in at six and he is not planning to get out.
bt: He got in at six and has no plans to get out.

text: Mohodi o ka kena. Sheba thaba.
en: Fog might be rolling in. Keep an eye on the mountain.
bt: [?Mohodi] may enter. Look at the mountain.

text: Isimo sezulu sakusasa sinkinga yakusasa.
en: Tomorrow's weather is tomorrow's problem.
bt: Tomorrow's weather is tomorrow's problem.

text: Iemand ry nou soontoe 'om te gaan kyk'. Hulle gaan in die verkeer sit.
en: Someone is driving up there 'just to look'. They are going to sit in traffic.
bt: Someone is driving there now 'to go and look'. They're going to sit in the traffic.

text: Akekho ozibhalisele leli zinga lokushisa.
en: Nobody signed up for this temperature.
bt: Nobody has signed up for this temperature.

text: Kufudumele ngokwaneleyo ukuvula ifestile. Unesibindi?
en: Warm enough to leave the window open. Brave enough?
bt: It is warm enough to open the window. Are you brave?

text: Lekker koud, kodwa ama-rugby fields azobukeka e-perfect manje.
en: Lekker koud, but the rugby fields are about to look perfect.
bt: Lekker cold, but the rugby fields will look perfect now.

text: Vrydag, en dit is die enigste bewegende lug vir omtrent sestig kilometer.
en: Friday, and that is the only moving air for about sixty kilometres.
bt: Friday, and it is the only moving air for about sixty kilometres.

text: Aantrek voel soos om 'n laag uit te trek.
en: Getting dressed feels like taking a layer off.
bt: Putting on [layers] feels like taking a layer off.

text: Akukho nto ibonwayo apha. Ngenene.
en: Nothing to see here. Literally.
bt: Nothing can be seen here. Truly.

text: Die son het 'n out-of-office gestuur.
en: The sun sent an out-of-office reply.
bt: The sun has sent an out-of-office.

text: Die huis het skielik jou gunsteling-plek geword.
en: Home has suddenly become your favourite venue.
bt: The house has suddenly become your favourite place.

text: Uhlobo lwesibhakabhaka olwenza ubulele izinto zasimahla.
en: The kind of sky that makes you grateful for free things.
bt: The kind of sky that makes you [?kill] free things.
note: 'kill free things' instead of grateful for free things

text: Karoo-oggend. Die soort wat jou laat respek he vir elke boer wat dit gekies het.
en: Karoo morning. The kind that makes you respect every farmer who chose this.
bt: Karoo morning. The kind that makes you respect every farmer who chose it.

text: Uhambo lusanda kuba ngumdlalo weqela.
en: The commute just became a team sport.
bt: The trip has just become a team game.

text: Di-fleece tse peli bonyane kajeno.
en: Two-fleece minimum today.
bt: At least two fleeces today.

text: Halfmaan, halfwolk, vol drom. Dinsdagaand, soos geadverteer.
en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.
bt: Half moon, half cloud, full [?drum]. Tuesday evening, as advertised.

text: Mohlomong maholimo a khutsitseng. Re na le bonnete mohlomong.
en: Probably quiet skies. We're fairly sure.
bt: Perhaps quiet skies. We are certain, perhaps.

text: Lyk rustig daar buite. Min of meer.
en: Looks settled out there. Roughly.
bt: Looks calm out there. More or less.

text: Goud maar helder
en: Cold but clear
bt: Gold but clear.

text: Isibhakabhaka sivele saba yi-Carte Blanche ngokupheleleyo.
en: The sky just went full Carte Blanche.
bt: The sky has suddenly become completely Carte Blanche.

text: Ponelopele ea kajeno: medium rare.
en: Today's forecast: medium rare.
bt: Today's forecast: medium rare.

text: Yoh, hlala ngaphakathi!
en: Jislaaik, stay inside!
bt: Yoh, stay inside!

text: Esita le sebaka sa liphakinki se bonahala se setle kajeno.
en: Even the parking lot looks pretty today.
bt: Even the [?liphakinki] area looks nice today.

text: Dit is hier buite om middernag koeler as wat dit sesuur binne was.
en: It is cooler out here at midnight than it was inside at six.
bt: It is cooler out here at midnight than it was inside at six o'clock.

text: Ukubanda yikho esikubhejayo. Ungathembi iwindi elinelanga ebusika.
en: Cold's the bet. Don't trust a sunny window in winter.
bt: The cold is what we are [?braaiing]. Don't trust a window with sun in winter.

text: Bonke sebakhohlwe ukushayela. Futhi.
en: Everyone's forgotten how to drive. Again.
bt: Everyone has forgotten how to drive. Again.

text: Izulu licwebile.
en: Clear skies.
bt: The weather is [?clear/bright].

text: Briesig, waarskynlik. Dalk meer.
en: Breezy, probably. Maybe more.
bt: Breezy, probably. Maybe more.

text: Heater ke motsoalle oa hao e moholo. E le mong.
en: The heater is your best friend. Your only friend.
bt: A heater is your great friend. The only one.

text: Sy leun skuinser as wat 'n plat paadjie ooit behoort te vra.
en: She is leaning at an angle that a flat path does not normally require.

en: Cold but clear

bt: Everyone awake. Nobody admits they got a fright.

bt: The lightning put on a good show.

bt: Hair plans: cancelled.

bt: You left early. The windscreen thought otherwise.

bt: Rain at sunrise, and the swim team does not mind. Wet is wet.

bt: Ponytail elastics doing overtime.

bt: The sun takes its time this morning, and it shows.

bt: Is your hairstyle gone? Accept it.

text: Daar's die eerste hadeda op, en nou gaan die hele vallei dit weet.
en: That is the first hadeda up and the entire valley is about to know.
bt: There is the first hadeda up, and now the whole valley will know.

text: Ilanga lidlala ucashisa.
en: Sun, hide-and-seek champion of the day.
bt: The sun is playing hide-and-seek.

text: Die wolke het twee vingers plek gelos, en die sonsondergang het dit gevat.
en: The sky left a two-finger gap for the sunset and the sunset took it.
bt: The clouds left two fingers of room, and the sunset took it.

text: Ii-fleece ezimbini ubuncinane namhlanje.
en: Two-fleece minimum today.
bt: Two fleeces minimum today.

text: Tlhaho e sa tsoa re hopotsa gore na ke mang ea pele.
en: Nature just reminded us of the pecking order.
bt: Nature has just reminded us who comes first.

text: Ka morao ha molala oa hao. O lebetse moo.
en: The back of your neck. You forgot that bit.
bt: On the back of your neck. You forgot there.

text: Almal het vergeet hoe om te bestuur. Weer.
en: Everyone's forgotten how to drive. Again.
bt: Everyone has forgotten how to drive. Again.

text: Umphefumulo wakho wenza i-special effects.
en: Your breath is doing special effects.
bt: Your soul makes special effects.

text: AC e kopa mohau.
en: The AC is begging for mercy.
bt: The AC begs for mercy.

text: Maru a potolohile. Hore na a makae ke ngangisano.
en: Cloud's around. How much is up for debate.
bt: The clouds have gone round. Whether they are many is a [?dispute].

text: Ho na le maru hanyane
en: Partly cloudy
bt: There are a few clouds.

text: Radio sagter. Jou oë het glo die hulp nodig.
en: Radio down. Apparently your eyes need the help.
bt: Radio softer. Your eyes apparently need the help.

text: Nat pad, grys lug, hond in 'n trui: winter is ten volle in werking.
en: Wet road, grey sky, dog in a jersey: winter is fully operational.
bt: Wet road, grey sky, dog in a jersey: winter is fully under way.

text: Sun liyabaleka namuhla.
en: The sun's bunking today.
bt: The sun is running away today.

text: Ntja e ka tlas'a bethe. Mohato o bohlale, ka nnete.
en: The dog's under the bed. Smart move, honestly.
bt: The dog is under the bed. A wise step, truly.

text: Die trui is êrens tussen die deur en die hek tot balaclava bevorder.
en: The jersey got promoted to balaclava somewhere between the door and the gate.
bt: The jersey was promoted to balaclava somewhere between the door and the gate.

text: Hoëveld-winter: die wasgoed is droog voor die ketel kook.
en: Highveld winter flex: laundry dry before the kettle's even done.
bt: Highveld winter: the washing is dry before the kettle boils.

text: Lehodimo le a duma. Lula haufi le marulelo.
en: Sky's grumbling. Stay close to a roof.
bt: The sky is thundering. Sit near the roof.

text: Kubanda, kodwamhle umhla.
en: Cold but stunning.
bt: It is cold, but the day is beautiful.

text: Twee waaiers, vier papiere wat vlieg, en nie een dokument is vandag gelees nie.
en: Two fans, four papers flying, and not one document has been read today.
bt: Two fans, four flying papers, and not one document was read today.

text: Daardie gordyn hang nou al omtrent 'n uur buite die venster.
en: That curtain has been outside the window for about an hour now.
bt: That curtain has been hanging outside the window for about an hour now.

text: Imimoya enamandla
en: Gusty winds
bt: Strong winds.

text: Cishe ihlobo lase-South Africa.
en: Some clouds. Some sun. South African summer admin.
bt: Almost a South African summer.
note: drops some clouds some sun, admin joke

text: EBloemfontein ngo-6 ekuseni: i-jersey, i-gown, i-scarf, ama-takkies, nobuso obunesibindi.
en: Bloemfontein at 6am: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, and a brave face.
bt: In Bloemfontein at 6 in the morning: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, and a brave face.

text: Dit is nader as wat jy met spanbou bedoel het.
en: This is closer than you meant by team building.
bt: It is closer than you meant with team building.

text: Mooi aand, as jy van mure hou.
en: Pretty evening, if you like walls.
bt: Lovely evening, if you like walls.

text: Niemand gaan vandaag betyds wees nie.
en: Nobody is being on time today.
bt: Nobody is going to be on time today.

text: Mohlomong sebakeng se seng tšokolate e sa tsoa qhibiliha.
en: Somewhere a chocolate bar just died.
bt: Perhaps in some place a chocolate has just melted.

text: Golden hour, yskoue lug. Kaapstad hou van drama.
en: Golden hour, ice-cold air. Cape Town loves a dramatic contrast.
bt: Golden hour, ice-cold air. Cape Town likes drama.

text: Iemand het reën vir die nag en son vir die oggend bestel, en dit is afgelewer.
en: Somebody ordered rain for the night and sun for the morning, and it was delivered.
bt: Someone ordered rain for the night and sun for the morning, and it was delivered.

text: Umnyama ngaphandle, ukukhanya kusasa.
en: Dark outside, bright tomorrow.
bt: Dark outside, light tomorrow.

text: Niemand hier wonder of dit werk nie. Hulle kyk hoe dit werk.
en: Nobody here is wondering whether it works. They are watching it work.
bt: Nobody here wonders whether it works. They watch how it works.

text: Heater ya koloi ke yona relationship ya bohlokwa ka ho fetisisa bophelong ba hao hona jwale.
en: The car's heater is the most important relationship in your life right now.
bt: The car heater is the most important relationship in your life right now.

text: Fridge e ikutloa e futhumetse ho feta lounge kajeno.
en: The fridge feels warmer than the lounge today.
bt: The fridge feels warmer than the lounge today.

text: Die son is 'n uur gelede weg en die plaveisel gee dit steeds terug.
en: The sun went down an hour ago and the paving is still giving it back.
bt: The sun left an hour ago and the pavement still gives it back.

text: Maru le letsatsi - bobeli mona.
en: Some clouds. Some sun. South African summer admin.
bt: Clouds and sun - both here.

text: Mus plus poffer plus skooldas: die kouefront het die skooldrag bereik.
en: Beanie plus puffer plus school tie: the cold front has reached the uniform.
bt: Beanie plus puffer plus school tie: the cold front has reached the school uniform.

text: Tee smaak beter as jou sokkies nie betrokke is nie.
en: Tea tastes better when your socks aren't involved.
bt: Tea tastes better when your socks are not involved.

text: Irhafu yesambreli isebenzayo ngoku.
en: The umbrella tax is now in effect.
bt: The umbrella tax is in effect now.

text: Isibhakabhaka sisikhumbuza ukuthi ubani ongumphathi.
en: The sky's reminding us who's boss.
bt: The sky reminds us who is in charge.

text: Die foon ken die roete; die mis toets hoeveel hy dit vertrou.
en: The phone knows the route; the fog is testing how much he trusts it.
bt: The phone knows the route; the fog tests how much it trusts it.

text: Yoh, kushushu ngempela!
en: Jislaaik, it's properly hot!
bt: Yoh, it is really hot!

text: Ifynbos iyakuthanda. Nawe kufanele.
en: The fynbos is loving it. You should too.
bt: The fynbos loves you. You should too.

text: Ngisho ne-geyser isebenza amahora engeziwe.
en: Even the geyser is putting in extra hours.
bt: Even the geyser is working extra hours.

text: Afskop nou-nou. Die ander kant van die veld vind kom eerste.
en: Kick-off soon. Finding the other end comes first.
bt: Kick-off soon. Finding the other side of the field comes first.

text: Jy kan hierdie sit in die kar 'me time' noem.
en: You can call this sitting in the car some me time.
bt: You can call this sitting in the car 'me time'.

text: Ntja e ntse e le mafolofolo. Ntja e dula e le mafolofolo. Respect.
en: The dog is still keen. The dog is always keen. Respect.
bt: The dog is still lively. The dog is always lively. Respect.

text: Twaalf treë van die voordeur tot by die kar, en die wind het al twaalf gevat.
en: Twelve steps from the front door to the car, and the wind took all twelve.
bt: Twelve steps from the front door to the car, and the wind took all twelve.

text: Vlae styf uit, wynglas styf vas. Die dek se weergawe van 'n kalm Maandag.
en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
bt: Flags stand stiff out, wine glass held fast. The deck's version of a calm Monday.

text: Om op te staan was 'n fout. 'n Gedokumenteerde een.
en: Getting out of bed was a mistake. A documented one.
bt: Getting up was a mistake. A documented one.

text: Die voëls het klaar stil geraak. Hulle weet iets.
en: The birds have already gone quiet. They know something.
bt: The birds have already gone quiet. They know something.

text: Izulu lokosa, boet! Akukho zaba.
en: Braai weather, boet! No excuses.
bt: Roasting [?lokosa] weather, boet! There are no [?zaba].

text: Hitte is waarskynlik. Die getal settle nog.
en: Heat's likely. The number's still settling.
bt: Heat is likely. The number is still settling.

text: Sena ke tlhahlobo ea lehodimo. Le pasitse.
en: This is the sky's performance review. It passed.
bt: This is a weather test. You have passed.

text: Behoorlik koud vandag. Die soort wat deur drie truie gaan asof hulle nie daar is nie.
en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
bt: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys as if they aren't there.

text: Daardie water het vyfuur koud ingegaan en was sedertdien nie weer koud nie.
en: That water went in cold at five and it has not been cold since.
bt: That water went in cold at five o'clock and hasn't been cold again since.

text: Donder met sonop, en skielik slaap almal in jou bed.
en: Thunder at dawn, and suddenly everyone sleeps in your bed.
bt: Thunder at sunrise, and suddenly everyone is sleeping in your bed.

text: Kungana. Kungasongela nje.
en: Could rain. Could just threaten to.
bt: It may rain. It may just threaten.

text: Kubanda
bt: It is cold.
note: No English source given; not checked.

text: Aandete smaak beter as die pad soontoe só lyk.
en: Dinner tastes better when the walk there looks like this.
bt: Dinner tastes better than the road there looks.

text: Ama-wipers aku-max kodwa akwanele.
en: The wipers are on max and it's still not enough.
bt: The wipers are on max but it's not enough.

text: Selfs die skaduwee is warm. Sterkte.
en: Even the shade is warm. Good luck out there.
bt: Even the shade is warm. Good luck.

text: Nie depressief nie. Net...grys.
en: Not depressing. Just... underwhelming.
bt: Not depressed. Just... grey.

text: Aandete sal verstaan hoekom jy jou tyd vat.
en: Dinner will understand why you're taking your time.
bt: Dinner will understand why you take your time.

text: Inkungu eqine kakhulu inezimvo.
en: Fog so thick it has opinions.
bt: Very thick fog has opinions.

text: Sekhele se robehile ka mosi oa pele. Setso.
en: The umbrella broke on the first gust. Classic.
bt: The [?sekhele] has broken with the first smoke. Tradition.
note: Smoke, not gust; umbrella unclear; 'mosi' is smoke.

text: Dit is die badkamervloer en dit is nou sy slaapkamer.
en: That is the bathroom floor and it is now his bedroom.
bt: That is the bathroom floor and it is now his bedroom.

text: Lae af teen 11-uur. Lae aan teen 4-uur. Highveld classic.
en: Layers off by 11. Layers on by 4. Highveld classic.
bt: Low off at 11 o'clock. Low on at 4 o'clock. Highveld classic.

text: Lo ngunobangela wokuba uNoah okhe uMkhombe.
en: This is why Noah built a boat.
bt: This is the reason Noah [?okhe] the Ark.

text: Dis truiweer. Onder jou trui.
en: It's jersey weather. Under your jersey.
bt: It's jersey weather. Under your jersey.

text: iTrampoline yomntu iphaphathekile ngapha kwezitalato ezimbini.
en: Someone's trampoline is now two streets away.
bt: Someone's trampoline has [?floated/blown] away past two streets.

text: Ubusuku obuhle-ish. Ungasibambi ezinkanyezini.
en: Clear-ish night. Don't hold us to the stars.
bt: A nice-ish night. Don't hold us to the stars.

text: Pouse, en die bries doen almal se hare. Die juffrouens ook.
en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
bt: Pause, and the breeze does everyone's hair. The ladies/teachers too.

text: Die aalwyne het nie 'n druppel daarvan nodig gehad nie en sal ook nooit nie.
en: The aloes have not needed a drop of that and they never will.
bt: The aloes didn't need a drop of it and never will.

text: Selfs die turbines lyk of hulle 'n blaaskans wil vat.
en: Even the turbines look like they could use a breather.
bt: Even the turbines look like they want to take a break.

text: Jy kan drie bergrûe van hier af sien, en dis waarvoor aande sonder wasigheid is.
en: You can see three ridgelines from here, which is what no-haze evenings are for.
bt: You can see three mountain ranges from here, and that's what evenings without fog are for.

text: Bewolk. Bly binne as jy 'n rede gesoek het.
en: Cloudy. Stay in if you were looking for a reason.
bt: Overcast. Stay inside if you were looking for a reason.

text: Kufana nedolophu yeziporho. Kanti nguLwesibini nje
en: Ghost town. But it's just Tuesday.
bt: It's like a town of ghosts. Yet it's just Tuesday.

text: Die yskas is die koelste kamer in die huis.
en: The fridge is the coolest room in the house.
bt: The fridge is the coolest room in the house.

text: Vier vriende, een pakkie tjips, nul sig. Perfekte aand.
en: Four friends, one parcel of chips, zero visibility. Perfect evening.
bt: Four friends, one packet of chips, zero view. Perfect evening.

text: Helder lug en regte sonskyn: die roomysverkoper was nog nooit so gewild nie.
en: Clear sky and proper sunshine: the ice-cream van has never been this popular.
bt: Clear sky and proper sunshine: the ice-cream seller has never been so popular.

text: ho nale maru hanyane
en: Partly cloudy.
bt: There are a few clouds.

text: Ho bonahala ho futhumetse. Hore na ho futhumetse hakae ho a fetoha.
en: Looks warm. How warm is a moving target.
bt: It seems warm. How warm it is keeps changing.

text: Getypoel-water: eers spyt, dan skielik tien jaar jonger.
en: Tidal pool water: instant regret, then instant youth.
bt: Tidal-pool water: first regret, then suddenly ten years younger.

text: Geen maan, geen sterre, geen straatligte nie: vanaand is die kopligte die hele lug.
en: No moon, no stars, no streetlights: tonight the headlights are the whole sky.
bt: No moon, no stars, no streetlights: tonight the headlights are the whole sky.

text: Dinsdag, en die koelste ding in hierdie hele tuin is daardie hond.
en: Tuesday, and the coolest thing in this entire garden is that dog.
bt: Tuesday, and the coolest thing in this whole garden is that dog.

text: Die ligte het twee uur gelede aangegaan en niemand het nog voorgestel ons skuif nie.
en: The lights went on two hours ago and nobody has suggested moving.
bt: The lights came on two hours ago and nobody has yet suggested we move.

text: Le mozulu ibhalwe 'meh' kuyo yonke indawo.
en: This weather has 'meh' written all over it.
bt: This weather [?mozulu] is written 'meh' everywhere.

text: Izicwangciso zeenwele: zirhoxisiwe.
en: Hair plans: cancelled.
bt: Hair plans: cancelled.

text: Lehodimo le lahla majoe. Sala ka hare.
en: Sky's throwing rocks. Stay inside.
bt: The sky is throwing stones. Stay inside.

text: I-hoodie nesimo sengqondo. Namuhla kunje.
en: A hoodie and an attitude. That's today.
bt: A hoodie with attitude. Today is like this.

text: Iremote ye-aircon ngoku yeyomntu wonke. Thethani kakuhle.
en: The aircon remote is now public property. Negotiate.
bt: The aircon remote now belongs to everyone. Negotiate nicely.

text: Maak toe, maak vas, gee oor.
en: Close it, tie it down, surrender.
bt: Close up, fasten, hand over.

text: Poskaart weer. Plesier.
en: Postcard weather. You're welcome.
bt: Postcard weather. Enjoy.

text: Die wasgoed hang buite en jy voel dapper.
en: The washing's on the line and you're feeling brave.
bt: The washing hangs outside and you feel brave.

text: Die lig het n volle vloermoer.
en: The sky's having a full-on tantrum.
bt: The light has a full [?vloermoer].
note: 'vloermoer' is not a word; sky became 'light'.

text: Ungawathembi lawo mafu. Ayaceba.
en: Don't trust those clouds. They're plotting.
bt: Don't trust those clouds. They [?ayaceba].

text: Geen slaap-app op aarde kan met 'n sinkdak meeding nie.
en: No sleep app on earth can compete with a tin roof.
bt: No sleep app on earth can compete with a tin roof.

text: Pool ha se kgetho.
en: The pool is not optional.
bt: Pool [swimming pool?] is not a choice.

text: Phatha isambreli nje uma kunokwenzeka, hey.
en: Take a brolly just in case, hey.
bt: Just carry an umbrella if it's possible, hey.

text: Dalk reën.
en: Might rain.
bt: Maybe rain.

text: Die elektriese heining is oukei. Die sypaadjie het heeltemal moed opgegee.
en: The electric fence is fine. The pavement has completely given up.
bt: The electric fence is okay. The pavement has completely given up.

text: Weerlig in die verte, koffie in die hand — beste kanaal op televisie.
en: Distant lightning and a warm mug: best channel on television.
bt: Lightning in the distance, coffee in hand — best channel on television.

text: Waarskynlik helder. Jou venster het die laaste sê.
en: Probably clear. Your window's the final say.
bt: Probably clear. Your window has the last say.

text: My warmwaterbottel bly oor.
en: My hot water bottle is staying over.
bt: My hot water bottle stays over.

text: Cishe kuyabanga. Thatha ijezi, uzosibonga.
en: Probably cold. Take the jersey, you'll thank us.
bt: It's probably chilly. Take a jersey, you'll thank us.

text: Imozulu ine drama ifuna uCarte Blanche.
en: Weather so dramatic it needs a Carte Blanche segment.
bt: The weather with drama wants Carte Blanche.

text: Kunamafu kancane, kuqagela kancane.
en: Partly cloudy, partly guessing.
bt: A little cloudy, a little guessing.

text: Nog 'n swem lyk makliker as nog 'n stort.
en: Another swim seems easier than another shower.
bt: Another swim looks easier than another shower.

text: Respekteer die donder. Hy het dit verdien.
en: Respect the thunder. It's earned it.
bt: Respect the thunder. It earned it.

text: Die hond staar na die reen asof dit n persoonlike belediging is.
en: The dog is staring at the rain like it's a personal insult.
bt: The dog stares at the rain as if it is a personal insult.

text: Jou kind wil hê die bad moet ook buitentoe skuif.
en: Your child would like the bath moved outside too.
bt: Your child wants the bath to move outside too.

text: Pretoria-kaal-jacaranda energie. Pragtig en troosteloos.
en: Pretoria-bare-jacaranda energy. Beautiful and bleak.
bt: Pretoria bare-jacaranda energy. Beautiful and bleak.

text: Leholimo le lebe
en: Severe weather
bt: The weather is bad.

text: Matamo a etsa motjeko o thabileng.
en: The dams are doing a happy dance.
bt: The ponds/dams [?matamo] do a happy dance.

text: Rustige aand. Jy moes dit saggies gesê het.
en: Quiet evening. You should have said it softly.
bt: Quiet evening. You should have said it softly.

text: Nat teer by sonsopkoms. Dis nie 'n reuk nie, dis 'n erfenis.
en: Wet tar at sunrise. That's not a smell, that's heritage.
bt: Wet tar at sunrises. It's not a smell, it's a heritage.

text: Mhlawumbe imvula, mhlawumbe cha. Okujwayelekile.
en: Maybe rain, maybe not. Classic.
bt: Maybe rain, maybe not. The usual.

text: Paka sekhele. Kapa o se ke oa paka. Ha re tsebe le rona.
en: Pack an umbrella. Or don't. We don't know either.
bt: Pack a [?sekhele]. Or don't pack. We don't know either.

text: Kon erger gewees het. Kon ook beter gewees het.
en: Could be worse. Could also be better.
bt: Could have been worse. Could also have been better.

text: Geen haas nie. Jou afdraai gaan nêrens heen nie.
en: No rush. Your turn-off isn't going anywhere.
bt: No rush. Your turn-off isn't going anywhere.

text: Die den agter hom is heeltemal oorgebuig, so dit was nooit 'n regverdige wedstryd nie.
en: The pine behind him is bent right over, so this was never a fair contest.
bt: The pine behind him is completely bent over, so it was never a fair match.

text: Dou só swaar beteken die nag het behoorlik koud geword en so gebly.
en: Dew this heavy means the night got properly cold and stayed there.
bt: Dew this heavy means the night turned properly cold and stayed that way.

text: Hlompha modumo .o e tsoanetse
en: Respect the thunder. It's earned it.
bt: Respect the thunder/noise. It deserves it.

text: Saterdag, en hy is voor sewe in, want teen tien is dit onbruikbaar.
en: Saturday, and he is in before seven because by ten it is unusable.
bt: Saturday, and he's in before seven, because by ten it's unusable.

text: Mooi aand. Diep onbewoonbaar.
en: Pretty evening. Deeply uninhabitable.
bt: Beautiful evening. Deeply uninhabitable.

text: Inkinga yokuthemba isibhakabhaka namuhla.
en: Trust issues with the sky today.
bt: The problem of trusting the sky today.

text: Jou oggendstap begin daarmee om die oggend te vind.
en: Your morning walk starts by finding the morning.
bt: Your morning walk starts by finding the morning.

text: Hoëveld-oggend: koud genoeg vir 'n jas, mooi genoeg dat jy nie omgee nie.
en: Highveld mornings: freezing, gorgeous, zero apologies.
bt: Highveld morning: cold enough for a coat, pretty enough that you don't mind.

text: Die goue lig kry die laaste sê.
en: Golden hour has stolen the last word.
bt: The golden light gets the last say.

text: Ilanga liyabaleka namuhla.
en: The sun's bunking today.
bt: The sun is running away today.

text: Tlisa jase. Kapa sethibelo sa letsatsi. Kapa ka bobeli.
en: Bring a jacket. Or sunscreen. Or both.
bt: Bring a coat. Or sun protection. Or both.

text: Jou asem doen spesiale effekte.
en: Your breath is doing special effects.
bt: Your breath does special effects.

text: Julle is albei op 'n stap. Net een lyk ingelig.
en: You're both on a walk. Only one seems briefed.
bt: You're both on a walk. Only one looks informed.

text: Tlotsa hape sunscreen, kapa letsatsi le tla u bontša mosebetsi oa lona.
en: Reapply that sunscreen or suffer.
bt: Smear on sunscreen again, or the sun will show you its work.

text: Reën teen die glas en koffie op die vensterbank: Sondag is gereël.
en: The rain is on the glass and the coffee is on the sill: Sunday is sorted.
bt: Rain against the glass and coffee on the windowsill: Sunday is arranged.

text: Ama-tile floors yi-villain yanamuhla kusihlwa. Gqoka okuthile ezinyaweni.
en: Tile floors are tonight's villain. Wear something on your feet.
bt: Tile floors are tonight's villain. Wear something on your feet.

text: Die aircon-knoppie is reg daar en dit is duidelik nog nie gedruk nie.
en: The A/C button is right there and it has clearly not been pressed.
bt: The aircon button is right there and clearly hasn't been pressed yet.

text: Die see hou sy winterkleur onder so 'n lug, wat die kalender ook al sê.
en: The sea keeps its winter colour under a sky like this, whatever the calendar says.
bt: The sea keeps its winter colour under such a sky, whatever the calendar says.

text: 'Ons kyk hoe dit lyk' — Suid-Afrika se amptelike RSVP.
en: 'We'll see how it looks' — South Africa's official RSVP.
bt: 'We'll see how it looks' — South Africa's official RSVP.

text: Letsatsi le balehile kajeno.
en: The sun's bunking today.
bt: The sun has fled today.

text: Ngisho namabakkie ku-N2 amile eceleni.
en: Even the bakkies on the N2 pulled over.
bt: Even the bakkies on the N2 have stopped at the side.

text: Ukushisa cishe kukhona. Inombolo isazinza.
en: Heat's likely. The number's still settling.
bt: Heat is probably there. The number is still settling.

text: Elke straatlig kry vanaand sy eie stralekrans; die mis is so vrygewig.
en: Every streetlamp gets its own halo tonight; the fog is generous like that.
bt: Every streetlight gets its own halo tonight; the fog is so generous.

text: Kubanda, izwe licwebile
en: Cold but clear
bt: It is cold, the land is [?icwebile - glistening/frosted].

text: Die vullisblikke sal môreoggend nog daar wees.
en: The bins will still be there in the morning.
bt: The rubbish bins will still be there tomorrow morning.

text: Die duvet kom saam. Hy het die uitstappie verdien.
en: The duvet's coming too. It has earned the outing.

text: Jy mis jou bed. Jy is nog in die huis.
en: You miss your bed. You're still in the house.
bt: You miss your bed. You're still in the house.

text: Alles onder die kombers is amptelik nie vandag se probleem nie.
en: Everything under the blanket is officially not today's problem.
bt: Everything under the blanket is officially not today's problem.

text: Izinkulunkulu zesimo sezulu ziyaziqhayisa.
en: The weather gods are showing off.
bt: The weather gods are boasting.

text: 'n Vrydagaand warm genoeg dat die tafel self buitentoe geloop het.
en: A Friday night warm enough that the table walked itself outside.
bt: A Friday evening warm enough that the table walked outside by itself.

text: Pula e fihlile
en: Rain's here.
bt: Rain has arrived.

text: Ngo - 6
en: Bloemfontein at 6am: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, and a brave face.
note: Bloemfontein, 6am and the clothing list are all missing.

text: Die huis het ná donker een warm kamer, en dit is waar die kombers ook al is.
en: The house has one warm room after dark, and it is wherever the blanket is.
bt: After dark the house has one warm room, and that is wherever the blanket is.

text: Die bakkie het onder 'n heeltemal skoon lug toegevries — presies hoe dit werk.
en: The bakkie iced over under a completely clear sky, which is exactly how it works.
bt: The bakkie froze over under a completely clear sky — exactly how it works.

text: Die somer het vanoggend sy aankomskennisgewing ingedien; die hemp is die papierwerk.
en: Summer filed its arrival notice this morning; the shirt is the paperwork.
bt: Summer filed its arrival notice this morning; the shirt is the paperwork.

text: Boemo ba weather bo matla
en: Severe weather
bt: The weather condition is strong.
note: 'weather' left in English instead of leholimo.

text: Isibikezelo: i-vibes ingenamthelela, izindlela ziphansi.
en: Forecast: vibes neutral, expectations lower.
bt: Forecast: the vibes have no effect, the roads are low.

text: Reën op 'n andersins mooi aand.
en: Rain on an otherwise good-looking evening.
bt: Rain on an otherwise lovely evening.

text: Daardie kole doen meer vir die heining as vir die vleis.
en: Those coals are doing more for the fence than they are for the meat.
bt: Those coals do more for the fence than for the meat.

text: Slaapweer van die boonste rak. Die wolke het seker gemaak.
en: Top-shelf sleeping weather. The clouds made sure of it.
bt: Top-shelf sleeping weather. The clouds made sure.

text: Jy kon teen dié tyd al aandete gekook het. Twee keer.
en: You could have cooked supper by now. Twice.
bt: You could have cooked dinner by this time already. Twice.

text: 'n Perfek gemiddelde lug wat perfek gemiddelde goed doen.
en: A perfectly average sky doing perfectly average things.
bt: A perfectly average sky doing perfectly average things.

text: Imingxuma endleleni ijika ibe ngamadama okuqubha.
en: The potholes are becoming swimming pools.
bt: Potholes in the road turn into swimming ponds.

text: Plakkies op teer was 'n fout.
en: Flip-flops on tar was a mistake.
bt: Flip-flops on tar was a mistake.

text: Ilungele ukungenza nto kwaphela.
en: Perfect for doing absolutely nothing.
bt: It is ready/suitable for doing nothing at all.

text: Izandla zakho zisepokothweni kwaye aziphumi.
en: Your hands are in your pockets and they're not coming out.
bt: Your hands are in your pocket and are not coming out.

text: Iemand het die lig binne aangelos en niemand gaan terug daarvoor nie.
en: Somebody left the light on inside and nobody is going back for it.
bt: Someone left the light on inside [?aangelos] and nobody is going back for it.

text: Mohlomong letsatsi le metsi. Paka ka nepo.
en: Probably a damp one. Pack accordingly.
bt: Maybe sun and water. Pack [?ka nepo] accurately/just right.

text: Aandete moet liewer warm wees. Dit is nie 'n versoek nie.
en: Supper had better be hot. This is not a request.
bt: Dinner had better be hot. This is not a request.

text: Die ruitveër is op sy tienduisendste veeg en die reën het nie eers geknip nie.
en: The wiper is on its ten-thousandth swipe and the rain has not blinked.
bt: The wiper is on its ten-thousandth wipe and the rain hasn't even blinked.

text: Kubanda okweWelkom namuhla. Amakhaza angena kuma-jersey amathathu sengathi awekho.
en: Welkom-cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
bt: It is cold like Welkom today. The cold goes through three jerseys as if they were not there.

text: Kan niks sien nie. Niks.
en: Can't see a thing. Not a thing.
bt: Can't see anything. Nothing.

text: Daar kom stoom van daardie swembad af, wat nie 'n goeie teken is om sesuur nie.
en: There is steam coming off that pool, which is not a good sign at six.
bt: Steam is coming off that swimming pool, which is not a good sign at six o'clock.

text: Kyk mooi. Oor tien minute is dit nag én Noordpool.
en: Look quickly. In ten minutes it's night and the North Pole.
bt: Watch carefully. In ten minutes it is night and the North Pole.

text: Slaaptyd het uiteindelik iemand aan sy kant.
en: Bedtime finally has somebody on its side.
bt: Bedtime finally has someone on its side.

text: Maak myne iets waarop ek moet blaas.
en: Make mine something I have to blow on.
bt: Make mine something I have to blow on.

text: Wolk is die roep. Met 'n sterretjie.
en: Cloud's the call. With an asterisk.
bt: Cloud is the call. With a sparkler/little star.

text: Roomys om agtuur is nie nagereg nie, dis 'n herstelplan.
en: Ice cream at eight isn't dessert, it's a recovery plan.
bt: Ice cream at eight o'clock is not dessert, it is a recovery plan.

text: Setuuruili sa hao ke setjheso.
en: Your steering wheel is a hot plate.
bt: Your [?setuuruili] is heat/hot.

text: Donker buite, helder môre.
en: Dark outside, bright tomorrow.
bt: Dark outside, bright tomorrow.

text: Môre is 'n nuwe onderhandeling met die weer. Vanaand rus ons.
en: Tomorrow is a fresh negotiation with the weather. Tonight we rest.
bt: Tomorrow is a new negotiation with the weather. Tonight we rest.

text: Ha ho leru le bonahalang. Le le le leng.
en: Not a cloud in sight. Not one.
