bt: There is no visible cloud. Not even one [?le le le leng].

text: Iimodeli zithi isibhakabhaka sicacile. Kodwa jonga nesibhakabhaka sokwenene.
en: Clear skies, says the maths. Check the actual sky too.
bt: The models say the sky is clear. But look at the real sky too.

text: Kubonakala kuzolile. Mhlawumbi.
en: Looks settled out there. Roughly.
bt: It seems calm. Maybe.

text: Die see het die kleur gekry wat hy net kry as die lug só leeg is.
en: The sea has gone the colour it only goes when the sky is this empty.
bt: The sea got the colour it only gets when the sky is this empty.

text: Nog twee keuses in die sak: die klubhuis of die kar.
en: Two club selections left: the clubhouse or the car.
bt: Two more choices in the bag: the clubhouse or the car.

text: Ingqele ifikile yaye ize nabahlobo bayo.
en: The cold front is here and it brought friends.
bt: The cold has arrived and has come with its friends.

text: Mohlolo o jele tikoloho.
en: The fog ate the neighbourhood.
bt: A miracle has devoured the environment/surroundings.

text: Bewolkte nag. Dapperheid in kombersvorm.
en: Cloudy night. Bravery in blanket form.
bt: Cloudy night. Bravery in blanket form.

text: Donderweer
en: Thunder
bt: Thunderstorm / thunder weather

text: Dis nie clouds nie, dis 'n lokprent.
en: Those aren't clouds, that's a trailer.
bt: It is not clouds, it is a trailer (film preview).

text: Amasele angene kwincoko.
en: The frogs have entered the chat.
bt: The [?amasele] have entered the conversation.

text: SPF 50 kapa o tla itshola ka bosiu.
en: SPF 50 or regret it by tonight.
bt: SPF 50 or you will blame yourself at night.

text: Kuyabanda, kodwa imozulu licwebile.
en: Cold but stunning.
bt: It is cold, but the weather is clear.

text: Die rit huis toe het 'n nuwe naam: kwaliteittyd.
en: The ride home has been renamed quality time.
bt: The drive home has a new name: quality time.

text: Afskop nou-nou. Om jou tone te voel sou handig wees.
en: Kick-off soon. Feeling your toes would be useful.
bt: Kick-off soon. Being able to feel your toes would be handy.

text: Die kole is amper dood. Die stories kom nou eers by.
en: Coals fading, stories only warming up.
bt: The coals are almost dead. The stories are only now arriving.

text: Ho boneha: hanyenyane nul.
en: Visibility: basically zero.
bt: Visibility: [?hanyenyane] (a little/slightly) zero.

text: Inkuku ayikhathalelanga ishedyuli yakho.
en: The fog doesn't care about your schedule.
bt: The chicken did not care about your schedule.

text: Jou dak het vanaand 'n langer storie as jy.
en: Your roof has a longer story than you do tonight.
bt: Your roof has a longer story tonight than you do.

text: Sondag, en die Karoo doen die een ding wat hy beter as enige plek doen.
en: Sunday, and the Karoo is doing the one thing it does better than anywhere.
bt: Sunday, and the Karoo does the one thing it does better than any place.

text: Om die familie-klets tot ontbyt stil te maak, lyk regverdig.
en: Muting the family chat until breakfast seems fair.
bt: Silencing the family chatter until breakfast seems fair.

text: Izihlahla zenza i-yoga engafuneki.
en: The trees are doing involuntary yoga.
bt: The trees are doing unwanted/unnecessary yoga.

text: Bel later. Die dak wil klaar praat.
en: Call later. The roof would like to finish speaking.
bt: Call later. The roof wants to finish talking.

text: Braai e hlakotsoe. E, ka nnete.
en: The braai is cancelled. Yes, really.
bt: The braai is cancelled/wiped out. Yes, truly.

text: Die lug is besluiteloos. Ons ook.
en: The sky's undecided. So are we.
bt: The sky is indecisive. So are we.

text: Bamba isigqoko sakho! Nabantwana bakho.
en: Hold onto your hat! And your kids.
bt: Hold on to your hat! Your children too.

text: Kupholile
bt: It has cooled down.

text: Imvelo isandakusikhumbuza ukuthi ubani ophambili.
en: Nature just reminded us of the pecking order.
bt: Nature has just reminded us who is ahead/in charge.

text: Dis mistig.
en: Foggy out there.
bt: It is misty.

text: EBloemfontein ngo-6 ekuseni: ijezi, igawuni, isikhafu, amateki, nesibindi sokubhekana namakhaza.
en: Bloemfontein at 6am: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, and a brave face.
bt: In Bloemfontein at 6 in the morning: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, and courage to face the cold.

text: Die familiegroep sê reën. Die lug weier kommentaar.
en: The family group says rain. The sky has declined to comment.
bt: The family group says rain. The sky declines to comment.

text: Boemo ba leholimo bo ka ba boima. Lula u hlokometse.
en: Weather might get serious. Stay loosely on alert.
bt: The weather could become heavy. Stay alert/watching.

text: Vrydag, en die aalwyne het glad niks ongewoons opgemerk nie.
en: Friday, and the aloes have not noticed anything unusual at all.
bt: Friday, and the aloes noticed absolutely nothing unusual.

text: Kuyabanda, kodwa izulu licwebile.
en: Cold but stunning.
bt: It is cold, but the sky is clear.

text: Vanaand se planne pas onder een duvet.
en: Tonight's plans fit under one duvet.
bt: Tonight's plans fit under one duvet.

text: Kutheni ushiye indlu? Ngenene.
en: Why did you leave the house? Honestly.
bt: Why did you leave the house? Seriously.

text: Reën hier buite is 'n gebeurtenis; die hele veld gaan teen sewe daarna ruik.
en: Rain out here is an event; the whole veld will smell of it by seven.
bt: Rain out here is an event; the whole veld will smell of it at seven afterwards.

text: Impahla yonekwe ecingweni yaye uziva unesbindi.
en: The washing's on the line and you're feeling brave.
bt: The washing got ruined/wet on the line and you feel brave.
note: washing already ruined, not just on the line

text: Kubukeka kunamafu. Imithombo ayivumelani.
en: Looks overcast. The sources aren't unanimous.
bt: It looks cloudy. The sources do not agree.

text: Bloemfontein ka 6 hoseng: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, le pelo e tiileng.
en: Bloemfontein at 6am: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, and a brave face.
bt: Bloemfontein at 6 in the morning: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, and a strong heart.

text: Waai in elk geval. Een van hulle skuld jou dalk geld.
en: Wave anyway. One of them may owe you money.
bt: Blow anyway. One of them might owe you money.

text: Elke los voorwerp in die tuin het geweld gekies.
en: Every loose object in the garden has chosen violence.
bt: Every loose object in the garden has chosen violence.

text: Daardie grys kolom is iemand se middag wat gekanselleer word. Ons s'n is volgende.
en: That grey column is someone’s afternoon getting cancelled. Ours is next in line.
bt: That grey column is someone's afternoon being cancelled. Ours is next.

text: Picnic-weer volgens die oë. Sop-weer volgens die res.
en: Picnic weather according to your eyes. Soup weather according to everything else.
bt: Picnic weather according to the eyes. Soup weather according to the rest.

text: Susa izintoeziphakwe ku-elektriki. Isibhakabhaka sinezinhlelo.
en: Unplug the things. The sky has plans.
bt: Remove the things [?izintoeziphakwe] from the electric(ity). The sky has plans.

text: Imigodi iba amapulazi okubhukuda.
en: The potholes are becoming swimming pools.
bt: The potholes become swimming [?amapulazi = farms/pools].

text: 'n Lug sonder sterre is die lug se manier om te sê gaan slaap.
en: A sky with no stars is the sky's way of saying go to bed.
bt: A sky without stars is the sky's way of saying go to sleep.

text: Leholimo le dramatic le hloka Carte Blanche.
en: Weather so dramatic it needs a Carte Blanche segment.
bt: The dramatic sky needs Carte Blanche.

text: Imvula isifikile.
en: Rain's here.
bt: The rain has arrived.

text: Lifensetere li koetsoe, ketlele e tuka, ema
en: Windows closed, kettle on, and wait.
bt: The windows are closed, the kettle is smoking/steaming, stop/wait.

text: Mnyama ngaphandle, kukhanya ngomso.
en: Dark outside, bright tomorrow.
bt: Dark outside, bright tomorrow.

text: Umoya ulindelekile. Bopha impahla yokuhlamba ngeziqhoboshi.
en: Wind's on the cards. Peg the washing down.
bt: The wind is expected. Tie the washing down with pegs/ties.

text: Jou tone het 'n formele klagte ingedien.
en: Your toes have filed a formal complaint.
bt: Your toes have lodged a formal complaint.

text: Die houtskool is uit, die lug is onbeslis, en nie een gee kop nie.
en: The charcoal is out, the sky is undecided, and neither is backing down.
bt: The charcoal is out, the sky is undecided, and neither one is giving in.

text: Jou kardeur het net 'n wapen geword.
en: Your car door just became a weapon.
bt: Your car door has just become a weapon.

text: Wedstryd vertraag. Almal is skielik weervoorspellers.
en: Match delayed. Everyone is suddenly a forecaster.
bt: Match delayed. Everyone is suddenly a weather forecaster.

text: Alles op daardie draad gaan teen agtuur na die see ruik.
en: Everything on that line is going to smell like the sea by eight o'clock.
bt: Everything on that line will smell of the sea by eight o'clock.

text: Grootmense wat 'net deur die tuin stap' presies waar die sproeier spuit. Toeval, nè.
en: Adults 'just taking a garden stroll' exactly where the sprinkler sprays. Coincidence, nè.
bt: Adults who 'just walk through the garden' exactly where the sprinkler sprays. Coincidence, right.

text: Hy wou koffie drink. Die beker staan nog op die trap.
en: He was going to have coffee. The mug is still standing on the step.
bt: He wanted to drink coffee. The mug is still standing on the step.

text: Hare gedoen. Dit was goed bestede geld.
en: Hair done. That was money well spent.
bt: Hair done. That was money well spent.

text: Die ketel werk harder as enigiemand vandag.
en: The kettle is working harder than anyone today.
bt: The kettle is working harder than anyone today.

text: Die braai is gekanselleer. Ja, regtig.
en: The braai is cancelled. Yes, really.
bt: The braai is cancelled. Yes, really.

text: Die tweede laag bly aan. Ja, selfs in die son.
en: The second layer stays. Yes, even in the sun.
bt: The second layer stays on. Yes, even in the sun.

text: Joburgse winterdagbreek: die uitsig is verniet; die lug vra toegangsgeld.
en: Joburg winter dawn: the view is free; the air charges admission.
bt: Joburg winter daybreak: the view is free; the sky asks an entrance fee.

text: Izinkanyezi zikhona, ukucisha akukwazi lokhu.
en: Stars out, load shedding can't touch this.
bt: The stars are there, the switching-off cannot [do] this.

text: 19:00 en steeds so warm. Die Karoo maak nie foute nie, net stellings.
en: 7pm and still this hot. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.
bt: 19:00 and still so warm. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.

text: Imoto ye ice cream idlale umhobe womntu wonke.
en: The ice cream van is playing everyone's anthem.
bt: The ice cream van played everyone's [?umhobe].

text: Thatha umzuzu. Bheka phezulu. Wamukelekile.
en: Take a moment. Look up. You're welcome.
bt: Take a moment. Look up. You are welcome.

text: Die kar is daarbuite. Glo so.
en: The car is out there. Allegedly.
bt: The car is out there. Believe it.

text: Izulu lihlanzekile.
bt: The weather is clean/clear.

text: Daardie grasperk is die enigste ding vir veertig kilometer wat 'n sê het.
en: That lawn is the only thing for forty kilometres that gets a say.
bt: That lawn is the only thing for forty kilometres that has a say.

text: Die verkeer het pas onthou dat reën bestaan, steeds.
en: The traffic just remembered rain exists. Again.
bt: Traffic has just remembered that rain exists, still.

text: Mathata a tšepo le lehodimo gompieno.
en: Trust issues with the sky today.
bt: [?Mathata a tšepo] trust problems with the sky today.
note: gompieno is Setswana/Sepedi, Sesotho is kajeno

text: Serame se fihlile mme se tlisitse metsoalle.
en: The cold front is here and it brought friends.
bt: The cold has arrived and has brought friends.

text: Die naweek word nie beter as dit nie.
en: The weekend doesn't get better than this.
bt: The weekend doesn't get better than this.

text: Saterdag, en die enigste ding op daardie draad wat werk doen is die pennetjies.
en: Saturday, and the only thing on that line doing any work is the pegs.
bt: Saturday, and the only thing on that line doing any work is the pegs.

text: Ungabhaqa inqa kuN1
en: You could fry an egg on the N1.
bt: Don't [?ungabhaqa] [?inqa] on the N1.
note: ungabhaqa inqa not real words; egg/fry lost

text: Serame mohloeng. Serame ho bakkie. Serame ka sekotlolong sa phoofolo ea lapeng.
en: Frost on the lawn. Frost on the bakkie. Frost in the pet bowl.
bt: Cold in the [?mohloeng]. Cold in the bakkie. Cold in the pet's bowl.

text: I-Highveld winter: indawo apho ugqoka ama-jacket amabili uyolanda iposi.
en: Highveld winter: the only place where you wear two jackets to fetch the post.
bt: Highveld winter: a place where you wear two jackets to go and fetch the post.

text: In dié wind begin die trampolien reisplanne maak.
en: Wind like this, the trampoline starts making travel plans.
bt: In this wind the trampoline starts making travel plans.

text: Die son gaan af soos hy weet ons kyk.
en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.
bt: The sun goes down as if it knows we are watching.

text: Die son het snooze gedruk. Weer.
en: The sun hit snooze again. Honestly? Same.
bt: The sun pressed snooze. Again.

text: Onthou jy die wasgoed, noudat jy aandete eet?
en: Remember the washing, now that you're eating supper?
bt: Do you remember the washing, now that you are eating dinner?

text: Koloi ea hao e teng kantle. Kae-kae. Mohlomong.
en: Your car is out there. Somewhere. Probably.
bt: Your car is outside. Somewhere. Maybe.

text: Die worshond het 'n trui. Hy het dit nie gevra nie, maar hy dra dit met waardigheid.
en: The sausage dog has a jersey. He didn't ask for it, but he wears it with dignity.
bt: The sausage dog has a jersey. He didn't ask for it, but he wears it with dignity.

text: Amafu akhona, ilanga likhona. Isilinganiso siwukuqagela.
en: Some cloud, some sun. The ratio's anyone's guess.
bt: There are clouds, there is sun. The estimate is a guess.

text: Izikhova zikwahlulela ngesikhathi sakho sesikrini.
en: The owls are judging your screen time.
bt: Owls judge you for your screen time.

text: Se ke oa ama buckle ea seatbelt. Re tšepe.
en: Don't touch the seatbelt buckle. Trust us.
bt: Do not touch the seatbelt buckle. Let us trust/hope.

text: I-duvet iyabiza futhi i-duvet iyaphumelela.
en: The duvet is calling and the duvet is winning.
bt: The duvet is expensive and the duvet wins.

text: Ukubonakala: ii-vibes kuphela.
en: Visibility: vibes only.
bt: Visibility: vibes only.

text: Yi-Welkom-cold namhlanje. La makhaza adlula kwii-jersey ezintathu ngathi azikho.
en: Welkom-cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
bt: It is Welkom-cold today. The cold passes through three jerseys as if they were not there.

text: Die son het vandag die direkte roete gevat: reguit af, geen verkeer nie.
en: The sun took the direct route today: straight down, no traffic.
bt: The sun took the direct route today: straight down, no traffic.

text: Die foon is die enigste ding hier buite wat stil gehou word.
en: The phone is the only thing out here being held still.
bt: The phone is the only thing out here that is being kept quiet.

text: Alle afsprake is amptelik verskuif na 'wanneer dit opklaar'.
en: All plans are officially moved to 'when it clears up'. Which is never. Shame.
bt: All appointments are officially moved to 'when it clears up'.

text: Een ding op 'n slag. Eintlik gerieflik.
en: One thing at a time. Convenient, really.
bt: One thing at a time. Actually convenient.

text: Cishe usuku olushisayo. Isigqoko asilona icebo elibi.
en: Probably a scorcher. A hat's not a bad idea.
bt: Almost a hot day. The hat is not a bad idea.

text: Ten minste is die tuin bly. Iemand moet wees.
en: At least the garden's happy. Someone has to be.
bt: At least the garden is happy. Someone has to be.

text: Lebaka le letle la ho hlakola merero.
en: Perfect excuse to cancel plans.
bt: A nice reason to cancel plans.

text: Letsatsi le futhumetseng le tla, mohlomong.
en: Warm one coming, give or take a few degrees.
bt: A warm sun will come, maybe.

text: Akukho i-alarm. Akukho i-agenda. Ii-vibes kuphela.
en: No alarm. No agenda. Just vibes.
bt: No alarm. No agenda. Vibes only.

text: Joburg lyk soos 'n advertensie en voel soos 'n yskas.
en: Looks like a tourism ad. Feels like the inside of a fridge.
bt: Joburg looks like an advertisement and feels like a fridge.

text: Sonskerm en 'n trui — vat altwee.
en: Sunscreen, but keep a hoodie close.
bt: Sunscreen and a jersey - take both.

text: Snoekweer, sê die ooms. Die ooms is nog nooit verkeerd nie.
en: Snoek weather, say the uncles. The uncles have never once been wrong.
bt: Snoek weather, say the uncles. The uncles are never wrong.

text: Kubanda kamnandi, kodwa amabala ombhoxo sele ezakubamahle.
en: Lekker koud, but the rugby fields are about to look perfect.
bt: It is nicely cold, but the [?ombhoxo] fields will soon be beautiful.

text: Vyf-ster akkommodasie. Nee wag — vyf miljoen.
en: Five-star accommodation. Wait, no — five million.
bt: Five-star accommodation. No wait - five million.

text: Grys soos daardie kan die hele dag hou sonder om iets te laat val — waarskynlik.
en: Grey like that can hold all day without dropping a thing — probably.
bt: Grey like that can last the whole day without dropping anything - probably.

text: Staan jy op? Bring tee terwyl jy dapper is.
en: You're getting up? Bring tea while you're brave.
bt: Getting up? Bring tea while you are brave.

text: Effens bewolk.
en: Partly cloudy.
bt: Slightly cloudy.

text: Fliekaand. Niemand stem vir 'n rit winkel toe nie.
en: Movie night. Nobody's voting for a trip to the shops.
bt: Movie night. Nobody votes for a trip to the shop.

text: Dis die soort dag waarvan die groepchat nog jare gaan hoor.
en: One of those days the group chat will hear about for years.
bt: It is the kind of day the group chat will hear about for years.

text: Isihlalo semoto yakho sisixhobo ngoku.
en: Your car seat is a weapon right now.
bt: Your car seat is a tool/weapon now.

text: In die Karoo is mis 'n gebeurtenis. Môre praat die hele distrik hieroor.
en: In the Karoo, fog is an event. The whole district will be talking about this tomorrow.
bt: In the Karoo fog is an event. Tomorrow the whole district will talk about this.

text: I-Table Mountain? Yiyiphi i-Table Mountain?
en: Table Mountain? What Table Mountain?
bt: Table Mountain? Which Table Mountain?

text: Imozulu efanele ukuphila ngaphandle komdla.
en: Perfect weather for existing without enthusiasm.
bt: Weather that should live without enthusiasm.

text: go  a tjhesa
en: It's hot.
bt: It is hot.
note: go is Setswana, Sesotho is ho

text: Jy het pajamas buitentoe gedra. 'n Ambisieuse uitrustinkie.
en: You wore pyjamas out. An ambitious little outfit.
bt: You wore pyjamas outside. An ambitious little outfit.

text: Letsatsi le bapala ho ipata.
en: Sun, hide-and-seek champion of the day.
bt: The sun is playing hide-and-seek.

text: Cima ii-high beam, boet. Azincedi nganto ngoku
en: Your high beams are making it worse, boet.
bt: Dip the high beams, bro. They don't help at all now.

text: Woensdag, en koeler as nou word dit vandag nie.
en: Wednesday, and this is the coolest it is going to be all day.
bt: Wednesday, and it won't get cooler than now today.

text: katiba ,liborele,setlolo sa letsatsi ha ho buisanoe
en: Hat, sunnies, sunscreen. Non-negotiable.
bt: [?katiba], [?liborele], the [?setlolo] of the sun, no talking to one another.

text: Ledimo le a duma.
en: Thunder's grumbling, hey.
bt: The [?ledimo] is rumbling.

text: Jou karsitplek is 'n wapen nou.
en: Your car seat is a weapon right now.
bt: Your car seat is a weapon now.

text: Die poel was dieper as wat dit gelyk het. Dis altyd dieper.
en: The puddle was deeper than it looked. It's always deeper.
bt: The pool was deeper than it looked. It is always deeper.

text: Jy het vir daardie speelgoed betaal. Hulle wil die tuinslang hê.
en: You paid for those toys. They want the hose.
bt: You paid for those toys. They want the garden hose.

text: Koud vanaand. Warm sjokolade tel as toerusting.
en: Cold tonight. Hot chocolate counts as kit.
bt: Cold tonight. Hot chocolate counts as equipment.

text: Imvelo yenza ukucisha kwayo.
en: Nature's doing its own load shedding.
bt: Nature does its own switching-off.

text: Ho bata hantle, empa mabala a rugby a tlo shebahala a le perfect
en: Lekker koud, but the rugby fields are about to look perfect.
bt: It is nicely cold, but rugby fields will look perfect.

text: Maluti-ryp-oggend. Lesotho export dit gratis.
en: Maluti-frost morning. Lesotho's exporting it for free.
bt: Maluti frost morning. Lesotho exports it for free.

text: Donderdagaand, en die enigste ding wat hier buite nog beweeg is die wasgoeddraad.
en: Thursday evening, and the only thing still moving out here is the line.
bt: Thursday evening, and the only thing still moving out here is the washing line.

text: Ubusuku bubonakala buzolile. Ukuba iimodeli ziyavuma.
en: Night looks calm. Models permitting.
bt: The night looks calm. If the models agree.

text: Akukho lifu. Nguwe neCross yaseMzantsi kuphela.
en: Not a cloud. Just you and the Southern Cross.
bt: No cloud. It is just you and the Southern Cross.

text: Die tuin sê uiteindelik dankie.
en: The garden's saying dankie at last.
bt: The garden finally says thank you.

text: pula e ka na
en: Might rain.
bt: Rain could fall.

text: Dit reën.
en: Rain's here.
bt: It is raining.

text: Die wind het 'n persoonlike vendetta teen sambrele.
en: The wind has a personal vendetta against umbrellas.
bt: The wind has a personal vendetta against umbrellas.

text: Waarskynlik mis later. Die Boland doen dit.
en: Probably fog later. The Boland does this.
bt: Probably fog later. The Boland does that.

text: As jy vandag werk, jammer vir jou.
en: If you're working today, we feel sorry for you.
bt: If you are working today, sorry for you.

text: Eerste ster is uit. Eerste tien grade is ook uit.
en: First star is out. First ten degrees have also left.
bt: First star is out. First ten degrees is also out.

text: Daardie mis is môreoggend se ryp wat 'n terreininspeksie doen.
en: That mist is tomorrow morning's frost out doing a site inspection.
bt: That fog is tomorrow morning's frost doing a site inspection.

text: Die osoonlaag het gebel. Hy's op verlof.
en: The ozone layer called. It's on leave.
bt: The ozone layer called. It is on leave.

text: Lae sigbaarheid
en: Low visibility
bt: Low visibility

text: Geniet die kleure. Die temperatuur is klaar in die kar.
en: Enjoy the colours. The temperature has already gone to the car.
bt: Enjoy the colours. The temperature is already in the car.

text: Wind is waarskynlik. Hou vas aan die braai-oortrek.
en: Wind's likely. Hold onto the braai cover.
bt: Wind is probable. Hold on to the braai cover.

text: Stewels eers uit. Dit is glo weer nuus.
en: Boots off first. This is apparently news again.
bt: Boots out first. Apparently it is news again.

text: Tafelberg is reg agter haar en sy kan nie 'n enkele stukkie daarvan sien nie.
en: Table Mountain is right behind her and she cannot see a single bit of it.
bt: Table Mountain is right behind her and she cannot see a single bit of it.

text: I-braai iyenzeka. I-braai ihlala isenzeka. Sitsala nje izitulo sondele.
en: The braai is happening. The braai always happens. We just pull the chairs closer.
bt: The braai is happening. The braai is always happening. We just pull the chairs closer.

text: Nog vyf minute in die kar lyk redelik.
en: Five more minutes in the car seems reasonable.
bt: Another five minutes in the car seems reasonable.

text: Selfs die parkeerterrein lyk mooi vandag.
en: Even the parking lot looks pretty today.
bt: Even the parking lot looks nice today.

text: Jy kan op pad huis toe verder kla.
en: You can keep complaining on the walk home.
bt: You can keep complaining on the way home.

text: Ho fifala kantle, ho phatsima hosane.
en: Dark outside, bright tomorrow.
bt: It is getting dark outside, it will brighten tomorrow.

text: Die lug wen, maar dis nie veel van n kompetisie nie.
en: Sky's doing the most, but only a little.
bt: The sky wins, but it is not much of a competition.

text: Esita le dinonyana di utloahala li thabile.
en: Even the hadedas sound happy.
bt: Even the birds sound happy.

text: Kune inkungu.
en: Foggy out there.
bt: There is fog.

text: Die son buffer nog. Moenie die bladsy verfris nie.
en: The sun is buffering. Do not refresh the page.
bt: The sun is still buffering. Don't refresh the page.

text: Vandag se voorspelling: verhoogeffekte.
en: Today's forecast: special effects.
bt: Today's forecast: stage effects.

text: Hou aan beweeg. Gesels is 'n binnenshuise aktiwiteit.
en: Keep moving. Chatting is an indoor activity.
bt: Keep moving. Chatting is an indoor activity.

text: Leeukop sorg vir die uitsig en die wind vir die komedie.
en: Lion's Head is doing the scenery and the wind is doing the comedy.
bt: Lion's Head provides the view and the wind the comedy.

text: Die helfte van die heining is in die lug voor haar en kom nog steeds aan.
en: Half the hedge is in the air in front of her and still arriving.
bt: Half the fence is in the air in front of her and still coming.

text: Tafelberg? Watter Tafelberg?
en: Table Mountain? What Table Mountain?
bt: Table Mountain? Which Table Mountain?

text: Uma usebenza namuhla, sikuzwela.
en: If you're working today, we feel sorry for you.
bt: If you are working today, we feel for you.

text: Twee druppels op die voorruit en die hele N1 vergeet hoe om te bestuur.
en: Two drops on a windscreen and the whole N1 forgets everything it ever learned.
bt: Two drops on the windscreen and the whole N1 forgets how to drive.

text: Skoon lug vanaand. Dit beteken die koue het vrye toegang.
en: Clear sky tonight. That means the cold has an all-access pass.
bt: Clear sky tonight. That means the cold has free entry.

text: 'n Trui oor jou pajamas tel as aangetrek.
en: A jersey over pyjamas counts as getting dressed.
bt: A jersey over your pyjamas counts as dressed.

text: Ingxoxo nge-aircon yaseofisini ifikelele kwinqanaba lesi-5 ngoku.
en: The office aircon debate just went to level 5.
bt: The office aircon argument has now reached stage 5.

text: Mosi o a foka.
en: Wind's up.
bt: The smoke is blowing/puffing.

text: Weerlig laat Eskom se kragnetwerk pateties lyk.
en: Lightning's putting Eskom's grid to shame.
bt: Lightning makes Eskom's power grid look pathetic.

text: Die maan het soveel wolke om deur te veg dat die flits die werk gekry het.
en: The moon has enough cloud to fight through that the torch got the job.
bt: The moon has so many clouds to fight through that the flashlight got the job.

text: Ho aparetse ka mabu
en: Overcast
bt: It is covered/dressed in soil/dust.

text: Rook wat reguit opstyg beteken koud, stil en geen luggie nie.
en: Smoke going straight up means cold, still and not one breath of wind.
bt: Smoke rising straight up means cold, still and no breeze.

text: Die hond het die presiese lyn tussen son en skadu gekry. Hy bly net daar.
en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
bt: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He just stays there.

text: Kuhle kakhulu ngaphandle.
en: Absolutely beautiful out there.
bt: It is very nice outside.

text: Een perfekte dag uitgereik. Moet hom nie op admin mors nie.
en: One perfect day issued. Non-transferable. Spend it wisely.
bt: One perfect day issued. Don't waste it on admin.

text: Kanselleer alles. Selfs jou verskonings.
en: Cancel everything. Even your excuses.
bt: Cancel everything. Even your excuses.

text: Die sonsondergang het opgedaag. Die koue het saamgekom.
en: Sunset showed up. The cold came with it.
bt: The sunset showed up. The cold came along.

text: Die laaste twee meter tot by die hek is die natste van die hele rit.
en: The last two metres to the gate are the wettest of the whole trip.
bt: The last two metres to the gate are the wettest of the whole trip.

text: Die see lyk kalm van hier bo af, wat 'n volslae leuen is.
en: The sea looks calm from up here, which is a complete lie.
bt: The sea looks calm from up here, which is a complete lie.

text: Umoya wemzantsi mpuma ufikile. Ungamenywanga njengesiqhelo.
en: The southeaster's arrived. Uninvited, as usual.
bt: The south-east wind has arrived. It was not invited, as usual.

text: Kaapstad na 'n front: skoon, helder, en yskoud eerlik.
en: Cape Town after a front: clean, bright, and honestly freezing.
bt: Cape Town after a front: clean, clear, and icy honest.

text: Reën met sonop: vanoggend se draf het 'n modderdraf geword.
en: Rain at sunrise: this morning's run has become a mud run.
bt: Rain at sunrise: this morning's run has become a mud run.

text: Isofa yenze icala elinamandla lokuhlala.
en: The couch has made a compelling case for staying.
bt: The sofa has made a strong case for sitting.

text: Daardie wasgoed is 'n reguit weddenskap teen daardie lug, en die lug lyk seker van sy saak.
en: That washing is a straight bet against that sky, and the sky looks confident.
bt: That washing is a straight bet against that sky, and the sky looks sure of its case.

text: Die mis het die aand vroeg kom toedraai. Soos 'n present.
en: The fog came early to gift-wrap the evening.
bt: The fog came to wrap up the evening early. Like a present.

text: Thatha isambulela xa kungenzeka, hey.
en: Take a brolly just in case, hey.
bt: Take an umbrella if possible, hey.

text: Isibhakabhaka sithulile. Akekho okhonondayo.
en: The sky's on mute. Nobody's complaining.
bt: The sky is silent. Nobody grumbles.

text: E, pula e na ka mahlakoreng. Phaello ea Afrika Boroa.
en: Yes, it's raining sideways. South Africa speciality.
bt: Yes, rain falls in the surrounding areas. [?Phaello] of South Africa.

text: Sambreel in die een hand, sonbril in die ander — hy het hierdie lug al ontmoet.
en: Umbrella in one hand, sunglasses in the other — he has met this sky before.
bt: Umbrella in one hand, sunglasses in the other - he has met this sky before.

text: Esita le GPS ea hao e ferekane.
en: Even your GPS is confused.
bt: Even your GPS is confused.

text: Nko ea hao e tla o eka ka 3pm.
en: Your nose is going to betray you by 3pm.
bt: Your nose will [?o eka] at 3pm.

text: Middagete is reg. Niemand wil die woord 'gaar' daarin hoor nie.
en: Lunch is ready. Nobody wants the word cooked in it.
bt: Lunch is ready. Nobody wants to hear the word 'done/cooked' in it.

text: Iinkwenkwezi ziphumile, ukuCimwa akukwazi oku.
en: Stars out, load shedding can't touch this.
bt: The stars are out, the switching-off cannot [do] this.

text: Koud genoeg dat die melkbottel-op-die-stoep nou 'n koelboks is.
en: Cold enough that the milk-bottle-on-the-stoep is now a cooler box.
bt: Cold enough that the milk bottle on the stoep is now a cooler box.

text: Die beeste is tuis voor die kleur weg is. Sondag eindig presies op tyd.
en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
bt: The cattle are home before the colour is gone. Sunday ends exactly on time.

text: Uhlobo losuku olwenza abantu bathumele 'usuku oluhle hey'.
en: The type of day that makes people text 'lekker dag hey'.
bt: The kind of day that makes people send 'nice day hey'.

text: Die hond het uitgevind waar die koelste teëls in die huis is.
en: The dog has worked out where the coldest tiles in the house are.
bt: The dog found out where the coolest tiles in the house are.

text: Letsatsi ka tsela ea ts'ebetso le teng. Ka moea le sebakeng se seng.
en: The sun is technically present. Spiritually elsewhere.
bt: The sun is present in working order. With wind in another place too.

text: Die lug is heeltemal leeg, so koeler as nou word dit vandag nie.
en: The sky is completely empty, which means this is as cool as today gets.
bt: The sky is completely empty, so it won't get cooler than now today.

text: Leholimo le hlakile, ho bolela lipalo. Sheba leholimo la nnete le lona.
en: Clear skies, says the maths. Check the actual sky too.
bt: The sky is clear, according to the numbers. Look at the real sky too.

text: Matšoao a tsela a lahlile thapo.
en: The street signs gave up.
bt: The road signs have thrown down the [?thapo wire/string].

text: Die lug het vanoggend sy volle gewig gebring, en die see het opgestaan om hom te ontmoet.
en: The sky brought its full weight this morning and the sea rose to meet it.
bt: The sky brought its full weight this morning, and the sea stood up to meet it.

text: Karoo-oggend. Die soort wat jou laat respek hê vir elke boer wat dit gekies het.
en: Karoo morning. The kind that makes you respect every farmer who chose this.
bt: Karoo morning. The kind that makes you respect every farmer who chose it.

text: Die duvet het die opdrag verstaan.
en: The duvet understood the assignment.
bt: The duvet understood the assignment.

text: Donder kom nader.
en: Thunder rolling in.
bt: Thunder is coming closer.

text: Endaweni ethile ngaphandle kunomgwaqo. Sicabanga.
en: Somewhere out there is the road. We think.
bt: Somewhere off the road. We are thinking.

text: Die hond ken hierdie roete met sy neus, en vanaand is dit die beter instrument.
en: The dog knows this route with its nose, which tonight is the better instrument.
bt: The dog knows this route by nose, and tonight that is the better instrument.

text: Sonsondergang is die Karoo se manier van jammer sê.
en: Sunset is the Karoo's way of apologising.
bt: Sunset is the Karoo's way of saying sorry.

text: Grys lug, wit tafel: die stoep het seisoene geruil sonder om iemand te vra.
en: Grey sky, white table: the patio has switched seasons without asking anyone.
bt: Grey sky, white table: the stoep swapped seasons without asking anyone.

text: Mhlawumbi kukho into ephekwayo. Hlala kufutshane nophahla.
en: Probably brewing something. Stay close to a roof.
bt: Maybe something is cooking. Stay close to the roof.

text: Ho na le mohlolo.
en: Foggy out there.
bt: There is a miracle.

text: Mis bou dalk op. Ligte sal nie skade doen nie.
en: Mist building, maybe. Headlights wouldn't hurt.
bt: Fog might be building up. Lights wouldn't hurt.

text: I-Pretoria-bare-jacaranda energy. Yinhle futhi i-bleak.
en: Pretoria-bare-jacaranda energy. Beautiful and bleak.
bt: Pretoria-bare-jacaranda energy. It is beautiful and bleak.

text: Die sambreel het gebreek met die eerste wond. Klassiek.
en: The umbrella broke on the first gust. Classic.
bt: The umbrella broke at the first [?wond - wound/gust]. Classic.

text: Thela ikhofi ngaphandle. Sithembe.
en: Pour the coffee outside. Trust us.
bt: Pour the coffee outside. Trust us.

text: Humeurige weer. Ek ook, eerlikwaar.
en: Moody weather. Same, honestly.
bt: Moody weather. Me too, honestly.

text: Yoh, kushisa ngempela!
en: Jislaaik, it's properly hot!
bt: Yoh, it is really hot!

text: Leholimo ha le qeta. Le rona.
en: The sky's undecided. So are we.
bt: The sky is not finished. Us too.

text: Imozulu yomlinganiswa ophambili apha.
en: Main character weather right here.
bt: Main-character weather here.

text: Waarskynlik 'n bietjie wolk. Of baie. Moeilik om te sê.
en: Probably a bit of cloud. Or a lot. Hard to call.
bt: Probably a bit of cloud. Or a lot. Hard to say.

text: Jou ys-koffie het gesmelt voor jy by die kar gekom het.
en: Your iced coffee melted before you reached the car.
bt: Your iced coffee melted before you got to the car.

text: Diep in die bos, diep onder 'n kombers — dieselfde energie.
en: Deep in the forest, deep under a blanket — exact same energy.
bt: Deep in the bush, deep under a blanket - same energy.

text: I-Silent Hill vibes. Ngaphandle kwezimanga. Sithemba.
en: Silent Hill vibes. Without the monsters. Hopefully.
bt: Silent Hill vibes. Without the monsters. Hopefully.

text: Die maan is uit, en iemand kleintjies hoor vir die eerste keer daarvan.
en: The moon is out and somebody small is hearing about it for the first time.
bt: The moon is out, and someone's little ones hear of it for the first time.

text: Kushushu kakhulu ube uxoxa. Kushushu kakhulu for nukusebenza.
en: Too hot to argue. Too hot to function.
bt: It is too hot [?ube uxoxa]. Too hot for working.

text: Ewe, rain ina ngecala. Yinto eqhelekileyo yaseMzantsi Afrika.
en: Yes, it's raining sideways. South Africa speciality.
bt: Yes, rain falls sideways. It is a normal South African thing.

text: Jy kan begin deur karwas van die lys af te haal.
en: You can start by moving car washing off the list.
bt: You can start by taking car wash off the list.

text: Digwagwa di kene puisanong.
en: The frogs have entered the chat.
bt: [?Digwagwa] have entered the conversation.

text: Amafu ayoyikisa kodwa mhlawumbi ayakhohlisa.
en: The clouds are threatening but probably bluffing.
bt: The clouds are frightening but maybe deceiving.

text: Die son sak eers ná agt. Somer weet hoe om 'n aand te rek.
en: The sun only sets after eight. Summer knows how to stretch an evening.
bt: The sun only sets after eight. Seems to know how to stretch out an evening.

text: Jy kan sy asem sien, en die skape dra die enigste goeie antwoord.
en: You can see his breath, and the sheep are wearing the only good answer.
bt: You can see its breath, and the sheep wear the only good answer.

text: Ukubanda koko sikubhejayo. Ungathembi ifestile enelanga ebusika.
en: Cold's the bet. Don't trust a sunny window in winter.
bt: The cold is just as we [?bhejayo - braced/predicted]. Don't trust a window with sun in winter.

text: Het ons regtig melk nodig, of wil ons dit net hê?
en: Do we actually need milk, or just want it?
bt: Do we really need milk, or do we just want it?

text: Kan stormagtig raak. Hou een oog op die lug.
en: Could turn stormy. Keep one eye on the sky.
bt: It could turn stormy. Keep one eye on the sky.

text: Iphayi yasegaraji ngenxa yokuba ikhitshi yi-lava.
en: Garage pie for lunch because the kitchen is lava.
bt: The garage [?iphayi - pie] because the kitchen is lava.

text: Die swembad is die hele dag die enigste kamer op die plek wat sin maak.
en: The pool has been the only sensible room in the place all day.
bt: The pool is the only room on the property that makes sense all day.

text: Jou tone kry die kar se verwarmer voor jou gesig.
en: Your toes get the car heater before your face.
bt: Your toes get the car's heater before your face.

text: Die stoel is gevat. Die hond het eerste gekom. Die reëls is die reëls.
en: The chair is taken. The dog got there first. Rules are rules.
bt: The chair is taken. The dog came first. The rules are the rules.

text: Padstalkoffie werk vandag as sentrale verhitting.
en: Padstal coffee is functioning as central heating today.
bt: Roadside-stall coffee works today as central heating.

text: Amafu axubene nelanga - kuhle kakhulu.
en: Cloudy enough to comment, sunny enough to ignore.
bt: Clouds mixed with sun - very nice.

text: Mohlomong ho bata. Nka jeresi, u tla re leboha.
en: Probably cold. Take the jersey, you'll thank us.
bt: Maybe it is cold. Take a jersey, you will thank us.

text: Iinzwane zakho zifake isikhalazo esisemthethweni.
en: Your toes have filed a formal complaint.
bt: Your toes have lodged an official complaint.

text: Die wolke sit reg op die berge, en die see het tingrys geword.
en: The cloud is sitting right on the mountains and the sea has gone pewter.
bt: The clouds sit right on the mountains, and the sea has turned tin-grey.

text: Ho lebeletsoe moea o itseng. Matla ha a e-s'o netefatsoe.
en: Some wind expected. Strength still TBC.
bt: A certain wind is expected. Its strength has not yet been confirmed.

text: Die wolk het oornag ingekom en geparkeer; niks daaronder is haastig nie.
en: The cloud came in overnight and parked; nothing under it is in a hurry.
bt: The cloud came in overnight and parked; nothing beneath it is in a hurry.

text: Die vullisblik uitvat behoort by jou stappe te tel.
en: Taking the bin out should count towards your steps.
bt: Taking out the rubbish bin should count towards your steps.

text: Aandete kan wag. By hierdie temperatuur bevorder die sproeier homself tot gesinswembad.
en: Supper can wait. At this temperature the sprinkler promotes itself to family pool.
bt: Dinner can wait. At this temperature the sprinkler promotes itself to family pool.

text: Die plaas se beste TV-kanaal.
en: The farm's best TV channel.
bt: The farm's best TV channel.

text: Grys lug, grys trui: die hele stoep pas by die weer.
en: Grey sky, grey jersey: the whole stoep is colour-coordinated with the weather.
bt: Grey sky, grey jersey: the whole stoep matches the weather.

text: Middernag en die lug wys af.
en: Midnight and the sky is showing off.
bt: Midnight and the sky is showing off.

text: Ho na le fog.
en: Foggy out there.
bt: There is fog. ('fog' is an English word left in)

text: Vat jou koffie buitentoe. Jy verdien dit.
en: Take your coffee outside. You deserve it.
bt: Take your coffee outside. You deserve it.

text: Isimo sezulu esingezinhle. Njengami.
en: Moody weather. Same, honestly.
bt: Bad (not good) weather. Like me.

text: Pakeng tsa ho loka le ho ba metsi. Katleho.
en: Somewhere between fine and soaked. Good luck.
bt: Between being fine and being wet. Success.

text: Die verwarmer het vieruur aangegaan en die kat het een minuut later ingeklok.
en: The heater went on at four and the cat clocked in at one minute past.
bt: The heater came on at four o'clock and the cat clocked in a minute later.

text: Ukubonakala okuphansi
en: Low visibility
bt: Low visibility

text: Die strand is soos 'n spieël, en dit vat een oggend van absoluut geen wind nie.
en: The beach is doubling as a mirror, which takes one morning of absolutely no wind.
bt: The beach is like a mirror, and it takes one morning of absolutely no wind.

text: Esita le dinonyana di kgutsitse.
en: Even the hadedas are quiet.
bt: Even the birds are quiet.

text: Kaapstad ná 'n front: skoon, helder, en yskoud eerlik.
en: Cape Town after a front: clean, bright, and honestly freezing.
bt: Cape Town after a front: clean, clear, and icy honest.

text: Qaphela inkungu — ithanda ukufika ingazange yazise.
en: Watch for fog — it likes to arrive unannounced.
bt: Beware of fog; it likes to arrive without warning.

text: Die suidooster het aangekom. Ongenooid, soos altyd.
en: The southeaster's arrived. Uninvited, as usual.
bt: The southeaster has arrived. Uninvited, as always.

text: Hael
en: Hail
bt: Hail

text: motle
en: beautiful (weather)
bt: beautiful / nice

text: Lug so skoon, jy kan amper tot môre toe sien.
en: Air this clear should come with a warning: plans will be made.
bt: Air so clean you can almost see to tomorrow.

text: Hoe helderder die sterre, hoe harder werk die kombers.
en: The brighter the stars, the harder your blanket has to work.
bt: The brighter the stars, the harder the blanket works.

text: Ngisho nezinkonjane ziyahamba namuhla.
en: Even the seagulls are walking today.
bt: Even the swallows are leaving today.

text: Aangenaam
en: Pleasant
bt: Pleasant (or: pleased to meet you)

text: Donderdag, en iemand het besluit om dit te geniet eerder as om te kla.
en: Thursday, and somebody has decided to enjoy this instead of complaining.
bt: Thursday, and someone decided to enjoy it rather than complain.

text: Daardie water is twee keer bygevul en dit is steeds die verkeerde temperatuur.
en: That water has been topped up twice and it is still the wrong temperature.
bt: That water has been topped up twice and it is still the wrong temperature.

text: Storm vanaand, en die hond het die kleinste kas in die huis gekies.
en: Storm tonight, and the dog has chosen the smallest cupboard in the house.
bt: Storm tonight, and the dog chose the smallest cupboard in the house.

text: Yifake ebhodleleni le. Yivule ebusika.
en: Bottle this one. Open it in winter.
bt: Put it in this bottle. Open it in winter.

text: Mokhoa oa kobo burrito: o bulehile.
en: Blanket burrito mode: activated.
bt: Blanket-burrito style: it is open.

text: Isibhakabhaka siyabafura.
en: The sky is buffering.
bt: The sky is [?siyabafura] them.

text: Ho bata ke seo re se behang. U se ke ua tšepa fensetere e nang le letsatsi mariha.
en: Cold's the bet. Don't trust a sunny window in winter.
bt: Cold is what we put up with. Do not trust a sunny window in winter.

text: Die son speel nie vandag nie.
en: The sun's not playing games today.
bt: The sun is not playing today.

text: Iemand het die wasgoed vergeet. Die bries nie, en dit doen 'n pragtige werk.
en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.
bt: Someone forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it is doing a beautiful job.

text: Die rit het 'n spansport geword.
en: The commute just became a team sport.
bt: The ride has become a team sport.

text: Lusuku oluhle lokuhamba, kodwa alulungelanga ukutshisa.
en: Good day for a walk, bad day for a tan.
bt: A good day for walking, but it is not suitable for burning/roasting.

text: Uiteindelik by die huis. Jou pantoffels het jou verwag.
en: Home at last. Your slippers have been expecting you.
bt: Finally home. Your slippers were expecting you.

text: Die koue weet presies waar jou kombers oopstaan.
en: The cold knows exactly where your blanket has a gap.
bt: The cold knows exactly where your blanket is lying open.

text: Sy het die een teël in hierdie huis gekry wat nog nie warm geword het nie.
en: She has found the one tile in this house that has not warmed up yet.
bt: She found the one tile in this house that has not yet got warm.

text: Night obulungileyo bokubona iNdlela yeMilky Way.
en: Perfect night to actually see the Milky Way.
bt: Night [English word] good for seeing the Milky Way [English words].

text: Ry nou, wonder later.
en: Drive now, wonder later.
bt: Drive now, wonder later.

text: Intela yesambulela isiyasebenza.
en: The umbrella tax is now in effect.
bt: The [?intela] of the umbrella is working now.

text: Mohlomong ho na le maru. Ho ka phahama, ho ka teba.
en: Probably grey. Could lift, could thicken.
bt: Maybe there are clouds. It may lift, it may [?teba] (thicken?).

text: Daardie sak werk soos 'n seil en hy het dit nog nie agtergekom nie.
en: That bag is working as a sail and he has not worked that out yet.
bt: That bag works like a sail and he hasn't noticed yet.

text: Die wereld het net... verdwyn.
en: The world just... disappeared.
bt: The world just... disappeared.

text: As die weer só gedra, gedra ons ook. Min of meer.
en: When the weather behaves this well, so do we. Roughly.
bt: If the weather behaves like that, we behave too. More or less.

text: Tsalela abahlobo. Fumana inyama. Masiye.
en: Call the mates. Get the meat. Let's go.
bt: Call the friends. Get meat. Let's go.

text: Die Karoo het die verkoeler oopgelos.
en: Somebody left the freezer door open overnight.
bt: The Karoo has [?oopgelos] the cooler (opened/solved the cooler box?).
note: 'oopgelos' non-word (likely oopgelaat); subject Karoo not somebody

text: Elke blaar hou stil; die hele tuin wag om te sien wat die lug besluit.
en: Every leaf is holding still; the whole garden is waiting to see what the sky decides.
bt: Every leaf holds still; the whole garden waits to see what the sky decides.

text: Ukuduma okusondeleizindonga zanyakaza. Inhlonipho.
en: Thunder so close the walls shook. Respect.
bt: Thunder close by; the walls moved. Respect.

text: Die wolken het 'n oomblik.
en: The clouds are having a moment.
bt: The clouds are having a moment. ('wolken' is the Dutch plural)

text: Die hele stad het vanaand dieselfde plan gehad. Kyk hoe lyk ons.
en: The whole city had the same plan tonight. Look at us all.
bt: The whole city had the same plan tonight. Look how we look.

text: Ilanga liku-airplane mode.
en: The sun's on airplane mode.
bt: The sun is in airplane mode.

text: Welkom-cold kajeno. Sefako se phunyeletsang di-jersey tse tharo eka ha di yo.
en: Welkom-cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
bt: Welkom-cold today. A hail that pierces three jerseys as if they weren't there.
note: 'sefako' reads as hail; English says cold

text: Jou plastiekstoele gaan dalk voor jou kuier.
en: Your plastic chairs may visit before you do.
bt: Your plastic chairs may go before your visit.

text: Ukusetshenziswa kwerooibos kusanda kuphindeka kabili.
en: Rooibos consumption just doubled.
bt: The use of rooibos has just doubled.

text: Stadsmense betaal groot geld hiervoor. Hier's dit sommer verniet.
en: City folk pay good money for this ceiling.
bt: City people pay big money for this. Here it is just free.

text: Die ryp doen vanaand sy rondtes en slaan niemand oor nie.
en: The frost is doing the rounds tonight and skipping nobody.
bt: The frost does its rounds tonight and skips nobody.

text: Beweeg stadig. Praat stadig. Oorleef.
en: Move slowly. Speak slowly. Survive.
bt: Move slowly. Talk slowly. Survive.

text: iimphuphuma
en: gusts
bt: [?iimphuphuma] (overflows/floods? dreams?)
note: unknown word; may mean overflows, not gusts

text: Kungani ushiye indlu? Ngempela.
en: Why did you leave the house? Honestly.
bt: Why did you leave the house? Seriously.

text: Vat 'n slukkie. Jou vingers kan 'n beurt kry.
en: Have a sip. Your fingers can take a turn.
bt: Take a sip. Your fingers can have a turn.

text: Cishe kunamafu amancane. Noma amaningi. Kunzima ukusho.
en: Probably a bit of cloud. Or a lot. Hard to call.
bt: Perhaps there are a few clouds. Or many. Hard to say.

text: Inja ibheka imvula sengathi inhlamba yomuntu siqu.
en: The dog is staring at the rain like it's a personal insult.
bt: The dog looks at the rain as if it were a personal insult.

text: Daardie lug sal hou vir die foto's — daarna, geen beloftes nie.
en: That sky will hold for the photographs — after that, no promises.
bt: That sky will hold for the photos; after that, no promises.

text: Die lug het daardie diep blou geword wat jy net so hoog bo seespieël kry.
en: The sky has gone that deep blue you only get this high above sea level.
bt: The sky has turned that deep blue you only get this high above sea level.

text: Mooi uitsig. Ons vat jou woord daarvoor.
en: Lovely view. We'll take your word for it.
bt: Lovely view. We'll take your word for it.

text: Damvlakke is die Kaap se eintlike Currie Cup.
en: Dam levels are the Cape's real Currie Cup.
bt: Dam levels are the Cape's real Currie Cup.

text: Hierdie weer het 'n lewensafrigter nodig.
en: This weather needs a life coach.
bt: This weather needs a life coach.

text: Pragtige uitsig. Vyandige lug.
en: Beautiful view. Hostile air.
bt: Beautiful view. Hostile sky.

text: Weather ine drama ifuna uCarte Blanche.
en: Weather so dramatic it needs a Carte Blanche segment.
bt: Weather [English word] has drama that wants Carte Blanche.

text: Nege-uur die aand en die plaveisel gee die middag nog terug.
en: Nine at night and the paving is still handing back the afternoon.
bt: Nine o'clock at night and the pavement is still giving back the afternoon.

text: Ixesha lokumba loo beanie imbi.
en: Time to dig out that ugly beanie.
bt: Time to dig out that bad/ugly beanie.

text: U-Eskom ufisa ukuba namandla anje.
en: Eskom wishes it had this power.
bt: Eskom pretends to have power like this.

text: Bring 'n baadjie. Of sonbrandroom. Of albei.
en: Bring a jacket. Or sunscreen. Or both.
bt: Bring a jacket. Or sunscreen. Or both.

text: Linamafu kancinci
en: Partly cloudy
bt: It has a few clouds.

text: Die wêreld eindig twee meter verby die hek.
en: The world ends two metres past the gate.
bt: The world ends two metres past the gate.

text: Fan ea siling e etsa sohle se matla, empa sohle sa eona ha se ea lekana.
en: The ceiling fan is doing its best, but its best is not enough.
bt: The ceiling fan does all its strength, but all of its own is not enough.

text: Isibhakabhaka sinombala wesiciko seTupperware esidala.
en: The sky is the colour of an old Tupperware lid.
bt: The sky is the colour of an old Tupperware lid.

text: Daardie een gloeilamp hou hierdie hele gebou aanmekaar.
en: That one bulb is holding this entire building together.
bt: That one light bulb holds this whole building together.

text: Die son is af tot een straal, en die hele veld kyk waar dit gaan land.
en: The sun is down to one beam and the whole veld is watching where it lands.
bt: The sun is down to one ray, and the whole veld watches where it will land.

text: Kumnandi
en: Pleasant
bt: It's pleasant / nice.

text: Dis 'n mooi dag om binne te wees.
en: It's a beautiful day to stay indoors.
bt: It's a nice day to be indoors.

text: Iintaba zithathe usuku lokuphumla namhlanje
en: The mountains are on holiday today.
bt: The mountains have taken a day of rest today.

text: E batla e le letsatsi la braai.
en: Almost a braai day.
bt: It is almost a braai day.

text: Perfekte weer vir n horror movie.
en: Perfect weather for a horror movie.
bt: Perfect weather for a horror movie.

text: Nul wolke. Nul verskonings. Nul kans dat ek binne bly.
en: Clear sky, clear diary. One of those is a lie.
bt: Zero clouds. Zero excuses. Zero chance I'm staying inside.

text: Kuhle kwaye koyikisa ngokulinganayo.
en: Beautiful and terrifying in equal measure.
bt: It is beautiful and frightening in equal measure.

text: Ukosa komuntu kusanda konakala.
en: Someone's braai just got ruined.
bt: Someone's braai has just spoiled.

text: Niemand gaan die temperatuur onthou nie, net die sproeier.
en: Nobody is going to remember the temperature, only the sprinkler.
bt: Nobody will remember the temperature, only the sprinkler.

text: Lieta tsa hao li tla ba le sun le lebe.
en: Your shoes are about to have a bad day.
bt: Your shoes will have a bad sun [English word 'sun'].

text: Koue soos dié laat 'n stap soos werk voel.
en: Cold like this makes a walk feel like work.
bt: Cold like this makes a walk feel like work.

text: Bel die tjommies. Kry die vleis. Kom ons gaan.
en: Call the mates. Get the meat. Let's go.
bt: Call the pals. Get the meat. Let's go.

text: Helder sonop: die fietsryklub is uit, en die koffiestop is klaar beplan.
en: Clear sunrise: the cycling club is out and the coffee stop is already planned.
bt: Bright sunrise: the cycling club is out, and the coffee stop is already planned.

text: Die voorstad gaan slaap onder 'n deksel, met een oranje naglampie wat nog brand.
en: The suburb is going to bed under a lid, with one orange nightlight left on.
bt: The suburb goes to sleep under a lid, with one orange night-light still burning.

text: Die see het heeltemal wit geword tot ver uit, en hy het dit voor almal opgemerk.
en: The sea has gone white all the way out and he noticed before anyone.
bt: The sea has turned completely white far out, and he noticed it before everyone.

text: Geen haas nie. Jy is geregtig om die afdraai te herken.
en: No rush. You're entitled to recognise the turn.
bt: No rush. You are entitled to recognise the turn-off.

text: Die baas kan vir een slag die sambreel vashou.
en: The boss can hold the umbrella for once.
bt: For once the boss can hold the umbrella.

text: Natuur wil 'n woordjie sê. Beste om te luister.
en: Nature's having a word. Best to listen.
bt: Nature wants to say a word. Best to listen.

text: Die mes het die buurt opgeëet.
en: The fog ate the neighbourhood.
bt: The knife ate up the neighbourhood.

text: Tsela ea Lebese
en: Milky Way
bt: Road of Milk (Milky Way)

text: Mathata a tšepo le lehodimo kajeno.
en: Trust issues with the sky today.
bt: Trust issues with the sky today.

text: Planne gekanselleer. Jy lyk verbasend verlig.
en: Plans cancelled. You seem surprisingly relieved.
bt: Plans cancelled. You look surprisingly relieved.

text: Skoon skemer. Gebruik dit voor dit uitklok.
en: Clear dusk. Use it before it clocks off.
bt: Clean dusk. Use it before it clocks out.

text: Neengabangaba zihamba ngeenyawo namhlanje.
en: Even the seagulls are walking today.
bt: Even the [?ingabangaba] walk on foot today.

text: Die plafonventilator probeer sy bes, maar sy bes is nie genoeg nie.
en: The ceiling fan is doing its best, but its best is not enough.
bt: The ceiling fan is trying its best, but its best is not enough.

text: Die voorruit het gisteraand se rekord behou, en sy vee dit met die hand uit.
en: The windscreen kept a record of last night and she is deleting it by hand.
bt: The windscreen kept last night's record, and she wipes it off by hand.

text: As jy dit kan lees, is jy te naby.
en: If you can read this, you're too close.
bt: If you can read this, you are too close.

text: Lakens gaan vandag in kartonvorm afgehaal word.
en: Those sheets are coming off the line in cardboard form.
bt: Sheets will be collected today in cardboard form.

text: Ho bonahala ho le hotle. Limodele le leholimo ha li lumellane kamehla.
en: Looks clear-ish. The models and the sky don't always agree.
bt: It looks lovely. The models and the sky do not always agree.

text: Karoo-nagmis: so skaars dat die dominee dit môre gaan noem.
en: Karoo night fog: rare enough that it'll get mentioned in church on Sunday.
bt: Karoo night-mist: so rare that the minister will mention it tomorrow.

text: Ne-GPS yakho iyadideka.
en: Even your GPS is confused.
bt: Even your GPS is confused.

text: Yebo, imvula ina ngecala. Yinto eqhelekileyo yaseMzantsi Afrika.
en: Yes, it's raining sideways. South Africa speciality.
bt: Yes, the rain falls sideways. It is a normal South African thing.

text: Son, dan wolk, dan son. Selfs die apies kan nie daarvolgens beplan nie.
en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.
bt: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the little monkey cannot plan by it.

text: Take neergeskryf. Sit liewer 'n potlood langsaan.
en: Jobs listed. Best put a pencil next to them.
bt: Tasks written down. Better put a pencil next to them.

text: Ama-hadedas amathathu, amagwababa amabili, nomuntu oyedwa oqhaqhazelayo ku-bird feeder.
en: Three hadedas, two crows, one shivering human at the bird feeder.
bt: Three hadedas, two crows, and one person shivering at the bird feeder.

text: Smeer weer aan of ly.
en: Reapply that sunscreen or suffer.
bt: Reapply or suffer.

text: Lula ka ntlong. Lithaba li ntse li le teng moo li leng teng.
en: Wait it out indoors. The mountains aren't going anywhere.
bt: Stay indoors. The mountains are still where they are.

text: Nditsho nabantu baseKapa bayavuma ukuba kuyabanda.
en: Even the Capetonians are admitting it's cold.
bt: Even the people of Cape Town admit that it is cold.

text: Bloemfontein ka 6 hosane: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, le pelo e tiileng.
en: Bloemfontein at 6am: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, and a brave face.
bt: Bloemfontein at 6 tomorrow: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, and a firm/strong heart.

text: Isibikezelo sithi mhlawumbe. Sithi cishe.
en: Forecast says maybe. We say probably.
bt: The forecast says maybe. It says roughly/nearly.

text: Marinade in. Foon af. Dag begin nou.
en: Marinade in. Phone off. Day starts now.
bt: Marinade in. Phone off. Day begins now.

text: Leholimo le bonahala le iponahatsa.
en: The sky looks like it's showing off.
bt: The sky seems to be showing itself off.

text: Jou baadjie weet beter as jou oë.
en: Your jacket knows better than your eyes.
bt: Your jacket knows better than your eyes.

text: Tsohle li shebahala 4K kajeno. Lehodimo le ultra mode.
en: Everything looks 4K today. The sky's in ultra mode.
bt: Everything looks 4K today. The sky is in ultra mode.

text: Hadedas tse tharo, makhoaba a mabeli, le motho a le mong ea thothomelang haufi le sebaka sa linonyana.
en: Three hadedas, two crows, one shivering human at the bird feeder.
bt: Three hadedas, two crows, and one person shivering near the bird place (feeder).

text: Net nog een laaste werkie voor huis toe, het jy gesê.
en: Just one last job before home, you said.
bt: Just one last little job before home, you said.

text: I-duvet iyiqondile into efunekayo.
en: The duvet understood the assignment.
bt: The duvet has understood what is needed.

text: Die wolke dreig maar bluf waarskynlik.
en: The clouds are threatening but probably bluffing.
bt: The clouds threaten but are probably bluffing.

text: Kufudumele ngokwanele ukuvula ifasitela. Unesibindi?
en: Warm enough to leave the window open. Brave enough?
bt: Warm enough to open the window. Are you brave?

text: Mofuta oa letsatsi o etsang hore o lebale load shedding.
en: The kind of day that makes you forget load shedding.
bt: The kind of sun that makes you forget load shedding.

text: Die hemel se gordyne is toe. Privaatheid, asseblief.
en: The sky's curtains are drawn. Privacy, please.
bt: The sky's curtains are closed. Privacy, please.

text: Isimo sezuluesinomdlalo esidinga i-Carte Blanche.
en: Weather so dramatic it needs a Carte Blanche segment.
bt: Weather that has drama and needs Carte Blanche.

text: Neem 'n oomblik. Kyk op. Plesier.
en: Take a moment. Look up. You're welcome.
bt: Take a moment. Look up. Pleasure.

text: Hulle het die ligte aangesit. Die mis het al die res afgesit.
en: They turned the lights on. Fog turned everything else off.
bt: They switched the lights on. The fog switched all the rest off.

text: Lug doen afskeep werk.
en: The sky's doing freelance today.
bt: Air doing sloppy/half-hearted work.

text: Stadig besig om 'n poel in die hoek te word.
en: Slowly becoming a puddle in the corner.
bt: Slowly becoming a puddle in the corner.

text: Jou enigste verantwoordelikheid is kies houtskool of hout.
en: Your only responsibility is choosing charcoal or wood.
bt: Your only responsibility is choosing charcoal or wood.

text: Lesi yisimo sezulu i-weekend eyenzelwe sona.
en: This is the weather the weekend was invented for.
bt: This is weather made for the weekend.

text: Jy sal droog word. Uiteindelik. Waarskynlik.
en: You'll dry. Eventually. Probably.
bt: You will get dry. Eventually. Probably.

text: Tšoara katiba ea hao! Le bana ba hao.
en: Hold onto your hat! And your kids.
bt: Hold your hat! And your children.

text: Heater ya koloi ke yona relationship ya bohlokwa ka ho fetisisa bophelong ba hao hona jaanong.
en: The car's heater is the most important relationship in your life right now.
bt: The car heater is the most important relationship in your life right now.
note: Setswana forms (jaanong, ya) and English heater/relationship

text: Lesi simo sezulu sinokuthi 'meh' kuyo yonke indawo.
en: This weather has 'meh' written all over it.
bt: This weather can say 'meh' everywhere.

text: Jou beste hou het gerieflik sonder getuies verbygegaan.
en: Your best shot has conveniently gone unwitnessed.
bt: Your best hold/stroke went by comfortably without witnesses.

text: Vandag swem selfs die mense wat 'net kom kyk het'.
en: Today even the people who 'just came to watch' are swimming.
bt: Today even the people who 'only came to look' swim.

text: Awujuluki. U-'glow'. Kulungile.
en: You're not sweating. You're 'glowing'. Sure.
bt: You are not sweating. You are 'glowing'. It's fine.

text: Bosiu bo bonahala bo khutsitse. Haeba limodele li lumela.
en: Night looks calm. Models permitting.
bt: The night looks quiet. If the models agree.

text: Wanneer die lug begin praat, hou al die res op.
en: When the sky starts talking, everything else stops.
bt: When the sky begins to speak, everything else stops.

text: Braai met musse op onder 'n kristalhelder lug: die winter kanselleer niks hier nie.
en: Braaiing in beanies under a hard clear sky: winter never cancelled anything here.
bt: Braai with beanies on under a crystal-clear sky: winter cancels nothing here.

text: Hoodie le boitšoaro. Ke kajeno.
en: A hoodie and an attitude. That's today.
bt: Hoodie and good behaviour/composure. It's today.

text: Elke venster wat aangaan is iemand wat besluit het: genoeg vir vandag.
en: Every window switching on is someone deciding: that's enough for today.
bt: Every window that lights up is someone who decided: enough for today.

text: Die skape het saamgebondel voor hy die hek oopgemaak het; hulle het die koue eerste gelees.
en: The sheep bunched before he opened the gate; they read the cold first.
bt: The sheep huddled together before he opened the gate; they read the cold first.

text: Steek die Weber aan. Dit is die wet.
en: Fire up the Weber. It's the law.
bt: Light the Weber. It's the law.

text: Uit vir vars lug. Terug vir 'n hele nuwe uitrusting.
en: Out for fresh air. Back for an entire outfit.
bt: Out for fresh air. Back for a whole new outfit.

text: Kancane ngiba yichibi ekhoneni.
en: Slowly becoming a puddle in the corner.
bt: Slowly I am becoming a pond in the corner.

text: Die koue front het darem 'n mooi kwitansie gelos.
en: At least the cold front left a beautiful receipt.
bt: The cold front did leave a nice receipt after all.

text: Ntoa ea aircon ea ofisi e qalile.
en: The office aircon war has begun.
bt: The office aircon war has started.

text: Amandla amakhulu esibhakabhaka. Impendulo encinci yomntu.
en: Big sky energy. Small human response.
bt: Great power of the sky. A small response from a person.

text: Die Boland word in sy slaap natgelê en morgen spog hy daaroor.
en: The Boland is getting watered in its sleep and will absolutely brag about it tomorrow.
bt: The Boland is put to bed wet in its sleep and tomorrow brags about it.

text: Die wolke het pienk geword net toe dit tyd was om op te pak. Niemand het opgepak nie.
en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.
bt: The clouds turned pink just when it was time to pack up. Nobody packed up.

text: Ha o bone `Add to Home Screen`? Tlanya `Edit Actions` ka tlase ho menyu ya Share, ebe u e nolofatsa.
bt: Don't you see 'Add to Home Screen'? Tap 'Edit Actions' at the bottom of the Share menu, then make it easy/loosen it.

text: Kae-kae tswiritswiri e binela ka matla.
en: Somewhere a cricket is really giving it.
bt: Here and there the cricket sings strongly.

text: Imvula iyeza, mhlawumbi.
en: Rain on the way, give or take.
bt: The rain is coming, maybe.

text: EWelkom, eSasolburg nase-Kroonstad amakhaza ayenza into yawo.
en: Welkom, Sasolburg, Kroonstad: the koue belt is doing its koue thing.
bt: In Welkom, Sasolburg and Kroonstad the cold does its thing.

text: Storm op die kaarte, nog nie bevestig nie. Bly skerp.
en: Storm on the cards, not yet confirmed. Stay sharp.
bt: Storm on the charts, not yet confirmed. Stay sharp.

text: Moenie daai wolke vertrou nie. Hulle beplan.
en: Don't trust those clouds. They're plotting.
bt: Don't trust those clouds. They are planning.

text: Letsatsi le o hlasela ka bo mong.
en: The sun is personally attacking you.
bt: The sun attacks you individually/alone.

text: Inkungu eqine kakhulu inezimvo.
en: Fog so thick it has opinions.
bt: Very thick fog has opinions.

text: Iemand het reggewens by die verjaarsdagkoek.
en: Somebody's birthday-candle wish just paid out.
bt: Someone has [?reggewens] at the birthday cake.

text: Ilanga emqolo wakho, i-freezer ebusweni bakho.
en: Sun on your back, freezer on your face.
bt: Sun on your back, freezer in your face.

text: Die fog het die buurt opgeëet.
en: The fog ate the neighbourhood.
bt: The fog ate up the neighbourhood.

text: Slaaptyd gemis. Die kinders nie.
en: Missed bedtime. The children have not.
bt: Bedtime missed. The children not (they did not miss it).

text: Die gewel het in driehonderd jaar erger gesien. Slaap gerus.
en: The gable has seen worse in three hundred years. Sleep easy.
bt: The gable has seen worse in three hundred years. Sleep well.

text: Jou duvet is uiteindelik op 'n afspraak uitgenooi.
en: Your duvet has finally been invited on a date.
bt: Your duvet has finally been invited on a date.

text: Igadi ikhona ngaphandle. Siyithemba inkqubo.
en: The garden is somewhere out there. We trust the process.
bt: The garden is outside. We trust the programme.

text: Dis nie wolke nie, dis 'n lokprent.
en: Those aren't clouds, that's a trailer.
bt: It's not clouds, it's a trailer.

text: Tšolla kofi kantle. Re tšepe.
en: Pour the coffee outside. Trust us.
bt: Pour out the coffee outside. Let's trust/hope.

text: Die maan kom tussen die wolke deur kuier. Hy ruik die vleis van daar bo af.
en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.
bt: The moon comes visiting between the clouds. He smells the meat from up there.

text: Vuur eerste. Dan bespreek ons ontbyt.
en: Fire first. Then we can discuss breakfast.
bt: Fire first. Then we'll discuss breakfast.

text: Hou jou hoed vas! En jou kinders.
en: Hold onto your hat! And your kids.
bt: Hold on to your hat! And your children.

text: Nie een meter skaduwee op hierdie promenade nie — dis hoekom hulle sesuur al uit is.
en: Not one metre of shade on this promenade, which is why they are out at six.
bt: Not one metre of shade on this promenade; that's why they are already out at six.

text: Nagskof weer: goedgekeur.
en: Night shift weather: approved.
bt: Night-shift weather: approved.

text: Die son skyn soos somer. Die lug het nie die memo gekry nie.
en: The sun is doing summer. The air didn't get the memo.
bt: The sun shines like summer. The air didn't get the memo.

text: Imvula ka-Schrödinger. Iyakhona futhi ayikho.
en: Schrodinger's rain. It both is and isn't.
bt: Schrödinger's rain. It is there and it is not.

text: 'n Bewolkte lug is 'n skilder se softbox — nie een harde skaduwee op daardie muur nie.
en: An overcast sky is a painter's softbox — not one hard shadow on that wall.
bt: A cloudy sky is a painter's softbox; not one hard shadow on that wall.

text: Inkulumo-mpikiswano ye-aircon yasehhovisi isanda kufinyelela izinga 5.
en: The office aircon debate just went to level 5.
bt: The office aircon debate has just reached level 5.

text: Halfpad na 'n Hoeveld bui. Of nie.
en: Halfway to a Highveld thunderstorm. Or not.
bt: Halfway to a Highveld shower/mood. Or not.

text: Alles lyk 4K vandag. Die lug is in ultra modus.
en: Everything looks 4K today. The sky's in ultra mode.
bt: Everything looks 4K today. The sky is in ultra mode.

text: Ngisho neNtaba yeThebula isiphumule.
en: Even Table Mountain's called it a day.
bt: Even Table Mountain has rested.

text: Aandete het nog 'n minuut in die oond nodig.
en: Supper will need another minute in the oven.
bt: Dinner needs another minute in the oven.

text: sefefo se atla
en: Storms rolling in.
bt: the storm [?atla] (increases/approaches?)

text: Warm-ish, waarskynlik. Hou die water naby.
en: Hot-ish, likely. Keep the water close.
bt: Warm-ish, probably. Keep the water close.

text: Jy was nog nooit so bly om jou hek te herken nie.
en: You've never been so pleased to recognise your gate.
bt: You have never been so glad to recognise your gate.

text: Die lug het die een gaping in die uitrusting gekry en hy maak dit met die hand toe.
en: The air found the one gap in the outfit and he is closing it by hand.
bt: The sky found the one gap in the outfit and closes it by hand.

text: Grimase ea hao e na le nako ea ho fela ea 9 hoseng.
en: Your makeup has an expiry date of 9am.
bt: Your grimace has an expiry time of 9 in the morning.

text: Die berg gloei soos 'n kaggel. Ongelukkig werk dit net vir die oe.
en: The mountain glows like a fireplace. Unfortunately it only warms the eyes.
bt: The mountain glows like a fireplace. Unfortunately it only works for the eye.

text: Die ryp is klaar besig. Teen dagbreek is die grasperk 'n spieël.
en: The frost has already started its shift. By dawn the lawn will be glass.
bt: The frost is already busy. By daybreak the lawn is a mirror.

text: Roomys is nie 'n lekkerny nie. Dis oorlewing.
en: Ice cream isn't a treat. It's survival.
bt: Ice cream is not a treat. It's survival.

text: Die hele veld met die kleur afgedraai. Die skape tel dieselfde, hoe ook al.
en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
bt: The whole veld with the colour turned off. The sheep count the same regardless.

text: Ja, dis truiweer. Dubbel trui.
en: Ja, it's jersey weather. Double jersey.
bt: Yes, it's jersey weather. Double jersey.

text: Die water is yskoud en almal maak of dit lekker is. Tradisie.
en: Atlantic rule: the water is freezing and everyone lies about it.
bt: The water is ice cold and everyone pretends it's nice. Tradition.

text: Hy gaan tot Vrydag pers in daardie baadjiesak kry.
en: He will be finding purple in that jacket pocket until Friday.
bt: He'll be finding [?pers] (purple/press) in that jacket pocket until Friday.

text: Die weer het binne gekies. Heeltemal reg ook.
en: The weather chose indoors. Correctly.
bt: The weather chose inside. Quite right too.

text: Dinsdag, en die wind het sterk menings oor iemand anders se uitrusting.
en: Tuesday, and the wind has strong opinions about somebody else's outfit.
bt: Tuesday, and the wind has strong opinions about someone else's outfit.

text: Umoya waseMzantsi-Mpuma ufike ungamenywanga njengesiqhelo
bt: The south-east wind arrived uninvited as usual.

text: Ontbyt kan wag. Om jou hande te voel kan nie.
en: Breakfast can wait. Feeling your hands can't.
bt: Breakfast can wait. Feeling your hands cannot.

text: Vensters-oop-weer het aangebreek, en die nuus het die motte bereik.
en: Windows-open weather has arrived, and word has reached the moths.
bt: Windows-open weather has arrived, and the news has reached the moths.

text: Die Vrystaat het pas onthou hy het 'n winter-setting.
en: The Free State just remembered it has a winter setting.
bt: The Free State just remembered it has a winter setting.

text: So koud dat die ryp middagete gebly het.
en: So cold the frost stayed for lunch.
bt: So cold that the frost stayed for lunch.

text: Nie eens koffie gaan dié bui regmaak nie.
en: Not even coffee is fixing this mood.
bt: Not even coffee will fix that mood.

text: Swem uitgestel. Jou verskonings het uiteindelik bewyse.
en: Swim postponed. Your excuses finally have evidence.
bt: Swim postponed. Your excuses finally have evidence.

text: Een kyk voor bed. Van hierdie kant van die glas.
en: One look before bed. From this side of the glass.
bt: One look before bed. From this side of the glass.

text: I-N1 manje yi-waterpark.
en: The N1 is now a waterpark.
bt: The N1 is now a waterpark.

text: Die bos vertel vanaand sy stories op fluistertoon.
en: Tonight the forest is telling its stories in a whisper.
bt: The forest tells its stories tonight in a whisper.

text: Stewels gepak. Die bene word nog oorreed.
en: Boots packed. Still negotiating with the legs.
bt: Boots packed. The legs are still being persuaded.

text: Te warm om binne te slaap, so die hele gesin het onder die Melkweg ingetrek.
en: Too warm to sleep inside, so the whole family moved under the Milky Way.
bt: Too warm to sleep inside, so the whole family moved in under the Milky Way.

text: Omakhelwane bakhona. Kubonakala kanjalo. Angikwazi ukuqinisekisa.
en: The neighbours exist. Apparently. Can't confirm.
bt: The neighbours are there. It seems so. I cannot confirm.

text: Die lug het die kleur geword wat Joburg na die group chat laat kyk.
en: The sky has gone the colour that makes Joburg check the group chat.
bt: The sky became the colour that makes Joburg look at the group chat.

text: Kyk vinnig. Teen môre is dit weg en niemand gaan jou glo nie.
en: Look quickly. By tomorrow it's gone and nobody will believe you.
bt: Look quickly. By tomorrow it's gone and nobody will believe you.

text: Ryp op die gras, stoom van die veld af: wintersdrafweer op sy eerlikste.
en: Frost on the grass, steam off the field: winter running weather at its most honest.
bt: Frost on the grass, steam off the field: winter running weather at its most honest.

text: Die wêreld het net... verdwyn.
en: The world just... disappeared.
bt: The world just... disappeared.

text: Die vlag doen sy vaderlandse plig teen omtrent sestig kilometer per uur.
en: The flag is doing its patriotic duty at about sixty kilometres an hour.
bt: The flag does its patriotic duty at about sixty kilometres per hour.

text: Mhlawumbi imvula, mhlawumbi hayi. Into eqhelekileyo.
en: Maybe rain, maybe not. Classic.
bt: Maybe rain, maybe not. A normal thing.

text: Koud genoeg om die baadjie-argument te beëindig.
en: Cold enough to end the jacket argument.
bt: Cold enough to end the jacket argument.

text: Melimo ea leholimo e a iponahatsa.
en: The weather gods are showing off.
bt: The gods/spirits of the sky show themselves.

text: Markdag in 'n stormwind: elke stalletjiehouer hou 'n gazebo vas.
en: Market day in a gale: every stallholder is holding down a gazebo.
bt: Market day in a storm wind: every stallholder is holding a gazebo.

text: Lehodimo ha le tsebe ho etsa qeto.
en: Sky can't make up its mind.
bt: The sky cannot make a decision.

text: Sefako se fihlile mme se tlisitse metsoalle.
en: The cold front is here and it brought friends.
bt: Hail has arrived and brought friends.
note: 'sefako' reads as hail; English says cold front

text: Die Karoo lieg nie oor die weer nie. Hy spog daarmee.
en: The Karoo doesn't lie about the weather. It brags about it.
bt: The Karoo doesn't lie about the weather. He brags about it.

text: Ons kuier buite in die koue want binne is dit, eerlikwaar, kouer.
en: We're visiting outside in the cold because inside is, honestly, colder.
bt: We socialise outside in the cold because inside it is, honestly, colder.

text: Een windvlaag, een muur, en twee huishoudings ken mekaar nou heelwat beter.
en: One gust, one wall, and two households now know each other much better.
bt: One gust, one wall, and two households now know each other a lot better.

text: Pienk lug, wit veld: die woestyn doen albei uiterstes voor ontbyt.
en: Pink sky, white veld: the desert runs both extremes before breakfast.
bt: Pink sky, white veld: the desert does both extremes before breakfast.

text: Een sonsopkoms, twee keer gebruik — een keer in die lug en een keer van die nat sand af.
en: One sunrise, used twice — once in the sky and once off the wet sand.
bt: One sunrise, used twice: once in the sky and once off the wet sand.

text: Nog 'n 'vinnige swem voor werk' — die Kaap se oudste leuen.
en: 'Quick dip before work.' Nobody in history has been quick.
bt: Another 'quick swim before work': the Cape's oldest lie.

text: Die aircon-afstandsbeheer is nou openbare eiendom. Onderhandel.
en: The aircon remote is now public property. Negotiate.
bt: The aircon remote is now public property. Negotiate.

text: Indlela eya kwii ndudumo. Mhlawumbi ayikho
en: Halfway to a Highveld thunderstorm. Or not.
bt: The road to the thunders. Maybe there isn't one.

text: Dit is die dag waaroor die brosjure gepraat het.
en: This is the day the brochure was talking about.
bt: This is the day the brochure talked about.

text: I-marinade ifakiwe. Ifowuni icinyiwe. Imini iqala ngoku.
en: Marinade in. Phone off. Day starts now.
bt: The marinade is in. The phone is switched off. The day starts now.

text: Umbane ubeka i-Eskom ehlazweni.
en: Lightning's putting Eskom's grid to shame.
bt: Electricity puts Eskom to shame.

text: Die kombers kom saam. Dis net die kombuis.
en: The blanket comes too. It's only the kitchen.
bt: The blanket comes along. It's just the kitchen.

text: Koffie-telling: styg. Motiverings-telling: steeds nul.
en: Coffee count: rising. Motivation count: still zero.
bt: Coffee count: rising. Motivation count: still zero.

text: Amafu amancane, ilanga elikhulu.
en: Halfway to a Highveld thunderstorm. Or not.
bt: Few clouds, big sun.
note: few clouds, big sun vs possible thunderstorm

text: Die temperatuur het saam met die son geval en die kring het presies soveel nader getrek.
en: The temperature dropped with the sun and the circle got tighter by exactly that much.
bt: The temperature fell along with the sun and the circle drew exactly that much closer.

text: Die lug sê nou al drie uur lank 'netnou'.
en: The sky's been saying 'just now' for three hours.
bt: The sky has been saying 'in a bit' for three hours now.
