text: Iemand se weerberig het pas baie langer geword.
en: Somebody's weather report just got a lot longer.
bt: Someone's weather report just got a lot longer.

text: Mis is op die kaarte. Die lug is skaam daaroor.
en: Fog's on the cards. The sky's being coy about it.
bt: Fog is on the charts. The sky is shy about it.

text: Skoene aan. 'n Merkwaardige vermorsing van moeite.
en: Shoes on. A remarkable waste of effort.
bt: Shoes on. A remarkable waste of effort.

text: Inja ijonga imvula ngathi iyithuka buqu.
en: The dog is staring at the rain like it's a personal insult.
bt: The dog looks at the rain as if insulting it personally.

text: Die plaveisel absorbeer niks meer nie en gee dit net aan.
en: The paving has stopped absorbing anything and is just passing it along.
bt: The pavement absorbs nothing more and just passes it on.

text: Foon weg. Die volgende een kan jy self kyk.
en: Phone away. You can watch the next one yourself.
bt: Phone away. The next one you can look at yourself.

text: Bloemfontein om 6vm: trui, kamerjas, serp, takkies, en 'n gesig wat maak of alles fine is.
en: Bloemfontein at 6am: jersey, gown, scarf, takkies, and a brave face.
bt: Bloemfontein at 6am: jersey, dressing gown, scarf, takkies, and a face pretending everything is fine.

text: Slaaptyd kan wag. Niemand is in elk geval daarvoor aangetrek nie.
en: Bedtime can wait. Nobody is dressed for it anyway.
bt: Bedtime can wait. Nobody is dressed for it anyway.

text: Imvula iyeza, cishe.
en: Rain on the way, give or take.
bt: The rain is coming, roughly/nearly.

text: Lo ngunobangelawokuba uNoah okhe uMkhombe.
en: This is why Noah built a boat.
bt: This is the cause that Noah [?okhe] the Ark.

text: Die wolke bly oor vir aandete, lyk dit.
en: Looks like the clouds are staying for supper.
bt: The clouds are staying for dinner, it seems.

text: ho nale maru
en: Cloudy vibes.
bt: there are clouds

text: Net n halwe koppie wolke vir vandag se resep.
en: Clouds, but make it casual.
bt: Just half a cup of clouds for today's recipe.

text: Cishe izulu lihle. Iwindi lakho yilo elinegunya lokugcina.
en: Probably clear. Your window's the final say.
bt: The weather is probably nice. Your window is the one with the final authority.

text: Isibhakabhaka sithule. Akukho mntu ukhalazayo.
en: The sky's on mute. Nobody's complaining.
bt: The sky is quiet. Nobody is complaining.

text: Die berg is daar êrens, toegedraai vir die winter.
en: The mountain is in there somewhere, wrapped up for the winter.
bt: The mountain is out there somewhere, wrapped up for the winter.

text: Ukosa kukhanselelwe. Yebo, ngempela.
en: The braai is cancelled. Yes, really.
bt: [?Ukosa] has been cancelled. Yes, truly.
note: ukosa not confirmed as braai in back-translation

text: Die wolke het die sonsondergang gevat en die voorstad die pienk kleingeld gelos.
en: The clouds took the sunset and left the suburb the pink change.
bt: The clouds took the sunset and left the suburb the pink small change.

text: Daardie stoep het stoele op en nie een gaan voor sesuur gebruik word nie.
en: That stoep has chairs on it and none of them will be used before six.
bt: That stoep has chairs out and not one will be used before six.

text: E lokile ho se etse letho.
en: Perfect for doing absolutely nothing.
bt: It is fine to do nothing.

text: Kungani wena-wesikhathi-esidlule wenze izinhlelo? Wena-wesikhathi-esidlule mubi.
en: Why did past-you make plans? Past-you is the worst.
bt: Why did past-you make plans? Past-you is [?mubi] (bad).

text: Iketile isebenza ngaphezu kwakhe wonke umntu namhlanje.
en: The kettle is working harder than anyone today.
bt: The kettle is working harder than everyone today.

text: Modumo o haufi mabota a thothomela. Hlompho.
en: Thunder so close the walls shook. Respect.
bt: Thunder is near, the walls are shaking. Respect.

text: Saterdagaand, en die stap van die voordeur af het die hele look verwoes.
en: Saturday evening, and the walk from the front door defeated the whole look.
bt: Saturday evening, and the walk from the front door ruined the whole look.

text: Iewers doen 'n boer nou 'n klein dansie wat niemand mag sien nie.
en: Somewhere a farmer is doing a small private dance nobody's allowed to see.
bt: Somewhere a farmer is now doing a little dance that nobody may see.

text: Selfs Google Maps is vaag vandag.
en: Even Google Maps is being vague today.
bt: Even Google Maps is vague today.

text: 'n Helder aand betaal omtrent veertig minute goud uit, en dit het pas begin.
en: A clear evening pays out about forty minutes of gold, and it has just started.
bt: A clear evening pays out about forty minutes of gold, and it has only just begun.

text: Daar gaan die duur wekker.
en: So much for that expensive alarm clock.
bt: There goes the expensive alarm clock.

text: Trek aan soos 'n aalwyn: lae op lae, en bly staan.
en: Dress like an aloe: layers on layers, and refuse to fall over.
bt: Dress like an aloe: layer upon layer, and stand your ground.

text: Skemer op mute vanaand. Die avond het nogtans opgedaag.
en: Dusk is on mute tonight. The evening showed up anyway.
bt: Twilight on mute tonight. The evening showed up all the same.

text: Ilanga lidlala umcacamezelo.
en: Sun's playing peek-a-boo.
bt: The sun is playing [?umcacamezelo] (shimmer? twinkle?).

text: Nie een ster het deur daardie deksel gekom nie, en niemand het dit nog agtergekom nie.
en: Not one star made it through that lid, and nobody has noticed yet.
bt: Not one star got through that lid, and nobody has noticed yet.

text: iWelkom iyabanda namhlanje. Okwakubanda kuphumela kwii-jersey ezintathu ingathi azikho.
en: Welkom-cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
bt: Welkom is cold today. What was cold ends up in three jerseys as if they weren't there.

text: Jy kan die draf met 'n skoon gewete oorslaan.
en: You can skip the run with a clear conscience.
bt: You can skip the jog with a clear conscience.

text: Sefako
en: Hail
bt: Hail

text: Karoo-blou: presies dieselfde perfekte kleur van hier tot môre.
en: Karoo sky: same flawless blue for the next 400 km. Guaranteed.
bt: Karoo blue: exactly the same perfect colour from here to tomorrow.

text: Jou baadjie vergeet? Die heelal het opgemerk.
en: Forgot your jacket? The universe noticed.
bt: Forgot your jacket? The universe noticed.

text: Vyf minute se sterrekyk. Dan terug binnetoe vir ewig.
en: Five minutes of stargazing. Then back inside forever.
bt: Five minutes of stargazing. Then back inside for ever.

text: Daardie een liggie is iemand wat winter reg doen: hut, vuur, klaar.
en: That one little light is someone doing winter correctly: hut, fire, done.
bt: That one little light is someone doing winter right: hut, fire, done.

text: Die skoolrit behels nou om die skool te vind.
en: The school run now involves finding the school.
bt: The school run now involves finding the school.

text: Bosiu bo hlakileng.
en: Clear night.
bt: A clear night.

text: Bewolkte skemer. Mooi, maar belowe niks.
en: Cloudy dusk. Pretty, not promising.
bt: Cloudy twilight. Pretty, but promises nothing.

text: Die son is wakker. Jy probeer nog uitstel.
en: The sun's awake. You're still negotiating.
bt: The sun is awake. You are still trying to put it off.

text: Lula u bolokehile. Lehodimo le etsa ntlha.
en: Stay safe. The sky is making a point.
bt: Stay safe. The sky is [?making a point].

text: Die sand steek die pad oor, een korrel op 'n slag. Niemand hier het haas nie.
en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.
bt: The sand crosses the road, one grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.

text: Jy gaan soos 'n kreef lyk. Jy is gewaarsku.
en: You will look like a lobster. You've been warned.
bt: You are going to look like a crayfish. You have been warned.

text: Mpunga, mhlawumbi. Sakha sabona kusothusa.
en: Grey, probably. We've seen it surprise us.
bt: Grey, perhaps. We have just seen it is startling.

text: Ilanga emhlane wakho, i-freezer ebusweni bakho.
en: Sun on your back, freezer on your face.
bt: Sun on your back, freezer in your face.

text: Die donder dreun.
en: Thunder's grumbling, hey.
bt: The thunder rumbles.

text: Niemand dra water nie, en dit is 'n besluit wat hulle weer gaan oorweeg.
en: Nobody is carrying water, which is a decision they are going to revisit.
bt: Nobody is carrying water, and it is a decision they are going to reconsider.

text: Daardie vuur is aangesteek voor iemand dit nodig gehad het — dis wat 'n skoon aand doen.
en: That fire was lit before anybody needed it, which is what a clear evening does.
bt: That fire was lit before anyone needed it - that is what a clear evening does.

text: Iindudumo ziyagquma.
en: Thunder's grumbling, hey.
bt: The thunders are booming.

text: Tienuur se mis maak elke straat 'n fliekstel.
en: Ten pm fog turns every street into a film set.
bt: Ten o'clock fog turns every street into a film set.

text: Lieta tsa hao li tla ba le lesedi le lebe.
en: Your shoes are about to have a bad day.
bt: Your shoes will have a bad [?lesedi] (light?).
note: lesedi reads as light, not day

text: Wolke is hier. Hoeveel is oop vir debat.
en: Cloud's around. How much is up for debate.
bt: Clouds are here. How many is open for debate.

text: Jakarandas doen dit net drie weke 'n jaar, en die lug het besluit om te pas.
en: Jacarandas only do this three weeks a year, and the sky decided to match.
bt: Jacarandas do this only three weeks a year, and the sky decided to match.

text: Die kat wil praat met wie ook al dit bespreek het.
en: The cat would like to speak to whoever booked this.
bt: The cat wants to talk to whoever booked this.

text: Dit is die eerste uur sedert ontbyt dat tuinwerk oorleefbaar is.
en: This is the first hour since breakfast that lawn work has been survivable.
bt: This is the first hour since breakfast that gardening is survivable.

text: Iislipas, iibhulukhwe ezimfutshane, ilanga. Imanyano emithathu.
en: Slip-slops, shorts, sun. The trinity.
bt: Slippers, short trousers, sun. Three [?imanyano] (unions/combinations).

text: Lebaka la hao la ho dula ka hare le sa tsoa fela.
en: Your excuse to stay inside just expired.
bt: Your reason for staying inside has just now run out.

text: Die dag het elke uur lig opgebruik en het steeds dít oorgehad.
en: The day used up every hour of light and still had this left over.
bt: The day used up every hour of light and still had this left over.

text: Lena ke leholimo leo re le iponelang lichaba.
en: This is the weather we brag about overseas.
bt: This is the sky that we see for ourselves, [?lichaba] (nations?).
note: brag about overseas missing; different image

text: Izandla zakho zisemaphaketheni futhi azibuyi.
en: Your hands are in your pockets and they're not coming out.
bt: Your hands are in your pockets and are not coming back.

text: Om jou eie hek te vind, tel nou as die eerste taak.
en: Finding your own gate now counts as the first errand.
bt: Finding your own gate now counts as the first task.

text: Mhlawumbi iza kuna, mhlawumbi cha. Into eqhelekileyo leyo.
en: Maybe rain, maybe not. Classic.
bt: Maybe it will rain, maybe not. That is the usual thing.

text: Vrystaat-skemer: die mooiste tien minute van die koudste aand.
en: Free State dusk: the most beautiful ten minutes of the coldest night.
bt: Free State twilight: the prettiest ten minutes of the coldest evening.

text: Helder lug met sononder: tyd om die kar toe te maak voor die ryp dit doen.
en: Clear sky at sunset: time to tuck the car in before the frost does.
bt: Clear sky at sunset: time to shut the car away before the frost does it.

text: Ungacabangi ngishongokushayela ndawo.
en: Don't even think about driving somewhere.
bt: Don't think I [?ngishongokushayela] somewhere.

text: Iemand het gesê die padkos sal oukei wees in die kattebak. Iemand was mis.
en: Somebody said the padkos would be fine in the boot. Somebody was wrong.
bt: Someone said the padkos would be OK in the boot. Someone was wrong.

text: Jou kar is daarbuite. Iewers. Waarskynlik.
en: Your car is out there. Somewhere. Probably.
bt: Your car is out there. Somewhere. Probably.

text: Die son lê al van vanoggend af op daardie planke, en die hond doen die oudit.
en: The sun has been on those boards since morning and the dog is doing the audit.
bt: The sun has been lying on those planks since this morning, and the dog is doing the audit.

text: Okungenani ingadi iyajabula. Othile kumele ajabule.
en: At least the garden's happy. Someone has to be.
bt: At least the garden is happy. Someone has to be happy.

text: Tasse reg. Die bus hou sy ligging vaag.
en: Bags ready. The bus is keeping its location vague.
bt: Bags in order. The bus keeps its location vague.

text: Die reën was die waarskuwing. Dit is die opvolg.
en: Rain was the warning. This is the follow-through.
bt: The rain was the warning. This is the follow-up.

text: Ipavimente ngumlambo kwaye umlambo unezicwangciso.
en: The pavement is a river and the river has plans.
bt: The pavement is a river and the river has plans.

text: Waarskynlik iets aan die brou. Bly naby 'n dak.
en: Probably brewing something. Stay close to a roof.
bt: Probably something brewing. Stay near a roof.

text: Elektriese kombers weer vergeet om vooraf aan te sit. Elke. Enkele. Aand.
en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.
bt: Forgot again to switch the electric blanket on beforehand. Every. Single. Evening.

text: Die wasgoed gaan nie droog word nie. Ons hang dit op vir die hoop.
en: The washing is not going to dry. We hang it up for hope.
bt: The washing is not going to dry. We hang it out for the hope of it.

text: Almal is skielik jou vriend as jy 'n swembad het.
en: Everyone's suddenly your friend when you have a pool.
bt: Everyone is suddenly your friend when you have a swimming pool.

text: Izimbadada, amabhulukwe amafushane, ilanga. Inhlangano emithathu.
en: Slip-slops, shorts, sun. The trinity.
bt: Sandals, shorts, sun. A gathering/union of three.

text: Die stof gaan êrens heen en dit vra nie verlof nie.
en: The dust is going somewhere and it is not asking permission.
bt: The dust is going somewhere and does not ask permission.

text: Selfs die kortpad huis toe voel ambisieus.
en: Even the short way home feels ambitious.
bt: Even the shortcut home feels ambitious.

text: Die oggend het vergeet om te laai.
en: The morning forgot to render.
bt: The morning forgot to charge.

text: Maandagaand, een verligte venster, en die reën doen al die praatwerk.
en: Monday night, one lit window, and the rain doing all the talking.
bt: Monday evening, one lit window, and the rain does all the talking.

text: I-UV iphezulu kakhulu.
en: UV's hectic.
bt: The UV is very high.

text: Susa izinto eziphakwe ku-elektriki. Isibhakabhaka sinezinhlelo.
en: Unplug the things. The sky has plans.
bt: Remove the things served/dished onto [?elektriki] (electric?). The sky has plans.

text: Die lug is oorgetrek. Jou bed ook. Toeval? Nooit.
en: The sky is under the covers. Yours are waiting. Coincidence? Never.
bt: The sky is overcast. So is your bed. Coincidence? Never.

text: Niemand in daardie huis is al wakker nie, en dit is presies die plan.
en: Nobody inside that house is awake yet and that is entirely the plan.
bt: Nobody in that house is awake yet, and that is exactly the plan.

text: Isichotho
en: Hail
bt: Hail

text: Panele geïnstalleer, son afwesig: die lug skuld hierdie dak 'n verskoning.
en: Panels installed, sun absent: the sky owes this roof an apology.
bt: Panels installed, sun absent: the sky owes this roof an apology.

text: Geniet dit. Die koue front het klaar sy tasse gepak.
en: Enjoy it. There's a cold front out there doing warm-ups.
bt: Enjoy it. The cold front has already packed its bags.
note: cold front leaving instead of arriving

text: Moenie eers dink om iewers heen te ry niet.
en: Don't even think about driving somewhere.
bt: Don't even think about driving anywhere.

text: Perfekte weer om iemand raak te loop wat jy 'nog wou bel'.
en: Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.
bt: Perfect weather to bump into someone you 'still wanted to call'.

text: Lehodimo le mahareng a maikutlo.
en: Indecisive sky energy.
bt: The sky in the midst of feelings.

text: Yilinde ngaphakathi le meko. Iintaba azisayi ndawo
en: Wait it out indoors. The mountains aren't going anywhere.
bt: Wait inside in this situation. The mountains are going nowhere.

text: Ha o bone `Add to Home Screen`? Tobetsa `Edit Actions` ka tlase ho menyu ya Share, ebe u e nolofatsa.
bt: Don't you see `Add to Home Screen`? Tap `Edit Actions` at the bottom of the Share menu, and then [?ease/loosen] it.

text: Dieselfde straat. Skielik wil jy die huisnommer hê.
en: Same street. Suddenly you want the house number.
bt: Same street. Suddenly you want the house number.

text: Perfekte verskoning om planne te kanselleer.
en: Perfect excuse to cancel plans.
bt: Perfect excuse to cancel plans.

text: Uqikelelo lwanamhlanje: aluvuthwanga kakuhle
en: Today's forecast: medium rare.
bt: Today's forecast: not properly cooked/ripened.

text: Die son doen sy admin buite. Hitte is nie deel van die pakket nie.
en: The sun is doing admin out here. Heat was not part of the package.
bt: The sun is doing its admin outside. Heat is not part of the package.

text: Kofi ea hao ea leqhoa e qhibilihile pele o fihla koloing.
en: Your iced coffee melted before you reached the car.
bt: Your iced coffee has melted before you reach the car.

text: Waarskynlik kil. Die Boland-oggende doen dit.
en: Probably nippy. The Boland mornings do this.
bt: Probably chilly. The Boland mornings do that.

text: Imoto yakho ikhona ngaphandle. Ndaweni ithile. Mhlawumbi.
en: Your car is out there. Somewhere. Probably.
bt: Your car is outside. Somewhere. Maybe.

text: Hoa bata, weather le hlakile
en: Cold but clear
bt: It is cold, the weather is clear.

text: Vol son, sigbare asem: die Karoo speel albei seisoene af voor middagete.
en: Full sun, visible breath: the Karoo running both seasons before lunch.
bt: Full sun, visible breath: the Karoo plays both seasons before lunch.

text: Reën só hard, selfs die taxi's sit hul flikkers aan.
en: Rain this hard, even the taxis start indicating.
bt: Rain so hard even the taxis switch on their hazards.

text: Weer koud. Die kar se verwarmer bedoel dit goed.
en: Cold again. The car heater means well.
bt: Cold again. The car's heater means well.

text: Kunokuba nomoya onamandla ngamaxesha athile. Uqikelelo aluqinisekanga kule meko
en: Could get gusty. The forecast's a bit loose on this one.
bt: There may be strong wind at certain times. The forecast is not certain in this situation.

text: Die hond is nog steeds keen. Die hond is altyd keen. Respek.
en: The dog is still keen. The dog is always keen. Respect.
bt: The dog is still keen. The dog is always keen. Respect.

text: Dula o na le metsi kapa o   fetohe sehwapa
en: Stay hydrated or become a biltong.
bt: Stay with water or you turn into [?sehwapa] (an armpit?) by evening.

text: Vrydag, en die klammigheid en die wind het teen almal saamgespan.
en: Friday, and the humidity has teamed up with the wind against everybody.
bt: Friday, and the humidity and the wind teamed up against everyone.

text: Son
en: Sun
bt: [?Son] (sun)

text: Imozulu esibi kakhulu
en: Severe weather
bt: Very bad weather

text: Die mis is so dik dat selfs die robot nie kleur wil beken nie.
en: The fog is so thick even the robot is hedging its bets.
bt: The fog is so thick that even the traffic light won't admit a colour.

text: Umhlaba nje... wanyamalala.
en: The world just... disappeared.
bt: The earth just... vanished.

text: Bamba umnqwazi wakho! Nabantwana bakho.
en: Hold onto your hat! And your kids.
bt: Hold on to your hat! And your children too.

text: Die lig is oor nege minute weg en niemand haas hom nie.
en: The light will be gone in nine minutes and nobody is hurrying.
bt: The light is gone in nine minutes and nobody is hurrying.

text: Jasse en koffies in vol son: winter in hierdie stad lyk op foto's soos somer.
en: Coats and coffees in full sun: winter in this city photographs like summer.
bt: Scarves and coffees in full sun: winter in this city looks like summer in photos.

text: Isimo sezulu esibi kakhulu
en: Severe weather
bt: Very bad weather

text: Kunokuba mhlophe yinkungu. Lumka.
en: Could go misty. The dew point's flirting with it.
bt: It may be white with fog. Be careful.

text: Niemand het nog aan daardie kardeur geraak nie en elkeen van hulle weet hoekom.
en: Nobody has touched that car door and every one of them knows why.
bt: Nobody has touched that car door yet and every one of them knows why.

text: Selfs die skape se kuiwe lê vandag agteroor.
en: Even the sheep are wearing their fringes slicked back today.
bt: Even the sheep's forelocks lie backwards today.

text: Reën is moontlik. So is om heeltemal verkeerd te wees.
en: Rain's possible. So is being completely wrong.
bt: Rain is possible. So is being completely wrong.

text: Izicwangciso zanamhlanje: phila ngaphandle.
en: Today's plans: exist outside.
bt: Today's plans: live outside.

text: Die teer het sag geword. Ons ook.
en: The tar's gone soft. So have we.
bt: The tar has gone soft. So have we.

text: Lehodimo le re hopotsa hore ke mang monga'a.
en: The sky's reminding us who's boss.
bt: The sky reminds us who its owner is.

text: Jy het daardie trui nodiger as wat hy 'n was nodig het.
en: You need that jersey more than it needs washing.
bt: You need that jersey more than it needs a wash.

text: Onder dié lug is 'n tweede koffie nie 'n luukse nie, dis prosedure.
en: Under this sky a second coffee isn't a luxury, it's procedure.
bt: Under this sky a second coffee is not a luxury, it is procedure.

text: Selfs die skape se kuiwe le vandag agteroor.
en: Even the sheep are wearing their fringes slicked back today.
bt: Even the sheep's forelocks lie backwards today.

text: Waatlemoenweer: die hele provinsie het teen omtrent tienuur vanoggend saamgestem.
en: Watermelon weather: the whole province agreed on it by about ten this morning.
bt: Watermelon weather: the whole province voted by around ten this morning.

text: Elke blaar in die straat staan tou om in daardie kar te kom.
en: Every leaf in the street is queueing to get into that car.
bt: Every leaf in the street is queueing to get into that car.

text: O ka besa steak holim'a pavement gona joale.
en: You could braai a steak on the pavement right now.
bt: You could roast a steak on the pavement right now.

text: Ikhrimu yelanga ayisosikhetho, boet.
en: Sunscreen is not optional, boet.
bt: Sun cream is not optional, boet.

text: Nog 'n rondte. Hierdie keer met handvatsels.
en: Another round. With handles this time.
bt: Another round. This time with handles.

text: Geyser e tripile bosiu. Ehlile e entse jwalo.
en: The geyser tripped overnight. Of course it did.
bt: The geyser tripped in the night. It really did.

text: Drie jaar se droogte-geheue en skielik is elke bui 'n lotto-wen.
en: One drought in living memory and now every downpour is a lottery win.
bt: Three years of drought memory and suddenly every shower is a lotto win.

text: Amafu akho, ilanga likho. Umlinganiselo ukuqashelo.
en: Some cloud, some sun. The ratio's anyone's guess.
bt: Your clouds, your sun. The balance/ratio is [?ukuqashelo].

text: Ubusuku obucwebile.
en: Clear night.
bt: A glistening/sparkling night.

text: Karoo morning. Mofuta o etsang hore o hlomphe molemi e mong le e mong ya kgethileng bophelo bona.
en: Karoo morning. The kind that makes you respect every farmer who chose this.
bt: Karoo morning. The kind that makes you respect every farmer who has chosen this life.
note: English phrase Karoo morning left in

text: Kar geparkeer. Nou moet jy met die veiligheidsgordel onderhandel.
en: Car parked. Now to negotiate with the seat belt.
bt: Car parked. Now you have to negotiate with the seatbelt.

text: Die lug hakkel.
en: The sky is buffering.
bt: The sky stutters.

text: Imvula inokwenzeka. Nokuba siphazame ngokupheleleyo kunokwenzeka.
en: Rain's possible. So is being completely wrong.
bt: Rain is possible. Even that we are completely [?siphazame] (mistaken) is possible.

text: Impahla yakho iphaphathekele kwamelwane.
en: Your washing just moved to the neighbour's yard.
bt: Your laundry has blown away to the neighbours.

text: Jou aandstap kan by die voordeur eindig.
en: Your evening walk can end at the front door.
bt: Your evening walk may end at the front door.

text: Die soort dag wat jou laat vergeet van beurtkrag.
en: The kind of day that makes you forget load shedding.
bt: The kind of day that makes you forget about load shedding.

text: Mhlawumbi iya kuna.
en: Might rain.
bt: Maybe it will rain.

text: Sigbaarheid: basies nul.
en: Visibility: basically zero.
bt: Visibility: basically zero.

text: Lekhetho la sekhele le se le sebetsa.
en: The umbrella tax is now in effect.
bt: The tax of [?sekhele] is now working.

text: Imvula? Kunokwenzeka. Ukuzibophelela? Soze.
en: Rain? Possibly. Commitment? Never.
bt: Rain? Possible. Commitment? Never.

text: Letsatsi le tla le tsamaee.
en: Cloud cover with main-character syndrome.
bt: The sun will come and go.
note: sun comes and goes; not cloud cover

text: Ewe, kuyana ngenhlangothi. Okukhethekile kweNingizimu Afrika.
en: Yes, it's raining sideways. South Africa speciality.
bt: Yes, it rains on one side. A South African special.

text: Isibhakabhaka asinqumanga. Nathi futhi.
en: The sky's undecided. So are we.
bt: The sky has not decided. Neither have we.

text: Sy kyk nie na die wasgoed nie, sy kyk waar dit dalk gaan land.
en: She is not looking at the washing, she is looking at where it might land.
bt: She isn't looking at the washing, she is looking at where it might land.

text: Leholimo la libhulukoe tse khutšoanyane? Lena ke leholimo la lipanty.
en: Shorts weather? This is underwear weather.
bt: Short-trousers weather? This is panty weather.

text: Goeie dag vir n stap, slegste dag vir n tan.
en: Good day for a walk, bad day for a tan.
bt: Good day for a walk, worst day for a tan.

text: Izihlangu zakho ziza ngoba nosuku olubi.
en: Your shoes are about to have a bad day.
bt: Your shoes are coming because and bad day [garbled; probably: your shoes will have a bad day].
note: ziza ngoba nosuku olubi does not parse

text: Pool ea baahisane ha e e-s'o shebahale e khahlisang hakana.
en: The neighbours' pool has never looked so tempting.
bt: The neighbours' pool does not yet look so appealing.
note: not yet tempting instead of never so tempting

text: Duvet e utloisitse mosebetsi.
en: The duvet understood the assignment.
bt: The duvet has understood the assignment.

text: umhlaba uphela kwiimitha ezimbini ngaphesheya kwesango.
en: The world ends two metres past the gate.
bt: The world ends two metres beyond the gate.

text: Haeba u sebetsa kajeno, re u utloela bohloko.
en: If you're working today, we feel sorry for you.
bt: If you work today, we feel sorry for you.

text: Yingakho sihlala eNingizimu Afrika.
en: This is why we live in South Africa.
bt: That is why we live in South Africa.

text: Isibane sivele saba yi-Carte Blanche ngokupheleleyo.
en: The sky just went full Carte Blanche.
bt: The light/lamp just became Carte Blanche completely.

text: Jy het jouself 'n draf belowe, nie entoesiasme nie.
en: You promised yourself a run, not enthusiasm.
bt: You promised yourself a jog, not enthusiasm.

text: Die wind het in vier sekondes weggewaai wat twee uur geneem het om te bou.
en: It took the wind four seconds to move what took two hours to build.
bt: In four seconds the wind blew away what took two hours to build.

text: Isimbo seenwele zakho? Simkile. Yamkela.
en: Your hairstyle? Gone. Accept it.
bt: Your hairstyle? It's gone. Accept it.

text: Ho motle haholo kantle.
en: Absolutely beautiful out there.
bt: It is very nice outside.

text: Daardie lug weier om kleur te beken, so hy het vir albei sy buie voorberei gekom.
en: That sky refuses to commit, so he came prepared for both of its moods.
bt: That sky refuses to admit a colour, so it came prepared for both its moods.

text: Niemand steek daardie Weber aan voor dit gaan lê nie, en almal op die werf weet dit.
en: Nobody is lighting that Weber until this drops, and everyone in the yard knows it.
bt: Nobody lights that Weber before it lies down (dies down), and everyone in the yard knows it.

text: Ha se leholimo la Instagram. Ha se qetello ea lefatše.
en: Not Instagram weather. Not the end of the world.
bt: It is not Instagram weather. It is not the end of the world.

text: Die kantoor aircon debat het nou vlak 5 bereik.
en: The office aircon debate just went to level 5.
bt: The office aircon debate has now reached level 5.

text: Jy kan dapper wees sodra die hond jou glo.
en: You can be brave once the dog believes you.
bt: You can be brave once the dog believes you.

text: Daardie lug doen sy hele vertoning oor 'n see te plat om hom te steur.
en: That sky is doing its whole show over a sea too flat to interrupt it.
bt: That sky does its whole show over a sea too flat to bother it.

text: Isizathu esihle sokurhoxisa izicwangciso.
en: Perfect excuse to cancel plans.
bt: A good reason to cancel plans.

text: Petrichor is die Griekse woord. Wij woord is 'sjoe'.
en: Petrichor is the Greek word for it. Our word is 'sjoe'.
bt: Petrichor is the Greek word. [?Wij] word is 'wow'.
note: Wij is Dutch; Afrikaans is ons

text: Isibhakabhaka sinikeza 'ngizozama kusasa' amandla.
en: The sky's giving 'I'll try again tomorrow' energy.
bt: The sky gives 'I'll try tomorrow' strength.

text: Izicathulo zakho zizoba nosuku olubi.
en: Your shoes are about to have a bad day.
bt: Your shoes will have a bad day.

text: Amandla angoMgqibelo: aphezulu. Imisebenzi: iphansi.
en: Saturday energy: maximum. Responsibilities: minimum.
bt: Saturday energy: high. Chores: low.

text: Umoya uphezulu
en: Wind's up.
bt: The wind is high.

text: Isibhakabhaka esinemibono eminingi.
en: Indecisive sky energy.
bt: A sky with many opinions.

text: Mooiste dag van die winter. Voel soos die koudste een.
en: Prettiest day of winter. Feels like the coldest one.
bt: Prettiest day of the winter. Feels like the coldest one.

text: Wind unenzondo yomuntu siqu ngezambulela.
en: The wind has a personal vendetta against umbrellas.
bt: Wind has a personal grudge against umbrellas.

text: Ukubonakala kuxhaswe ngubani. Muntu.
en: Visibility sponsored by nobody.
bt: Visibility is supported by who. [?Muntu] (person).

text: Perfekte wasgoedweer. Die wasgoed gaan droog word én bevries.
en: Perfect drying weather. The washing will dry and freeze, in that order.
bt: Perfect washing weather. The washing will dry and freeze.

text: Umphandle ukuphoxe wahamba.
en: Outside has betrayed you and you went anyway.
bt: [?Umphandle] [?ukuphoxe] and left.

text: Izintaba ziseholidini namuhla.
en: The mountains are on holiday today.
bt: The mountains are on holiday today.

text: Bottel hierdie een. Maak hom oop in die winter.
en: Bottle this one. Open it in winter.
bt: Bottle this one. Open it in the winter.

text: Iewers het 'n sambreel net binnestebuite gedraai. Oomblik van stilte.
en: Somewhere an umbrella just turned inside out. Moment of silence.
bt: Somewhere an umbrella just turned inside out. Moment of silence.

text: Braai ea motho e senyehile.
en: Someone's braai just got ruined.
bt: Someone's braai is ruined.

text: Umthunzi usebenza ngamandla kunawe namuhla.
en: The shade is working harder than you today.
bt: The shade is working harder than you today.

text: Yhuu, kushushu nyhani!
en: Jislaaik, it's properly hot!
bt: Wow, it is really hot!

text: Pudi e fihlile
en: Rain's here.
bt: The goat has arrived.

text: Vensterson is die enigste son wat vandag werk.
en: Window sun is the only sun doing its job today.
bt: Window sun is the only sun that works today.

text: Daai wolke beteken swaai-boulwerk. Vra enige oom by die hek.
en: Clouds like these mean swing bowling. Ask any oom at the gate.
bt: Those clouds mean swing bowling. Ask any uncle at the gate.

text: Skooldrag aan. Ekstra skooldrag maak skielik sin.
en: Uniform on. Spare uniform suddenly makes sense.
bt: School uniform on. Extra school uniform suddenly makes sense.

text: Almal met 'n swembad het skielik baie populêr geword.
en: Everyone with a pool just became very popular.
bt: Everyone with a pool has suddenly become very popular.

text: Noko akunethi. Yilonto qha.
en: At least it's not raining. That's the bar.
bt: [?Noko] it is not raining. That is all.

text: Die dag blaas uiteindelik uit. Ons ook.
en: The day is finally exhaling. So are we.
bt: The day finally exhales. So do we.

text: Layers off ka 11. Layers on ka 4. Highveld classic.
en: Layers off by 11. Layers on by 4. Highveld classic.
bt: Layers off at 11. Layers on at 4. Highveld classic.

text: Die lêer waarmee sy koelte waai is die een wat sy veronderstel is om te lees.
en: The file she is fanning with is the one she is meant to be reading.
bt: The file with which her coolness blows is the one she is supposed to read.

text: Skoon aand. Die gras het geen verskoning nie.
en: Clear evening. The grass has no excuse.
bt: Clear evening. The grass has no excuse.

text: Kushushu ngaphezu kwe-dashboard yebakkie emini.
en: Hotter than a bakkie dashboard at noon.
bt: It is hotter than a bakkie dashboard at noon.

text: Akukho simbo seenwele esibonwayo. Abasindileyo kuphela.
en: Not a hairstyle in sight. Just survivors.
bt: No hairstyle is visible. Only the survivors.

text: Iemand het die sterre se volume opgedraai.
en: Someone turned the stars up to full volume.
bt: Someone turned up the volume of the stars.

text: Amafu sesona sigqibo, kodwa kunophawu.
en: Cloud's the call. With an asterisk.
bt: Clouds are the final decision, but there is a sign.

text: Ilanga lidlala undize, lizenza iintshatsheli zosuku.
en: Sun, hide-and-seek champion of the day.
bt: The sun is playing [?undize] (flight?), making itself the champions of the day.

text: Hand op die pet, een tree op 'n slag. Die bries hou haar pas.
en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.
bt: Hand on the cap, one step at a time. The breeze keeps her pace.

text: Die lug is op stil en die ry ook. Maandag het nog nie sy volume gekry nie.
en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.
bt: The sky is on mute and so is the road. Monday has not got its volume yet.

text: Die son val jou persoonlik aan.
en: The sun is personally attacking you.
bt: The sun attacks you personally.

text: Die son gaan weg en vat al die grade saam.
en: The sun is leaving and taking all the degrees with it.
bt: The sun goes away and takes all the degrees with it.

text: Nat teer plus sonop is gelyk aan 'n straat van goud, vir 'n rukkie.
en: Wet tar plus sunrise equals a street made of gold, briefly.
bt: Wet tar plus sunrise equals a street of gold, for a while.

text: Te warm om te slaap: die bad is nou die koelste bed in die huis.
en: Too hot to sleep: the bath is now the coolest bed in the house.
bt: Too hot to sleep: the bath is now the coolest bed in the house.

text: Die maan hou stil en al die res daarbo nie.
en: The moon is holding still and everything else up there is not.
bt: The moon holds still and everything else up there does not.

text: Die veld weet reeds. Die veld weet altyd eerste.
en: The veld already knows. The veld always knows first.
bt: The veld already knows. The veld always knows first.

text: Ngisho nepaki ibukeka kahle namuhla.
en: Even the parking lot looks pretty today.
bt: Even the park looks good today.

text: Bietjie wind verwag. Hoeveel is nog onbeslis.
en: Some wind expected. Strength still TBC.
bt: A little wind expected. How much is still undecided.

text: Daardie een venster staan vanaand vuurtoringdiens, en dit is genoeg.
en: That one window is doing lighthouse duty tonight, and it is enough.
bt: That one window is on lighthouse duty tonight, and it is enough.

text: Ho ka tšela hanyane. Ho ka se tshoenyehe.
en: Might spit a bit. Might not bother.
bt: It might pour a little. Nothing to worry about.

text: Leholimo le matšoenyehong. Le nna, ka nnete.
en: Moody weather. Same, honestly.
bt: The sky is in worries. Me too, truly.

text: Die eerste verkeer van die oggend, en dit stap en kla terselfdertyd.
en: First traffic of the morning, and it walks and complains at the same time.
bt: The first traffic of the morning, and it walks and complains at the same time.

text: Tong e a bitsa. Araba eona.
en: The tongs are calling. Answer them.
bt: [?Tong] is calling. Answer it.

text: Die hemel het die sterre op stil gesit. Hulle is nog daar, belowe.
en: The sky put the stars on silent. They're still up there, promise.
bt: The sky has put the stars on silent. They are still there, promise.

text: Die wolke het die groot lig afgesit. Gaan slaap, Mzansi.
en: The clouds switched off the big light. Go to bed, Mzansi.
bt: The clouds switched off the big light. Go to sleep, Mzansi.

text: Een laaste kyk na 'n lug wat op die punt staan om ernstig koud te word.
en: One last look at a sky that is about to get seriously cold.
bt: One last look at a sky about to get seriously cold.

text: Ingemuva yentamo yakho. Ukhohlwe leyo ndawo.
en: The back of your neck. You forgot that bit.
bt: The back of your neck. You forgot that spot.

text: Maluti-frost morning. Lesotho e a e exporta mahala.
en: Maluti-frost morning. Lesotho's exporting it for free.
bt: Maluti-frost morning. Lesotho exports it for free.
note: English phrase and exporta left in

text: Effens bewolk, effens geraai.
en: Partly cloudy, partly guessing.
bt: Slightly cloudy, slightly guessed.

text: Isibane siqumba ngokupheleleyo.
en: The sky's having a full-on tantrum.
bt: The light/lamp is completely [?siqumba].
note: lamp, not sky; tantrum word unclear

text: Kunamafu kancinci.
en: Partly cloudy.
bt: There are a few clouds.

text: Iemand binne het reeds besluit hulle gaan vanaand nêrens heen nie.
en: Somebody inside has already decided they are not going anywhere tonight.
bt: Someone inside has already decided they are going nowhere tonight.

text: Die verkeer is emosioneel.
en: The traffic is emotional.
bt: The traffic is emotional.

text: Ukubalwa kwekhofi: kuyenyuka. Ukubalwa kogqozi: kusewuziro.
en: Coffee count: rising. Motivation count: still zero.
bt: Coffee count: going up. Inspiration count: already at zero.

text: Nog 'n koppie. Die uitsig gaan nêrens heen nie.
en: Another cup. The view isn't going anywhere.
bt: Another cup. The view is not going anywhere.

text: Pula e tla, mohlomong.
en: Rain on the way, give or take.
bt: Rain will come, maybe.

text: Kuyabanda ngokwaneleyo kwesuphu. Nesuphu yesibini.
en: Cold enough for soup. And a second soup.
bt: It is cold enough for soup. And a second soup.

text: Basa i-Weber. Kungumthetho.
en: Fire up the Weber. It's the law.
bt: Light the Weber. It is the law.

text: Amalahle awazozikhanyisela.
en: The coals aren't going to light themselves.
bt: The coals will not light themselves.

text: Amafu abukeka esolisa ngempela.
en: Clouds looking proper suspicious.
bt: The clouds look really suspicious.

text: Ubusika baseHighveld: indawo ekuphela kwayo apho unxiba ii-jackets ezimbini nje uyokuthatha iposi.
en: Highveld winter: the only place where you wear two jackets to fetch the post.
bt: Highveld winter: the only place where you put on two jackets just to go and collect the post.

text: Daardie wolk is net dik genoeg om die maan op die grond niks te laat tel nie.
en: That cloud is just thick enough to make the moon count for nothing on the ground.
bt: That cloud is just thick enough to make the moon count for nothing on the ground.

text: Ander stede kry weer. Joburg kry 'n vertoning.
en: Other cities get weather. Joburg gets a production.
bt: Other cities get rain. Joburg gets a show.

text: Clouds anesikhathi sawo.
en: The clouds are having a moment.
bt: Clouds have their time.

text: Izibopho zezinwele zisebenza ngokweqile.
en: Ponytail holders are doing overtime.
bt: Hair ties are working overtime.

text: Ho bonahala ho khutsitse. Hoo e ka bang.
en: Looks settled out there. Roughly.
bt: It looks quiet. More or less.

text: Bohle ke metsoalle ea hao ka tšohanyetso ha o na le pool.
en: Everyone's suddenly your friend when you have a pool.
bt: Everyone is your friend all of a sudden when you have a pool.

text: Akudabukisi. Nje... akuhlabi umxhwele.
en: Not depressing. Just... underwhelming.
bt: It is not sad. Just... not impressive.

text: Die strandmeer het plat en silwer geword, wat niemand wat hier woon flous nie.
en: The lagoon has gone flat and silver, which fools nobody who lives here.
bt: The beach lake has gone flat and silver, which fools nobody who lives here.

text: Dit het sedert omtrent Dinsdag nie in daardie huis afgekoel nie.
en: It has not cooled down in that house since about Tuesday.
bt: It has not cooled down in that house since about Tuesday.

text: Joburg se reën hou dagboek: 14:00, stiptelik, vol drama.
en: Joburg rain keeps a diary: 2pm sharp, maximum drama, no apologies.
bt: Joburg's rain keeps a diary: 14:00, on the dot, full of drama.

text: Die son vat sy tyd vanoggend, en dit is 100% dit werd.
en: The sun took its time this morning. Worth the wait.
bt: The sun is taking its time this morning, and it is 100% worth it.

text: Die hond het geweier om buite te gaan. Billik.
en: The dog refused to go outside. Fair.
bt: The dog refused to go outside. Fair.

text: Amafu akhangeleka erhaneleka nyhani.
en: Clouds looking proper suspicious.
bt: The clouds look truly [?erhaneleka] (worrying?).

text: Die mis het die buurt opgeëet.
en: The fog ate the neighbourhood.
bt: The fog ate the neighbourhood.

text: ke nako ya ho ntsha katiba yane empe
en: Time to dig out that ugly beanie.
bt: It is time to take out the [?katiba yane empe].

text: Die enigste een wat vanaand swem, is die reën self.
en: The only one swimming tonight is the rain itself.
bt: The only one swimming tonight is the rain itself.

text: Een kombers vir twee? Kom ons bly getroud.
en: One blanket for two? Let's stay married.
bt: One blanket for two? Let's stay married.

text: Die persoon wat die vloer mop, wil 'n woordjie met jou hê.
en: The person who mops would like a word with you.
bt: The person mopping the floor wants a word with you.

text: Nie Troufoto weer nie. Nie die einde van die wereld nie.
en: Not Instagram weather. Not the end of the world.
bt: Not another wedding photo. Not the end of the world.

text: Modumo o a tla. Sala ka hare.
en: Thunder rolling in. Inside is the move.
bt: Thunder is coming. Stay inside.

text: Kwane-geyser isebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo.
en: Even the geyser is putting in extra hours.
bt: Even the geyser is working extra hours.

text: Stoel na die verwarmer gedraai, kombers op, tee naby: wintersondag, korrek uitgevoer.
en: Chair turned to the heater, blanket up, tea close: winter Sunday, executed correctly.
bt: Chair turned to the heater, blanket on, tea near: winter Sunday, correctly executed.

text: Akufuneki ifilitha. Jonga ngaphandle nje.
en: No filter needed. Just look outside.
bt: A [?ifilitha] (filter?) is not needed. Just look outside.

text: Helder nag.
en: Clear night.
bt: Clear night.

text: Bypassende sokkies het laer op die lys geskuif.
en: Matching socks have slipped down the list.
bt: Matching socks have moved lower down the list.

text: Slaaptyd weer. Niemand het jou blykbaar gehoor nie.
en: Bedtime again. Nobody seems to have heard you.
bt: Bedtime again. Apparently nobody heard you.

text: Die yskas voel warmer as die sitkamer vandag.
en: The fridge feels warmer than the lounge today.
bt: The fridge feels warmer than the lounge today.

text: Son speel wegkruipertjie.
en: Sun's playing peek-a-boo.
bt: Sun plays hide-and-seek.

text: Koud vanaand: in die bed klim is nou 'n daad van moed.
en: Cold tonight: getting into bed is now an act of courage.
bt: Cold tonight: getting into bed is now an act of courage.

text: Usuku oluphelele. Akukho zaba. Phuma.
en: Perfect day. No excuses. Get out.
bt: A perfect day. No excuses. Go out.

text: Oranje blomme, blou lug, blou lippe.
en: Orange flowers, blue sky, blue lips.
bt: Orange flowers, blue sky, blue lips.

text: Dit waai.
en: Wind's up.
bt: It is windy.

text: Ho tsoha e ne e le phoso. E ngotsoeng fatshe.
en: Getting out of bed was a mistake. A documented one.
bt: Getting up was a mistake. Which has been written down.

text: E, ke leholimo la jersey. Jersey tse peli.
en: Ja, it's jersey weather. Double jersey.
bt: Yes, it is jersey weather. Two jerseys.

text: Imvula? Kungenzeka. Ukuzibophezela? Soze.
en: Rain? Possibly. Commitment? Never.
bt: Rain? Possible. Commitment? Never.

text: Vandag se weer: laai nog.
en: Today's weather: still loading.
bt: Today's weather: still loading.

text: Joburg somerreën: kom vyfuur, deurweek alles, weg teen aandete.
en: Joburg summer rain: arrives at five, soaks everything, gone by supper.
bt: Joburg summer rain: arrives at five, soaks everything, gone by dinner.

text: Die bank het 'n oortuigende saak gemaak vir bly.
en: The couch has made a compelling case for staying.
bt: The bench made a convincing case for staying.

text: Impelaveki ayibi bhetele kunale.
en: The weekend doesn't get better than this.
bt: The weekend is not better than this one.

text: Die son het hierdie grasperk al 'n maand vir homself, en hy wen.
en: The sun has had this lawn to itself for a month and it is winning.
bt: The sun has had this lawn to itself for a month already, and it is winning.

text: Elke straatlig dink hy's vanaand die maan.
en: Every streetlamp thinks it's the moon tonight.
bt: Every streetlight thinks it is the moon tonight.

text: Jy kan die koue sien inkom. Dit maak nie eers geheim daarvan nie.
en: You can watch the cold arriving. It's not even being subtle about it.
bt: You can see the cold coming in. It does not even hide it.

text: Izihlangu zingakhethwa. Isimilo siyanyanzelelwa.
en: Shoes optional. Attitude mandatory.
bt: Shoes can be chosen. Posture/character is insisted upon.

text: Die swembad is so blou omdat die lug al die werk doen.
en: The pool is that blue because the sky is doing all of it.
bt: The swimming pool is so blue because the sky does all the work.

text: Abaqhubi baseJoburg sele beqalile ukuphakuzela.
en: Joburg drivers are panicking already.
bt: Joburg drivers have already started [?ukuphakuzela].

text: Tande geborsel. Hier bly lyk redelik.
en: Teeth brushed. Staying here seems reasonable.
bt: Teeth brushed. Staying here looks reasonable.

text: Imozulu inganzima. Hlala ulumkile.
en: Weather might get serious. Stay loosely on alert.
bt: The weather may be heavy. Stay wise/alert.

text: Imvula imhlawumbi ikho. Isibhakabhaka asikatyikityi nto.
en: Rain's likely-ish. The sky hasn't signed anything.
bt: Rain is perhaps there. The sky has not yet [?tyikityi] anything.

text: Andiboni nto. Nento encinci.
en: Can't see a thing. Not a thing.
bt: I see nothing. Not even a little thing.

text: Dibomo tse nyenyane tsa leqhoa di a wa. Ka hare ke moralo o le mong feela.
en: Tiny ice bombs falling. Indoors is the only plan.
bt: Little [?dibomo] of ice are falling. Inside is only one plan.

text: Ukuvuka bekuyiphutha. Elibhaliwe phansi.
en: Getting out of bed was a mistake. A documented one.
bt: Waking up was a mistake. The one that is written down.

text: Die son is op airplane mode.
en: The sun's on airplane mode.
bt: The sun is on airplane mode.

text: Koud genoeg dat die koffie-tou om die blok loop.
en: Cold enough that the coffee queue goes round the block.
bt: Cold enough that the coffee queue goes around the block.

text: Ha ho motho ea ingolisitseng bakeng sa mocheso ona.
en: Nobody signed up for this temperature.
bt: There is no one who has registered for this heat.

text: Kunamafu
en: Cloudy vibes.
bt: There are clouds.

text: Kushisa ngaphezu kwe-dashboard yebakkie emini.
en: Hotter than a bakkie dashboard at noon.
bt: It is hotter than a bakkie's dashboard at midday.

text: Die reën klink lekker op die dak. Solank jy nié in dit is nie.
en: Rain sounds lovely on the roof. Provided you are not in it.
bt: The rain sounds nice on the roof. As long as you are not in it.

text: Amafu azibophezele ekubeni phakathi naphakathi.
en: The clouds are committed to being average.
bt: The clouds are committed to being in the middle/moderate.

text: Isichotho siyeza.
en: Hail incoming.
bt: The hail is coming.

text: Jy kan die dak beter hoor as die televisie.
en: You can hear the roof better than you can hear the television.
bt: You can hear the roof better than the television.

text: Yi-Maluti-frost morning. ILesotho iyayithumela mahala.
en: Maluti-frost morning. Lesotho's exporting it for free.
bt: It is a Maluti-frost morning. Lesotho sends it for free.

text: Iemand het die kussing vanaand al twee keer omgedraai.
en: Somebody has already turned the pillow over twice tonight.
bt: Someone has already turned the pillow over twice tonight.

text: Die buurt is weg. Koffie eers, dan kyk ons weer.
en: The neighbourhood is gone. Coffee first, then we'll check again.
bt: The neighbourhood is gone. Coffee first, then we will look again.

text: Die lug gee weer gemengde seine.
en: The sky's giving mixed signals again.
bt: The sky is giving mixed signals again.

text: Inkungu itye indawo.
en: The fog ate the neighbourhood.
bt: The fog has eaten the place.

text: Die piesangblare word voor jou oë herontwerp en vat dit goed.
en: The banana leaves are being redesigned in real time and taking it well.
bt: The banana leaves are being redesigned before your eyes and are taking it well.

text: Ho tsamaea ho ea koloing ke kotsi ea letsatsi kajeno.
en: Walking to the car counts as a sun hazard today.
bt: Walking to the car is the danger of the day today.

text: Jou bure weet nou hoe jou pajamas lyk.
en: Your neighbours now know what your pyjamas look like.
bt: Your neighbours now know what your pyjamas look like.

text: Die wind is al van vyfuur af op en skuif almal se vullisdromme rond.
en: The wind's been up since five, rearranging everyone's bins.
bt: The wind has been up since five o'clock and is shifting everyone's rubbish bins around.

text: Wonke umntu uba ngumhlobho wakho uma une pool.
en: Everyone's suddenly your friend when you have a pool.
bt: Everyone becomes your friend when you have a pool.

text: Kubanda, weather licwebile
en: Cold but clear
bt: It is cold, the weather is [?clear/sharp].
note: English "weather" left in place of imozulu

text: Kukho inkungu.
en: Foggy out there.
bt: There is fog.

text: Die son probeer sy geluk op die horison, en die wolke is onbeïndruk.
en: The sun is trying its luck at the horizon and the cloud is unmoved.
bt: The sun tries its luck on the horizon, and the clouds are unimpressed.

text: Ho na le maru. Braai ha e na tiisetso kajeno
en: Cloudy-ish. Don't bet the braai on it.
bt: There are clouds. The braai has no certainty today.

text: Die werk het nie die boodskap gekry dat ons binne bly nie.
en: Work didn't get the message about staying in.
bt: The work did not get the message that we are staying inside.

text: Ha ho masoabi. Feela... ha ho khotsofatse.
en: Not depressing. Just... underwhelming.
bt: There is no sorrow. Only... it is not satisfying.

text: Jou sambreel se waarborg het 'n bietjie te verduidelik.
en: Your umbrella warranty has some explaining to do.
bt: Your umbrella's warranty has a bit too much to explain.

text: Braaiweer, boet! Geen verskonings nie.
en: Braai weather, boet! No excuses.
bt: Braai weather, boet! No excuses.

text: Kungaba nesiphepho. Bheka isibhakabhaka.
en: Could turn stormy. Keep one eye on the sky.
bt: There may be a storm. Look at the sky.

text: Night obuhle bokubona iNdlela yoSisi.
en: Perfect night to actually see the Milky Way.
bt: Night [that is] beautiful for seeing [?the Milky Way / the Sister's Way].
note: English "Night" left in place of ubusuku

text: Die helfte van die lug het 'n mening, en die ander helfte gaan dit nou-nou hoor.
en: Half the sky has an opinion and the other half is about to hear it.
bt: Half of the sky has an opinion, and the other half is about to hear it.

text: Die ys in daardie kan het nooit 'n kans gestaan nie, en almal het dit geweet.
en: The ice in that jug never stood a chance and everybody knew it.
bt: The ice in that can never stood a chance, and everyone knew it.

text: Die dag het nog nie eers begin nie en hy wen alreeds.
en: The day hasn't even started yet and it's already winning.
bt: The day has not even started yet and it is already winning.

text: Ilanga lithumele impendulo ka out-of-office
en: The sun sent an out-of-office reply.
bt: The sun sent an out-of-office reply.

text: Die eerste briesie van die dag het nou net opgedaag. Gee hom applous.
en: The first breeze of the day has just arrived. Give it a round of applause.
bt: The first breeze of the day has just turned up. Give it applause.

text: Isaqhwithi siyenzeka. Ukugrila kungafuna olunye usuku.
en: Storm's possible. The braai might need a rain check.
bt: A storm is happening. Grilling may need another day.

text: Endaweni ethile uphahla lungumkhumbi omusha.
en: Somewhere a roof is someone's new kite.
bt: Somewhere a roof is a new ship.

text: Die braai-deksel is in die volgende voorstad.
en: The braai cover is in the next suburb.
bt: The braai lid is in the next suburb.

text: Donderweer op volume tien, die buurman se hond op elf.
en: Thunder at volume ten, the neighbour's dog at eleven.
bt: Thunder at volume ten, the neighbour's dog at eleven.

text: Inja iphantsi kwebhedi. Icebo elihle, inene.
en: The dog's under the bed. Smart move, honestly.
bt: The dog is under the bed. A good plan, indeed.

text: Jy het daardie koffie hoofsaaklik vir jou hande gekoop.
en: You've bought that coffee mostly for your hands.
bt: You bought that coffee mainly for your hands.

text: Lehodimo le fana le 'ke tla leka hosane' matla.
en: The sky's giving 'I'll try again tomorrow' energy.
bt: The sky has the 'I'll try tomorrow' strength/energy.

text: Ama-tong ayabiza. Waphendule.
en: The tongs are calling. Answer them.
bt: The tongs are calling. Answer.

text: Palo ea kofi: e nyolohang. Palo ea khothatso: e ntse e le zero.
en: Coffee count: rising. Motivation count: still zero.
bt: Coffee count: rising. Motivation count: still zero.

text: Effens bewolk
en: Partly cloudy
bt: Slightly cloudy

text: Die vuur is die enigste ding hier buite wat sy baadjie mag uittrek.
en: The fire is the only thing out here allowed to take its jacket off.
bt: The fire is the only thing out here allowed to take its jacket off.

text: CV ea lehodimo e sa tsoa ntlafatsoa.
en: The sky's CV just got updated.
bt: The sky's CV has just been updated.

text: Le ayisiyiyo into eyathenjiswa yibrochure yezokhenketho
en: This is not what the tourism brochure promised.
bt: This is not what the tourism brochure promised.

text: Izinga le-UV liphezulu
en: High UV
bt: The UV level is high.

text: Umuzi unenzondo yomuntu siqu ngezambulela.
en: The wind has a personal vendetta against umbrellas.
bt: The homestead has a personal hatred of umbrellas.
note: Subject is the homestead, not the wind

text: Kutheni wena wakudala wenza izicwangciso? Wena wakudala ngoyena mbi.
en: Why did past-you make plans? Past-you is the worst.
bt: Why do you of old make plans? You of old are the worst one.

text: Daardie seemuur doen sy uiterste bes en verloor steeds.
en: That sea wall is doing its absolute best and it is still losing.
bt: That sea wall is doing its utmost and still losing.

text: Ngaka ea Cape e etsa litšeliso.
en: The Cape Doctor is making house calls.
bt: The Cape doctor is making [?litšeliso].

text: Imowudi ye-blanket burrito: ivuliwe.
en: Blanket burrito mode: activated.
bt: Blanket burrito mode: opened/on.

text: Koud genoeg om elke asem te sien, helder genoeg dat niemand omgee nie.
en: Cold enough to see every breath, clear enough that nobody minds.
bt: Cold enough to see every breath, clear enough that nobody cares.

text: Isibhakabhaka sivele saba i-Carte Blanche ngokuphelele.
en: The sky just went full Carte Blanche.
bt: The sky has suddenly become completely Carte Blanche.

text: Bajete ea Setlolo sa letsatsi  e phahame ho feta akhaonto ea  data
en: Sunscreen budget: higher than your data bill.
bt: The sunscreen [?(sun medicine)] budget is higher than the data account.

text: Weerlig, en die hele huis tel tot drie.
en: Lightning, then the whole house counts to three.
bt: Lightning, and the whole house counts to three.

text: Uit die bed uit was die moeilikste bergklim van die dag.
en: Getting out of bed was the hardest summit of the day.
bt: Getting out of bed was the hardest mountain climb of the day.

text: Die sterre het 'n aand af gevat. Selfs húlle.
en: The stars took a night off. Even them.
bt: The stars took a night off. Even them.

text: Ngisho ama-hadeda athule.
en: Even the hadedas are quiet.
bt: Even the hadedas are quiet.

text: Die soort dag wat Joburg voorgee hy nie het nie totdat jy daarin staan.
en: The kind of day Joburg pretends it doesn't have until you're standing in it.
bt: The kind of day Joburg pretends it does not have until you are standing in it.

text: Isofa yenze icala elinamandla lokuba uhlale.
en: The couch has made a compelling case for staying.
bt: The sofa has made a strong case for you to sit.

text: Saterdag, en die enigste skaduwee vir die volgende uur is binne hierdie kar.
en: Saturday, and the only shade for the next hour is inside this car.
bt: Saturday, and the only shade for the next hour is inside this car.

text: Afrika se lug tref net anders.
en: Africa's sky just hits different.
bt: Africa's sky just hits differently.

text: Die horison het een strokie oranje gehou as bewys dat die son hier was.
en: The horizon kept one strip of orange as proof the sun was here.
bt: The horizon held one strip of orange as proof that the sun was here.

text: Izinsuku ezinje kufanele zize ne-soundtrack.
en: Days like this should come with a soundtrack.
bt: Days like these should come with a soundtrack.

text: Isibhakabhaka sithukuthele ngempela.
en: The sky's having a full-on tantrum.
bt: The sky is really angry.

text: Die skuur se gloeilamp is vanaand se sonsondergang. Die beeste aanvaar die afgradering.
en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
bt: The barn's light bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.

text: Kwanendawo yokuphaka ibonakala intle namhlanje.
en: Even the parking lot looks pretty today.
bt: Even the [?place for dishing up / parking] looks nice today.

text: Die lapa-kussings is crispy.
en: The lapa cushions are crispy.
bt: The lapa cushions are crispy.

text: Liaparo tsa hao li sa tsoa fallela jareteng ea moahisane.
en: Your washing just moved to the neighbour's yard.
bt: Your clothes have just [?gone flying] into the neighbour's yard.

text: Laaste taxi's van die aand, en die mis het binnekort die hele staanplek vir homself.
en: Last taxis of the night, and the fog has the whole rank to itself soon.
bt: Last taxis of the evening, and the mist will soon have the whole rank to itself.

text: Ubusuku obucacileyo kancinci. Musa ukusibamba ngeenkwenkwezi
en: Clear-ish night. Don't hold us to the stars.
bt: A slightly clear night. Do not [?catch] us with the stars.

text: Amafu adlala kancane.
en: Half-committed clouds.
bt: The clouds play a little/slowly.

text: Ukuduma kwezulu
en: Thunder
bt: The rumbling of the sky (thunder).

text: I-Free State isanda kukhumbula ukuthi ine-setting yasebusika.
en: The Free State just remembered it has a winter setting.
bt: The Free State has just remembered it has a winter setting.

text: Dit alles vir brood waarvan jy nie seker was jy nodig het nie.
en: All this for bread you weren't sure you needed.
bt: All of this for bread you were not sure you needed.

text: Die meeue klink kwaad. Dieselfde, meeue. Dieselfde.
en: The seagulls sound furious about it. Same, seagulls. Same.
bt: The seagulls sound angry. Same, seagulls. Same.
