bt: Traffic has just remembered that rain exists. Again.

text: Die UV-indeks is hoër as jou verwagtinge.
en: The UV index is higher than your expectations.
bt: The UV index is higher than your expectations.

text: Jy ruik Hoëveldse reën voor jy hom sien. Dis die lokprent.
en: You smell Highveld rain before you see it. That's the trailer.
bt: You smell Highveld rain before you see it. It is the trailer.

text: Moenie eers dink om iewers heen te ry nie.
en: Don't even think about driving somewhere.
bt: Do not even think about driving anywhere.

text: Bane ea ice cream e bapala pina ea bohle.
en: The ice cream van is playing everyone's anthem.
bt: The [?bane] of ice cream plays everyone's song.

text: Umbane ubekaumboniso omhle.
en: The lightning is putting on a proper show.
bt: The lightning put on a good show.

text: Jy het vroeg vertrek. Almal anders ook.
en: You left early. So did absolutely everyone else.
bt: You left early. Everyone else too.

text: Die son is elf minute op en hy het reeds opgehou beweeg.
en: The sun has been up eleven minutes and he has already stopped moving.
bt: The sun has been up eleven minutes and has already stopped moving.

text: Cishe usuku lwebraai.
en: Almost a braai day.
bt: Almost braai day.

text: Yimozulu yokubilisa i-ketile kabini. Kube kanye eye-kofu, kubekanye eye-zandla
en: Boiling-the-kettle-twice weather: once for the coffee, once for the hands.
bt: It is weather for boiling the kettle twice. Once for coffee, once for hands.

text: Isimo sezulu asikwazi ukuzinquma njengawe eSpur.
en: Weather's being more indecisive than you at Spur.
bt: The weather cannot make up its mind like you at Spur.

text: Ukushayela kancane akusona isiphakamiso.
en: Driving slow is not a suggestion.
bt: Driving slowly is not a suggestion.

text: Kook-die-ketel-twee-keer weer: een keer vir die koffie, een keer vir die hande.
en: Boiling-the-kettle-twice weather: once for the coffee, once for the hands.
bt: Boil-the-kettle-twice weather again: once for the coffee, once for the hands.

text: Niemand in hierdie huis betaal vandag om iets droog te maak nie.
en: Nobody in this house is paying to dry anything today.
bt: Nobody in this house pays to dry something today.

text: Lipara tse tharo tsa dikausu empa ha li ea lekana.
en: Three pairs of socks and still not enough.
bt: Three pairs of socks but they are not enough.

text: Elke boom in die straat buig dieselfde kant toe. Groepsdruk.
en: Every tree on the street is bowing the same way. Peer pressure.
bt: Every tree in the street bends the same way. Peer pressure.

text: Inkuku ayikhathaleli isheduli yakho.
en: The fog doesn't care about your schedule.
bt: The chicken does not care about your schedule.
note: Subject is a chicken, not fog

text: Ha se nako ea bosenatla, hey.
en: Not the time for hero moves, hey.
bt: It is not the time for [?bosenatla], hey.

text: Drink jou koffie gou. Teen sewe is dit sop.
en: Drink your coffee fast. By seven it's soup.
bt: Drink your coffee quickly. By seven it is soup.

text: Die lug is oop, die pad is oop, jou neus loop.
en: Clear skies, open roads, running nose. The full winter set.
bt: The sky is open, the road is open, your nose is running.

text: Fog ayikhathaleli isheduli yakho.
en: The fog doesn't care about your schedule.
bt: Fog does not care about your schedule.
note: English "Fog" left in place of inkungu

text: Lesi yisimo sezulu ozosithanda ethrafikhini kaDisemba.
en: This is the weather you'll miss in December traffic.
bt: This is weather you will love in December traffic.

text: Tyd om op te staan. Die dak is al ure wakker.
en: Time to get up. The roof has been up for hours.
bt: Time to get up. The roof has been awake for hours.

text: Ngisho nezinkomo eziku-N1 zibuthene sengathi zikhokhele indawo.
en: Even the cattle on the N1 are huddled like they paid for it.
bt: Even the cows on the N1 are huddled together as if they have paid for the spot.

text: Geen stroomdiens het 'n genre vir hierdie nie.
en: No streaming service has a genre for this.
bt: No streaming service has a genre for this.

text: Kunenkungu.
bt: There is fog.

text: Die rits gaan vandag heeltemal op; die stap hek toe het tande.
en: The zip goes all the way up today; the walk to the gate has teeth.
bt: The zip is going all the way up today; the walk to the gate has teeth.

text: Selfs die skaduwee sweet.
en: Even the shade is sweating.
bt: Even the shadow is sweating.

text: Jou haarafspraak voel nou taamlik optimisties.
en: Your hair appointment now feels rather optimistic.
bt: Your hair appointment feels rather optimistic now.

text: Mophefumulo oa hao o etsa li-special effects.
en: Your breath is doing special effects.
bt: Your breath is making special effects.

text: Bietjie wolk, bietjie son. Die verhouding is enigiemand se raaiskoot.
en: Some cloud, some sun. The ratio's anyone's guess.
bt: A bit of cloud, a bit of sun. The ratio is anyone's guess.

text: Jy het lekker geslaap. Die hond vertel 'n ander storie.
en: You slept well. The dog has a different account.
bt: You slept well. The dog tells a different story.

text: Reën op pad, min of meer.
en: Rain on the way, give or take.
bt: Rain on the way, more or less.

text: Die mis lê in die strate asof hy hier erfbelasting betaal.
en: The fog is lying in the streets like it pays rates here.
bt: The fog lies in the streets as if it pays inheritance tax here.

text: Amafutha ayazibonakalisa namhlanje.
en: The clouds are having a moment.
bt: The oils/fats show themselves today.

text: Isembozo sebraai sisesifundeni esilandelayo.
en: The braai cover is in the next suburb.
bt: The braai cover is in the next province/region.

text: Jou vingers het die vroeë begin van die hand gewys.
en: Your fingers have declined the early start.
bt: Your fingers showed the early start of the hand.

text: Ingxenye yakho konke. Usuku oluphakathi nendawo.
en: Bit of everything. Classic in-between day.
bt: Part of all yours. A so-so (middle) day.

text: Nie een van hulle kan regop staan nie en nie een lyk of hulle omgee nie.
en: Neither of them can stand up straight and neither of them seems to mind.
bt: Not one of them can stand upright and not one looks like they care.

text: Amafu akhona, kodwa akukho nto ayenzayo.
en: The clouds are here but they're not doing anything.
bt: There are clouds, but they are doing nothing.

text: Iewers blaf 'n hond en almal maak of hulle weet waar.
en: Somewhere a dog is barking and everyone's pretending they know where.
bt: Somewhere a dog barks and everyone pretends they know where.

text: Waarskynlik stil lug. Ons is redelik seker.
en: Probably quiet skies. We're fairly sure.
bt: Probably still air. We are fairly sure.

text: Sephethephethe se sa tsoa hopola hore pula e teng. Hape.
en: The traffic just remembered rain exists. Again.
bt: The [?sephethephethe] (whirlwind?) has only just remembered that there is rain. Again.
note: Subject word uncertain; traffic vs whirlwind.

text: Ama-hadedas amathathu, amagwababa amabili, nomuntu oyedwa oqhaqhazelayo endaweni yokuphakela izinyoni.
en: Three hadedas, two crows, one shivering human at the bird feeder.
bt: Three hadedas, two crows, and one person shivering at the bird feeder.

text: Table Mountain? Table Mountain efe?
en: Table Mountain? What Table Mountain?
bt: Table Mountain? Which Table Mountain?

text: Perfekte nag om die Melkweg te sien.
en: Perfect night to actually see the Milky Way.
bt: Perfect night to see the Milky Way.

text: O tla oma. Qetellong. Mohlomong.
en: You'll dry. Eventually. Probably.
bt: It will dry up. Finally. Maybe.

text: Isibhakabhaka sibukeka siziqhayisa.
en: The sky looks like it's showing off.
bt: The sky looks like it is boasting.

text: 50/50 op die reën. Vat 'n baadjie, net ingeval.
en: 50/50 on the rain. Bring a jacket, just in case.
bt: 50/50 on the rain. Take a jacket, just in case.

text: Nie reën nie. Net atmosfeer met menings.
en: Not rain. Just atmosphere with opinions.
bt: No rain. Just atmosphere with opinions.

text: Bosiu bo hlakileng
en: Clear night
bt: Clear night

text: Die dag het nooit warm geword nie, en een inwoner het opgehou wag.
en: The day never warmed up, and one resident has stopped waiting for it to.
bt: The day never got warm, and one resident stopped waiting.

text: Buite is vanaand vir die sterre; alles met pels het vir die kaggel gestem.
en: Outside is for the stars tonight; everything with fur voted fireplace.
bt: Outside is for the stars tonight; everything with fur voted for the fireplace.

text: So-so weer. Nie wonderlik nie, nie verskriklik nie.
en: Good enough weather. Not great, not terrible.
bt: So-so weather. Not wonderful, not terrible.

text: I-heater yemoto yiyona relationship ebaluleke kakhulu empilweni yakho njengamanje.
en: The car's heater is the most important relationship in your life right now.
bt: The car heater is the most important relationship in your life at the moment.

text: Eyona ilungileyo. Sukuyichitha.
en: A proper good one. Don't waste it.
bt: The best one. Don't waste it.

text: Skoene uit. Die hele huishouding stem saam.
en: Shoes off. The whole household agrees on this.
bt: Shoes off. The whole household agrees.

text: Waarskynlik reën. Vat die sambreel, sluit die argument af.
en: Probably rain. Take the umbrella, settle the argument.
bt: Probably rain. Take the umbrella, close the argument.

text: Isibhakabhaka sinika yonke into namhlanje.
en: The sky's giving everything today.
bt: The sky is giving everything today.

text: Dis hoekom ons in Suid-Afrika bly.
en: This is why we live in South Africa.
bt: That is why we live in South Africa.

text: Ilanga liphumile. Ungakhohliswa. Imvelo iqamba amanga.
en: Sun's out. Don't be fooled. Nature is lying.
bt: The sun is out. Don't be fooled. Nature tells lies.

text: Die balkon klop die bank as die lug dít doen.
en: The balcony beats the couch when the sky is doing this.
bt: The balcony beats the couch when the sky does that.

text: Night bo hlakileng
en: Clear night
bt: Night clear (English word "Night" left in)

text: Amapheya amathathu amakawusi kodwa akwanele.
en: Three pairs of socks and still not enough.
bt: Three pairs of [?amakawusi] but it is not enough.

text: Isibhakabhaka asikwazi ukunquma.
en: Sky can't make up its mind.
bt: The sky cannot decide.

text: Lieta tsa hao tsa suede li khethile gompieno? Sebete.
en: Your suede shoes chose today? Bold.
bt: Have your suede shoes decided today? Brave.

text: Môreoggend se eerste taak: vyf minute ys krap in jou kerkklere.
en: Tomorrow's first task: five minutes of windscreen scraping in your work clothes.
bt: Tomorrow morning's first task: five minutes of scraping ice in your church clothes.

text: Die water lyk soos glas. Dit voel soos ys. Moenie eksperimenteer nie.
en: The water looks like glass. It feels like ice. Do not run the experiment.
bt: The water looks like glass. It feels like ice. Don't experiment.

text: Daardie sekuriteitslig doen die beste werk wat dit die hele jaar gedoen het.
en: That security light is doing the best work it has done all year.
bt: That security light is doing the best work it has done all year.

text: Ilanga lidlala imidlalo namhlanje.
en: The sun's not playing games today.
bt: The sun is playing games today.
note: Sun plays games; English says not playing games.

text: Wind waseningizimu ufikile. Ungamenyiwe, njengenjwayelo.
en: The southeaster's arrived. Uninvited, as usual.
bt: The southerly wind has arrived. Uninvited, as usual.

text: Die wolke tjank, iemand kry 'n tissue asb.
en: The clouds are having a moment.
bt: The clouds are crying, someone get a tissue please.

text: Thatha isambulela sakho, boet.
en: Grab your brolly, boet.
bt: Take your umbrella, boet.

text: Die dag begin sonder drama. Verdag, maar ons vat dit.
en: Zero drama in the sky. Highly unusual. Gladly accepted.
bt: The day starts without drama. Suspicious, but we'll take it.

text: Esita le dikgomo tse pela N1 di petetsane jwaloka eka di lefile ho ba te
en: Even the cattle on the N1 are huddled like they paid for it.
bt: Even the cows near the N1 are huddled together as if they have paid to be [?te... (cut off)]

text: UDokotela waseKapa ufikile ezovakasha.
en: The Cape Doctor is making house calls.
bt: The Cape Doctor has arrived to holiday/visit.

text: Lena ke boemo ba leholimo boo mafelo-beke a etselitsoeng bona
en: This is the weather the weekend was invented for.
bt: This is the weather that weekends were made for.

text: Aandete lyk na die hoogtepunt van jou vakansie.
en: Dinner is looking like the highlight of your holiday.
bt: Dinner looks like the highlight of your holiday.

text: 50/50 ukufumana amanzi. Njengomdlalo.
en: 50/50 on getting wet. Like a coin toss.
bt: 50/50 to get water. Like a game.

text: Nie een wolk nie, wat beteken daardie malvas gaan dit vanaand weer nodig hê.
en: Not one cloud, which means those geraniums will need this again tonight.
bt: Not one cloud, which means those malvas will need it again tonight.

text: Ukusela amazwi: ewe. Onke.
en: Water consumption: yes. All of it.
bt: Drinking [?amazwi] (words/voices): yes. All.

text: Imozulu ilungile ngokwaneleyo. Ayintle kakhulu, ayimbi kakhulu.
en: Good enough weather. Not great, not terrible.
bt: The weather is good enough. Not very nice, not very bad.

text: Theewaterskloof gaan vanoggend viraal in die groepsgesprek.
en: Theewaterskloof is about to trend in the group chat.
bt: Theewaterskloof will go viral in the group chat this morning.

text: Neebakkie kwi-N2 zime ecaleni.
en: Even the bakkies on the N2 pulled over.
bt: Even the bakkies on the N2 have stopped at the side.

text: Faka i-marinade. Cisha ifoni. Usuku luqala manje.
en: Marinade in. Phone off. Day starts now.
bt: Put on the marinade. Charge the phone. The day is starting now.
note: Back-translation says charge phone; English says phone off.

text: Namhlanje yi-hoodie nesimo sengqondo nje.
en: A hoodie and an attitude. That's today.
bt: Today is just a hoodie and attitude.

text: Wolke is wat 'n sonsondergang nodig het, en vanaand het die lug presies genoeg gebring.
en: Cloud is what a sunset needs, and tonight the sky brought exactly enough.
bt: Clouds are things that need a sunset, and tonight the sky brought exactly enough.

text: Stap na die kar tel as 'n songevaar vandag.
en: Walking to the car counts as a sun hazard today.
bt: Walking to the car counts as a sun hazard today.

text: Daardie handdoeke moet eers kan buig voor jy hulle kan opvou.
en: You'll need those towels to bend before you fold them.
bt: Those towels must be able to bend before you can fold them.

text: Storm is moontlik. Die braai mag 'n reëndatum nodig kry.
en: Storm's possible. The braai might need a rain check.
bt: Storm is possible. The braai may need a rain date.

text: Garage-pastei vir middagete want die kombuis is lawa.
en: Garage pie for lunch because the kitchen is lava.
bt: Garage pie for lunch because the kitchen is lava.

text: Selfs die meeuë loop vandag.
en: Even the seagulls are walking today.
bt: Even the seagulls walk today.

text: Natuur wil 'n woordjie se. Beste om te luister.
en: Nature's having a word. Best to listen.
bt: Nature wants to say a word. Best to listen.

text: 'n Deksel soos daardie lig eers teen elfuur, as dit enigsins lig.
en: A lid like that takes until about eleven to lift, if it lifts at all.
bt: A lid like that lifts only by eleven o'clock, if it lifts at all.

text: Jou vingers wil 'n beurt in die sakke hê.
en: Your fingers would like a turn inside the pockets.
bt: Your fingers want a turn in the pockets.

text: Isithwathwa otshanini. Isithwathwa ku-bakkie. Isithwathwa ku-pet bowl.
en: Frost on the lawn. Frost on the bakkie. Frost in the pet bowl.
bt: Frost on the grass. Frost in the bakkie. Frost in the pet bowl.

text: Besoekers op pad. Hulle kan twee keer klop.
en: Visitors expected. They can knock twice.
bt: Visitors on the way. They may knock twice.

text: Jarata e teng kantle. Re tšepa ts'ebetso.
en: The garden is somewhere out there. We trust the process.
bt: The yard (garden) is outside. We hope for [?ts'ebetso] (operation/function).

text: Ifriji iyindawo epholile kunayo yonke endlini.
en: The fridge is the coolest room in the house.
bt: The fridge is the coolest place in the house.

text: Die helfte van die sterre is agter wolke. Die liggies staan vir hulle in.
en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
bt: Half of the stars are behind clouds. The lights stand in for them.

text: Onthou om die TV se prop uit te trek — dis tradisie.
en: Unplug the TV — it's tradition.
bt: Remember to pull the TV's plug out - it's tradition.

text: Amper binne. 'n Uitstekende plek om weer te dink.
en: Nearly inside. An excellent place to reconsider.
bt: Almost inside. An excellent place to think again.

text: Iewers het 'n sjokolade net gesterf.
en: Somewhere a chocolate bar just died.
bt: Somewhere a chocolate just died.

text: Mohlomong letsatsi le letle. Re na le bonnete ba hoo e ka bang 80%.
en: Probably a good one. We're about 80% sure.
bt: Maybe a nice day. We are about 80% sure.

text: Kuyabanda, cishe. Gqoka izingubo eziningi.
en: Chilly, most likely. Layer up to be safe.
bt: It's getting cold, nearly. Wear lots of clothes.

text: Vikela ubuso bakho! Kunye kuphela onabu.
en: Protect that face! It's the only one you've got.
bt: Protect your face! You only have one.

text: Grys is ook 'n kleur, sê my ma. Vandag glo ek haar.
en: Grey is also a colour, says my ma. Today I believe her.
bt: Grey is also a colour, my mother says. Today I believe her.

text: Die rook het die bure se erf gekry. Saterdag se braai is amptelik 'n gemeenskapsgeleentheid.
en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.
bt: The smoke has reached the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.

text: Jou gunsteling-parkeerplek het sy aantrekkingskrag verloor.
en: Your favourite parking spot has lost its appeal.
bt: Your favourite parking spot has lost its appeal.

text: Tweeuur die oggend, en daardie waaier was die hardste ding in die huis.
en: Two in the morning, and that fan has been the loudest thing in the house.
bt: Two in the morning, and that fan was the loudest thing in the house.

text: Eskom e ka rata matla ana.
en: Eskom wishes it had this power.
bt: Eskom would like this power.

text: Ubusuku obuzolileyo, mhlawumbi. Isibhakabhaka singatshintsha.
en: Calm night, most likely. The sky reserves the right to change.
bt: A calm night, maybe. The sky may change.

text: Die braai gaan aan. Die vertoning ook.
en: The braai continues. So does the show.
bt: The braai is going ahead. So is the show.

text: Nka motsotso. Sheba holimo. Kea leboha.
en: Take a moment. Look up. You're welcome.
bt: Take a moment. Look up. Thank you.

text: Amptelik gee hy die tuin water. Die tuin is derde in die tou.
en: Officially he’s watering the garden. The garden is third in the queue.
bt: Officially he is watering the garden. The garden is third in line.

text: Jou skoot is nou bespreek vir die hele hond.
en: Your lap is now reserved for the entire dog.
bt: Your lap is now booked for the whole dog.

text: Amafu azihambela nje. Akukho zithembiso namhlanje
en: The clouds are just vibing. No promises.
bt: The clouds just wander about. No promises today.

text: Noko igadi iyavuya. Umntu angavuya.
en: At least the garden's happy. Someone has to be.
bt: Even the garden is happy. A person could be happy.

text: Die lug dreig, die aanmaakblokkies antwoord: 'n baie Suid-Afrikaanse kragmeting.
en: The sky is threatening, the firelighters are answering: a very South African standoff.
bt: The sky threatens, the firelighters answer: a very South African power struggle.

text: Iewers is 'n dak iemand se nuwe vlieër.
en: Somewhere a roof is someone's new kite.
bt: Somewhere a roof is someone's new kite.

text: Jou dakherstelspaargeld is raakgesien.
en: Your roof repair savings have been noticed.
bt: Your roof-repair savings have been noticed.

text: Die braai gaan aan. Die braai gaan altyd aan. Ons trek net die stoele nader.
en: The braai is happening. The braai always happens. We just pull the chairs closer.
bt: The braai goes on. The braai always goes on. We just pull the chairs closer.

text: N1 jaanong ke waterpark.
en: The N1 is now a waterpark.
bt: The N1 now is a waterpark.

text: Sneeu op daai berge, ys in hierdie briesie.
en: Snow on those mountains, ice in this breeze. Connected? Very.
bt: Snow on those mountains, ice in this breeze.

text: Die see is 12 grade. Teen tienuur gaan dit soos 'n spa voel.
en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.
bt: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it will feel like a spa.

text: Weerlig sit 'n show op — kyk deur die venster.
en: Lightning's putting on a show — watch from the window.
bt: Lightning puts on a show - watch through the window.

text: Ryp op die draad, son in die oë, gevoel in nul vingers.
en: Frost on the fence, sun in your eyes, feeling in zero fingers.
bt: Frost on the wire, sun in the eyes, feeling in zero fingers.

text: Niks daarbo behalwe sterre nie, en so beland aandete onder hulle.
en: Nothing up there but stars, which is how supper ends up under them.
bt: Nothing up there except stars, and so dinner ends up under them.

text: Sig is vir mense wat omdraai.
en: Visibility is for people who turn back.
bt: Fog is for people who turn around.

text: Niks om te sien hier nie. Letterlik.
en: Nothing to see here. Literally.
bt: Nothing to see here. Literally.

text: Jou kolfgemiddeld oorleef nog 'n dag.
en: Your batting average survives another day.
bt: Your batting average survives another day.

text: Kungaba nenkungu. Qaphela.
en: Could go misty. The dew point's flirting with it.
bt: There may be fog. Be careful.

text: Jy het buite gesê. Die hond het iets anders gehoor.
en: You said outside. The dog heard something else.
bt: You said outside. The dog heard something else.

text: Kufukufuku kancinci.
en: Partly cloudy.
bt: A little [?kufukufuku] (drizzly/misty?).

text: Durban se grys is steeds lekker warm, en daarom raak die promenade nooit leeg nie.
en: Durban grey is still properly warm, which is why the promenade never empties.
bt: Durban's grey is still nicely warm, and that is why the promenade never empties.

text: Cishe kushisa. Sizothola sonke ndawonye.
en: Probably hot. We'll all find out together.
bt: It is nearly hot. We will all get it together.

text: Gratis vuurwerke, geen kaartjies nodig nie.
en: Free fireworks, no tickets needed.
bt: Free fireworks, no tickets needed.

text: Die mooi roete kan sonder jou klaarkom.
en: The scenic route can manage without you.
bt: The scenic route can finish without you.

text: 06:30 en die teer dink al aan smelt.
en: 6:30 and the tar is already considering melting.
bt: 06:30 and the tar is already thinking about melting.

text: Die dorp het sewe-uur al besluit dis kombers-tyd. Die dorp is reg.
en: The town decided at seven that it's blanket time. The town is correct.
bt: The town decided at seven o'clock it is blanket time. The town is right.

text: Die Kaap wys af en toe presies hoekom almal so aangaan oor hom.
en: Every so often Cape Town explains itself. No notes.
bt: The Cape shows off now and then exactly why everyone goes on about it.

text: Vrydag, en hierdie promenade doen die werk van ses verskillende kroeë.
en: Friday, and this promenade is doing the work of six different bars.
bt: Friday, and this promenade does the work of six different bars.

text: Amafu ayesabisa kodwa cishe ayakhohlisa.
en: The clouds are threatening but probably bluffing.
bt: The clouds are frightening but nearly deceptive.

text: Di-koppies di shebahala jwalo ka postcard. Maoto a hao a ikutlwa eka ke ice blocks.
en: The koppies look like a postcard. Your feet feel like ice blocks.
bt: The koppies look like a postcard. Your feet feel like ice blocks.

text: Gemengde sak daar buite. Ons hou voor.
en: Mixed bag out there. We're hedging.
bt: Mixed bag out there. We hold on.

text: Ke seo e leng sona.
en: It is what it is.
bt: That is what it is.

text: Almal wil skielik 'n beurt by die braai hê.

bt: There are clouds but we will survive.

bt: The washing should have been in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.

bt: Yes, it is jersey time. Double jersey.

text: I-weekend ayibi ngcono kunalokhu.

bt: The weekend does not get better than this.

text: Ho khanna butle hase tlhahiso.

bt: Driving slowly is not a suggestion.

bt: The pool light is the only thing in this garden still doing its job.

text: Amafu namhlanje, mhlawumbi neentshukumo.

bt: Clouds today, maybe with [?movements/tremors].

text: Konke kubukeka nge-4K namuhla. Isibhakabhaka siku-ultra mode.

bt: Everything looks 4K today. The sky is in ultra mode.

bt: Pretty enough to climb out of the blanket for a photo. Almost.

bt: The tablecloth was laid before anyone ordered breakfast.

bt: Rain at knock-off time: the whole office waits it out in the lobby.

text: Igeyser icimile ebusuku. Ewe, bekulindelekile

bt: The geyser went off in the night. Yes, it was expected.

text: SPF 50 of jy sal spyt wees teen vanaand.
en: SPF 50 or regret it by tonight.
bt: SPF 50 or you will be sorry by tonight.

text: Braai ke khalendara ea boithabiso. Hlaha.

bt: Braai is the calendar of entertainment. [?Show up].

bt: This weather needs a life coach.

text: Iemand se braai is sopnat.

bt: Someone's braai is soaking wet.

bt: The clothes are still being dried and you feel brave.

en: The road ahead has been the same road for a very long time.
bt: The road ahead has been the same road for a very long time.

en: The clouds are just vibing. No promises.
bt: Clouds are just there. No promises.

text: Die mis het onverwags opgedaag. Klassieke mis.

bt: The fog showed up unexpectedly. Classic fog.

en: Somewhere a roof is someone's new kite.
bt: In some places the roof turned into a kite.

text: E ka ba mpe le ho feta. E ka ba betere le ho feta.
en: Could be worse. Could also be better.
bt: It could be even worse. It could be even better.

text: Daardie hare was 'n besluit wat omtrent veertig minute gelede binne geneem is.
en: That hair was a decision made indoors about forty minutes ago.
bt: That hair wash was a decision made indoors about forty minutes ago.

text: Die son speel siek vandag.
en: The sun's bunking today.
bt: The sun is playing sick today.

text: Een persoon gaan al daardie pers opvee, en iemand anders gaan nie.
en: Somebody is going to sweep all that purple up and somebody is not.
bt: One person is going to wipe up all that purple, and someone else is not.

text: Die son het ingeklok voor jou wekker eers probeer het.
en: The sun clocked in before your alarm even tried.
bt: The sun clocked in before your alarm even tried.

text: Iitshops ziyabiza. Nesitulo naso silindile.
en: The chops are calling. So is the chair.
bt: Chops are expensive. And the chair too, waiting.

text: Geen sterre nie, maar die buurt se honde het steeds opinies.
en: No stars tonight, but the neighbourhood dogs still have opinions.
bt: No stars, but the neighbourhood dogs still have opinions.

bt: The sea is still there. You smell it, it does not see you.

text: EBloemfontein ngo-6 morning: ijezi, igawuni, isikhafu, amateki, nesibindi sokubhekana namakhaza.

bt: In Bloemfontein at 6 morning: jersey, gown, scarf, beanies, and the courage to face the cold.

bt: You can stop promising yourself an evening swim.

bt: The wind has a personal grudge against the umbrella.

en: A sky this clear hands you one cool hour, and this is it.
bt: A sky this clear gives you one cool hour, and this is it.

bt: The sea claps hands, the wind bows. We just want to get home.

bt: Frost on the lawn, and the morning alarm has just landed, feathers and all.

bt: The universe is showing off tonight. Look quickly, freeze slowly.

bt: The sky went fully crazy.

bt: By calculation the sun is there. By the wind it is somewhere else.

bt: This table is not for sale. We are staying until September.

text: Ihlabathi lifumene ifilitha ethambileyo ngale ntsasa.
en: The world got a soft filter this morning.
bt: The world found a soft [?filter] this morning.

bt: Dinner is ready. Now everyone just has to get home.

bt: The rain is almost here. The sky has signed nothing.

en: The sky is the colour of an old Tupperware lid.
bt: The sky is the colour of an old Tupperware lid.

text: Tšokolate e chesang ha se takatso. Ke tlhoko.

bt: Hot chocolate is not a craving. It is a need.

bt: Visibility backed by whom? Person.

bt: It looks wet. The models are almost sure, not fully.

bt: Clear sky, say the sums. Also look at the real sky.

bt: Good weather for pretending to sleep early.

text: Kuyabanda.
en: It's chilly.
bt: It is cold.

en: Wednesday, and the Cape Doctor is doing its rounds a little early.
bt: Wednesday, and the Cape Doctor is doing his rounds a bit early.

bt: First coffee outside. The emails can wait.

bt: The clouds put tonight's sunset behind a paywall.

bt: The sky gives nothing.

bt: Your car's steering wheel is hot as a pan.

bt: The Karoo cools quickly under a clear sky, but nobody has noticed yet.

text: Vandag se planne: bestaan buitentoe.

bt: Today's plans: exist outside.

bt: Clouds are there, sun is there. [?Measure/estimate] is [?phohmisetso].

bt: On the set. It is your story anyway.

bt: Perhaps something is cooking. Stay close to the roof.

bt: Someone is going to come home to a lounge full of Seinheuwel.

bt: The gutter carries this street's problems straight down to the next one.

bt: Your hairstyle? Gone. Accept it.

bt: Watch out for the fog: it likes to arrive unannounced.

bt: Thursday's forecast, as the dog reads it: warm floorboards until further notice.

en: Cold but clear

bt: Loose things are now part of the weather.

bt: The beach has become one colour, and it's the cold one.

bt: Nice weather.

bt: There is no cloud. Just you and the Southern Cross.

text: Die son gaan nie vandag die blink kom inspekteer nie. Die kar is tevrede.
en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
bt: The sun won't come to inspect the shine today. The car is satisfied.

text: Ons praat nie oor vandag nie. Vandag is verby. Ons is trots op ons.
en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.
bt: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We are proud of ourselves.

text: Rain so swaar dit moet huur betaal.
en: Rain so heavy it should pay rent.
bt: Rain so heavy it should pay rent.

text: Buite: 2 grade. Binne: 9 grade en 'n baie goeie vuur. SA huise, nè.
en: Outside: 2 degrees. Inside: 9 degrees and a very good fire. SA homes, hey.
bt: Outside: 2 degrees. Inside: 9 degrees and a very good fire. SA houses, hey.

text: Nabani onepuli namhlanje ngumhlobo wakho omtsha omkhulu.
en: Whoever has a pool today is your new best friend.
bt: Anyone with a pool today is your big new friend.

text: I-duvet yayinombono ofanele morning.
en: The duvet had the right idea this morning.
bt: The duvet had the right idea for morning.

text: I-grey vibes. Isibhakabhaka sifana noMsombuluko wami.
en: Grey vibes. The sky matched my Monday.
bt: Grey vibes. The sky is like my Monday.

text: Die hond het klaar sy plek onder die bed bespreek.
en: The dog has already booked his spot under the bed.
bt: The dog has already booked his spot under the bed.

text: Jou telkaart kan nou ophou om erger te word.
en: Your scorecard can stop getting worse now.
bt: Your scorecard can stop getting worse now.

text: Fridge ke kamore e pholileng ka ho fetisisa ka tlung.
en: The fridge is the coolest room in the house.
bt: The fridge is the coolest room in the house.

text: Cishe night obuhle. Izinkanyezi azikaqinisekisi.
en: Probably a clear night. The stars haven't confirmed.
bt: Nearly a nice night. The stars have not yet confirmed.

text: Koel, grys en windstil — eerlikwaar die beste drafweer wat hierdie stad verkoop.
en: Cool, grey and windless — honestly the best running weather this city sells.
bt: Cool, grey and windless — honestly the best running weather this city sells.

text: Hlonipha ukuduma. Kukufanele.
en: Respect the thunder. It's earned it.
bt: Respect the thunder. It deserves it.

text: Kubonakala kumanzi. Iimodeli ziqinisekile mhlawumbi, cha ngokupheleleyo.
en: Looks wet. The models are fairly sure, not certain.
bt: It looks wet. The models are sure, maybe, no, not entirely.

text: Gratis vuurwerke. Geen kaartjies. Beste sitplekke in die huis.
en: Free fireworks, no tickets, best seats in the house.
bt: Free fireworks. No tickets. Best seats in the house.

text: Donder so naby die mure het geskud. Respek.
en: Thunder so close the walls shook. Respect.
bt: Thunder so close the walls shook. Respect.

text: Die son het hierdie maand meer aan daardie grasperk gedoen as wat enige grassnyer ooit sal.
en: The sun has done more to that lawn this month than any mower ever will.
bt: The sun has done more for that lawn this month than any lawnmower ever will.

text: Storm op die horison. Dis jou sperdatum.
en: Storm on the horizon. That's your deadline.
bt: Storm on the horizon. It's your deadline.

text: Elke neonbord in die straat word vanaand op die nat teer verdubbel.
en: Every neon sign in the street is being doubled on the wet tar tonight.
bt: Every neon sign in the street is doubled tonight on the wet tar.

text: Niemand gaan vandag betyds wees nie.
en: Nobody is being on time today.
bt: Nobody is going to be on time today.

text: Kushushu.
en: It's hot.
bt: It is hot.

text: Bohle ba lebetse ho otlela. Gape.
en: Everyone's forgotten how to drive. Again.
bt: Everyone has forgotten how to [?otlela]. Again.

text: Blou links, ernstige besigheid regs, en die lyn skuif na jou kant toe.
en: Blue on the left, business on the right, and the line is moving your way.
bt: Blue on the left, serious business on the right, and the line is shifting toward you.

text: Isibhakabhaka esiqhelekileyo sisenza izinto eziqhelekileyo nje.
en: A perfectly average sky doing perfectly average things.
bt: The ordinary sky is just doing ordinary things.

text: Daardie beker stoom, want Joburg-oggende onder die wolke begin behoorlik koud.
en: That mug is steaming because Joburg mornings under cloud start properly cold.
bt: That mug is steaming, because Joburg mornings under the clouds are getting properly cold.

text: Die son het uitgeklok sonder om te groet. Onbeskof, maar relatable.
en: The sun clocked out without saying bye. Rude, but relatable.
bt: The sun clocked out without saying goodbye. Rude, but relatable.

text: Krieket tot die lig weg is, en lig soos dié vat sy tyd om te gaan.
en: Cricket till the light goes, and light like this takes its time going.
bt: Cricket until the light is gone, and light like this takes its time to go.

text: Yonke into ibonakala nge-4K namhlanje. Isibhakabhaka siku-ultra mode.
en: Everything looks 4K today. The sky's in ultra mode.
bt: Everything looks 4K today. The sky is in ultra mode.

text: Maandag het die mooiste lug van die week gekry en mors dit op 'n plaaspad.
en: Monday got the best sky of the week and is wasting it on a farm road.
bt: Monday got the prettiest sky of the week and wastes it on a farm road.

text: Mis dié dik, en die doelwagter verdedig 'n gerug.
en: Fog this thick, the goalie is defending a rumour.
bt: Fog this thick, and the goalkeeper is defending a rumour.

text: ho  a tjhesa
en: It's hot.
bt: It is hot.

text: Butle butle ke fetoha letamo lekhutlong.
en: Slowly becoming a puddle in the corner.
bt: Slowly, slowly I am turning into a dam in the corner.

text: I-aircon remote manje yimpahla yomphakathi. Xoxisana.
en: The aircon remote is now public property. Negotiate.
bt: The aircon remote is now public property. Negotiate/talk it out.

text: Alles hier buite is óf behoorlik gewortel óf reeds weg.
en: Everything out here is either properly rooted or already gone.
bt: Everything out here is either properly rooted or already gone.

text: Ayidakumbisi. Kodwa... ayinamdla tu.
en: Not depressing. Just... underwhelming.
bt: It is not [?depressing]. But... it is not interesting at all.

text: Sebenzisa lo sunscreen okanye kuzakubanzima kuwe.
en: Reapply that sunscreen or suffer.
bt: Use this sunscreen or it will be hard on you.

text: Jou baadjie het 'n baadjie. Dis daai soort dag.
en: Your jacket has a jacket. It's that kind of day.
bt: Your jacket has a jacket. It's that kind of day.

text: Endaweni ethile intethe iyazinikela ngempela.
en: Somewhere a cricket is really giving it.
bt: Somewhere a grasshopper is truly giving itself up.

text: Nie Troufoto weer nie. Nie die einde van die wêreld nie.
en: Not Instagram weather. Not the end of the world.
bt: Not Wedding Photo again. Not the end of the world.

text: Die baadjie-argument hou ontbyt op.
en: The jacket argument is holding up breakfast.
bt: The jacket argument is holding up breakfast.

text: Elke blaar op daardie mat het opgedaag sonder 'n uitnodiging.
en: Every leaf on that mat arrived without being invited.
bt: Every leaf on that mat showed up without an invitation.

text: Indalo yenzaukucima kwayo.
en: Nature's doing its own load shedding.
bt: Nature is doing its switching-off (going out).

text: Haar hare gaan een kant toe, die palm gaan dieselfde kant toe, en nie een is gevra nie.
en: Her hair is going one way, the palm is going the same way, and neither was asked.
bt: Her hair goes one way, the palm goes the same way, and neither was asked.

text: Skoolskoene se grootste vyand het pas geland.
en: School shoes' greatest enemy has just landed.
bt: School shoes' greatest enemy has just landed.

text: Die berge het vanaand vroeg gaan slaap.
en: The mountains went to bed early tonight.
bt: The mountains went to sleep early tonight.

text: Die tafel het 'n uitsig. Vra eerder vir die spyskaart.
en: The table has a view. Ask for the menu instead.
bt: The table has a view. Rather ask for the menu.

text: Geen wind op die water vanoggend nie, en dit is daar buite meer werd as sonskyn.
en: No wind on the water this morning, which is worth more than sunshine out there.
bt: No wind on the water this morning, and out there that is worth more than sunshine.

text: Ungacinganga ngokuqhuba ndawo.
en: Don't even think about driving somewhere.
bt: You could think about driving somewhere.
note: reads as permission, not warning against driving

text: Maru a teng empa ha a etse letho.
en: The clouds are here but they're not doing anything.
bt: There are clouds but they are not doing anything.

text: Sewukhumbula ibhedi yakho kodwa unemizuzu nje elishumi elinesibini uphumile.
en: You miss your bed and you've been gone twelve minutes.
bt: You are already missing your bed but you have only been out twelve minutes.

text: Vingerlose handskoene by 'n laptop: winter het die tuiskantoor betree.
en: Fingerless gloves at a laptop: winter has entered the home office.
bt: Fingerless gloves at a laptop: winter has entered the home office.

text: Nagskof-wolke: hulle hou net die plek warm tot die son terug is.
en: Night-shift clouds: just keeping the place warm till the sun gets back.
bt: Night-shift clouds: they only keep the place warm until the sun is back.

text: Iewers loei die mishoring en 'n duisend mense sê gelyk 'ag nee'.
en: Somewhere the foghorn moans and a thousand people say 'ag nee' at exactly the same time.
bt: Somewhere the foghorn blares and a thousand people say 'oh no' in unison.

text: 'Net 'n uurtjie strand toe.' Vier uur later...
en: 'One hour at the beach.' History's most confident lie.
bt: 'Just an hour at the beach.' Four hours later...

text: Die weer het die kantoor dak toe geskuif, en produktiwiteit kan later stry.
en: The weather moved the office to the roof and productivity can argue later.
bt: The weather moved the office to the roof, and productivity can argue later.

text: Ihlabathi nje... lanyamalala.
en: The world just... disappeared.
bt: The world just... disappeared.

text: Alles op daardie draad was tien minute gelede al droog. Die wind spog nou net.
en: Everything on that line was dry ten minutes ago. The wind is just showing off now.
bt: Everything on that line was already dry ten minutes ago. The wind is just showing off now.

text: Die hele straat ruik na iemand anders se kos. Die mis hou die geheim.
en: The whole street smells like someone else's dinner and the fog won't say whose.
bt: The whole street smells of someone else's food. The fog keeps the secret.

text: Dis koud.
en: It's chilly.
bt: It's cold.

text: Die tuin beweeg en hy het besluit die deur is ver genoeg.
en: The garden is moving and he has decided the doorway is far enough.
bt: The garden is moving and he decided the door is far enough.

text: Izibini ezintathu zee kawusi kodwa kunjalo azonelanga.
en: Three pairs of socks and still not enough.
bt: Three pairs of socks but still they [?did not suffice].

text: Bring die wasgoed in. Ontdooi dan jou vingers.
en: Bring the washing in. Then thaw your fingers.
bt: Bring in the washing. Then thaw your fingers.

text: Daardie baadjie-argument is verby voor ontbyt.
en: That jacket argument is over before breakfast.
bt: That jacket argument is over before breakfast.

text: Daardie palm is al so lank so gebuig dat hy dink hy staan regop.
en: That palm has been bent that way so long it thinks it is upright.
bt: That palm has been bent for so long that it thinks it stands upright.

text: Sonskyn: 10/10. Gevoel: vra liewer nie.
en: Sunshine: 10/10. Feels-like: don't ask.
bt: Sunshine: 10/10. Feeling: rather don't ask.

text: Die wolke jaag asof hulle laat is vir iets.
en: The clouds are rushing like they're late for something.
bt: The clouds race as if they are late for something.

text: Die wolk het omtrent vier minute ná die handdoek neergesit is aangekom, en dis beleid.
en: The cloud arrived about four minutes after the towel went down, which is policy.
bt: The cloud arrived about four minutes after the towel was put down, and that's policy.

text: Ijinsi emanzi yonke imini. Isohlwayo esiqhelekileyo.
en: Wet jeans for the rest of the day. The classic punishment.
bt: Wet jeans all day. The usual punishment.

text: I-boerie roll yesidlo sakusasa? Ngempelaveki? Yamkelekile.
en: Boerie roll for breakfast? On a weekend? Acceptable.
bt: A boerie roll for breakfast? On the weekend? Welcome.

text: Jou aandbraai het 'n binnenshuise komitee gekry.
en: Your evening braai has acquired an indoor committee.
bt: Your evening braai has got an indoor committee.

text: Selfs jou foon oorverhit.
en: Even your phone's overheating.
bt: Even your phone overheats.

text: Ukusela amanzi: ewe. Onke.
en: Water consumption: yes. All of it.
bt: Drinking water: yes. Everyone.

text: I-AC icela umusa.
en: The AC is begging for mercy.
bt: The AC begs for mercy.

text: Selfs die vlaktes hou vandag geheime.
en: Even the plains are keeping secrets today.
bt: Even the plains are keeping secrets today.

text: Lyk toegetrek. Die bronne is nie eenparig nie.
en: Looks overcast. The sources aren't unanimous.
bt: Looks overcast. The sources are not unanimous.

text: Die oggend se tweede ketel het niks met tee te doen nie.
en: The morning's second kettle has nothing to do with tea.
bt: The morning's second kettle has nothing to do with tea.

text: Jy is nie koud nie, jy is 'lekker koud'. Groot verskil.
en: You're not cold, you're 'lekker koud'. Big difference.
bt: You're not cold, you're 'nicely cold'. Big difference.

text: Iewers hier is 'n uitsig. Die brosjure het belowe.
en: There's a view here somewhere. The brochure promised.
bt: Somewhere here is a view. The brochure promised.

text: Jou hande is in jou sakke en hulle kom nie uit nie.
en: Your hands are in your pockets and they're not coming out.
bt: Your hands are in your pockets and they are not coming out.

text: Daardie venster het vanoggend die beste program, en dit is net reën.
en: That window has the best programme on this morning and it is just rain.
bt: That window has the best programme this morning, and it's just rain.

text: Die son het afgeteken. Die wolke gloei nog, en die balkon ook.
en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
bt: The sun has signed off. The clouds still glow, and so does the balcony.

text: Mpunga, cishe. Sike sabona kusimangaza.
en: Grey, probably. We've seen it surprise us.
bt: Grey, nearly. We have just seen it, and it surprises us.

text: Umgca kwisikhululo sepethroli usanda kuphindeka kathathu.
en: The queue at the petrol station just tripled.
bt: The line at the petrol station has just folded/multiplied three times.

text: Die plan was tien minute. Die neuse het ná twee ingegee.
en: The plan was ten minutes. The noses tapped out after two.
bt: The plan was ten minutes. The nose gave in after two.

text: Izicathulo zakho zesuede zikhethe namuhla? Isibindi.
en: Your suede shoes chose today? Bold.
bt: Your suede shoes chose today? Courage.

text: Abadlali be-kite bajabulile kakhulu.
en: Kite surfers are having the time of their lives.
bt: The kite flyers are very happy.

text: Bohobe bo hlakileng.
en: Clear night.
bt: The bread that is clear.

text: Kukho amafu nelanga. Umlinganiselo awuqinisekanga
en: Cloudy enough to comment, sunny enough to ignore.
bt: There are clouds and sun. The estimate is not certain.

text: Die lang pad huis toe? Moeilik om te sê vanaand.
en: The long way home? Hard to tell tonight.
bt: The long road home? Hard to say tonight.

text: Oggendtake. Begin deur die wasgoeddraad te soek.
en: Morning jobs. Start by finding the washing line.
bt: Morning tasks. Start by looking for the washing line.

text: Niemand het die voorspelling gesê nie. Dit het net opgedaag.
en: Nobody told the forecast. It just arrived.
bt: Nobody gave the forecast. It just showed up.

text: Een pantoffel is klaar uit die spel en die oortreksel wen steeds.
en: One slipper is already out of the game and the cover is still winning.
bt: One slipper is already out of the game and the overcoat still wins.

text: Die reën het nie uitgeklok nie.
en: The rain didn't clock off.
bt: The rain hasn't clocked out.

text: Jou kar het gevra om van die huis af te werk.
en: Your car has asked to work from home.
bt: Your car asked to work from home.

text: Maandag, en ontbyt in hierdie dorp is deur 'n enjinkap afgehandel.
en: Monday, and breakfast in this dorp has been sorted by a car bonnet.
bt: Monday, and breakfast in this town was dealt with by an engine bonnet.

text: Bonke bangabangane bakho uma unepuli.
en: Everyone's suddenly your friend when you have a pool.
bt: All of them can be your friends if you have a pool.

text: Wolke die hele middag, nie 'n druppel nie. Die tuinslang is weer aan diens.
en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.
bt: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The garden hose is back on duty.

text: Ikhrimu yelanga ayikhona ukukhetha, boet.
en: Sunscreen is not optional, boet.
bt: Sunscreen is not a matter of choosing (not optional), boet.

text: Die Hoëveld hou nie van subtiel nie en ons is dankbaar.
en: The Highveld doesn't do subtle, and honestly we're grateful.
bt: The Highveld doesn't like subtle and we are grateful.

text: Die afskop word hersien deur die enigste amptenaar wat hoër as die skeidsregter is.
en: Kickoff is under review by the only official that outranks the referee.
bt: The kick-off is being reviewed by the only official higher than the referee.

text: Uiteindelik 'n ordentlike verskoning vir jou telkaart.
en: Finally, a respectable excuse for your scorecard.
bt: Finally a decent excuse for your scorecard.

text: Teen twaalfuur is hierdie water bad-temperatuur. Beplan daarvolgens.
en: By noon this water is bath temperature. Plan accordingly.
bt: By twelve o'clock this water is bath temperature. Plan accordingly.

text: Die berg gloei soos 'n kaggel. Ongelukkig werk dit net vir die oë.
en: The mountain glows like a fireplace. Unfortunately it only warms the eyes.
bt: The mountain glows like a hearth. Unfortunately it only works for the eyes.

text: Mhlawumbi kuyabanda. Thatha ijezi, uya kusibulela.
en: Probably cold. Take the jersey, you'll thank us.
bt: Maybe it's cold. Take a jersey, you will thank us.

text: Die palms maak al ure daardie geraas en niemand is wakker om om te gee nie.
en: The palms have been making that noise for hours and nobody is awake to mind.
bt: The palms have been making that noise for hours and nobody is awake to care.

text: Die karsitplekke vries. Alles vries.
en: The car seats are freezing. Everything is freezing.
bt: The car seats are freezing. Everything is freezing.

text: Letsatsi le phethahetseng. Ha ho mabaka. Tsamaea.
en: Perfect day. No excuses. Get out.
bt: A perfect sun. No reasons. Go.

text: Sun lisekhefu letiye. Akukho ETA.
en: The sun's on a tea break. No ETA.
bt: The sun is on a tea break. No ETA.

text: Bewolk, maar dit sit nie juis moeite in nie.
en: Cloud cover, low effort.
bt: Overcast, but it isn't really putting in any effort.

text: Tlhaho e iponahatsa mme re teng.
en: Nature's flexing and we're here for it.
bt: Nature shows itself and we are here.

text: Umbane ubonisa umboniso — jonga ngefestile.
en: Lightning's putting on a show — watch from the window.
bt: Lightning (electricity) puts on a show — look through the window.

text: Hoëveld-winter: die enigste plek waar jy twee jasse aantrek om die pos te gaan haal.
en: Highveld winter: the only place where you wear two jackets to fetch the post.
bt: Highveld winter: the only place where you put on two coats to fetch the post.

text: Imini efudumeleyo iyeza, mhlawumbi.
en: Warm one coming, give or take a few degrees.
bt: A warm day is medicine, maybe.

text: Leholimo le ratoang ke Eskom. Ha ho solar kajeno.
en: Eskom-friendly weather. No solar today.
bt: The sky loved by Eskom. No solar today.

text: Imoto ikho ngaphandle. Kuthiwa nje.
en: The car is out there. Allegedly.
bt: The car is outside. So they say.

text: Niemand staan by die kole vir die kos nie. Ons staan vir die hitte.
en: Nobody's standing at the coals for the food. We're here for the heat.
bt: Nobody stands at the coals for the food. We stand for the heat.

text: Weekend vibes ezinamandla kakhulu zifuna i-playlist yazo.
en: Weekend vibes so strong they need their own playlist.
bt: Very strong weekend vibes want their own playlist.

text: Die dag het nog niks verkeerd gedoen nie. Gee hom kans.
en: Zero mistakes from today so far. Sky included.
bt: The day hasn't done anything wrong yet. Give it a chance.

text: Bosiu bo khutsitseng, mohlomong. Leholimo le ka fetoha.
en: Calm night, most likely. The sky reserves the right to change.
bt: A quiet night, maybe. The sky could change.

text: Die tjoppies roep. Die stoel ook.
en: The chops are calling. So is the chair.
bt: The chops are calling. The chair too.

text: Jou span skuld jou wasmasjien 'n verskoning.
en: Your team owes your washing machine an apology.
bt: Your team owes your washing machine an apology.

text: Akekho ozoposta lokhu ku-Instagram.
en: Nobody's posting this sunset on Instagram.
bt: Nobody is going to post this on Instagram.

text: Die lug dra sy onderhoudspak: grys, netjies, sê niks.
en: The sky is in its interview suit: grey, neat, giving nothing away.
bt: The sky is wearing its overalls: grey, neat, says nothing.

text: Die Karoo se koudste uur kom net voor sy mooiste een.
en: The Karoo does its coldest hour right before its prettiest one.
bt: The Karoo's coldest hour comes just before its prettiest one.

text: Kussing omgedraai. Onderhandelinge duur voort.
en: Pillow turned. Negotiations continue.
bt: Pillow turned over. Negotiations continue.

text: Een rukwind, en elke servet in die kafee vertrek tegelyk.
en: One gust, and every napkin in the café leaves at once.
bt: One gust, and every napkin in the café leaves at once.

text: Imvula enzima kakhulu kufanele ikhokhe irenti.
en: Rain so heavy it should pay rent.
bt: Rain that stands (stays) very much should pay rent.

text: Leholimo le lerootho, tumelo e tlase.
en: Grey skies, low conviction.
bt: Grey sky, low faith.

text: Donderdag, en sy is die enigste ding op hierdie pad wat nie sywaarts gaan nie.
en: Thursday, and she is the only thing on this road not going sideways.
bt: Thursday, and she is the only thing on this road not going sideways.

text: Die een dier wat by die lug se bui kan pas, het vandag geen moeite nie.
en: The one animal that can match the sky's mood is having no trouble today.
bt: The one animal that can match the sky's mood has no trouble today.

text: Warmsjokolade-weer diagnoseer homself. Die malvalekkers is die tweede mening.
en: Hot chocolate weather is self-diagnosing. The marshmallows are the second opinion.
bt: Hot-chocolate weather diagnoses itself. The marshmallows are the second opinion.

text: Ukuwasha imoto kwakho bekuyize yemali.
en: Your car wash was a waste of money.
bt: Washing your car was a waste of money.

text: Wolke met hoofseun sindroom.
en: Cloud cover with main-character syndrome.
bt: Clouds with head-boy syndrome.

text: Te warm om te stry. Te warm om te funksioneer.
en: Too hot to argue. Too hot to function.
bt: Too hot to argue. Too hot to function.

text: Helder nag
en: Clear night
bt: Clear night

text: Een dun streep lig op die horison, en die hele lug leun daarop.
en: One thin line of light at the horizon, and the whole sky leaning on it.
bt: One thin streak of light on the horizon, and the whole sky leans on it.

text: Moenie aan die veiligheidsgordel-gespe vat nie. Vertrou ons.
en: Don't touch the seatbelt buckle. Trust us.
bt: Don't touch the seatbelt buckle. Trust us.

text: Die lug se CV is pas opgedateer.
en: The sky's CV just got updated.
bt: The sky's CV has just been updated.

text: Die nag het nog niks afgekoel nie; selfs die water sweet.
en: Night has not cooled anything yet; even the water is perspiring.
bt: The night has cooled nothing yet; even the water sweats.

text: Inkungu iyiselile intaba.
en: The fog drank the mountain.
bt: Fog has swallowed the mountain.

text: Maru a shebahala a belaela ka nnete.
en: Clouds looking proper suspicious.
bt: The clouds look doubtful, truly.

text: Menoana ea hao e tlisitse tletlebo ka molao.
en: Your toes have filed a formal complaint.
bt: Your fingers have lodged a formal (legal) complaint.

text: Ukuduma kwezulu kuyeza.
en: Thunder rolling in.
bt: The rumbling of the sky is measuring (testing).

text: Ikhala lakho lizokudayisa ngo-3pm.
en: Your nose is going to betray you by 3pm.
bt: Your nose will sell you out at 3pm.

text: Afrika e iponahatsa hape. Ka khotso ka ho qhibilihisang.
en: Africa showing off again. Quietly devastating.
bt: Africa shows itself again. In peace, in [?melting].

text: Kunamafu.
en: Cloudy vibes.
bt: There are clouds.

text: Se ke oa nahana le ho khanna ho ea kae kapa kae
en: Don't even think about driving somewhere.
bt: Don't even think about driving anywhere.

text: Vuur aan voor twaalf. Ons speel nie meer nie.

bt: Fire on before twelve. We are not playing any more.

text: Umkhenkce kwisiselo sakho uhlale imizuzwana engama-30.
en: The ice in your drink lasted exactly 30 seconds.
bt: The ice in your drink lasted 30 seconds.

text: Tlanya konopo ya `Share` ya Safari ka tlase ho skirini sa hao
bt: Tap the `Share` button of Safari at the bottom of your screen.

text: Van hier bo lyk almal se probleme onskerp. Werk vir my.
en: From up here everyone's problems look out of focus. Works for me.
bt: From up here everyone's problems look blurry. Works for me.

text: Die dag was so mooi, selfs die verkeer het saamgespeel.
en: A day so good even rush hour felt optional.
bt: The day was so beautiful that even the traffic played along.

text: Kubanda, izulu licwebile
en: Cold but clear
bt: It is cold, the sky has cleared [?licwebile].

text: Die stoeptrap is nog warm en gaan nog 'n uur so bly.
en: The stoep step is still warm and will be for another hour yet.
bt: The stoep step is still warm and will stay so for another hour.

text: Daardie dashboard is so warm dat die papiertjie voor die sjokolade moed opgegee het.
en: That dashboard is hot enough that the wrapper gave up before the chocolate did.
bt: That dashboard is so hot that the wrapper gave up before the chocolate.

text: Lefatše le... nyametse.
en: The world just... disappeared.
bt: The earth... has vanished.

text: As dit nóú al so voel, gaan tweede pouse 'n oorlewingsport wees.
en: If it feels like this now, second break is going to be a survival sport.
bt: If it feels like this already, second break will be a survival sport.

text: Die soort middag wat 'n hele sokkerspan op 'n randsteen laat sit.
en: The sort of afternoon that keeps a whole soccer team sitting on a curb.
bt: The kind of afternoon that makes a whole soccer team sit on a kerb.

text: Die lug brom. Bly naby 'n dak.
en: Sky's grumbling. Stay close to a roof.
bt: The sky rumbles. Stay near a roof.

text: Moea mohlomong o teng. Tšoara sekoahelo sa braai.
en: Wind's likely. Hold onto the braai cover.
bt: Wind maybe exists/is there. Hold on to the braai cover.

text: Ntho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e lokolohileng serapaneng e khethile pefo.
en: Every loose object in the garden has chosen violence.
bt: Everything that is loose in the garden has chosen violence.

text: Ungacabangi ngisho ngokushayela ndawo.
en: Don't even think about driving somewhere.
bt: Don't even think about driving anywhere.

text: Jou hond wil vir een slag ontbyt afgelewer hê.
en: Your dog would like breakfast delivered for once.
bt: Your dog wants breakfast delivered for once.

text: Die lug gee 'ek probeer weer more' energie.
en: The sky's giving 'I'll try again tomorrow' energy.
bt: The sky gives 'I'll try again tomorrow' energy.

text: Niemand gaan ooit daardie een wit sokkie weer kry nie.
en: Nobody is ever going to find that one white sock again.
bt: Nobody will ever find that one white sock again.

text: I-CV yesibhakabhaka isanda kuhlaziywa.
en: The sky's CV just got updated.
bt: The sky's CV has just been updated.

text: Kubonakala kubanda. I-thermometer isenza siqikelele.
en: Looks cold-ish. The thermometer's keeping us guessing.
bt: It looks cold. The thermometer makes us sure.
note: thermometer makes sure vs keeps us guessing

text: Grys lug, lae oortuiging.
en: Grey skies, low conviction.
bt: Grey sky, low conviction.

text: Ifriji ibonakala ifudumele kunelawunji namuhla.
en: The fridge feels warmer than the lounge today.
bt: The fridge seems warmer than the lounge today.

text: Probably Weather e kopanya diponelopele tse tsoang ho Open-Meteo, WeatherAPI.com, MET Norway le Pirate Weather ho u fa ponelopele e tšepahalang.
bt: Probably Weather combines forecasts from Open-Meteo, WeatherAPI.com, MET Norway and Pirate Weather to give you a reliable forecast.

text: Kaapse koue is nat koue. Dit klim in jou bene en pak uit.
en: Cape cold is wet cold. It moves into your bones and unpacks.
bt: Cape cold is wet cold. It climbs into your legs and unpacks.

text: Maandag, en die tuin het homself herrangskik sonder om iemand te vra.
en: Monday, and the garden has rearranged itself without asking anyone.
bt: Monday, and the garden rearranged itself without asking anyone.

text: Inyanga lisekhefu letiye. Akukho ETA.
en: The sun's on a tea break. No ETA.
bt: The moon is on a tea break [?lisekhefu letiye]. No ETA.
note: moon on tea break instead of sun

text: Iewers is 'n braai op sy laaste kole, geen sterre nie — die gesels dra die aand.
en: Somewhere a braai is down to its last coals, no stars — the conversation carries the night.
bt: Somewhere a braai is on its last coals, no stars - the conversation carries the evening.

text: Die son het vir die hele wedstryd uitgebly en draai nog rond vir die tjips.
en: The sun stayed out for the whole match and is hanging around for the chips.
bt: The sun stayed away for the whole match and is still hanging around for the chips.
note: sun stayed away vs stayed out

text: Jou duur sambreel het 'n kort loopbaan gekies.
en: Your expensive umbrella has chosen a short career.
bt: Your expensive umbrella chose a short career.

text: Ten minste maak iemand geld uit hierdie wind.
en: At least somebody's making money out of this wind.
bt: At least someone is making money from this wind.

text: Ii-wipers ziku-max kodwa azanelanga.
en: The wipers are on max and it's still not enough.
bt: The wipers are at max but they are not enough.

text: Haeba o ka bala sena, o haufi haholo.
en: If you can read this, you're too close.
bt: If you can read this, you are very close.

text: I-Afrika iyaziqhayisa futhi. Ngokuthula ngokuphazamisayo.
en: Africa showing off again. Quietly devastating.
bt: Africa is boasting again. Disturbingly quietly.

text: Vandag se lug is skoongewas en yskoud gestryk.
en: Today's sky: freshly washed, ice-pressed.
bt: Today's sky is washed clean and ironed ice-cold.

text: Ewe, imvu ina ngecala. Yinto eqhelekileyo yaseMzantsi Afrika.
en: Yes, it's raining sideways. South Africa speciality.
bt: Yes, the [?imvu: sheep] rains sideways. It's a normal South African thing.

text: Daardie son is elf minute op en doen dit reeds.
en: That sun has been up eleven minutes and it is already doing that.
bt: That sun has been up for eleven minutes and is already doing it.

text: Ukuselwa kwerooibos kuphindaphindeke kabini ngoku.
en: Rooibos consumption just doubled.
bt: Rooibos drinking has doubled now.

text: Kuyilokho okuyikho.
en: It is what it is.
bt: It is what it is.

text: Jou koplampe doen 'n 'gedagtes en gebede'.
en: Your headlights are doing a 'thoughts and prayers'.
bt: Your headlights are doing 'thoughts and prayers'.

text: Iindudumo
en: Thunder
bt: Thunder (rumblings).

text: Inkuku idle indawo.
en: The fog ate the neighbourhood.
bt: The chicken has eaten [the] place.
note: chicken ate the place instead of fog ate neighbourhood

text: Teen die oggend is dit droog en teen sesuur weer klam — so werk dit maar.
en: It will be dry by morning and damp again by six, which is the deal.
bt: By morning it is dry and by six o'clock damp again - that's how it works.

text: Die beste plek is die een wat jy weier om te los.
en: The best seat is the one you refuse to leave.
bt: The best place is the one you refuse to leave.

text: 'n Tafel buite? Ons vat eerder die rekening.
en: A table outside? We'll take the bill.
bt: A table outside? We'd rather take the bill.

text: I-Afrika iyaziqhayisa kwakhona. Ngokuzolileyo ngokumangalisayo.
en: Africa showing off again. Quietly devastating.
bt: Africa boasts again. Calmly astonishingly.

text: hoseng ho lebetse ho fetolela
en: The morning forgot to render.
bt: In the morning it forgot to translate.

text: Bly gehidreer of word biltong.
en: Stay hydrated or become a biltong.
bt: Stay hydrated or become biltong.

text: Maemo a metsi, mohlomong. U se ke ua re qotsa braaing.
en: Wet conditions, probably. Don't quote us at the braai.
bt: Water conditions, maybe. Don't [?qotsa] us while braaing.

text: Imvula iyenzeka. Nokungabi yikho nhlobo kuyenzeka.
en: Rain's possible. So is being completely wrong.
bt: Rain is happening. Even if it isn't at all, it happens.

text: Khusela obo buso! Bubo kuphela onabo.
en: Protect that face! It's the only one you've got.
bt: Protect that face! It's the only one you have.

text: Huis toe dan. Jy kan môre na jou waardigheid soek.
en: Home, then. You can look for your dignity tomorrow.
bt: Home then. You can look for your dignity tomorrow.

text: Ibhotile yamanzi ashushu yeyona MVP yokwenyani namhlanje.
en: Hot water bottle is the real MVP today.
bt: A bottle of hot water is the real MVP today.

text: Imozulu egqibeleleyo yokuzenza uza kulala kwangoko.
en: Perfect weather for pretending you'll go to bed early.
bt: Perfect weather for pretending you will go to sleep right away.

text: Plat see, moeë son, en die lug nog warm genoeg om in 'n nat wetsuit rond te sit.
en: Flat sea, spent sun, and air still warm enough to sit around in a wet wetsuit.
bt: Flat sea, tired sun, and the air still warm enough to sit around in a wet wetsuit.

text: Amafu, kodwa kungekho ukukhathazeka.
en: Clouds, but make it casual.
bt: Clouds, but with no worry.

text: Tafel buite? Jou serp wil beswaar maak.
en: Table outside? Your scarf would like to object.
bt: Table outside? Your scarf wants to object.

text: Die dag gaan uit soos 'n kers, nie 'n vuurwerk nie. Respek.
en: The day is going out like a candle, not a firework. Respect.
bt: The day goes out like a candle, not a firework. Respect.

text: Jou aanddrankie het 'n kort sperdatum ontwikkel.
en: Your evening drink has developed a short deadline.
bt: Your evening drink has developed a short deadline.

text: Amasokisi amanzi. Ukukhaphela okukhulu.
en: Wet socks. The ultimate betrayal.
bt: Wet socks. Big [?ukukhaphela].

text: Die geut vertel jou presies hoe lank jy dit gelos het.
en: The gutter is telling you exactly how long you left it.
bt: The gutter tells you exactly how long you have left it.

text: ke bosiu bobotle ho bona Molalatladi
en: Perfect night to actually see the Milky Way.
bt: It is a beautiful night to see [?Molalatladi].

text: I-trampoline yomuntu manje imigwaqo emibili.
en: Someone's trampoline is now two streets away.
bt: Someone's trampoline is now two roads.

text: Stel die wekker vroeër. Die kar gaan dit nie doen nie.
en: Set the alarm earlier. The car won't.
bt: Set the alarm earlier. The car won't do it.

text: Die hond het by die voordeur gekyk, omgedraai, en teruggegaan bed toe. Wys jou.
en: The dog looked out the front door, turned around, and went back to bed. Says it all.
bt: The dog looked at the front door, turned around, and went back to bed. Shows you.

text: Rain engase ine
en: Possible showers
bt: Rain might fall.

text: Nul wind, nul wolke, nul genade.
en: Zero wind. Zero clouds. Zero mercy.
bt: Zero wind, zero clouds, zero mercy.

text: Daardie heining leun al van Donderdag af so, en dit gaan nie regop kom nie.
en: That hedge has been leaning like that since Thursday and it is not straightening.
bt: That fence has been leaning like that since Thursday, and it's not coming upright.

text: Die wolke het laat gebly net vir die kleur. Maandag skuld almal soveel.
en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.
bt: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owes everyone that much.

text: Duvet e ne e na le mohopolo o nepahetseng hoseng.
en: The duvet had the right idea this morning.
bt: The duvet had the right idea in the morning.

text: Een persoon by hierdie troue hou die lug dop, en sy was al voorheen reg.
en: One person at this wedding is checking the sky, and she has been right before.
bt: One person at this wedding is watching the sky, and she was right before.

text: Die Weber is hierdie week nie een keer aangesteek nie en vandag is nie die dag nie.
en: The Weber has not been lit once this week and today is not the day.
bt: The Weber hasn't been lit once this week and today isn't the day.

text: Kla word toegelaat, van onder die kombers af.
en: Complaining is allowed from under the blanket.
bt: Complaining is allowed, from under the blanket.

text: Platteland-stilte: jy kan jou eie gedagtes hoor. Skrikwekkend.
en: Small-town quiet: you can actually hear yourself think. Terrifying.
bt: Countryside silence: you can hear your own thoughts. Frightening.

text: Izingubo zakho zisanda kuthuthela egcekeni likamakhelwane.
en: Your washing just moved to the neighbour's yard.
bt: Your clothes have just moved to the neighbour's yard.

text: Die vuur is nie vir gesellig nie. Die vuur is vir oorlewing.
en: The fire isn't for atmosphere. The fire is for survival.
bt: The fire is not for cosiness. The fire is for survival.

text: Die stad het sy duvet opgetrek. Los hom.
en: The city pulled up its duvet. Leave it alone.
bt: The city pulled up its duvet. Leave it.

text: Leholimo la kajeno: le sa loadhella.
en: Today's weather: still loading.
bt: Today's sky: still loading.

text: Voor die son op. Steeds nie beïndruk nie.
en: Up before the sun. Still not impressed.
bt: Before the sun is up. Still not impressed.

text: Bo botle le bo tšosa ka tekanyo e lekanang.
en: Beautiful and terrifying in equal measure.
bt: Beauty and terror in equal measure.

text: Umnyango wemoto yakho usanda kuba yisikhali.
en: Your car door just became a weapon.
bt: Your car door has just become a weapon.

text: Sonbril én serp. Dis daai soort dag.
en: Sunglasses and a scarf. It's that kind of day.
bt: Sunglasses and scarf. It's that kind of day.

text: Die son het snooze gedruk.
en: The sun hit snooze again. Honestly? Same.
bt: The sun pressed snooze.

text: I-ozone layer ifownile — ithathe ileave.
en: The ozone layer called. It's on leave.
bt: The ozone layer has phoned - it has taken leave.

text: Hy gaan twee keer skuif voor middagete, en altwee keer omtrent 'n meter.
en: He will move twice before lunch and both times by about a metre.
bt: He will shift twice before lunch, and both times about a metre.

text: Ponahalo e tlase
en: Low visibility
bt: Low visibility.

text: Bring 'n baadjie. Of sonroom. Of albei.
en: Bring a jacket. Or sunscreen. Or both.
bt: Bring a jacket. Or sun cream. Or both.

text: Joburg-bestuurders paniek al klaar.
en: Joburg drivers are panicking already.
bt: Joburg drivers are already panicking.

text: Jy het net vir melk uitgegaan en het nou vriende.
en: You only popped out for milk and now have friends.
bt: You only went out for milk and now have friends.

text: Ukuba uyakwazi ukufunda oku, ukufutshane kakhulu.
en: If you can read this, you're too close.
bt: If you can read this, it is very close.

text: 'n Doodgewone lug wat doodgewone dinge doen.
en: A perfectly average sky doing perfectly average things.
bt: An ordinary sky doing ordinary things.

text: Ukuhambisa inja kusanda kuba ngumdlalo wokuthemba.
en: Walking the dog has become a trust exercise.
bt: Walking the dog has just become a trust game.

text: Die mis het die Drakensberg gekanselleer. Geen terugbetalings nie.
en: The fog cancelled the Drakensberg. No refunds.
bt: The mist has cancelled the Drakensberg. No refunds.

text: Ha ke bone letho. Letho.
en: Can't see a thing. Not a thing.
bt: I see nothing. Nothing.

text: Ho aparetse ka clouds
en: Overcast
bt: It is covered with clouds.

text: Uzokoma. Ekugcineni. Cishe.
en: You'll dry. Eventually. Probably.
bt: It will dry. Eventually. Probably.

text: Sit die foon neer. Die dak is besig om te praat.
en: Put the phone down. The roof is talking.
bt: Put the phone down. The roof is talking.

text: Maak klaar. Die weer gaan nie klaarmaak nie.
en: Finish up. The weather won't.
bt: Finish up. The weather isn't going to finish.

text: Umphefumlo wakho wenza i-special effects.
en: Your breath is doing special effects.
bt: Your breath is making special effects.

text: Wolke soos visskubbe beteken die weer dink daaraan om van plan te verander.
en: Cloud like fish scales means the weather is thinking about changing its mind.
bt: Clouds like fish scales mean the weather is thinking about changing its plan.

text: Die windpomp staan doodstil. Nie eers die wind wil vandag werk nie.
en: The windpomp is dead still. Even the wind isn't coming in to work today.
bt: The windmill stands dead still. Not even the wind wants to work today.

text: Imvula kaSchrödinger — ikhona kodwa kwangaxeshanye ayikho
en: Schrodinger's rain. It both is and isn't.
bt: Schrödinger's rain - it is there but at the same time it isn't.

text: Hoeveel van hierdie stap het jy regtig belowe?
en: How much of this walk did you actually promise?
bt: How much of this walk did you actually promise?

text: Minus iets vanoggend: die voorruit het sy eie kunsversameling gekweek.
en: Minus something this morning: the windscreen has grown its own art collection.
bt: Minus something this morning: the windscreen grew its own art collection.

text: Ingadi ithi ekugcineni ngiyabonga.
en: The garden's saying dankie at last.
bt: The garden says finally thank you.

text: Slip-slops, kortbroek, son. Die drie-eenheid.
en: Slip-slops, shorts, sun. The trinity.
bt: Flip-flops, shorts, sun. The trinity.

text: Sukuwathemba loo-mafu. Ayadibana.
en: Don't trust those clouds. They're plotting.
bt: Don't trust those clouds. They gather/meet up.

text: Vanaand se besoekers moet dalk by die hek gaan haal word.
en: Tonight's visitors may need collecting at the gate.
bt: Tonight's visitors might have to be fetched at the gate.

text: Selfs die beeste op die N1 staan in 'n bondel asof hulle daarvoor betaal het.
en: Even the cattle on the N1 are huddled like they paid for it.
bt: Even the cattle on the N1 stand in a huddle as if they paid for it.

text: So koud dat die verwarmer 'n waglys het.
en: Cold enough that the heater has a waiting list.
bt: So cold the heater has a waiting list.

text: Die mis het die hele straat gesluk en die agterligte as kwitansie gelos.
en: The fog swallowed the whole street and left the tail lights as a receipt.
bt: The mist swallowed the whole street and left the tail lights as a receipt.

text: Die aandstap kom nou met gereelde appèlle.
en: The evening walk now comes with frequent roll calls.
bt: The evening walk now comes with regular appeals.

text: Die skaduwee op hierdie pad raak oor omtrent tweehonderd meter op.
en: The shade on this road runs out in about two hundred metres.
bt: The shade on this road runs out in about two hundred metres.

text: Jou oefenverskoning het uiteindelik betyds opgedaag.
en: Your exercise excuse has finally arrived on time.
bt: Your exercise excuse has finally arrived on time.

text: Jou saamrygeleentheid is al 'n hele ruk amper hier.
en: Your lift has been nearly here for quite a while.
bt: Your carpool has been almost here for quite a while.

text: Boemo ba lefatshe bo matla
en: Severe weather
bt: The condition of the earth is strong.

text: IFynbos iyayonwabela le mozulu. Nawe kufanele.
en: The fynbos is loving it. You should too.
bt: Fynbos is happy with this weather. You should be too.

text: Die plas buite die hek is nou deel van die kurrikulum.
en: The puddle outside the gate is now part of the curriculum.
bt: The puddle outside the gate is now part of the curriculum.

text: Moriti o sebetsa ka thata ho feta uena kajeno.
en: The shade is working harder than you today.
bt: The shade works harder than you today.

text: Die bure se swembad het nog nooit so verleidelik gelyk nie.
en: The neighbours' pool has never looked so tempting.
bt: The neighbours' pool has never looked so tempting.

text: Mohlomong ho na le maru a manyane. Kapa a mangata. Ho thata ho bolela.
en: Probably a bit of cloud. Or a lot. Hard to call.
bt: Maybe there are small clouds. Or many. Hard to say.

text: Die son maak van jou karsitplek 'n snackwich-masjien.
en: The sun is turning your car seat into a snackwich machine.
bt: The sun turns your car seat into a snackwich machine.

text: Selfs die water hou sy asem op.
en: Even the water is holding its breath.
bt: Even the water holds its breath.

text: Helder, in teorie. Die Kaapse Dokter RSVP nie altyd nie.
en: Clear, in theory. The Cape Doctor doesn't always RSVP.
bt: Clear, in theory. The Cape Doctor doesn't always RSVP.

text: Die wolke doen vanoggend sonroomdiens, en die drawwers maak die meeste daarvan.
en: The cloud is doing sunscreen duty this morning and the runners are cashing in.
bt: The clouds are doing sun-cream duty this morning, and the runners make the most of it.

text: Isitelingi sakho siyisitsha esishisayo.
en: Your steering wheel is a hot plate.
bt: Your [?isitelingi] is a hot dish.

text: Die plaas is nog daar. Ons vat maar mekaar se woord daarvoor.
en: The farm is still there. We're all just taking each other's word for it.
bt: The farm is still there. We'll just take each other's word for it.

text: Sefako se a wa — koahela bakkie.
en: Hail's down — cover the bakkie.
bt: Hail has fallen - cover the bakkie.

text: Die beste televisie in die huis is op die oomblik die weer.
en: The best television in the house is currently the weather.
bt: The best television in the house right now is the weather.

text: Yonke itekisi emgwaqweni ikhethe ukudlala ngokukhululeka.
en: Every taxi on the road has decided to freestyle.
bt: Every taxi on the road has chosen to play freely.

text: Nie 'n wolk in sig nie. Ook nie 'n graad nie.
en: Not a cloud in sight. Not a degree either.
bt: Not a cloud in sight. Not a degree either.

text: Joburg-winter: jas in die oggend, T-hemp teen twee, jas weer teen vier.
en: Joburg winter: jacket in the morning, T-shirt by two, jacket again by four.
bt: Joburg winter: coat in the morning, T-shirt at two, coat again at four.

text: Moontlike buie
en: Possible showers
bt: Possible storms.

text: Amafu azungeza. Ukuthi mangaki kuyimpikiswano.
en: Cloud's around. How much is up for debate.
bt: Clouds are circling. How many is a matter of dispute.

text: Die laatnag-melkrit het 'n groter versoek geword.
en: The late-night milk run has become a bigger request.
bt: The late-night milk run has become a bigger request.

text: Jy kan die bure-waai tot later uitstel.
en: You can postpone the neighbourly wave until later.
bt: You can postpone the neighbours' [?waai] until later.

text: Lekker stap. Die fiets kry ook oefening.
en: Nice walk. The bike is also getting some exercise.
bt: Enjoy the walk. The bicycle also gets exercise.

text: Cold se fihlile mme se tlisitse metsoalle.
en: The cold front is here and it brought friends.
bt: Cold has arrived and brought friends.

text: Imithi yenza i-yoga ngenkani.
en: The trees are doing involuntary yoga.
bt: The trees are doing yoga by force.

text: Lena ke leholimo leo o tla le thella sephetphetheng sa Tšitoe.
en: This is the weather you'll miss in December traffic.
bt: This is the sky that you will [?pour] in the [?sephetphetheng] of [?Tšitoe].

text: Die bord sê die reën het gewen; die gesigte sê nee.
en: The sign says the rain won; the faces say it didn't.
bt: The board says the rain won; the faces say no.

text: Die wind het dit vinniger as hy oopgemaak en hy lag nog steeds.
en: The wind opened it faster than he did and he is still laughing.
bt: The wind had it faster than he opened it and he is still laughing.

text: Drag uit. Niemand sit dit saam met die handdoeke in nie.
en: Kit off. Nobody is putting that in with the towels.
bt: [?Drag] out. Nobody packs it in with the towels.

text: Slaai vir aandete is nou baie makliker om te verkoop.
en: Salad for supper has become much easier to sell.
bt: Salad for dinner is now much easier to sell.

text: Die app sê bewolk. Tannie se knie sê reën. Ons vertrou die knie.
en: The app says cloudy. Aunty's knee says rain. We trust the knee.
bt: The app says cloudy. Auntie's knee says rain. We trust the knee.

text: Vrydagaand, en die stoep het stilweg die hele aand geword.
en: Friday night, and the stoep has quietly become the whole evening.
bt: Friday evening, and the stoep quietly became the whole evening.

text: Ho boneha ho sponsoritsoe ke motho. Motho.
en: Visibility sponsored by nobody.
bt: It seems to have been sponsored by someone. Someone.

text: Só 'n dag koop jy nie. Jy kry hom net.
en: Days like this aren't earned. They're issued.
bt: A day like this you don't buy. You just get it.

text: mesamo ya lapa e thatafetse ke serame
en: The lapa cushions are crispy.
bt: The [?mesamo] of the yard are stiff with frost/cold.

text: Isibhakabhaka esimpunga, ukholo oluphantsi.
en: Grey skies, low conviction.
bt: Grey sky, low faith.

text: Iqabaka engceni. Iqabaka kwi-bakkie. Iqabaka nakwisitya samanzi sesilwanyana.
en: Frost on the lawn. Frost on the bakkie. Frost in the pet bowl.
bt: Frost on the lawn. Frost on the bakkie. Frost even on the pet's water dish.

text: Lichopo li a bitsa. Setulo le sona.
en: The chops are calling. So is the chair.
bt: The [?lichopo] is calling. The chair as well.

text: Jy het vars lug gehad. Niemand het gesê hoeveel nie.
en: You've had fresh air. Nobody said how much.
bt: You had fresh air. Nobody said how much.

text: Amakati akhelwane asethathile.
