en: The neighbourhood cats have taken over.
bt: The neighbour's cats have already taken [it].

text: Mis kan inrol. Hou die berg dop.
en: Fog might be rolling in. Keep an eye on the mountain.
bt: Mist can roll in. Keep an eye on the mountain.

text: Lehodimo le fana le matšoao a tsoakaneng hape.
en: The sky's giving mixed signals again.
bt: The sky resembles mixed signals again.

text: In die Karoo kyk jy reën soos ander mense rugby kyk.
en: In the Karoo you watch rain the way other people watch rugby.
bt: In the Karoo you watch rain the way other people watch rugby.

text: Nat en koud is die Kaap se winterresep. Twee bestanddele, elke keer.
en: Wet and cold is the Cape's winter recipe. Two ingredients, every time.
bt: Wet and cold is the Cape's winter recipe. Two ingredients, every time.

text: Die hond is definitief nog aan die punt van daardie leiband. Amper definitief.
en: The dog is definitely still on the end of that leash. Almost definitely.
bt: The dog is definitely still at the end of that leash. Almost definitely.

text: Jou eerste boodskap het 'n toets van toewyding geword.
en: Your first errand has become a test of commitment.
bt: Your first message has become a test of commitment.

text: Sonskyn soos dié los jy nie vir Maandag nie.
en: You don't waste a sky like this on being sensible.
bt: Sunshine like this you don't leave for Monday.

text: Lokhu akukhona okwethenjiswa yincwadi yokuvakasha.
en: This is not what the tourism brochure promised.
bt: This is not what the tourism brochure promised.

text: Die voorspelling het gesê gedeeltelik sonnig; die lug het vir volle toewyding aan grys gekies.
en: The forecast said partly sunny; the sky went with fully committed grey.
bt: The forecast said partly sunny; the sky chose full commitment to grey.

text: Di-wiper di ho max empa ha di ea lekana.
en: The wipers are on max and it's still not enough.
bt: The wipers are at max but they are not enough.

text: Sizakundwendwelwa ngumoya woGqirha waseKapa.
en: The Cape Doctor is making house calls.
bt: We will be visited by the wind of the Doctor of the Cape.

text: Boiling-the-kettle-twice weather: hang bakeng sa coffee, hang bakeng sa matsoho.
en: Boiling-the-kettle-twice weather: once for the coffee, once for the hands.
bt: Boiling-the-kettle-twice weather: either for coffee, or for hands.

text: Die horison het een strokie oranje behou as bewys dat die son hier was.
en: The horizon kept one strip of orange as proof the sun was here.
bt: The horizon kept one strip of orange as proof that the sun was here.

text: Sondag, en sy het omtrent negentig minute voor sy weer moet skuif.
en: Sunday, and she has about ninety minutes before she has to move again.
bt: Sunday, and she has about ninety minutes before she must shift again.

text: Dikausu tse metsi. Boko bo boholo.
en: Wet socks. The ultimate betrayal.
bt: Wet socks [?dikausu]. Big brain.

text: Blou lug, volle son: die kar word gewas, en Pa ook.
en: Blue sky, full sun: the car gets washed, and so does Dad.
bt: Blue sky, full sun: the car gets washed, and Dad too.

text: Los die tweede stort vir ná aandete.
en: Leave the second shower until after supper.
bt: Leave the second shower for after dinner.

text: Niemand in daardie gebou kan 'n venster oopmaak nie en elkeen van hulle het probeer.
en: Nobody in that building can open a window and every one of them has tried.
bt: Nobody in that building can open a window and every one of them has tried.

text: Bewolk
en: Overcast
bt: Cloudy.

text: Die lug het hom gedra. Nou jy.
en: The sky behaved. So must you.
bt: The sky behaved itself. Now you.

text: Imvu inetha ngamandla kangangokuba kufanele ihlawule irenti.
en: Rain so heavy it should pay rent.
bt: The [?imvu: sheep] rains so hard that it must pay rent.

text: Uhlobo losuku othumela umuntu umlayezo ngalo.
en: The kind of day you text someone about.
bt: The kind of day you send someone a message about.

text: Jou haarstyl? Weg. Aanvaar dit.
en: Your hairstyle? Gone. Accept it.
bt: Your hairstyle? Gone. Accept it.

text: Isibhakabhaka siqumba ngokupheleleyo.
en: The sky's having a full-on tantrum.
bt: The sky is completely overcast.

text: Jou tweede koppie is hoofsaaklik 'n handwarm-reëling.
en: Your second cup is mostly a hand-warming arrangement.
bt: Your second cup is mostly a lukewarm arrangement.

text: Leholimo ha le e-s’o etse qeto
en: Sky's drafting, not committing.
bt: The sky/weather hasn't made a decision yet.

text: Die mis het drieuur ingerol en die buurt van die verste kant af begin uitvee.
en: The fog rolled in at three and started deleting the neighbourhood from the far end.
bt: The fog rolled in at three o'clock and began wiping out the neighbourhood from the far side.

text: Die werf is nat, die lug is koud, en sekuriteit het patrollies opgeskort.
en: The yard is wet, the air is cold, and security has suspended patrols.
bt: The yard is wet, the air is cold, and security has suspended patrols.

text: IKapa lithole iswishi yokuncipha ukukhanya.
en: Cape Town just got a dimmer switch.
bt: Cape Town has found the switch for dimming the light.

text: Ho ka na. Ho ka tšosa feela.
en: Could rain. Could just threaten to.
bt: It might rain. It might only frighten.

text: Kuyabanda, mhlawumbi. Nxiba iimpahla ezininzi.
en: Chilly, most likely. Layer up to be safe.
bt: It's cold, maybe. Put on lots of clothes.

text: Iewers onder daardie sterre trippel iemand kaalvoet badkamer toe. Sterkte.
en: Somewhere under those stars, someone is tiptoeing barefoot to the bathroom. Strength.
bt: Somewhere under those stars someone is tiptoeing barefoot to the bathroom. Good luck.

text: Kom ons noem dit atmosfeer en gaan in.
en: Let's call it atmosphere and go inside.
bt: Let's call it atmosphere and go inside.

text: Jou oprit is 'n spanningsroman nou.
en: Your driveway is a mystery novel right now.
bt: Your driveway is a thriller now.

text: Dit is nie wat die toerisme brosjure beloof het nie.
en: This is not what the tourism brochure promised.
bt: This isn't what the tourism brochure promised.

text: Pragtig, nè? Moenie hom vertrou nie.
en: Gorgeous, right? Do not trust it.
bt: Beautiful, right? Don't trust it.

text: Geen filter nodig nie. Kyk net buite.
en: No filter needed. Just look outside.
bt: No filter needed. Just look outside.

text: Jou pantoffels verdien beter as hierdie vroeë begin.
en: Your slippers deserve better than this early start.
bt: Your slippers deserve better than this early start.

text: Die mis het die hele straat ingesluk en by die reflekterende baadjie opgegee.
en: The fog swallowed the whole street and gave up at the hi-vis.
bt: The fog swallowed the whole street and gave up at the reflective jacket.

text: Donderdagaand, en die balkon is tot hoofkamer bevorder.
en: Thursday night, and the balcony has been promoted to the main room.
bt: Thursday evening, and the balcony has been promoted to main room.

text: Letsatsi le phomoletseng ho noa tee. Ha ho ETA.
en: The sun's on a tea break. No ETA.
bt: A day that has rested, for drinking tea. There is no ETA.

text: I-weather yokubilisa i-kettle kabili: kanye nge-coffee, kanye ukufudumeza izandla.
en: Boiling-the-kettle-twice weather: once for the coffee, once for the hands.
bt: Weather for boiling the kettle twice: once with coffee, once to warm the hands.

text: Die berge het sneeu aangetrek. Trek jy ook maar alles aan.
en: The mountains put on snow. You should put on everything.
bt: The mountains have put on snow. You put everything on too.

text: Ungabhaka iqanda ku-N1.
en: You could fry an egg on the N1.
bt: You could bake an egg on the N1.

text: Izicathulo zingakhethwa. Isimo sengqondo siyaphoqeleka.
en: Shoes optional. Attitude mandatory.
bt: Shoes are optional. Attitude is compulsory.

text: Umoya onamandla
en: Gusty winds
bt: Strong wind.

text: Hoa bata, lefatshe le hlakile
en: Cold but clear
bt: It's cold, the land is clear.

text: Sewentiende verdieping, nul uitsig, honderd persent snug.
en: Seventeenth floor, zero view, one hundred percent snug.
bt: Seventeenth floor, zero view, a hundred percent snug.

text: 'Een sundowner,' sê die mense wat die sterre gaan sien uitkom.
en: 'Just one sundowner' — famous last words, every single time.
bt: 'One sundowner,' say the people who are going to watch the stars come out.

text: Elke hek in hierdie straat is toe en elke hond het 'n mening.
en: Every gate in this street is shut and every dog has an opinion.
bt: Every gate on this street is closed and every dog has an opinion.

text: Mooiste tyd van die dag. Sê die mense wat binne bly.
en: Most beautiful time of day. Say the people who stay inside.
bt: Best time of day. Say the people who stay inside.

text: In dié wind is rugbyoefening meestal keëls jaag.
en: Wind this strong, rugby practice is mostly chasing cones.
bt: In this wind, rugby practice is mostly chasing cones.

text: Die onkruid kan nog 'n dag van vryheid geniet.
en: The weeds can enjoy another day of freedom.
bt: The weeds can enjoy another day of freedom.

text: Vullisdag het nog 'n laag by aantrek gevoeg.
en: Bin day has added another layer to getting dressed.
bt: Rubbish day has added another layer to the dressing.

text: Isihlabathi ezindaweni isihlabathi okungafanele sibe khona.
en: Sand in places sand should never be.
bt: Sand in places where sand should not be.

text: Wasgoed-roulette: hang jy, of vou jy?
en: Washing-line roulette: do you hang, or do you fold?
bt: Washing roulette: do you hang it out, or fold it?

text: Imozulu yobusuku: yamkelekile.
en: Night shift weather: approved.
bt: Night weather: welcome.

text: Daardie lug kan doen wat hy wil; die wors is klaar op die vuur.
en: That sky can do what it wants; the wors is already on.
bt: That sky can do what it wants; the sausage is already on the fire.

text: Skink die koffie buite. Vertrou ons.
en: Pour the coffee outside. Trust us.
bt: Pour the coffee outside. Trust us.

text: Duvets in die bakkie, fles op die agterklap: die lug is vanaand die koue werd.
en: Duvets in the bakkie, flask on the tailgate: the sky is worth the freeze tonight.
bt: Duvets in the bakkie, bottle on the tailgate: tonight's sky is worth the cold.

text: Kubanda, kodwa mhle umhla.
en: Cold but stunning.
bt: It's cold, but the day is beautiful.

text: Tyd om daai lelike beanie te soek.
en: Time to dig out that ugly beanie.
bt: Time to find that ugly beanie.

text: Die windpomp werk oortyd en vra nie eens dubbeltarief nie.
en: The windpump's doing overtime and not even charging double.
bt: The windpump is working overtime and doesn't even ask for double rate.

text: IHelderberg iyazibonakalisa namhlanje.
en: The Helderberg is showing off today.
bt: The Helderberg shows itself off today.

text: Laaste een by die huis maak die kaggel aan. Ry, vriend, ry.
en: Last one home lights the fire. Drive, friend, drive.
bt: Last one home lights the fireplace. Drive, friend, drive.

text: Die ys in daardie glas het omtrent vier minute oor.
en: The ice in that glass has about four minutes left.
bt: The ice in that glass has about four minutes left.

text: Vat jou sambreel, boet.
en: Grab your brolly, boet.
bt: Take your umbrella, bro.

text: Nditsho nomthunzi lo ushushu. Ndininqwenelela impumelelo phandl’apha
en: Even the shade is warm. Good luck out there.
bt: I say, even [?nomthunzi - steam/vapour] this hot. I wish you success out here.
note: My blind read steam; umthunzi means shade

text: Ndaweni ithile phaya kukho indlela. Mhlawumbi
en: Somewhere out there is the road. We think.
bt: Somewhere over there there is a road. Maybe.

text: Iewers tussen oukei en pap nat. Sterkte.
en: Somewhere between fine and soaked. Good luck.
bt: Somewhere between okay and soggy wet. Good luck.

text: Natuur maak dit duidelik wie regtig in beheer is.
en: Nature just reminded us of the pecking order.
bt: Nature makes it clear who is really in charge.

text: Maemo a hao a vitamin D a a leboha.
en: Your vitamin D levels are thanking you.
bt: Your vitamin D status says thank you.

text: Linamafu kancinci, kuqashelwa kancinci.
en: Partly cloudy, partly guessing.
bt: There are a few clouds, little caution needed.

text: Kombers burrito modus: geaktiveer.
en: Blanket burrito mode: activated.
bt: Blanket burrito mode: activated.

text: Iziqhumane zakho ezikhulu zenza 'iingcinga nemithandazo'.
en: Your headlights are doing a 'thoughts and prayers'.
bt: Your big [?iziqhumane] are making 'thoughts and prayers'.

text: Die kouefront is hier en hy het maats gebring.
en: The cold front is here and it brought friends.
bt: The cold front is here and it brought mates.

text: Boikarabelo ba hao bo le bong feela ke ho khetha mashala kapa patsi.
en: Your only responsibility is choosing charcoal or wood.
bt: Your only responsibility is to choose coals or wood.

text: Isihlalo semoto sakho sisixhobo ngoku.
en: Your car seat is a weapon right now.
bt: Your car seat is a tool/device now.

text: Sand in plekke waar sand nooit moet wees nie.
en: Sand in places sand should never be.
bt: Sand in places where sand should never be.

text: Die wind weet waar jy bly. Sterkte.
en: The wind knows where you live. Good luck.
bt: The wind knows where you live. Good luck.

text: Phatha ihembe nesijele - kokubili.
en: Sunscreen, but keep a hoodie close.
bt: Carry a shirt and a [?isijele - jail/jersey?] - both.
note: Sunscreen missing; shirt/jail oddity instead of hoodie

text: Ha ho letho le sa lokisoeng ke kopi ea rooibos.
en: Nothing a cup of rooibos won't fix.
bt: There is nothing that a cup of rooibos doesn't fix.

text: Ama-fleece amabili okungenani namuhla.
en: Two-fleece minimum today.
bt: At least two fleeces today.

text: Ungabhaka isteki epavimentini manje.
en: You could braai a steak on the pavement right now.
bt: You could bake a steak on the pavement now.

text: Jy kan 'n steak op die sypaadjie braai nou.
en: You could braai a steak on the pavement right now.
bt: You can braai a steak on the pavement now.

text: Ibhishi noma ukosa? Yebo.
en: Beach or braai? Yes.
bt: Beach or braai? Yes.

text: Izingubo zisemsebenzini futhi uzizwa unesibindi.
en: The washing's on the line and you're feeling brave.
bt: The clothes are at work/in use and you feel brave.

text: Die son verlaat die berge een rak op 'n slag.
en: The sun is leaving the mountains one shelf at a time.
bt: The sun leaves the mountains one shelf at a time.

text: Die bries werk vandag by die vrugtestalletjie. Lugverkoeling ingesluit, geen ekstra koste nie.
en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.
bt: The breeze is working at the fruit stall today. Air-conditioning included, no extra charge.

text: Daardie kyk is 'n man wat die wolke vir nog vyf-en-veertig minute vra.
en: That look is a man asking the clouds for forty-five more minutes.
bt: That look is a man asking the clouds for another forty-five minutes.

text: Die weer is meer besluiteloos as jy by Spur.
en: Weather's being more indecisive than you at Spur.
bt: The weather is more indecisive than you are at Spur.

text: Die paddas het die gesprek betree.
en: The frogs have entered the chat.
bt: The frogs have joined the conversation.

text: Letsatsi le romeletse out-of-office.
en: The sun sent an out-of-office reply.
bt: The sun has sent an out-of-office.

text: Le yimini incwadana eyayithetha ngayo.
en: This is the day the brochure was talking about.
bt: This is the day the little [?incwadana - letter/book] was talking about.

text: Vat 'n baadjie. Of nie. Ons is net redelik seker.
en: Bring a jacket. Or don't. We're only fairly sure.
bt: Take a jacket. Or not. We're only fairly sure.

text: Ho na le clouds hanyane
en: Partly cloudy
bt: There are a few clouds.

text: Ayikho mbi, ayikho ntle. Njeng date ye6/10
en: Not bad, not great. Like a 6/10 date.
bt: Not bad, not nice. Like a 6/10 date.

text: Umzi wemzantsi mpuma ufikile. Ungamenywanga njengesiqhelo.
en: The southeaster's arrived. Uninvited, as usual.
bt: The south-east home has arrived. Uninvited as usual.

text: Leholimo lena le hloka mokoetlisi oa bophelo.
en: This weather needs a life coach.
bt: This weather needs a life coach.

text: Indalo iyaziqhayisa kwaye silapha ngenxa yayo.
en: Nature's flexing and we're here for it.
bt: Nature boasts and we are here because of it.

text: Elkeen van hulle wys dieselfde kant toe en nie een het dit gekies nie.
en: Every one of them is pointing the same way and not one of them chose it.
bt: Each of them points the same way and not one of them chose it.

text: Perfekte toestande om jou waardigheid te verloor.
en: Perfect conditions for losing your dignity.
bt: Perfect conditions to lose your dignity.

text: Elke ster is vanaand uit, en die ryp is die toegangsgeld.
en: Every star is out tonight, and the frost is the entry fee.
bt: Every star is out tonight, and the frost is the entrance fee.

text: Cishe kumpunga. Kungaphakama, kungajiya.
en: Probably grey. Could lift, could thicken.
bt: It's nearly grey. It might lift, it might thicken.

text: Donderdag, en daardie kar gaan vieruur erger wees as nou.
en: Thursday, and that car is going to be worse at four than it is now.
bt: Thursday, and that car will be worse at four o'clock than now.

text: Lehodimo le khethile vibe mme vibe ke ho phahamisa mahetla.
en: The sky picked a vibe and the vibe is shrug.
bt: The sky has chosen a vibe and the vibe is a shrug of the shoulders.

text: Blou lug, warm briesie. Die eenvoudige goed.
en: Blue sky, warm breeze. The simple stuff.
bt: Blue sky, warm breeze. The simple things.

text: Imanyano kubo bonke abanesihlangu esinye esimanzi ngoku.
en: Solidarity to everyone with one wet shoe right now.
bt: Solidarity with everyone who has one wet shoe now.

text: Skakel jou toestelle af. Die lug het planne.
en: Unplug the things. The sky has plans.
bt: Switch off your devices. The sky has plans.

text: Die straatlig werk oortyd waarvoor niemand gaan betaal nie.
en: The streetlight is doing overtime that nobody is going to pay for.
bt: The streetlight is working overtime that nobody is going to pay for.

text: I-makeup yakho inesikhathi esiphelelayo sangu-9 ekuseni.
en: Your makeup has an expiry date of 9am.
bt: Your makeup has an expiry time of 9 in the morning.

text: Phakathi kobamhle nokuba manzi. Unqweno omhle.
en: Somewhere between fine and soaked. Good luck.
bt: Between pretty and wet. Good wishes.

text: Akukho mntu uza kuposta le sunset kwi-Instagram.
en: Nobody's posting this sunset on Instagram.
bt: Nobody is going to post this sunset on Instagram.

text: Ilaphu lentaba ye tafile liphumile.
en: Table Mountain's tablecloth is out.
bt: The tablecloth of Table Mountain is out.

text: Yihloniphe induduma, iyakufanele"
en: Respect the thunder. It's earned it.
bt: Respect the thunder, it is due to you / it suits you.

text: Mhlawumbi kushushu kakhulu. Umnqwazi awuyongcamango embi
en: Probably a scorcher. A hat's not a bad idea.
bt: Maybe it's very hot. A hat is not a bad idea.

text: Daardie das waai al horisontaal vandat hy uit die kar geklim het.
en: That tie has been horizontal since he left the car.
bt: That tie has been blowing horizontally ever since he got out of the car.

text: Hy leun so ver vooroor omdat regop staan nie meer werk nie.
en: He is bent that far over because standing upright stopped working.
bt: He leans so far forward because standing upright no longer works.

text: Waarskynlik koud. Vat die trui, jy sal ons dank.
en: Probably cold. Take the jersey, you'll thank us.
bt: Probably cold. Take the jersey, you'll thank us.

text: Ukuhlangana nabo bonke abanesicathulo esisodwa esimanzi manje.
en: Solidarity to everyone with one wet shoe right now.
bt: Solidarity with everyone who has one wet shoe now.

text: Die reën het die hele pad saam huis toe gekom.
en: Rain came all the way home.
bt: The rain came all the way home with us.

text: Kom jy nog? Beskryf weer jou hek.
en: Still coming over? Describe your gate again.
bt: Are you still coming? Describe your gate again.

text: Hael val — gooi iets oor die bakkie.
en: Hail's down — cover the bakkie.
bt: Hail is falling - throw something over the bakkie.

text: Die lug het vanoggend oor die kleredrag besluit, en hy het net gehoorsaam.
en: The sky made the dress-code decision this morning and he just obeyed it.
bt: The sky decided about the dress code this morning, and he just obeyed.

text: Die wolke is toegewy aan gemiddeld wees.
en: The clouds are committed to being average.
bt: The clouds are dedicated to being average.

text: Afskop is tien en die verste pale het nog nie opgedaag nie.
en: Kickoff is ten and the far posts have not arrived yet.
bt: Kick-off is at ten and the farthest posts haven't shown up yet.

text: Die lug gee 'ek probeer weer morgen' energie.
en: The sky's giving 'I'll try again tomorrow' energy.
bt: The sky gives 'I'll try again tomorrow' energy.

text: Free State e sa tswa hopola hore e na le winter setting.
en: The Free State just remembered it has a winter setting.
bt: The Free State has just remembered that it has a winter setting.

text: Kubanda kangangokuthi ibhodlela lobisi ese-stoep manje isiyi-cooler box.
en: Cold enough that the milk-bottle-on-the-stoep is now a cooler box.
bt: It's so cold that the milk bottle on the stoep is now a cooler box.

text: Die braai is die sosiale kalender. Daag op.
en: The braai is the social calendar. Show up.
bt: The braai is the social calendar. Show up.

text: Mhlawumbi kunomoya. I-Cape Doctor inendlela yayo yokuziphatha.
en: Probably windy. The Cape Doctor keeps its own diary.
bt: Maybe it's windy. The Cape Doctor has its own way of behaving.

text: Die son is op en doen sy bes; die ryp is tot dusver nie oortuig nie.
en: The sun is up and doing its best; the frost is unconvinced so far.
bt: The sun is up and doing its best; the frost is so far not convinced.

text: Wedstryd gespeel, tjips uit, en die lug het nie een keer die wedstryd bedreig nie.
en: Match played, chips out, and the sky never once threatened the fixture.
bt: Match played, chips out, and the sky didn't threaten the match once.

text: I-Toyota i-startile nge-first try. Uyikweleta i-wash.
en: The Toyota started first try. You owe it a wash.
bt: The Toyota started on the first try. You owe it a wash.

text: Die wingerd slaap. Die koue werk nagskof.
en: The vines are asleep. The cold is working the night shift.
bt: The vineyard sleeps. The cold works the night shift.

text: Isimo sezulu esihle sokuphila ngaphandle kwentshisekelo.
en: Perfect weather for existing without enthusiasm.
bt: Nice weather for living without enthusiasm.

text: Ho tsamaisa ntja e fetohile papali ea tšepo.
en: Walking the dog has become a trust exercise.
bt: Walking the dog has become a game of hope.

text: Kunomoya omncane, cishe. Mhlawumbe okwengeziwe.
en: Breezy, probably. Maybe more.
bt: There's a little wind, almost. Maybe more.

text: Jou neus gaan jou verraai teen 3nm.
en: Your nose is going to betray you by 3pm.
bt: Your nose will betray you at 3pm.

text: Die lug het ekstra gedoen. Die voorspelling nie.
en: The sky did extras. The forecast didn’t.
bt: The sky did extra. The forecast didn't.

text: Blou lug, behoorlike ryp. Die son is net hier om te kyk.
en: Blue sky, proper frost. The sun's just here to watch.
bt: Blue sky, proper frost. The sun is only here to watch.

text: Grys lug, plat see, sigbare asem: presies die oggend wat die visse hulle verwag.
en: Grey sky, flat sea, visible breath: the exact morning the fish expect them.
bt: Grey sky, flat sea, visible breath: exactly the morning the fish expect.

text: Stil, helder, vriesend. Die klassieke Hoëveld-drieling.
en: Still, clear, freezing. The classic Highveld triple.
bt: Still, clear, freezing. The classic Highveld trio.

text: Die swembad is reeds bespreek. Deur almal. Vir die hele dag.
en: The pool is already fully booked. By everyone. For the whole day.
bt: The swimming pool is already booked. By everyone. For the whole day.

text: Isimo sezulu sanamuhla: sisalayisha.
en: Today's weather: still loading.
bt: Today's weather: it is [?slaying].
note: sisalayisha = still loading; my blind read wrong

text: Kae-kae moromuoa oa leholimo o phela bophelo bo botle.
en: Somewhere a weather reporter is living their best life.
bt: Somewhere the sky's [?moromuoa - messenger/apostle] lives a good life.

text: Isibhakabhaka asikagqibi. Nathi.
en: The sky's undecided. So are we.
bt: The sky isn't finished. Neither are we.

text: Jou huisherstellys het 'n dringende opdatering aangevra.
en: Your home repair list has requested an urgent update.
bt: Your [?huisherstellys - home-repair/recovery ice] has requested an urgent update.

text: Inkungu isenokusondela. Gcina iliso entabeni.
en: Fog might be rolling in. Keep an eye on the mountain.
bt: Fog may still approach. Keep an eye on the mountain.

text: Ngaphandle ukuhlolwa kwesimilo. Uyehluleka.
en: Outside is a test of character. You're failing.
bt: Outside [?without] the character test. You fail.

text: Die kinders gaan steeds skool toe in kortbroek. Hulle weet dinge wat ons nie weet nie.
en: The kids still going to school in shorts. They know things we don't.
bt: The children still go to school in shorts. They know things we don't.

text: Isibhakabhaka esiluhlaza, umoya ofudumele. Izinto ezilula.
en: Blue sky, warm breeze. The simple stuff.
bt: Blue sky, warm wind. Simple things.

text: Hulle is halfses al uit, want vandag is daar geen ander kans nie.
en: They are out at half past five because there is no other window today.
bt: They're already half past six out, because today there's no other chance.
note: halfses is half past five; my blind read wrong

text: Ubusuku obucacileyo
en: Clear night
bt: A clear night.

text: Koud maar helder
en: Cold but clear
bt: Cold but clear.

text: Noma ngubani onepuli namuhla ngumngane wakho omusha omkhulu.
en: Whoever has a pool today is your new best friend.
bt: Anyone with a pool today is your new best friend.

text: Isibhakabhaka sibukeka sithukuthele. Kungakhula.
en: Sky's looking moody. Could escalate.
bt: The sky looks angry. It might grow.

text: Amafu akhona, kodwa awazami kakhulu.
en: Cloud cover, low effort.
bt: There are clouds, but they aren't trying very hard.

text: Umoya unenzondo yomuntu siqu ngezambulela.
en: The wind has a personal vendetta against umbrellas.
bt: The wind has a personal hatred of umbrellas.

text: Ama-tong ayabiza. Waphendule.
en: The tongs are calling. Answer them.
bt: The tongs are calling. Answer.

text: Letsatsi ha le khathalele merero ea hao.
en: The sun doesn't care about your plans.
bt: The sun doesn't care about your affairs.

text: Jou karwas was geldmors.
en: Your car wash was a waste of money.
bt: Your car wash was a waste of money.

text: Nog 'n stomp. Vir meer kole, natuurlik.
en: Another log. For the cook, apparently.
bt: Another log. For more coals, of course.

text: Wonke umntu uba ngumhlobho wakho xa une pool.
en: Everyone's suddenly your friend when you have a pool.
bt: Everyone becomes your friend when you have a pool.

text: Ilanga limane liphuma kancinci
en: Sky's doing the most, but only a little.
bt: The sun keeps coming out a little.

text: Merubisi e ahlola nako ea hao ea skrini.
en: The owls are judging your screen time.
bt: [?Merubisi] is judging your screen time.
note: Subject word merubisi not recognised; owls not clear

text: Iimini ezinje kufanele zibe ne-soundtrack yazo.
en: Days like this should come with a soundtrack.
bt: Days like this should have their own soundtrack.

text: Vroeë grys — soos die tee, laat dit net trek.
en: Early grey. Like the tea, just let it steep.
bt: Early grey - like tea, just let it steep.

text: Ubusuku obuhle bokubona iNdlela yoSisi.
en: Perfect night to actually see the Milky Way.
bt: A good night to see the Milky Way [?iNdlela yoSisi].

text: Lesi yisimo sezulu esiziqhenya ngaso phesheya.
en: This is the weather we brag about overseas.
bt: This is the weather that is boasted about overseas.

text: Izulu lihle, kusho izibalo. Bheka nesibhakabhaka sangempela.
en: Clear skies, says the maths. Check the actual sky too.
bt: The weather is nice, say the statistics. Look at the real sky too.

text: Isiziba sasijule kunalokho ebesibukeka ngakho. Sihlala sijule.
en: The puddle was deeper than it looked. It's always deeper.
bt: The pond was deeper than it looked. It is always deep.

text: Die lug het te veel aangetrek. Die weer is nog heeltemal reg.
en: The sky’s overdressed. The weather’s still fine.
bt: The sky overdressed. The weather is still entirely fine.

text: Niemand gaan dit vir 'n maand hoef by te vul nie.
en: Nobody is going to have to top that up for a month.
bt: Nobody will have to top this up for a month.

text: Yiloo nto. Apha kanye.
en: This is the stuff. Right here.
bt: That's the thing. Right here.

text: Akusona isikhathi sokuqhawe, hey.
en: Not the time for hero moves, hey.
bt: It's not the time for [?ukuqhawe], hey.

text: Izulu elimpunga, ukholo oluphansi.
en: Grey skies, low conviction.
bt: Grey weather, low faith.

text: Ho bata hoo milk-bottle-on-the-stoep e seng e le cooler box.
en: Cold enough that the milk-bottle-on-the-stoep is now a cooler box.
bt: That cold of the milk-bottle-on-the-stoep that is already a cooler box.

text: Izibane zendlela ziyavuma enkungu.
en: The traffic lights are vibing in the mist.
bt: The street lights agree in the fog.

text: Iibhini ziphinde zangena kwi-adventure
en: The bins are on an adventure again.
bt: The bins have gone into the adventure again.

text: Lumkela inkungu — ithanda ukufika ingalindelekanga.
en: Watch for fog — it likes to arrive unannounced.
bt: Watch out for fog - it likes to arrive unexpectedly.

text: Isimo sezulu esilungele i-Eskom. Akukho solar.
en: Eskom-friendly weather. No solar today.
bt: Eskom-friendly weather. No solar.

text: Ilanga lisayotshaya
en: Sun on a smoke break.
bt: The sun is still about to strike/burn.

text: Grys lug, truie aan, skool is uit. Die naweek vra nie die son se toestemming nie.
en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
bt: Grey sky, jerseys on, school is out. The weekend doesn't ask the sun's permission.

text: Uyilibele ibhatyi yakho? Indalo iphela ikuqaphele oko.
en: Forgot your jacket? The universe noticed.
bt: Did you forget your jacket? Nature always notices that.

text: So helder sien jy Kaapstad net wanneer dit regtig seer is buite.
en: The city only looks this sharp when it genuinely hurts outside.
bt: You only see Cape Town this clearly when it's really sore outside.

text: Alles in hierdie straat leun dieselfde kant toe, die mense inkluis.
en: Everything on this street leans the same way, including the people.
bt: Everything in this street leans the same way, the people included.

text: IKapa iyabengezela. Mhlawumbi.
en: Cape Town's twinkling. Probably.
bt: Cape Town is shining. Maybe.

text: Yimini iJoburg ezenza ngathi ayinayo, ude uzifumane umi kuyo.
en: The kind of day Joburg pretends it doesn't have until you're standing in it.
bt: It's the day Joburg pretends it doesn't have, until you find yourself standing in it.

text: Leholimo la hosane ke bothata ba hosane.
en: Tomorrow's weather is tomorrow's problem.
bt: Tomorrow's sky is tomorrow's problem.

text: Dié lug is die rede hoekom niemand vanaand vroeg huis toe gaan nie.
en: Nobody's leaving early under a sky like this.
bt: This sky is the reason nobody goes home early tonight.

text: Die straatborde het tou opgegooi.
en: The street signs gave up.
bt: The street signs have thrown in the towel.

text: Die eike is oukei. Die vullisdromme het nooit 'n kans gestaan nie.
en: The oaks are fine. The wheelie bins never stood a chance.
bt: The oaks are okay. The rubbish bins never stood a chance.

text: Pula? Mohlomong. Boitlamo? Le kgale.
en: Rain? Possibly. Commitment? Never.
bt: Rain? Maybe. Commitment? Long ago.
note: Never became long ago; kgale looks Setswana

text: Indlela yakho yokungena iyinoveli yemfihlo manje.
en: Your driveway is a mystery novel right now.
bt: Your way in is a mystery novel now.

text: Dit is wat dit is.
en: It is what it is.
bt: It is what it is.

text: Ubusika baseHighveld: indawo ekuphela kwayo lapho unxiba ii-jackets ezimbini nje uyokuthatha iposi.
en: Highveld winter: the only place where you wear two jackets to fetch the post.
bt: Highveld winter: the only place where you put on two jackets just to go and fetch the mail.

text: I-heater ingumngane wakho omkhulu. Owodwa.
en: The heater is your best friend. Your only friend.
bt: The heater is your best friend. The only one.

text: ho fihla ho
bt: to arrive at

text: Die mis het 'n uur gelede ingetrek en die straatligte het sedertdien verdubbel.
en: The fog moved in an hour ago and the streetlights have doubled in size since.
bt: The fog moved in an hour ago and the streetlights have doubled since.

text: Die heuwel beweeg in golwe. Die beeste het besluit om dit nie raak te sien nie.
en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.
bt: The hill moves in waves. The cattle decided not to notice.

text: Ha ho motho ea bolelletseng ponelopele. E fihletse fela.
en: Nobody told the forecast. It just arrived.
bt: No one has announced [?ponelopele]. It has simply arrived.

text: Woensdag, en dit is die eerste gemaklike minuut wat sy sedert elfuur gehad het.
en: Wednesday, and this is the first comfortable minute she has had since eleven.
bt: Wednesday, and it's the first comfortable minute she's had since eleven o'clock.

text: Die soort son wat een tennisbal in 'n hele middag verander.
en: The kind of sun that turns one tennis ball into a whole afternoon.
bt: The kind of sun that turns one tennis ball into an entire afternoon.

text: Kopano le bohle ba nang le seeta se le seng se metsi jaanong.
en: Solidarity to everyone with one wet shoe right now.
bt: Solidarity with everyone who has one wet shoe now.

text: Daardie hond het hierdie stuk meer kere geloop as enigeen van hulle.
en: That dog has walked this stretch more times than any of them.
bt: That dog has walked this stretch more times than any of them.

text: Die blomme kom vinniger van daardie bome af as wat hy onderdeur ry.
en: The blossom is coming off those trees faster than he is going under them.
bt: The blossoms come off those trees faster than he drives underneath.

text: Die lug kan nie tussen golden hour en vroeg huis toe gaan besluit nie. Niemand anders ook nie.
en: The sky can’t decide between golden hour and going home early. Neither can anyone else.
bt: The sky can't decide between golden hour and going home early. Neither can anyone else.

text: Kaapse winternag: die berg is daar, jy sal hom môre weer sien.
en: Cape winter night: the mountain's still there, you'll see it again tomorrow.
bt: Cape winter night: the mountain is there, you'll see it again tomorrow.

text: Nie 'n haarstyl in sig nie. Net oorlewendes.
en: Not a hairstyle in sight. Just survivors.
bt: Not a hairstyle in sight. Just survivors.

text: Die lakens is klaar droog en die wind is nog nie klaar met hulle nie.
en: The sheets are dry already and the wind is not finished with them.
bt: The sheets are already dry and the wind isn't finished with them yet.

text: Imozulu inedrama ifuna uCarte Blanche.
en: Weather so dramatic it needs a Carte Blanche segment.
bt: The weather has drama that wants Carte Blanche.

text: Die wind lewer die hele aand blare by daardie deurmat af.
en: The wind has been delivering leaves to that doormat all evening.
bt: The wind delivers leaves to that doormat all evening.

text: Hy gaan daar sit tot iets interessanters gebeur, en dit gaan nie gebeur nie.
en: He will sit there until something more interesting happens, which it will not.
bt: He's going to sit there until something more interesting happens, and it won't.

text: Die Hooglandlug ná reën behoort in 'n botteltjie verkoop te word.
en: Post-storm Highveld air should be bottled and sold overseas.
bt: The Highveld air after rain should be sold in a bottle.

text: U-Eskom unqwenela la mandla.
en: Eskom wishes it had this power.
bt: Eskom wishes for this power.

text: Merero ea kajeno: phela kantle.
en: Today's plans: exist outside.
bt: Today's plans: live outdoors.

text: Ibhodlela lamanzi ashisayo yiqhawe langempela namuhla.
en: Hot water bottle is the real MVP today.
bt: A hot water bottle is a real hero today.

text: Niemand het nog 'n lig binne aangesit nie, en niemand gaan ook nie.
en: Nobody has switched a light on inside yet and nobody intends to.
bt: Nobody has switched on a light inside yet, and nobody will.

text: Die soort koud wat jou laat Google: vloerverwarming Bloemfontein.
en: The kind of cold that has you Googling 'underfloor heating Bloemfontein'.
bt: The kind of cold that makes you Google: underfloor heating Bloemfontein.

text: Tobetsa menyu ea sebatli, ebe Kenya app — kapa leka hape ka motsotsoana.
bt: Press the [?sebatli] menu, then Enter app - or try again in a moment.
note: Source empty; text is app-menu instruction not weather

text: Isichotho siyawa — vala ibakkie.
en: Hail's down — cover the bakkie.
bt: Hail is falling - close the bakkie.

text: Izikhova ziyawugweba umsebenzi wakho wesikrini.
en: The owls are judging your screen time.
bt: The owls judge your screen work.

text: Môre se eerste afspraak is met die voorruit.
en: Tomorrow's first appointment is with the windscreen.
bt: Tomorrow's first appointment is with the windscreen.

text: Jy werk dalk van die huis af, op algemene aandrang.
en: You might be working from home by popular demand.
bt: You might be working from home, by popular demand.

text: Daardie gordyn is die enigste bewegende lug in die hele woonstel.
en: That curtain is the only moving air in the entire flat.
bt: That curtain is the only moving air in the whole flat.

text: Lehodimo le halefile ka botlalo.
en: The sky's having a full-on tantrum.
bt: The sky is completely angry.

text: Isimo sezuluesimnandi
en: Pleasant
bt: Nice weather.

text: Isibhakabhaka sase-Afrika sihlukile nje.
en: Africa's sky just hits different.
bt: The African sky is just different.

text: Laat die hond maar voorgee hy weet waar julle is.
en: Best let the dog pretend it knows where you are.
bt: Let the dog pretend he knows where you are.

text: Dit is die derde keer vanaand en nie een van hulle gaan oor kos nie.
en: That is the third time tonight and not one of them is about food.
bt: It's the third time tonight and none of them is about food.

text: Die hond se asem wys ook. Dis hoe koud dit is.
en: Even the dog's breath is showing. That's the reading.
bt: The dog's breath shows too. That's how cold it is.

text: Nie een wolk nie, nie een graad nie: 'n Hoëveldse wintermôre doen albei gelyk.
en: Not one cloud, not one degree: a Highveld winter morning doing both at once.
bt: Not one cloud, not one degree: a Highveld winter morning does both at once.

text: Fog idle indawo.
en: The fog ate the neighbourhood.
bt: Fog [?idle] place/area.
note: Fog left in English; idle means ate

text: I-Free State isanda kukhumbula ukuthi ine-winter setting.
en: The Free State just remembered it has a winter setting.
bt: The Free State has just remembered that it has a winter setting.

text: Iemand het die kontras heeltemal te hoog gestel.
en: Someone cranked the contrast way too high.
bt: Someone set the contrast way too high.

text: Isibhakabhaka asikwazi ukuzinquma. Joyina iklabhu.
en: The sky can't make up its mind. Join the club.
bt: The sky can't make up its mind. Join the club.

text: Uiteindelik 'n blaaskans van gevra word om die kar te stop.
en: At last, a break from being asked to stop the car.
bt: Finally a break from being asked to stop the car.

text: Vrydag, en teen elf gaan hierdie hele rant weer een kleur wees.
en: Friday, and by eleven this whole ridge will be one colour again.
bt: Friday, and by eleven this whole ridge will be one colour again.

text: Daardie wolk oefen al die hele middag en het nog steeds nie sy reël gesê nie.
en: That cloud has been rehearsing all afternoon and still hasn't said its line.
bt: That cloud has been rehearsing all afternoon and still hasn't said its line.

text: Ubusuku obuhlanzekile
bt: A clean/cleared night.

text: Niemand op hierdie stoep gaan enige plek heen voor omtrent vieruur nie.
en: Nobody on this stoep is going anywhere until about four o'clock.
bt: Nobody on this stoep is going anywhere before about four o'clock.

text: Maru a arabile 'mohlomong' empa a fihlile.
en: The clouds RSVP'd 'maybe' and showed up anyway.
bt: The clouds answered 'maybe' but they have arrived.

text: Ukubonakala: cishe iqanda.
en: Visibility: basically zero.
bt: Visibility: about an egg.

text: Die Suiderkruis is uit, en die ryp ook. Pakketaanbod.
en: The Southern Cross is out, and so is the frost. Package deal.
bt: The Southern Cross is out, and the frost too. Package deal.

text: Jy kan nou opstaan en gister se optimisme gaan inspekteer.
en: You can get up now and inspect yesterday's optimism.
bt: You can get up now and go inspect yesterday's optimism.

text: Bewolkte nagte hou die warmte in, en iemand is hier buite en gebruik dit.
en: Overcast at night keeps the warmth in, and somebody is out here using it.
bt: Cloudy nights hold the warmth in, and someone out here is using it.

text: Ha o futhumetse. O a 'glow'. Ehlile.
en: You're not sweating. You're 'glowing'. Sure.
bt: If you are warm, you glow. Of course.

text: Amafu anesikhathi sawo.
en: The clouds are having a moment.
bt: Clouds have their time.

text: Letsatsi le tsoakaneng. Rea itšireletsa.
en: Mixed bag out there. We're hedging.
bt: A mixed-up sun/day. We protect ourselves.

text: Stap na die asblik is nou 'n ekspedisie.
en: Walking to the bin is now an expedition.
bt: Walking to the dustbin is now an expedition.

text: Klein hond, dik trui, kort patrollie: winteroggende werk verkorte ure.
en: Small dog, thick jersey, short patrol: winter mornings run on reduced hours.
bt: Small dog, thick jersey, short patrol: winter mornings work shortened hours.

text: Isimo sezulu sangobusuku: samukelwe.
en: Night shift weather: approved.
bt: Night weather: welcome.

text: Daardie twee op die stoep het hul keuse gemaak en hulle bly daarby.
en: Those two on the stoep have made their choice and they are sticking with it.
bt: Those two on the stoep made their choice and are sticking to it.

text: Nie genoeg wind om een wiek te draai nie, en daarom het die ryp alles gevang.
en: Not enough wind to turn one blade, which is why the frost got everything.
bt: Not enough wind to turn a single vane, and so the frost caught everything.

text: Groet liewer eers die buurman voor jy goed terugvra.
en: Best greet the neighbour before asking for things back.
bt: Better to greet the neighbour first before you ask for things back.

text: Mohlomong pula. Nka sekhele, re felise khang.
en: Probably rain. Take the umbrella, settle the argument.
bt: Maybe rain. Take a [?sekhele], we'll finish [?khang].

text: Amafasitela avalwe, iketile ivuliwe, ulinde.
en: Windows closed, kettle on, and wait.
bt: Windows closed, kettle open, you wait.

text: Die eerste vergadering sal dalk sonder jou moet begin.
en: The first meeting may have to start without you.
bt: The first meeting may have to start without you.

text: Grys vibes. Die lug pas by my Maandag.
en: Grey vibes. The sky matched my Monday.
bt: Grey vibes. The sky suits my Monday.

text: Jou kinders het duur speelgoed om te ignoreer.
en: Your children have expensive toys to ignore.
bt: Your children have expensive toys to ignore.

text: Die sand gaan vinniger by hulle verby as wat die gety inkom.
en: The sand is going past them faster than the tide is coming in.
bt: The sand goes past them faster than the tide comes in.

text: Geen kleure in die lug vanaand nie, net skakerings van rustig.
en: No colours in the sky tonight, just shades of calm.
bt: No colours in the sky tonight, only shades of calm.

text: Awubilanga uya glowa qha.
en: You're not sweating. You're 'glowing'. Sure.
bt: You don't sweat, you just glow.

text: Izihlangu zakho zesuede zikhethe namhlanje? Sisibindi eso.
en: Your suede shoes chose today? Bold.
bt: Your suede shoes chose today? That's guts.

text: Wolke só dik maak van die Karoo 'n gang, en hy is halfpad daarin af.
en: Overcast this thick turns the Karoo into a corridor, and he is halfway down it.
bt: Clouds this thick make the Karoo a corridor, and he is halfway down it.

text: Jy moet twee uur van enige plek af ry om so 'n lug te kry.
en: You have to drive two hours from anywhere to get a sky like that.
bt: You have to drive two hours from anywhere to get a sky like this.

text: Selfs die hadida hou dit sag. Die lug het die toon aangegee.
en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.
bt: Even the hadeda keeps it soft. The sky set the tone.

text: Inkungu iyanda. Izibane zemoto aziyingozi
en: Mist building, maybe. Headlights wouldn't hurt.
bt: The fog is increasing. Car lights are not dangerous.
note: Maybe lost; headlights wouldnt hurt became not dangerous

text: Dibomo tse nyenyane tsa leqhoa di a wa. Ka hare ke moralo o le mong fela.
en: Tiny ice bombs falling. Indoors is the only plan.
bt: Small [?dibomo] of ice are falling. Inside there is only one plan.

text: Die water is so helder jy kan die koue sien.
en: The water is so clear you can basically see the cold.
bt: The water is so clear you can see the cold.

text: Silent Hill vibes. Sonder die monsters. Hopelik.
en: Silent Hill vibes. Without the monsters. Hopefully.
bt: Silent Hill vibes. Without the monsters. Hopefully.

text: Leholimo la postcard. Kea leboha.
en: Postcard weather. You're welcome.
bt: Postcard sky. Thank you.

text: Die aalwyne blom. Hulle is die enigstes wat die winter geniet.
en: The aloes are blooming. They're the only ones enjoying winter.
bt: The aloes are blooming. They're the only ones enjoying the winter.

text: Jy kan vanaand die lang totsiens by die hek oorslaan.
en: You can skip the long goodbye at the gate tonight.
bt: Tonight you can skip the long goodbye at the gate.

text: Om die hond te stap het 'n vertroue-oefening geword.
en: Walking the dog has become a trust exercise.
bt: Walking the dog has become a trust exercise.

text: Maandag, en dit gaan môre alles weer doen sonder dat iemand vra.
en: Monday, and it will do all of that again tomorrow without being asked.
bt: Monday, and it's going to do it all again tomorrow without anyone asking.

text: Die Suiderkruis is uit en die grasperk het silwer geword daaronder.
en: The Southern Cross is out and the lawn has gone silver under it.
bt: The Southern Cross is out and the lawn has turned silver beneath it.

text: Bewonder dit van die bank af; dis waarvoor vensters is.
en: Admire it from the couch; that's what windows are for.
bt: Admire it from the couch; that's what windows are for.

text: Amafutha abukeka esolisa ngempela.
en: Clouds looking proper suspicious.
bt: The [?amafutha - fats/oils] look really suspicious.

text: I-CV yesibhakabhakaisanda kuhlaziywa.
en: The sky's CV just got updated.
bt: The sky's CV was just updated.

text: Kubonakala kufudumele. Kodwa ubushushu buhlala butshintsha.
en: Looks warm. How warm is a moving target.
bt: It looks warm. But the heat keeps changing.

text: Hy het sedert elfuur nie daaruit beweeg nie en gaan ook nie.
en: He has not moved out of it since eleven and he is not going to.
bt: He hasn't moved out of it since eleven and won't.

text: Bohobe bo hlakileng
en: Clear night
bt: Clear bread [?"bohobe bo hlakileng": bread that is clear/clean]

text: Die beste sitplek in die huis is buite.
en: Best seat in the house isn't in the house.
bt: The best seat in the house is outside.

text: Stokke gepak. Jou trots kom heel by die huis.
en: Clubs packed. Your pride gets to come home intact.
bt: Sticks packed. Your pride comes home intact.

text: Elke jakaranda in hierdie straat maak homself op een man leeg.
en: Every jacaranda on this street is emptying itself onto one man.
bt: Every jacaranda in this street empties itself all at once.

text: Ubusuku obuhle.
en: Clear night.
bt: A good night. / Beautiful night.

text: Dis nie wolken nie, dis 'n lokprent.
en: Those aren't clouds, that's a trailer.
bt: It's not clouds, it's a film trailer.

text: Jy het iets buite vergeet en jou duvet onthou.
en: You forgot something outside and remembered your duvet.
bt: You forgot something outside and remembered your duvet.

text: Warm, stil en helder: elke insek in die provinsie is by hierdie een lamp.
en: Warm, still and clear: every insect in the province is at this one lamp.
bt: Warm, quiet and bright: every insect in the province is at this one lamp.

text: Hoeveld-winter: die enigste plek waar jy twee jasse aantrek om die pos te gaan haal.
en: Highveld winter: the only place where you wear two jackets to fetch the post.
bt: Highveld winter: the only place where you put on two coats to go and fetch the post.

text: Check jy die weer, of check jy of Saterdag se braai aan is? Presies.
en: Be honest — you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.
bt: Are you checking the weather, or checking whether Saturday's braai is on? Exactly.

text: ho hotle kantle
en: Absolutely beautiful out there.
bt: It is [?nice] outside.

text: Nag lyk kalM. As die modelle dit reg het.
en: Night looks calm. Models permitting.
bt: Night looks calm. If the models have it right.

text: Bonke balibele ukuba kuqhutywa kanjani. Kwakhona.
en: Everyone's forgotten how to drive. Again.
bt: Everyone has forgotten how to drive [?how it is driven]. Again.

text: Daardie doringboom leun al van voor enigiemand in hierdie straat aangekom het.
en: That thorn tree has been leaning since before anyone on this street arrived.
bt: That thorn tree has been leaning since before anyone in this street arrived.

text: Idolobha lesipoki. Kodwa kungoLwesibili nje.
en: Ghost town. But it's just Tuesday.
bt: Ghost town. But it's only Tuesday.

text: Izingane zisaya esikoleni ngama-shorts. Ziyazi izinto thina esingazazi.
en: The kids still going to school in shorts. They know things we don't.
bt: The children still go to school in shorts. They know things that we don't know.

text: Nog een glas. Dan nog 'n poging om te slaap.
en: One more glass. Then another attempt at sleeping.
bt: One more glass. Then another attempt to sleep.

text: Kry 'n handdoek voor iemand oor werk begin uitvra.
en: Find a towel before anyone starts asking about work.
bt: Get a towel before someone starts asking about work.

text: Besoekers uitgestel. Die meubels gaan dalk steeds.
en: Visitors postponed. The furniture may still go.
bt: Visitors postponed. The furniture may still go.

text: Ugqozi lwakho luqande endleleni eya emnyango.
en: Your motivation froze on the way to the door.
bt: Your inspiration [?has stalled] on the way to the door.

text: Amadamu enza umdanso ojabulayo.
en: The dams are doing a happy dance.
bt: The dams are doing a joyful dance.

text: Moea o na le vendetta ea motho ka bo eena khahlanong le disekhele.
en: The wind has a personal vendetta against umbrellas.
bt: The wind has a personal vendetta against bicycles.

text: Dinaledi di teng, load shedding e ke ke ea ama sena.
en: Stars out, load shedding can't touch this.
bt: The stars are there, load shedding cannot touch this.

text: Unga braai inyama kwi pavement ngalomzuzu.
en: You could braai a steak on the pavement right now.
bt: You could braai meat on the pavement right now.

text: Gona ha se seo brosure ea bohahlauli e neng e se tšepisa.
en: This is not what the tourism brochure promised.
bt: That is not what the tourist brochure promised.

text: Uhlobo lwesibhakabhaka olukwenza ubonge izinto zamahhala.
en: The kind of sky that makes you grateful for free things.
bt: The kind of sky that makes you thank for free things.

text: Letamo le ne le tebile ho feta kamoo le neng le shebahala kateng. Le lula le tebile.
en: The puddle was deeper than it looked. It's always deeper.
bt: The pool was deeper than it looked. It is still deep.
note: Puddle became pool/pond; rain context lost.

text: Maa
en: Mon
bt: [?Maa] (Mom? / truncated "But")
note: Maa is the standard abbreviation of Maandag.

text: Geen sonsondergangfoto's nie — die hemel se privaatheid-instellings is aan.
en: No sunset pics tonight. The sky's privacy settings are on.
bt: No sunset photos - the sky's privacy settings are on.

text: Daardie skoen is volgende, en sy het nie meer hande oor nie.
en: That shoe is coming off next and she has run out of hands.
bt: That shoe is next, and she has no hands left.

text: Ho na le maru empa re tla phela.
en: Overcast but we'll survive.
bt: There are clouds but we will live.

text: Inyanga alibonakali namhlanje.
en: The sun's bunking today.
bt: The moon is not visible today.
note: Moon not visible, not sun bunking.

text: Koloi e teng kantle. Ho thoe.
en: The car is out there. Allegedly.
bt: The car is outside. So they say.

text: Daardie kopligte is al twee volle minute 'amper hier' in die mis.
en: Those headlights have been 'almost here' for two full minutes of fog.
bt: Those headlights have been "almost here" in the fog for two full minutes.

text: Die lug hou 'n vertoning. Die vis, soos gewoonlik, nie.
en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.
bt: The sky is putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.

text: Selfs die bakkies op die N2 het stilgehou.
en: Even the bakkies on the N2 pulled over.
bt: Even the bakkies on the N2 stood still.

text: Kuyabanda.
en: It's chilly.
bt: It is cold.

text: Jou stuurwiel is 'n warmplaat.
en: Your steering wheel is a hot plate.
bt: Your steering wheel is a hotplate.

text: Coffee letsatsing stoepong. Ke lona lebaka lohle leo re dulang mona.
en: Coffee in the sun on the stoep. The whole reason we live here.
bt: Coffee in the sun on the stoep. That is the whole reason we sit here.

text: Die straatligte gaan vroeg aan en niemand kla nie.
en: Streetlights on early tonight, and not a single complaint.
bt: The streetlights come on early and nobody complains.

text: I-duvet iyiqondile into edingekayo.
en: The duvet understood the assignment.
bt: The duvet understood what was needed.

text: Awugodoli, u “lekker koud”. Mkhulu umahluko.
en: You're not cold, you're 'lekker koud'. Big difference.
bt: You're not cold, you're "lekker cold". Big difference.

text: Imigqa yokushisa ayisiyona ubuntu.
en: Tan lines are not a personality trait.
bt: The heat lines are not kindness [?ubuntu].
note: Heat lines and kindness, not tan lines and personality.

text: Die hele dorp het gewag dat die son sak en toe eers uitgekom.
en: The whole town waited for the sun to go down and then came outside.
bt: The whole town waited for the sun to set and only then came out.

text: Sephethephethe se na le maikutlo.
en: The traffic is emotional.
bt: The [?sephethephethe: whirlwind] has feelings.
note: Sephethephethe may mean chaos or traffic; unclear.

text: Iambrela yophuke nje kwakuvuthuza umzi wokuqala. Okwesiqhelo.
en: The umbrella broke on the first gust. Classic.
bt: The umbrella just broke as it blew the first [?umzi: home/homestead]. As usual.

text: Die blesbokke dra nie serpe nie en kla ook nie. Ons kan iets leer. Ons gaan nie, maar ons kan.
en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
bt: The blesbok don't wear scarves and don't complain either. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.

text: Vandag se voorspelling: medium gaar.
en: Today's forecast: medium rare.
bt: Today's forecast: medium done.

text: Out-of-office ea hao e etsa mosebetsi o boima.
en: Your out-of-office is doing the heavy lifting.
bt: Your out-of-office is doing hard work.

text: Droë kol gekry; waardigheid hangende; die reën wys geen teken van verskoning nie.
en: Dry spot found; dignity pending; the rain shows no sign of apologising.
bt: Dry spot found; dignity pending; the rain shows no sign of apology.

text: Ishawa kwakuyinto enhle. Konke kuya phansi manje.
en: The shower was the highlight. It is downhill from here.
bt: The shower was a nice thing. Everything is going down now.

text: Isibhakabhaka siphosa amatye. Hlala ngaphakathi.
en: Sky's throwing rocks. Stay inside.
bt: The sky is throwing stones. Stay inside.

text: Wat ook al op daardie pad land is nie reën nie, dit is die see wat sywaarts aankom.
en: Whatever is landing on that road is not rain, it is the sea arriving sideways.
bt: Whatever has landed on that road is not rain, it is the sea coming in sideways.

text: Isikhali sokumba i-beanie embi.
en: Time to dig out that ugly beanie.
bt: The weapon [for] digging up an ugly beanie.

text: Umoya ucishe ubekhona. Bambelela kokokumboza ukosa.
en: Wind's likely. Hold onto the braai cover.
bt: The wind is almost here. Hold on to what covers the braai.

text: Bly naby. Die hond het nie vir jou gevra nie.
en: Stay close. The dog wasn't asking you.
bt: Stay close. The dog didn't ask for you.

text: Die skottelgoed kan nog 'n bietjie langer week.
en: The dishes can soak a little longer.
bt: The dishes can soak a bit longer.

text: Bewolk maar ons sal oorleef.
en: Overcast but we'll survive.
bt: Cloudy but we will survive.

text: Irhafu yesambreli isebenzayo manje.
en: The umbrella tax is now in effect.
bt: The umbrella tax is in effect now.

text: Isizathu sakho sokuhlala ngaphakathi sisanda kuphelelwa.
en: Your excuse to stay inside just expired.
bt: Your reason for staying inside has just run out.

text: Die beton is nog klam, en die lug lyk nie of hy klaar is nie.
en: The concrete is still damp and the sky looks like it isn't finished.
bt: The concrete is still damp, and the sky doesn't look like it's finished.

text: Imozulu efanelekileyo yokuya eWoolies nokubukela iNetflix.
en: Perfect weather for a Woolies run and Netflix.
bt: Perfect weather for going to Woolies and watching Netflix.

text: Gaan-binne-weer.
en: Get inside weather.
bt: Go-inside-again.

text: Ryp eerste. Jou planne kan tien minute wag.
en: Frost first. Your plans can wait ten minutes.
bt: Frost first. Your plans can wait ten minutes.

text: Itrafikhi isanda kukhumbula ukuba imvula ikhona. Kwakhona.
en: The traffic just remembered rain exists. Again.
bt: Traffic has just remembered that rain exists. Again.

text: Die tang is uit, so die argument oor wie braai is verby.
en: The tongs are out, so the argument about who cooks is over.
bt: The tongs are out, so the argument about who braais is over.

text: Slaap lekker, damme. Julle het vandag hard gewerk.
en: Sleep tight, dams. You worked hard today.
bt: Sleep well, dams. You worked hard today.

text: Joburgse somerreën: kom vyfuur, deurweek alles, weg teen aandete.
en: Joburg summer rain: arrives at five, soaks everything, gone by supper.
bt: Joburg summer rain: arrives at five, soaks everything, gone by dinner.

text: Mela ea ho tjhesa ha se botho.
en: Tan lines are not a personality trait.
bt: The heat lines [?mela] are not humane/kind [?botho].
note: Heat lines and kindness, not tan lines and personality.

text: Jou eerste koffie verdien jou onverdeelde aandag.
en: Your first coffee deserves your undivided attention.
bt: Your first coffee deserves your undivided attention.

text: Niemand gaan daar terug in voor die mure die dag laat gaan nie.
en: Nobody is going back in there until the walls let go of the day.
bt: Nobody is going back in there before the walls let the day go.

text: Uza kubomvu njenge-lobster. Ulumkisiwe.
en: You will look like a lobster. You've been warned.
bt: You will be red like a lobster. You have been warned.

text: Lehodimo la Afrika le fapane feela.
en: Africa's sky just hits different.
bt: The African sky is simply different.

text: Imoto ikhona ngaphandle. Kuthiwa nje.
en: The car is out there. Allegedly.
bt: The car is outside. So it is said.

text: Reën so swaar dit moet huur betaal.
en: Rain so heavy it should pay rent.
bt: Rain so heavy it should pay rent.

text: Een kol son het in hierdie sitkamer ingekom en die hond was eerste daar.
en: One patch of sun came into this lounge and the dog got there first.
bt: One patch of sun came into this lounge and the dog was there first.

text: Koud maar pragtig.
en: Cold but stunning.
bt: Cold but beautiful.

text: Voel jou nie verplig om by die dag aan te sluit voor koffie nie.
en: Don't feel obliged to join the day before coffee.
bt: Don't feel obliged to join the day before coffee.

text: Galela ikofu ngaphandle. Sithembe.
en: Pour the coffee outside. Trust us.
bt: Pour coffee outside. Trust us.

text: Endaweni ethileumethuli wezindaba zesimo sezulu uphila kahle.
en: Somewhere a weather reporter is living their best life.
bt: Somewhere a weather news presenter [?umethuli] is living well.

text: Planne gemaak. Verskeie van hulle het nou 'n lift nodig.
en: Plans made. Several of them now need a lift.
bt: Plans made. Several of them now need a lift.

text: Die lug gee absoluut niks.
en: The sky's giving absolutely nothing.
bt: The sky gives absolutely nothing.

text: Lyk warm. Hoe warm is 'n bewegende teiken.
en: Looks warm. How warm is a moving target.
bt: Looks warm. How warm is a moving target.

text: Akekho otshele isibikezelo. Sivele safika.
en: Nobody told the forecast. It just arrived.
bt: Nobody told the forecast. It just arrived.

text: Selfs die hadedas is stil.
en: Even the hadedas are quiet.
bt: Even the hadedas are quiet.

text: Mhlawumbi mpunga. Inokucaca, inokujiya.
en: Probably grey. Could lift, could thicken.
bt: Maybe grey. It may clear, it may thicken.

text: Waarskynlik 'n helder nag. Die sterre het nog nie bevestig nie.
en: Probably a clear night. The stars haven't confirmed.
bt: Probably a clear night. The stars haven't confirmed yet.

text: Cishe kunomoya. I-Cape Doctor inendaba yayo.
en: Probably windy. The Cape Doctor keeps its own diary.
bt: Almost windy. The Cape Doctor has its story.

text: Los dalk vanaand die mooi pad huis toe.
en: Perhaps skip the scenic route home tonight.
bt: Maybe leave the pretty road home alone tonight.

text: Sokkies gaan eerste op die verwarmer; voete kom later — die winterstelsel werk.
en: Socks go on the heater first; feet join later — the winter system works.
bt: Socks go on the heater first; feet come later - the winter system works.

text: Wie ook al dit daar gelos het, het gedink hulle sal net twintig minute wees.
en: Whoever left that there thought they would only be twenty minutes.
bt: Whoever left that there thought they'd only be twenty minutes.

text: Die huis is kouer binne as buite. Argitektuur is 'n mooi ding.
en: The house is colder inside than outside. Architecture is a beautiful thing.
bt: The house is colder inside than outside. Architecture is a beautiful thing.

text: Leholimo le loketseng ho phela ntle le mafolofolo.
en: Perfect weather for existing without enthusiasm.
bt: A sky suitable for living without energy/enthusiasm.

text: Die hond geniet hierdie wind. Hy het die enigste haarstyl wat daarvoor gebou is.
en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.
bt: The dog enjoys this wind. He has the only hairstyle built for it.

text: iFlops etheni ibeyeyona mpazamo.
en: Flip-flops on tar was a mistake.
bt: The [?iFlops etheni: flip-flops then] were the mistake.

text: Lug gooi klippe. Bly binne.
en: Sky's throwing rocks. Stay inside.
bt: Sky throws stones. Stay inside.

text: Die skaduwee werk harder as jy vandag.
en: The shade is working harder than you today.
bt: The shade is working harder than you today.

text: Ikhofi elangeni ku-stoep. Yiso sonke isizathu esenza sihlale la.
en: Coffee in the sun on the stoep. The whole reason we live here.
bt: Coffee in the sun on the stoep. That is the whole reason that makes us stay here.

text: Kubukeka kuhle. Amamodeli nesibhakabhaka awavumelani njalo.
en: Looks clear-ish. The models and the sky don't always agree.
bt: It looks good. The models and the sky don't always agree.

text: Skooltasse gepak. Hande ontdooi nog.
en: School bags packed. Hands still defrosting.
bt: School bags packed. Hands still thawing.

text: Die agtiende putjie kan wag; die lug speel deur.
en: The eighteenth can wait; the sky is playing through.
bt: The eighteenth hole can wait; the sky is playing through.

text: Inyanga yenza konke namhlanje ebusuku.
en: The moon's doing the most tonight.
bt: The moon does everything tonight (today at night).

text: Die lug het n vibe gekies en die vibe is slapgat.
en: The sky picked a vibe and the vibe is shrug.
bt: The sky chose a vibe and the vibe is limp/slack.

text: Bonke bangabangane bakho xa unepuli.
en: Everyone's suddenly your friend when you have a pool.
bt: All [?bangabangane] are your friends when you have a pool.
note: xa is isiXhosa; isiZulu uses uma.

text: Iimini ezinje zezinto ezisenza sinyamezele i-load shedding.
en: Days like this is why we put up with the load shedding.
bt: Days like these are things that make us put up with load shedding.

text: Joburg reën twintig minute en verf dan die lug asof niks gebeur het nie.
en: Joburg rains for twenty minutes, then paints the sky like nothing happened.
bt: Joburg rains for twenty minutes and then paints the sky as if nothing happened.

text: Die GPS sê die pad is daar, en vandag is dit al bewys wat daar is.
en: The GPS says the road is there, and today that is the whole case for it.
bt: The GPS says the road is there, and today that is all the proof there is of what's there.

text: Die lug het sewe-uur ingeboek, die hele dag nêrens heen gegaan nie, en bly vir die naweek.
en: The sky checked in at seven, went nowhere all day, and is staying for the weekend.
bt: The sky booked in at seven, went nowhere all day, and is staying for the weekend.

text: Petrichor is die Griekse woord. Ons woord is 'sjoe'.
en: Petrichor is the Greek word for it. Our word is 'sjoe'.
bt: Petrichor is the Greek word. Our word is "sjoe".

text: setlolo sa letsatsi
en: Your future self will thank you for that sunscreen.
bt: The sun's [?setlolo].
note: Future-self sunscreen line missing; only a fragment.

text: Jy het weer aangetrek deur by die venster uit te kyk.
en: You dressed by looking out the window again.
bt: You dressed again by looking out of the window.

text: Dis nog vyftig kilometer weg en die stoep is klaar vol.
en: It's still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already sold out.
bt: It is still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already full.

text: Droë sokkies eerste. Ons kan praat terwyl jy hulle soek.
en: Dry socks first. We can talk while you find them.
bt: Dry socks first. We can talk while you look for them.

text: Kae-kae sekhele se sa tsoa reteleha ka hare. Motsotso oa kgutso.
en: Somewhere an umbrella just turned inside out. Moment of silence.
bt: [?Kae-kae] [?sekhele] has just [?failed/fallen] inside. A moment of silence.

text: Kombers om die skouers op die stoep: nasionale drag van die winter.
en: Blanket around the shoulders on the stoep: national dress of winter.
bt: Blanket around the shoulders on the stoep: national dress of winter.

text: Umugqa esiteshini sikaphethiloli usanda kuphindeka kathathu.
en: The queue at the petrol station just tripled.
bt: The queue at the petrol station has just tripled.

text: Ukhohlwe ijazi lakho? Indawo yonke iqaphele.
en: Forgot your jacket? The universe noticed.
bt: Did you forget your coat? The whole place noticed.

text: Chappies vra vanoggend geloof, nie net 'n lisensie nie.
en: Chappies is asking for faith this morning, not just a licence.
bt: Chappies asks this morning for faith, not just a licence.

text: Umoya waseningizimu ufikile. Ungamenyiwe, njengenjwayelo.
en: The southeaster's arrived. Uninvited, as usual.
bt: The south wind has arrived. Uninvited, as usual.

text: Nie 'n luggie wat daardie lakens roer nie, en van bo af kom ook geen hulp nie.
en: Not a breath moving those sheets, and nothing helpful coming from above either.
bt: Not a breeze stirring those sheets, and no help from above either.

text: Die lug lyk of dit pronk.
en: The sky looks like it's showing off.
bt: The sky looks like it is showing off.

text: Lesi simo sezulu sidinga umqeqeshi wempilo.
en: This weather needs a life coach.
bt: This weather needs a life coach.

text: Ekuseni eKaroo. Uhlobo lwasekuseni olwenza uhloniphe wonke umlimi okhethe lokhu.
en: Karoo morning. The kind that makes you respect every farmer who chose this.
bt: Morning in the Karoo. The kind of morning that makes you respect every farmer who chose this.

text: Daardie kar was met omtrent vier minute te spaar onder die afdak.
en: That car made it under the carport with about four minutes to spare.
bt: That car had about four minutes to save under the carport.

text: Die Weber het die hele week hiervoor gewag.
en: The Weber's been waiting all week for this.
bt: The Weber has been waiting all week for this.

text: Imozulu yangomso yingxaki yangomso.
en: Tomorrow's weather is tomorrow's problem.
bt: Tomorrow's weather is tomorrow's problem.

text: I-50/50 emvuleni. Thatha ibhatyi, ukuba kuyenzeka.
en: 50/50 on the rain. Bring a jacket, just in case.
bt: 50/50 in the rain. Take a coat, if it happens.

text: Ontbyt eerste. Die res is nou onderhandelbaar.
en: Breakfast first. The rest is now negotiable.
bt: Breakfast first. The rest is negotiable now.

text: Sy gaan die res van die dag sout proe en sy weet dit.
en: She will be tasting salt for the rest of the day and she knows it.
bt: She is going to taste salt for the rest of the day and she knows it.

text: Ii-koppies zijongeka njengeposikhadi. Iinyawo zakho zivakala njengeebhloko zomkhenkce
en: The koppies look like a postcard. Your feet feel like ice blocks.
bt: The koppies are shaped like a postcard. Your feet feel like blocks of ice.

text: Die vlegsels het die besluit geneem en sy gaan maar saam.
en: The braids have made the decision and she is going along with it.
bt: The braids made the decision and she just goes along.

text: Nditsho nomthunzi lo uyabila.
en: Even the shade is sweating.
bt: I say even this shade is boiling.

text: Terug vir die serp. Jy was amper dapper.
en: Back for the scarf. You were nearly brave.
bt: Back for the scarf. You were almost brave.

text: Iewers sê 'n eiendomsagent 'lifestyle'.
en: Somewhere an estate agent is saying 'lifestyle'.
bt: Somewhere an estate agent says "lifestyle".

text: Isibhakabhaka siyaduma. Hlala eduze nophahla.
en: Sky's grumbling. Stay close to a roof.
bt: The sky is thundering. Stay near the roof.

text: Baie plek buite, as iemand vra hoekom jy gebly het.
en: Plenty of room outside, if anyone asks why you stayed.
bt: Plenty of room outside, if anyone asks why you stayed.

text: Die wind stry met almal. Jy’s volgende.
en: The wind’s arguing with everyone. You’re next.
bt: The wind is fighting with everyone. You're next.

text: Elke taxi op die pad het besluit om te freestyle.
en: Every taxi on the road has decided to freestyle.
bt: Every taxi on the road decided to freestyle.

text: Die kleinste is nog wakker en het besluit die lug is dit werd.
en: The youngest is still awake and has decided the sky is worth it.
bt: The smallest one is still awake and decided the sky is worth it.

text: Trek lae aan asof jy Sani Pass klim.
en: Layer up like you're climbing Sani Pass.
bt: Dress in layers as if you're climbing Sani Pass.

text: Eerste een op moet die ketel aansit. Dis die wet.
en: First one up puts the kettle on. That's the law.
bt: The first one up must put the kettle on. It's the law.

text: Amamodeli athi kuhle. Iqiniso lingahluka.
en: Models say lovely. Reality reserves the right to differ.
bt: The models say it's good. The truth may differ.

text: Tara e bonolo. Batho ba bonolo le ho feta.
en: The tar is soft. The people are softer.
bt: The tar is soft. People are even softer.

text: Ngisho abaseCape bayavuma kubanda.
en: Even the Capetonians are admitting it's cold.
bt: Even people from the Cape admit it's cold.

text: Perfekte weer om voor te gee jy gaan vroeg slaap.
en: Perfect weather for pretending you'll go to bed early.
bt: Perfect weather to pretend you're going to bed early.

text: Die palm is krom gewaai en sy staan hier buite en glimlag.
en: The palm is bent double and she is out here smiling about it.
bt: The palm is blown crooked and she stands out here smiling.

text: Twee druppels op die voorruit en die hele N1 se geheue is skoon gewas.
en: Two drops on a windscreen and the whole N1 forgets everything it ever learned.
bt: Two drops on the windscreen and the whole N1's memory is washed clean.

text: Lug lyk nukkerig. Kan eskaleer.
en: Sky's looking moody. Could escalate.
bt: Sky looks grumpy. Could escalate.

text: Ubusuku obuzolile. Isibhakabhaka singashintsha.
en: Calm night, most likely. The sky reserves the right to change.
bt: A calm night. The sky may change.

text: Jy het die adres gestuur. Stuur nou aanmoediging.
en: You sent the address. Now send encouragement.
bt: You sent the address. Now send encouragement.

text: Indalo isanda kusikhumbuza ukuba ngubani ophambili.
en: Nature just reminded us of the pecking order.
bt: Nature has just reminded us who is in front/in charge.

text: Ayiyomozulu ye-Instagram. Ayisosiphelo sehlabathi.
en: Not Instagram weather. Not the end of the world.
bt: It is not Instagram weather. It is not the end of the world.

text: Vanaand se wind het opinies.
en: Tonight's wind has opinions.
bt: Tonight's wind has opinions.

text: Die wolke wen vanaand, omtrent nege rondtes teen een.
en: The clouds are winning tonight, about nine rounds to one.
bt: The clouds win tonight, roughly nine rounds to one.

text: Jy sweet nie. Jy 'glow'. Ja, reg.
en: You're not sweating. You're 'glowing'. Sure.
bt: You're not sweating. You're "glowing". Yes, right.

text: Kan reën. Kan net dreig.
en: Could rain. Could just threaten to.
bt: Might rain. Might just threaten.

text: Die bome doen onvrywillige yoga.
en: The trees are doing involuntary yoga.
bt: The trees are doing involuntary yoga.

text: Mohlomong le hlakile. Fensetere ea hau e na le taelo ea ho qetela.
en: Probably clear. Your window's the final say.
bt: Maybe it is clear. Your window has the final instruction.

text: Die lug het om verskoning gevra. Die sypaadjie nie.
en: The sky apologised. The pavement didn't.
bt: The sky apologised. The pavement didn't.

text: Bewolk maar met min ambisie.
en: Patchy ambitions.
bt: Cloudy but with little ambition.

text: Ponelopele: vibes li bohareng, litebello li tlase.
en: Forecast: vibes neutral, expectations lower.
bt: Forecast: vibes are in the middle, expectations are low.

text: Nou-nou by die huis. Jy het opgehou om 'n tyd daarop te sit.
en: Home soon. You have stopped putting a time on it.
bt: Soon at home. You stopped putting a time on it.

text: Pula mohlomong e teng. Leholimo ha le e-s'o saene letho.
en: Rain's likely-ish. The sky hasn't signed anything.
bt: Rain maybe. The sky hasn't signed anything yet.

text: Melk kan wag. Tee sonder melk bou karakter.
en: Milk can wait. Tea without it builds character.
bt: Milk can wait. Tea without milk builds character.

text: Die Berg dra sneeu vanaand. Iewers is 'n boer se hond klaar in die huis.
en: The Berg is wearing snow tonight. Somewhere a farmer's dog has already moved indoors.
bt: The Berg is wearing snow tonight. Somewhere a farmer's dog is already in the house.

text: Daardie kopligte is al vyf minute 'amper hier'. Mistyd loop stadiger.
en: Those headlights have been ‘almost here’ for five minutes. Fog time runs slower.
bt: Those headlights have been "almost here" for five minutes. Fog time runs slower.

text: Isichotho siyeza.
en: Hail incoming.
bt: The cold spell/frost is coming.
note: Reads as cold spell/frost, not hail.

text: Almal in hierdie straat staan nou by 'n venster wat hulle nooit gebruik nie.
en: Everyone on this street is now standing at a window they never use.
bt: Everyone in this street is now standing at a window they never use.

text: Reën verander elke Suid-Afrikaanse bestuurder terug in 'n leerling.
en: Rain turns every South African driver back into a learner. Hazards on, dignity off.
bt: Rain turns every South African driver back into a learner.

text: Asem soos rook, ryp op die glas, son reeds op: Hoëveldse skoolrit.
en: Breath like smoke, frost on the glass, sun already out: Highveld school run.
bt: Breath like smoke, frost on the glass, sun already up: Highveld school run.

text: Jy kan daardie gesprek êrens met mure klaarmaak.
en: You can finish that conversation somewhere with walls.
bt: You can finish that conversation somewhere with walls.

text: Imozulu iyatshintsha-tshintsha. Nam ke kunjalo.
en: Moody weather. Same, honestly.
bt: The weather keeps changing. Me too, so it is.

text: Ukuhamba uye esikhongelweni manje kuwuhambo.
en: Walking to the bin is now an expedition.
bt: Going to the place of prayer now is a journey.
note: Going to prayer, not walking to the bin.

text: Selfs die skape staan stil vir hierdie een.
en: Even the sheep are standing still for this one.
bt: Even the sheep stand still for this one.

text: Isihlalo semoto sakho siyisikhali manje.
en: Your car seat is a weapon right now.
bt: Your car seat is a weapon now.

text: 50/50 kans om nat te word. Better odds as om die Lotto te wen...
en: 50/50 on getting wet. Like a coin toss.
bt: 50/50 chance of getting wet. Better odds than winning the Lotto...
note: English phrase left in; coin-toss image changed.

text: Ukuvuka yayiyimpazamo. Ebhaliweyo phantsi.
en: Getting out of bed was a mistake. A documented one.
bt: Waking up was a mistake. Noted.

text: Kusenokuna. Kusenokoyikisa nje.
en: Could rain. Could just threaten to.
bt: It may still rain. It may just be frightening.

text: Niemand gaan hierdie sononder op Instagram sit nie.
en: Nobody's posting this sunset on Instagram.
bt: Nobody is going to put this sunset on Instagram.

text: Mhlawumbi ubusika obuhle. Iinkwenkwezi azikaqinisekisi.
en: Probably a clear night. The stars haven't confirmed.
bt: Maybe a good winter. The stars haven't confirmed yet.

text: Modumo wa seaduma
en: Thunder
bt: The sound of [?seaduma].

text: Monyako oa fridge o fumana boikoetliso kajeno.
en: The fridge door is getting a workout today.
bt: The fridge door is getting exercise today.

text: Beskuit eerste. Paniek later.
en: Rusks first. Panic later.
bt: Rusks first. Panic later.

text: Ukosa kukhanselelwe. Ewe, ngempela.
en: The braai is cancelled. Yes, really.
bt: Braai cancelled. Yes, really.

text: Die horison het vandag verlof gevat.
en: The horizon took the day off.
bt: The horizon took leave today.

text: Matsoho a hao a lipokothong 'me ha a tsoe.
en: Your hands are in your pockets and they're not coming out.
bt: Your hands are in your pockets and they are not coming out.

text: Jou familie sal dalk sonder jou kommentaar moet eet.
en: Your family may have to eat without your commentary.
bt: Your family may have to eat without your commentary.

text: Die teer is sag. Die mense is sagter.
en: The tar is soft. The people are softer.
bt: The tar is soft. The people are softer.

text: Die uitsig is gratis. Die gevoel in jou ore ook weg.
en: The view is free. So is the feeling in your ears — gone.
bt: The view is free. The feeling in your ears is gone too.

text: Vlieërsurfers het die tyd van hul lewe.
en: Kite surfers are having the time of their lives.
bt: Kitesurfers are having the time of their lives.

text: Lekker koud, maar die rugbyvelde gaan nou-nou perfek lyk.
en: Lekker koud, but the rugby fields are about to look perfect.
bt: Lekker cold, but the rugby fields will look perfect soon.

text: Fog ayikhathalelanga ishedyuli yakho.
en: The fog doesn't care about your schedule.
bt: Fog does not care about your schedule.

text: Kwezinye iindawouphahla luguquke lwaba yikhayithi.
en: Somewhere a roof is someone's new kite.
bt: In some places the roof has bent/turned into a kite.

text: Waarskynlik grys. Kan optrek, kan verdik.
en: Probably grey. Could lift, could thicken.
bt: Probably grey. Could lift, could thicken.

text: Yhuu, hlala ngaphakathi!
en: Jislaaik, stay inside!
bt: Yhuu, stay inside!
