text: Akukho lifu elibonwayo. Nelilodwa.
en: Not a cloud in sight. Not one.
bt: No cloud is seen. Not even one.

text: Koud genoeg om een kombers te deel, helder genoeg om dit die moeite werd te maak.
en: Cold enough to share one blanket, clear enough to make it worth it.
bt: Cold enough to share one blanket, clear enough to make it worth it.

text: Winterson: al die lig, nul van die hitte. Mooi probeer, son.
en: Winter sun: all of the light, none of the heat. Nice try, sun.
bt: Winter sun: all the light, none of the heat. Nice try, sun.

text: Nog een stomp. Dit was drie stompe gelede die laaste een.
en: One more log. That was the last one three logs ago.
bt: Another [?stomp: bump/punch]. The last one was three [?stomp] ago.

text: Jy is vroeg genoeg op om dit twee keer te berou.
en: You're up early enough to regret it twice.
bt: You're up early enough to regret it twice.

text: Sig: swak. Vibes: onaantasbaar.
en: Visibility: poor. Vibes: untouchable.
bt: Visibility: poor. Vibes: untouchable.

text: Daardie wasgoed gaan droog wees voor sy klaar is om die res uit te dra.
en: That washing will be dry before she has finished carrying the rest of it out.
bt: That washing will be dry before she is done carrying out the rest.

text: Imvula ikhona.
en: Rain's here.
bt: The rain is here.

text: Imigangatho ye-tile yi-villain yanamhlanje. Nxiba into ezinyaweni.
en: Tile floors are tonight's villain. Wear something on your feet.
bt: The tile floor is today's villain. Cover/close the thing at your feet.

text: Pragtig en skrikwekkend in gelyke mate.
en: Beautiful and terrifying in equal measure.
bt: Beautiful and terrifying in equal measure.

text: Ubusuku bubukeka buzolile. Uma amamodeli evuma.
en: Night looks calm. Models permitting.
bt: The night looks calm. If the models agree.

text: Die reuk van rain het klaar ge-RSVP.
en: The smell of rain has already RSVP'd.
bt: The smell of rain has already RSVP'd.

text: Die son is op presies die hoogte waar die hele veld goud word.
en: The sun is at the exact height where the whole veld goes gold.
bt: The sun is at exactly the height where the whole field turns gold.

text: Akukho nto ingalungiswa yikomityi yerooibos.
en: Nothing a cup of rooibos won't fix.
bt: Nothing that a cup of rooibos can't fix.

text: Die sypaadjie is 'n rivier en die rivier het planne.
en: The pavement is a river and the river has plans.
bt: The pavement is a river and the river has plans.

text: Nkqu neenkomo ezikwi-N1 ziqokelelene ngathi zibhatele.
en: Even the cattle on the N1 are huddled like they paid for it.
bt: Even the cattle on the N1 are huddled together as if wrapped in blankets.

text: Die koeie weet presies waar hulle is. Meer as wat ons kan sê.
en: The cows know exactly where they are. Which is more than the rest of us can say.
bt: The cows know exactly where they are. More than we can say.

text: Pers op die grond, wit in die lug. Vrydag se kleure is goedgekeur.
en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.
bt: Purple on the ground, white in the air. Friday's colours are approved.

text: Sterk wind
en: Gusty winds
bt: Strong wind

text: Die sproeier gaan vyfuur aan en is teen sewe weer af.
en: The sprinkler goes on at five and it is off again by seven.
bt: The sprinkler goes on at five and is off again by seven.

text: Ucango lwemoto yakho lusanda kuba sisixhobo.
en: Your car door just became a weapon.
bt: Your car door has just become a tool/weapon.

text: Izinhlelo zezinwele: zikhanselelwe.
en: Hair plans: cancelled.
bt: Hair plans: cancelled.

text: Oggende soos dié is hoekom Kapenaars nooit ophou spog nie.
en: Mornings like this are why Capetonians never stop mentioning it.
bt: Mornings like these are why Capetonians never stop bragging.

text: Die blou lug is nog êrens daaragter, maar die grys het die woord.
en: The blue sky is still back there somewhere, but the grey has the floor.
bt: The blue sky is still somewhere behind it, but the grey has the floor.

text: Die pantoffels is aan. Die res is onderhandelbaar.
en: The slippers are on. The rest is negotiable.
bt: The slippers are on. The rest is negotiable.

text: Cold ya mofuta o etsang hore o Google 'underfloor heating Bloemfontein'.
en: The kind of cold that has you Googling 'underfloor heating Bloemfontein'.
bt: Cold of the kind that makes you Google "underfloor heating Bloemfontein".

text: Ukuhambisa inja sekube umsebenzi wokuthemba.
en: Walking the dog has become a trust exercise.
bt: Walking the dog has become a job of trust.

text: Take uitgestel. Verskeie nuwes is op pad.
en: Chores postponed. Several new ones are on the way.
bt: Tasks postponed. Several new ones are on the way.

text: Die koppies lyk soos 'n poskaart. Jou voete voel soos ysblokke.
en: The koppies look like a postcard. Your feet feel like ice blocks.
bt: The koppies look like a postcard. Your feet feel like ice blocks.

text: Romanse later. Kry eers iets wat water opsuig.
en: Romance later. First find something absorbent.
bt: Romance later. First get something that absorbs water.

text: Ho tjhesa ho feta dashboard ea bakkie motsheare.
en: Hotter than a bakkie dashboard at noon.
bt: Hotter than a bakkie's dashboard at midday.

text: 'n Behoorlike goeie een. Moenie dit mors nie.
en: A proper good one. Don't waste it.
bt: A proper good one. Don't waste it.

text: Die agapante gaan oop vir presies hierdie soort lug, en hulle het dit gekry.
en: The agapanthus open for exactly this kind of sky, and they got it.
bt: The agapanthus open up for exactly this kind of sky, and they got it.

text: Die wind bring die buitekant in en hy laat dit na hom toe kom.
en: The wind is bringing the outside in and he is letting it come to him.
bt: The wind brings the outside in and lets it come to him.

text: Ses reënjasse, een plas, nul spyt: die reën ken sy gehoor.
en: Six raincoats, one puddle, zero regrets: the rain knows its audience.
bt: Six raincoats, one puddle, zero regret: the rain knows its audience.

text: Jy wou 'n korter vergadering hê. Nou is jy vasgekeer.
en: You wanted a shorter meeting. Now you're trapped.
bt: You wanted a shorter meeting. Now you are trapped.

text: Die tuin se uiteindelik dankie.
en: The garden's saying dankie at last.
bt: The garden's "finally, thank you".

text: Romanse is om die ekstra warm sokkies te onthou.
en: Romance is remembering the spare warm socks.
bt: Romance is remembering the extra warm socks.

text: Die vullisblikrit verg nou meer beplanning as ontbyt.
en: The bin run now requires more planning than breakfast.
bt: The bin run now requires more planning than breakfast.

text: Die reëls is eenvoudig: laaste boulbeurt wanneer die straatligte aankom.
en: House rules: last over when the streetlights win.
bt: The rules are simple: last bowling turn when the streetlights come on.

text: Jou span het vir een slag iemand anders gekry om te blameer.
en: Your team has found someone else to blame for once.
bt: Your team has someone else to blame for once.

text: 19:00 en steeds 30 grade. Die Karoo maak nie foute nie, net stellings.
en: 7pm and still 30 degrees. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.
bt: 19:00 and still 30 degrees. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.

text: Naweek-grys: amptelike toestemming om niks te doen nie.
en: Weekend grey: official permission to do absolutely nothing.
bt: Weekend grey: official permission to do nothing.

text: Sneeu op die berge beteken een ding: almal gaan dit vandag vir jou sê.
en: Snow on the mountains means one thing: everyone is going to tell you about it today.
bt: Snow on the mountains means one thing: everyone will tell you about it today.

text: Die berg lyk omtrent ses aande 'n jaar so, en dit is een van hulle.
en: The mountain looks like that about six evenings a year and this is one.
bt: The mountain looks like this about six evenings a year, and this is one of them.

text: Die Hoeveld hou nie van subtiel nie en ons is dankbaar.
en: The Highveld doesn't do subtle, and honestly we're grateful.
bt: The Highveld doesn't like subtle and we are grateful.

text: Jy kan jou planne aan iemand verduidelik wat luister.
en: You can explain your plans to someone who listens.
bt: You can explain your plans to someone who listens.

text: Haar oë is toe en daardie waaier is op presies een persoon gerig.
en: Her eyes are closed and that fan is aimed at exactly one person.
bt: Her eyes are closed and that fan is aimed at exactly one person.

text: Izulu liyaduma.
en: Thunder's grumbling, hey.
bt: The sky is thundering.

text: Die plasse eis die sypaadjie op, een blok op 'n slag.
en: The puddles are claiming the pavement one slab at a time.
bt: The puddles claim the pavement, one block at a time.

text: Dithaele tsa fatše bosiung ba  kajeno ke balotsana ,bona hore o apara ntho maotong
en: Tile floors are tonight's villain. Wear something on your feet.
bt: The floor tiles tonight are [?balotsana], see that you wear something on your feet.

text: Die sonsondergang is verniet. Die verkoue ook.
en: The sunset is free of charge. So is the head cold.
bt: The sunset is free. The cold too.

text: Maandag begin oor vyf uur en daardie waaier gaan nie af nie.
en: Monday starts in five hours and that fan is not going off.
bt: Monday starts in five hours and that fan isn't coming down.

text: Die hond het die hele straat hiervan vertel.
en: The dog has told the whole street about this.
bt: The dog told the whole street about this.

text: Die wolke gee die maan vir mekaar aan. Die balkon wag graag.
en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
bt: The clouds pass the moon to each other. The balcony gladly waits.

text: Skoot beskikbaar. Voorwaardes word nou deur die hond gestel.
en: Lap available. Terms now set by the dog.
bt: Lap available. Conditions are now set by the dog.

text: Die diefwering is die enigste reguit lyne wat in die hele straat oor is.
en: The burglar bars are the only straight lines left in the whole street.
bt: The burglar bars are the only straight lines left in the whole street.

text: Twee pare aan. Skielik is die skoene die probleem.
en: Two pairs on. Suddenly the shoes are the problem.
bt: Two pairs on. Suddenly the shoes are the problem.

text: Yiza nesilamba. Okanye iSunscreen. Okanye zombini.
en: Bring a jacket. Or sunscreen. Or both.
bt: Come with a lamp. Or Sunscreen. Or both.

text: Isimo sezulu esinele. Asikuhle, asikubi.
en: Good enough weather. Not great, not terrible.
bt: Weather that is enough. It is not good, it is not bad.

text: Inyanga liyabaleka namuhla.
en: The sun's bunking today.
bt: The moon is running away today.

text: Die reuk van reen het klaar ge-RSVP.
en: The smell of rain has already RSVP'd.
bt: The smell of rain has already RSVP'd.

text: Niemand het aan daardie kardeur geraak nie en elkeen van hulle weet hoekom.
en: Nobody has touched that car door and every one of them knows why.
bt: Nobody touched that car door and each of them knows why.

text: amafindo
en: gusts
bt: [?amafindo: hems/edges]

text: Yonke into ekhululekileyo egadini ikhethe ubundlobongela.
en: Every loose object in the garden has chosen violence.
bt: Everything loose in the garden has chosen violence.

text: Selfs die weer-apps baklei oor hierdie een.
en: Even the weather apps are arguing about this one.
bt: Even the weather apps are fighting over this one.

text: Endaweni ethile isambulela sisanda kuphenduka ngaphakathi. Umzuzu wokuthula.
en: Somewhere an umbrella just turned inside out. Moment of silence.
bt: Somewhere an umbrella has just turned inside out. A moment of silence.

text: Die geyser het oornag getrip. Natuurlik het hy.
en: The geyser tripped overnight. Of course it did.
bt: The geyser tripped overnight. Of course it did.

text: Ilanga alibonakali namhlanje.
en: The sun's bunking today.
bt: The sun is not visible today.

text: Nagsoentjie. Hou dit kort.
en: Goodnight kiss. Make it brief.
bt: Good night (little night). Keep it short.
note: nagsoentjie means goodnight kiss; BT lost the kiss

text: 'n Vrystaatse storm gee jou presies soveel waarskuwing soos wat hy lus het.
en: A Free State storm gives you exactly as much warning as it feels like.
bt: A Free State storm gives you exactly as much warning as it feels like.

text: Iikawusi ezimanzi. Olona kungcatshwa lukhulu.
en: Wet socks. The ultimate betrayal.
bt: Wet socks. The [?olona kungcatshwa] is big.
note: olona kungcatshwa lukhulu unclear; betrayal not recoverable

text: Mhlawumbi kushushu. Siya kufumanisa sonke kunye.
en: Probably hot. We'll all find out together.
bt: Maybe it is hot. We will all find out together.

text: Amafu azimisele kancinci kuphela
en: Half-committed clouds.
bt: The clouds are only a little bit determined.

text: Ubushushu mhlawumbi bukho. Inani lisazinza.
en: Heat's likely. The number's still settling.
bt: Heat is perhaps present. The number is still settling.

text: Tafelberg, 'n braai, en 'n wind met sy eie sterk mening.
en: Table Mountain, a braai, and a wind with its own strong opinion.
bt: Table Mountain, a braai, and a wind with its own strong opinion.

text: Jou wekker verwag steeds dat jy opstaan.
en: Your alarm still expects you to get up.
bt: Your alarm clock still expects you to get up.

text: Die wond het 'n persoonlike vendetta teen sambrele.
en: The wind has a personal vendetta against umbrellas.
bt: The wound [wond; probably a typo for wind] has a personal vendetta against umbrellas.

text: Die perde doen hul eie weerberig, een asem op 'n slag.
en: The horses are doing their own weather report, one breath at a time.
bt: The horses give their own weather report, one breath at a time.

text: Nat koue by die see: die soort wat deur vier lae en 'n goeie humeur trek.
en: Wet sea cold: the kind that gets through four layers and a good mood.
bt: Wet cold at the sea: the kind that goes through four layers and a good mood.

text: Laaste swem van die dag voel altyd soos 'n geheim.
en: Last swim of the day always feels like a secret.
bt: The last swim of the day always feels like a secret.

text: Drie hadedas, twee kraaie, een rillende mens by die voëlbak.
en: Three hadedas, two crows, one shivering human at the bird feeder.
bt: Three hadedas, two crows, one shivering person at the bird bath.

text: Jy mes jou bed en jy is twaalf minute weg.
en: You miss your bed and you've been gone twelve minutes.
bt: You [?mes (miss?)] your bed and you are twelve minutes away.

text: Die stad oorkant die water het 'n heeltemal ander aand.
en: The city across the water is having a completely different evening.
bt: The city across the water has a completely different evening.

text: Jakarandaseisoen en 'n Maandag, en die plaveisel vat albei sleg.
en: Jacaranda season and a Monday, and the paving is taking both badly.
bt: Jacaranda season and a Monday, and the pavement takes both badly.

text: Kucacile ngokwethiyori. I-Cape Doctor ayisoloko ifika xa ilindelwe.
en: Clear, in theory. The Cape Doctor doesn't always RSVP.
bt: Clear in theory. The Cape Doctor does not always arrive when expected.

text: Nagskof-wolke: hulle hou net die plek wurm tot die son terug is.
en: Night-shift clouds: just keeping the place warm till the sun gets back.
bt: Night-shift clouds: they just keep the place [?wurm (warm?)] until the sun is back.

text: Goud maar pragtig.
en: Cold but stunning.
bt: Gold but beautiful.

text: Reën is net die weer se manier om te sê: bly waar die koffie is.
en: Rain is just weather's way of saying stay where the coffee is.
bt: Rain is just the weather's way of saying: stay where the coffee is.

text: Die aircon verloor, en almal in hierdie kar het opgehou om daaroor te praat.
en: The aircon is losing and everyone in this car has stopped talking about it.
bt: The aircon loses, and everyone in this car has stopped talking about it.

text: 06:00 en die hemel het reeds 'n vergadering belê.
en: 6am and the sky has already called a meeting.
bt: 06:00 and the sky has already called a meeting.

text: Onthou jy toe gaan stap niks gekos het nie?
en: Remember when going for a walk didn't cost anything?
bt: Remember when going for a walk cost nothing?

text: Ipuli yommelwane ayikaze ibonakale iheha kangaka
en: The neighbours' pool has never looked so tempting.
bt: The neighbour's pool has never looked this inviting.

text: Kushisa kakhulu
en: Very hot
bt: It is very hot.

text: Hy het uit die hok gekom, en hy het nie vir die uitsig uitgekom nie.
en: He came out of the cage, and he did not come out for the view.
bt: He came out of the cage, and he did not come out for the view.

text: Ilanga alikhathalelanga izicwangciso zakho.
en: The sun doesn't care about your plans.
bt: The sun does not care about your plans.

text: Izibani zakho ezinkulu zenza 'imicabango nemikhuleko'.
en: Your headlights are doing a 'thoughts and prayers'.
bt: Your big lights make 'thoughts and prayers'.

text: Imini egqibeleleyo. Akukho zaba. Phuma.
en: Perfect day. No excuses. Get out.
bt: A perfect day. No excuses. Go outside.

text: Bonyane jarata e thabile. Motho e mong o tlameha ho thaba.
en: At least the garden's happy. Someone has to be.
bt: At least the yard is happy. Someone has to be happy.

text: Puisano ea aircon ea ofisi e sa tsoa fihla boemong ba 5.
en: The office aircon debate just went to level 5.
bt: The office aircon conversation has just arrived at level 5 [?boemong].

text: Skool begin nou-nou. Jou vingers nog nie.
en: School starts soon. Your fingers haven't.
bt: School starts soon. Your fingers not yet.

text: Umbane ubeka umboniso omhle.
en: The lightning is putting on a proper show.
bt: Lightning puts on a nice show.

text: Nat sokkies. Die finale verraad.
en: Wet socks. The ultimate betrayal.
bt: Wet socks. The final one betrays.

text: Vrydagaand, sneeu op die Apostels, en die enigste tou is vir die ketel.
en: Friday evening, snow on the Apostles, and the only queue is for the kettle.
bt: Friday evening, snow on the Apostles, and the only queue is for the kettle.

text: Uhlobo lwamakhaza olukwenza ugcine usu-Google'a 'underfloor heating Bloemfontein'.
en: The kind of cold that has you Googling 'underfloor heating Bloemfontein'.
bt: The kind of cold that makes you end up Googling 'underfloor heating Bloemfontein'.

text: Vertroueprobleme met die lug vandag.
en: Trust issues with the sky today.
bt: Trust issues with the sky today.

text: Akhomtu ubhalisele le mozulu.
en: Nobody signed up for this temperature.
bt: [?Akhomtu] has registered for this [?mozulu].
note: 'Akhomtu' is a non-word; temperature became weather

text: Mang kapa mang ea nang le pool kajeno ke motsoalle oa hao e mocha e moholo.
en: Whoever has a pool today is your new best friend.
bt: Anyone who has a pool today is your new best friend.

text: Daardie gras is sedert omtrent elfuur vanoggend te warm om op te staan.
en: That grass has been too hot to stand on since about eleven this morning.
bt: That grass has been too hot to stand on since about eleven this morning.

text: Sneeu op die berge. Elke familiegroep het nou dieselfde foto.
en: Snow on the mountains. Every family WhatsApp group now has the same photo.
bt: Snow on the mountains. Every family group now has the same photo.

text: Die N1 is nou 'n waterpark.
en: The N1 is now a waterpark.
bt: The N1 is now a water park.

text: Jou vitamien D-vlakke bedank jou.
en: Your vitamin D levels are thanking you.
bt: Your vitamin D levels thank you.

text: Imvu engase ine
en: Possible showers
bt: [?Imvu (rain?)] that might fall.
note: 'imvu' not a word; rain meaning unclear

text: 'n Knik sal doen; jou hande bly in jou sakke.
en: A nod will do; your hands are staying in your pockets.
bt: A nod will do; your hands stay in your pockets.

text: Die aand bly presies op die temperatuur waaroor niemand praat nie.
en: The evening is holding at exactly the temperature nobody talks about.
bt: The evening stays at exactly the temperature nobody talks about.

text: Mohlomong sebakeng se seng marulelo ke khaete e ncha.
en: Somewhere a roof is someone's new kite.
bt: Perhaps in some place a roof is a new [?khaete].

text: Jou skoene gaan 'n slegte dag hê.
en: Your shoes are about to have a bad day.
bt: Your shoes are going to have a bad day.

text: Matla a maholo a lehodimo. Karabo e nyenyane ea motho.
en: Big sky energy. Small human response.
bt: Great powers of the sky. A person's small answer.

text: Agt meter tot by die kar. Glo 'n ekspedisie.
en: Eight metres to the car. Apparently a journey.
bt: Eight metres to the car. Consider it an expedition.

text: Isibhakabhaka asikwazi ukwenza isigqibo. Wamkelekile eklabhini
en: The sky can't make up its mind. Join the club.
bt: The sky cannot make a decision. Welcome to the club.

text: Ilanga likhona ngokwasemthethweni. Kodwa ngomoya likwenye indawo.
en: The sun is technically present. Spiritually elsewhere.
bt: The sun is there officially. But by wind it is somewhere else.

text: Warm sjokolade is nie 'n wens nie. Dis 'n behoefte.
en: Hot chocolate is not a want. It's a need.
bt: Hot chocolate is not a wish. It is a need.

text: Die reuk van reën het klaar ge-RSVP.
en: The smell of rain has already RSVP'd.
bt: The smell of rain has already RSVP'd.

text: Jou grimering se vervaldatum is 9vm.
en: Your makeup has an expiry date of 9am.
bt: Your make-up's expiry date is 9am.

text: Hy lê daar sedert omtrent agtuur en het geen verdere planne nie.
en: He has been lying there since about eight and has no further plans.
bt: He has been lying there since about eight and has no further plans.

text: Jy kan wag. Jou inkopies moet nêrens anders wees nie.
en: You can wait. Your shopping has nowhere else to be.
bt: You can wait. Your shopping needn't be anywhere else.

text: Niemand bied aan om die ekstra stoele te gaan haal nie.
en: Nobody's volunteering to fetch the extra chairs.
bt: Nobody offers to go and fetch the extra chairs.

text: Daardie kap sou al halfpad in die straat af wees as haar hand nie daarop was nie.
en: That hood would be halfway down the road if her hand was not on it.
bt: That hood would already be halfway down the street if her hand were not on it.

text: Môreoggend gaan hierdie pad onder iemand anders se boom lê.
en: Tomorrow morning this road will be covered in somebody else's tree.
bt: Tomorrow morning this road will lie under someone else's tree.

text: Ilanga alikhathali ngezinhlelo zakho.
en: The sun doesn't care about your plans.
bt: The sun does not care about your plans.

text: Ho a bata, mohlomong. Apara liaparo tse ngata.
en: Chilly, most likely. Layer up to be safe.
bt: It is cold, perhaps. Wear lots of clothes.

text: Veerwolke só pienk beteken die lug is heeltemal droog, tot bo.
en: Cirrus this pink means the sky is completely dry all the way up.
bt: Feather clouds this pink mean the sky is completely dry, all the way up.

text: Kuhle kwayekoyikisa ngokulinganayo.
en: Beautiful and terrifying in equal measure.
bt: It is nice, it [?stopped scaring / frightens] equally. [?kwayekoyikisa]

text: Jy hoor die hadidas, maar jy sien niks. Onheilspellend? Nee. Net Dinsdag.
en: You can hear the hadedas but you can't see them. Ominous? No. Just Tuesday.
bt: You hear the hadedas, but you see nothing. Ominous? No. Just Tuesday.

text: Twee pennetjies per hemp vandag. Enigiets minder is 'n skenking aan die bure.
en: Two pegs a shirt today. Anything less is a donation to the neighbours.
bt: Two pins per shirt today. Anything less is a donation to the neighbours.

text: Welkom-cold kajeno. Serame se phunyeletsang di-jersey tse tharo eka ha di yo.
en: Welkom-cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
bt: Welkom-cold today. The cold that pierces three jerseys as if they were not there.

text: kwa ne Table mountain igqibe ngalo mhla
en: Even Table Mountain's called it a day.
bt: [?kwa] with Table Mountain it ended with it that day. [garbled]

text: Botlolo ea metsi a chesang ke mohale oa 'nete kajeno.
en: Hot water bottle is the real MVP today.
bt: A bottle of hot water is a true hero today.

text: Chrome ho iPhone e ke ke ea kenya di-app. Tlanya ka tlase ho bula sebaka sena ho Safari, joale latela mehato.
bt: Chrome on iPhone cannot install apps. Tap below to open this place in Safari, then follow the steps.
note: no English source supplied; reads as install instruction

text: Die blou helfte van die lug leef op geleende tyd, en die grasperke weet dit.
en: The blue half of the sky is on borrowed time and the lawns know it.
bt: The blue half of the sky lives on borrowed time, and the lawns know it.

text: Laat die bestuurder agter jou geduld ontdek.
en: Let the driver behind you discover patience.
bt: Let the driver behind you discover patience.

text: Die take kan wag. Jou vingers het eerste gebel.
en: The chores can wait. Your fingers called first.
bt: The tasks can wait. Your fingers called first.

text: Maru kajeno, vibes ke optional.
en: Clouds today, vibes optional.
bt: Clouds today, vibes are optional.

text: Grys en kouerig: skielik onthou almal hul trui is in die kar.
en: Grey and chilly: suddenly everyone remembers their jersey is in the car.
bt: Grey and chilly: suddenly everyone remembers their jersey is in the car.

text: Umhlaba uphela amamitha amabili ngale kwesango.
en: The world ends two metres past the gate.
bt: The world ends two metres beyond the gate.

text: Bewolk genoeg om te kla, sonnig genoeg om jou bek te hou.
bt: Cloudy enough to complain, sunny enough to keep your mouth shut.
note: no English source supplied; reads fine

text: Daardie glas is al 'n uur vol en sy is glad nie haastig nie.
en: That glass has been full for an hour and she is in no hurry.
bt: That glass has been full for an hour and she is not in a hurry at all.

text: Daardie wolklyn skuif in met die selfvertroue van 'n Maandag.
en: That cloud line is moving in with the confidence of a Monday.
bt: That cloud line moves in with the confidence of a Monday.

text: Vyf treë buite. Oorweeg reeds padkos.
en: Five steps out. Already considering provisions.
bt: Five steps outside. Already considering padkos (road snacks).

text: Ngisho nomthunzi uyajuluka.
en: Even the shade is sweating.
bt: Even the shade is sweating.

text: Mola seteisheneng sa petlolo o sa tsoa phethahala hararo.
en: The queue at the petrol station just tripled.
bt: [?Mola] at the petrol station has just been completed three [?hararo].

text: Ligte haal omtrent twintig meter hier; die res is geheue en respek.
en: Headlights do about twenty metres out here; the rest is memory and respect.
bt: Lights reach about twenty metres here; the rest is memory and respect.

text: Die eerste een in mag nie kla dis koud nie. Dis die reël.
en: First one in doesn't get to complain that it's cold. That's the rule.
bt: The first one in may not complain that it is cold. That is the rule.

text: Wag dit binne uit. Die berge gaan nêrens nie.
en: Wait it out indoors. The mountains aren't going anywhere.
bt: Wait it out inside. The mountains are not going anywhere.

text: Ukosa kuyikhalenda yenhlalo. Vela.
en: The braai is the social calendar. Show up.
bt: Roasting (braai) is the social calendar. Show up.

text: Die vullisblik word vanaand teen spoed uitgevat, en die lug weet hoekom.
en: The bin run is being done at speed tonight, and the sky knows why.
bt: The rubbish bin is being taken out at speed tonight, and the sky knows why.

text: Die maan skyn helder genoeg om wasgoed op te hang, en iemand het dit gedoen.
en: There is enough moon out there to hang washing by, and somebody did.
bt: The moon shines bright enough to hang washing, and someone did.

text: Isiphepho siyeza.
bt: A whirlwind/storm is coming.
note: no English source supplied; reads fine

text: Nat toestande
en: Wet conditions
bt: Wet conditions.

text: Wolk oor die berg, potjie onder die lapa. Albei kort nog 'n uur.
en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.
bt: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.

text: Blou lug: die buitegimnasium het skielik nuwe lede.
en: Blue sky: the outdoor gym has suddenly found new members.
bt: Blue sky: the outdoor gym suddenly has new members.

text: 'n Grys skemer bring die aand vroeër, en die vensters stem klaar saam.
en: A grey dusk brings the evening forward, and the windows have already agreed.
bt: A grey dusk brings the evening earlier, and the windows already agree.

text: Buurtwag se nuwe agenda: die lug.
en: Neighbourhood watch has a new agenda: the sky.
bt: Neighbourhood watch's new agenda: the sky.

text: Perfekte weer vir bestaan sonder entoesiasme.
en: Perfect weather for existing without enthusiasm.
bt: Perfect weather for existing without enthusiasm.

text: Die dag eindig soos 'n voicenote wat net skielik ophou.
en: The day is ending like a voicenote that just cuts off mid-
bt: The day ends like a voice note that just suddenly stops.

text: Die stormwater is see toe op pad en vat gevangenes.
en: The storm water is heading for the sea and taking prisoners.
bt: The stormwater is on its way to the sea and takes prisoners.

text: Tlhaho e batla ho bua. Ho molemo ho mametsa.
en: Nature's having a word. Best to listen.
bt: Nature wants to speak. It is better to listen.

text: Die bome by die heining vat dit erger as hy.
en: The trees at the fence are taking this worse than he is.
bt: The trees by the fence take it worse than he does.

text: Een planeet op, geen wolke op pad nie, en die hele dorp is nog buite.
en: One planet up, no clouds coming, and the whole dorp still outside.
bt: One planet up, no clouds on the way, and the whole town is still outside.

text: Hobaneng uena-oa-nakong-e-fetileng o entse merero? Uena-oa-nakong-e-fetileng o mobe.
en: Why did past-you make plans? Past-you is the worst.
bt: Why did you-of-the-past-time make plans? You-of-the-past-time is bad.

text: Lokhu ukuhlolwa kwesibhakabhaka. Siphasile.
en: This is the sky's performance review. It passed.
bt: This is a sky inspection/test. We passed.

text: Dinsdagaand, en die swembad geniet dit meer as enigiemand.
en: Tuesday night, and the pool is having a far better time than anyone.
bt: Tuesday evening, and the pool enjoys it more than anyone.

text: Albei hande is op die romp, wat beteken die hare is op sy eie.
en: Both hands are on the skirt, which means the hair is on its own.
bt: Both hands are on the skirt, which means the hair is on its own.

text: Weke van niks behalwe blou nie, en selfs die hadeda moet by die sproeier toustaan.
en: Weeks of nothing but blue, and even the hadeda has to queue at the sprinkler.
bt: Weeks of nothing but blue, and even the hadeda has to queue at the sprinkler.

text: Die handdoeke is klam uitgehang en kom as planke terug.
en: The towels went out damp and are coming in as boards.
bt: The towels are hung out damp and come back as planks.

text: Die nag het 'n weighted blanket oor alles kom gooi.
en: The night has thrown a weighted blanket over everything.
bt: The night came to throw a weighted blanket over everything.

text: Die vullisblik het tot by die sypaadjie gekom en toe self besluit.
en: The bin made it to the pavement and then made its own decisions.
bt: The rubbish bin got as far as the pavement and then decided for itself.

text: Ipuli alikho ukukhetha.
en: The pool is not optional.
bt: The pool has no choosing / is not there to choose.

text: Pula e ka ba teng. Le ho fosa ka botlalo ho ka etsahala.
en: Rain's possible. So is being completely wrong.
bt: Rain may come. Even being completely wrong may happen.

text: Lifate li etsa yoga e sa batleheng.
en: The trees are doing involuntary yoga.
bt: The trees are doing unwanted yoga.

text: Maikemisetso a sa tsitsang
en: Patchy ambitions.
bt: Unsteady intentions.

text: Sebenzisa futhi noma uhlupheke.
en: Reapply that sunscreen or suffer.
bt: Use again or suffer.

text: Ewe, imvula ina ngecala. Yinto eqhelekileyo yaseMzantsi Afrika.
en: Yes, it's raining sideways. South Africa speciality.
bt: Yes, the rain falls sideways. It is a normal South African thing.

text: Êrens daarbo het die reën 'n pad ingekry, en dit word hanteer.
en: Somewhere up there the rain found a way in, and it is being managed.
bt: Somewhere up there the rain found a way in, and it is being handled.

text: Die wind het die wolke kom wegvee sodat jy die sterre kan sien. Jammer oor al die res.
en: The wind swept the clouds away so you could see the stars. Apologies about everything else.
bt: The wind came to sweep the clouds away so you can see the stars. Sorry about everything else.

text: Daardie druppel dink al van omtrent vieruur vanoggend af daaraan om los te laat.
en: That drop has been thinking about letting go since about four this morning.
bt: That drop has been thinking about letting go since about four this morning.

text: Die lug het die kleur van die personeelkamer se plafon gekry en maak hom tuis.
en: The sky has gone the colour of the staff-room ceiling and settled in.
bt: The sky has taken on the colour of the staffroom ceiling and is making itself at home.

text: Die weergode pronk vandag.
en: The weather gods are showing off.
bt: The weather gods are showing off today.

text: Die reflekterende baadjie doen vanoggend presies waarvoor dit gekoop is.
en: The hi-vis is doing exactly what it was bought for this morning.
bt: The reflective jacket is doing exactly what it was bought for this morning.

text: Selfs dié wat sweer dit word nooit koud nie, erken dit nou.
en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.
bt: Even those who swear it never gets cold admit it now.

text: Die maan doen sy bes vanaand.
en: The moon's doing the most tonight.
bt: The moon is doing its best tonight.

text: Koloi e kgohletse habeli pele e dumela ho starta.
en: The car coughed twice before it agreed to start.
bt: The car coughed twice before agreeing to start.

text: Die clouds het 'n oomblik.
en: The clouds are having a moment.
bt: The clouds are having a moment.

text: I-heater ngumhlobo wakho omkhulu. Enyanisweni, kuphela kwakhe
en: The heater is your best friend. Your only friend.
bt: The heater is your best friend. In fact, his only one.

text: Jou gesig wil ook 'n beurt in die son hê.
en: Your face would also like a turn in the sun.
bt: Your face also wants a turn in the sun.

text: Die son is omtrent tien minute gelede oor die dak, en die teëls is klaar warm.
en: The sun cleared the roof about ten minutes ago and the tiles are already warm.
bt: The sun has been over the roof for about ten minutes, and the tiles are already warm.

text: Amafu aphendule athi 'mhlawumbi' avele eza nje.
en: The clouds RSVP'd 'maybe' and showed up anyway.
bt: The clouds answered saying 'maybe' and just come along like that.

text: Die wind het die wasgoed gevat. Die knypers mag ons maar hou.
en: The wind took the washing. It's keeping the pegs.
bt: The wind took the washing. We may keep the pegs.

text: Jou hond het slaap in sy eie bed gekanselleer.
en: Your dog has cancelled sleeping in its own bed.
bt: Your dog has cancelled sleeping in its own bed.

text: Kubukeka kubanda. I-thermometer isenza siqagele.
en: Looks cold-ish. The thermometer's keeping us guessing.
bt: It looks cold. The thermometer makes us guess.

text: Die vibe is beige. Aanvaar dit.
en: The vibe is beige. Accept it.
bt: The vibe is beige. Accept it.

text: Boloka letsatsi lena mohopolong.
en: Save this one in the memory bank.
bt: Keep this day in memory.

text: Ho tjhesa haholo ho phehisa. Ho tjhesa haholo ho sebetsa.
en: Too hot to argue. Too hot to function.
bt: Too hot to cook. Too hot to work.

text: Nie 'n wolk in sig nie. Nie een nie.
en: Not a cloud in sight. Not one.
bt: Not a cloud in sight. Not one.

text: Mag n bietjie spoeg. Mag dalk nie moeite doen daarmee nie.
en: Might spit a bit. Might not bother.
bt: May spit a little. May perhaps not bother with it.

text: Braai e a etsahala. Braai e dula e etsahala. Re hulela ditulo haufi feela.
en: The braai is happening. The braai always happens. We just pull the chairs closer.
bt: Braai happens. Braai always happens. We just move the chairs closer.

text: Die vullisblik uitvat tel as jou aandstap.
en: Taking the bin out counts as your evening walk.
bt: Taking the rubbish bin out counts as your evening walk.

text: Imvelo iyaziqhayisa futhi silapha ngayo.
en: Nature's flexing and we're here for it.
bt: Nature is showing off and we are here for it.

text: Storm. Planne kan wag.
en: Storm. Plans can wait.
bt: Storm. Plans can wait.

text: Die roomys verloor en al drie van hulle weet dit.
en: The ice cream is losing and all three of them know it.
bt: The ice cream is losing and all three of them know it.

text: Amafu amancinci. Ilanga elincinci. iAdmin yehlobo lwaseMzantsi Africa
en: Some clouds. Some sun. South African summer admin.
bt: Small clouds. Small sun. South African summer admin.

text: I-out-of-office yakho yenza umsebenzi onzima.
en: Your out-of-office is doing the heavy lifting.
bt: Your out-of-office is doing heavy work.

text: Die stuurwiel daarin is op die oomblik nie iets wat jy kan vashou nie.
en: The steering wheel in there is currently not something you can hold.
bt: The steering wheel in there is not something you can hold at the moment.

text: Isibhakabhaka silahla amatshe. Hlala phakathi.
en: Sky's throwing rocks. Stay inside.
bt: The sky is throwing stones. Stay inside.

text: Die wêreld het 'n sagte filter gekry vanoggend.
en: The world got a soft filter this morning.
bt: The world got a soft filter this morning.

text: Daardie deur gaan toeslaan of hy gereed is of nie.
en: That door is going to shut whether he is ready or not.
bt: That door is going to slam whether it is ready or not.

text: Usuku olufudumele luyeza, cishe.
en: Warm one coming, give or take a few degrees.
bt: A warm day is coming, almost.

text: Uena oa hosane o tla leboha ka setofo sa letsatsi.
en: Your future self will thank you for that sunscreen.
bt: Tomorrow's you will be thankful for the sun [?setofo (stove?)].

text: Vanaand hou die lug sy stories vir homself.
en: The sky's keeping tonight to itself.
bt: Tonight the sky keeps its stories to itself.

text: Bed kan wag. Die kombers het saamgekom.
en: Bed can wait. The blanket has come with.
bt: Bed can wait. The blanket came along.

text: Elke liggie daar onder is iemand wat ook nie kan glo dis al winter nie.
en: Every glow down there is someone else who also can't believe it's already winter.
bt: Every little light down there is someone who also cannot believe it is already winter.

text: Ho kgutsitse kantle. E batla ho belaela.
en: Quiet out there. Almost suspicious.
bt: It is quiet outside. It wants to be suspicious.

text: Die kole gaan nie hulself aansteek nie.
en: The coals aren't going to light themselves.
bt: The coals will not light themselves.

text: Dit reën nog. Dis die opdatering.
en: Still raining. That's the update.
bt: It is still raining. That is the update.

text: Sefefo se monyetleng, ha se e-s'o netefatsoe. Lula u falimehile.
en: Storm on the cards, not yet confirmed. Stay sharp.
bt: A [?sefefo (storm/blizzard)] in the [?monyetleng], not yet confirmed. Stay covered.

text: Kubonakala kugutyungelwe. Imithombo ayivumelani.
en: Looks overcast. The sources aren't unanimous.
bt: It looks overcast. The sources do not agree.

text: Ontbyt eerste. Die dak nagaan kan wag.
en: Breakfast first. Checking the roof can wait.
bt: Breakfast first. Checking the roof can wait.

text: Kubonakala kuyimini entle. Siqinisekile malunga ne-80%.
en: Probably a good one. We're about 80% sure.
bt: It looks like a nice day. We are about 80% sure.

text: Impumlo yakho iya kukuthengisa ngo-3pm.
en: Your nose is going to betray you by 3pm.
bt: Your nose will sell you out at 3pm.

text: Vyf tarentale stap in 'n ry oor: die ryp laat almal versigtig trap.
en: Five guinea fowl crossing in single file: the frost has everyone walking carefully.
bt: Five guinea fowl walk across in a row: the frost makes everyone step carefully.

text: Al warm met sonop: die boer se dag begin om vier en is om tien verby.
en: Hot already at sunrise: the farmer's day starts at four and ends by ten.
bt: Already warm at sunrise: the farmer's day begins at four and is over at ten.

text: Tlhaho e sa tsoa re hopotsa hore na ke mang ea pele.
en: Nature just reminded us of the pecking order.
bt: Nature has just reminded us who comes first.

text: Lehodimo le a buffera.
en: The sky is buffering.
bt: The sky is buffering.

text: Phandle luvavanyo lwesimilo — kwaye uyasilela.
en: Outside is a test of character. You're failing.
bt: Outside is a character test, and you are failing.

text: Hou die planne vaag; die bure gaan nie agterkom nie.
en: Keep the plans vague; the neighbours won't notice.
bt: Keep the plans vague; the neighbours won't notice.

text: Die trampolien het verhuis en die buurman se muur as maat gevat.
en: The trampoline has relocated and taken the neighbour's wall as a partner.
bt: The trampoline moved and took the neighbour's wall as a partner.

text: Regen so swaar dit moet huur betaal.
en: Rain so heavy it should pay rent.
bt: Rain [Regen: Dutch/German spelling] so heavy it should pay rent.

text: Kunomoya omncinci, mhlawumbi. Mhlawumbi ngaphezulu.
en: Breezy, probably. Maybe more.
bt: There is a little wind, maybe. Maybe more.

text: Dis die stilte voor die groepsgesprek ontplof.
en: The calm before the group chat explodes.
bt: It is the silence before the group chat explodes.

text: Bly nog 'n minuut. Dan het ons nog 'n kombers nodig.
en: Stay another minute. Then we'll need another blanket.
bt: Stay another minute. Then we will need another blanket.

text: Letsatsi le nka khefu.
en: Sun on a smoke break.
bt: The sun is taking a break.

text: Klein ysbomme val. Binne is die enigste plan.
en: Tiny ice bombs falling. Indoors is the only plan.
bt: Small hailstones fall. Inside is the only plan.

text: Maru a etsa polelo e nyane.
en: The sky's doing freelance today.
bt: The clouds make a small speech.

text: Silent Hill vibes. Ntle le dimanka. Re tšepa.
en: Silent Hill vibes. Without the monsters. Hopefully.
bt: Silent Hill vibes. Without monsters. We hope.

text: Sofa e entsoe nyeoe e matla ea ho dula.
en: The couch has made a compelling case for staying.
bt: A sofa made a strong case for sitting.

text: Komberse buite in die donker: die aand is koud, die geselskap nie.
en: Blankets outside in the dark: the evening is cold, the company is not.
bt: Blankets outside in the dark: the evening is cold, the company is not.

text: Die Karoo maak nou die dak oop. Trek warm aan vir die vertoning.

bt: Not a cloud. Just you and the Southern Cross.

bt: The fog drank the mountain.
