en: There is a whole garden out there and about a metre of it is bearable.
bt: There is a whole garden out there and about a metre of it is bearable.

text: Inja inomnqweno. Inja isoloko inomnqweno. Hlonipha.
en: The dog is still keen. The dog is always keen. Respect.
bt: The dog has a wish/longing. The dog always has a wish. Respect.

text: Die Boland word in sy slaap natgelê en more spog hy daaroor.
en: The Boland is getting watered in its sleep and will absolutely brag about it tomorrow.
bt: The Boland gets soaked in its sleep and brags about it tomorrow.

text: I-ice cream ayisiyona isipho. Yikuphila.
en: Ice cream isn't a treat. It's survival.
bt: Ice cream is not a gift. It is living.

text: Jou wekker kyk nooit waarin hy jou instuur nie.
en: Your alarm never checks what it's sending you into.
bt: Your alarm never looks at what it sends you into.

text: Isimo sezulu esinomdlalo esidinga i-Carte Blanche.
en: Weather so dramatic it needs a Carte Blanche segment.
bt: Weather with a [?play/performance] that needs Carte Blanche.

text: Die mis was eerste by die uitkykpunt en het die hele uitsig vir homself gevat.
en: The fog got to the lookout first and took the whole view for itself.
bt: The fog was first at the lookout point and took the whole view for itself.

text: I-SPF 50 noma uzozisola ngokuhlwa.
en: SPF 50 or regret it by tonight.
bt: SPF 50 or you will blame yourself in the evening.

text: Matsatsi a tjena a lokela ho tla le soundtrack.
en: Days like this should come with a soundtrack.
bt: Days like this should come with a soundtrack.

text: I-ice cream ayisosipho — kukusinda.
en: Ice cream isn't a treat. It's survival.
bt: Ice cream is not a gift, it is surviving.

text: Imodhi ye-blanket burrito: ivuliwe.
en: Blanket burrito mode: activated.
bt: Blanket burrito mode: on.

text: Lehodimo le hlakileng.
en: Clear skies.
bt: Clear sky

text: Donder so naby tel as 'n huisgas.
en: Thunder that close counts as a house guest.
bt: Thunder this close counts as a house guest.

text: Inxalenye yento yonke. Imini ephakathi.
en: Bit of everything. Classic in-between day.
bt: A part of everything. Midday.

text: Hoed, sonbrille, sonbrandroom. Nie onderhandelbaar nie.
en: Hat, sunnies, sunscreen. Non-negotiable.
bt: Hat, sunglasses, sunscreen. Non-negotiable.

text: Abanamaphondo ezinweleni basebenza i overtime.
en: Ponytail holders are doing overtime.
bt: Those with [?amaphondo = horns/?] in the [?ezinweleni = hair?] work overtime.

text: Mhlawumbi inkungu kamva. I-Boland yenza oku.
en: Probably fog later. The Boland does this.
bt: Maybe fog later. The Boland does this.

text: Akubi kubi, akubi kuhle. Njengedethi ye-6/10.
en: Not bad, not great. Like a 6/10 date.
bt: It is not bad, it is not good. Like a 6/10 date.

text: Iphantse yalusuku lwe braai
en: Almost a braai day.
bt: It is almost a braai night.

text: Golden hour maak selfs die stof 'n spesiale effek.
en: Golden hour turns even the dust into a special effect.
bt: Golden hour makes even the dust a special effect.

text: Die son is skaars op en sy het haar plek reeds gekies.
en: The sun is only just up and she has already picked her spot.
bt: The sun is barely up and she has already chosen her spot.

text: Kunamafu kancinci. Ungabhejeli ukosa inyama kuko
en: Cloudy-ish. Don't bet the braai on it.
bt: A little cloudy. Don't gamble on braaiing meat in it.

text: Imvu enzima kakhulu kufanele ikhokhe irenti.
en: Rain so heavy it should pay rent.
bt: A sheep that [?enzima = stands firm/stubborn] very much must pay rent.
note: sheep must pay rent, not heavy rain

text: Daardie syfer het in tagtig kilometer nie geroer nie, en die uitsig ook nie.
en: That number has not moved in eighty kilometres and neither has the scenery.
bt: That number hasn't budged in eighty kilometres, and neither has the view.

text: Iewers daarbuite is die pad. Ons dink.
en: Somewhere out there is the road. We think.
bt: Somewhere out there is the road. We think.

text: I-Highveld winter: indawo lapho ugqoka ama-jacket amabili uyolanda iposi.
en: Highveld winter: the only place where you wear two jackets to fetch the post.
bt: Highveld winter: the place where you put on two jackets to go fetch the post.

text: Ho monate
en: Pleasant
bt: It is nice

text: Vat jou tyd. Die tou agter jou kan ook.
en: Take your time. The queue behind you can too.
bt: Take your time. The queue behind you can too.

text: Die jakaranda laat pers val op 'n grasperk wat hy pas natgemaak het.
en: The jacaranda is dropping purple on a lawn he has just finished watering.
bt: The jacaranda lets purple fall on a lawn that has just been watered.

text: Bonyane ha ho ne pula. Ke standaard.
en: At least it's not raining. That's the bar.
bt: At least there is no rain. That is standard.

text: Die sun speel siek vandag.
en: The sun's bunking today.
bt: The sun is playing sick today.

text: Imozulu yo ukosa inyama boet! Akukho zaba.ukosa inyama
en: Braai weather, boet! No excuses.
bt: Braai weather, boet! No [?zaba]. Braai meat.

text: EWelkom, eSasolburg, eKroonstad: i-koue belt yenza i-koue thing yayo.
en: Welkom, Sasolburg, Kroonstad: the koue belt is doing its koue thing.
bt: In Welkom, Sasolburg, Kroonstad: the cold belt does its cold thing.

text: Maan agter 'n wolk, hond op die stoep. Sondag se diens is verby.
en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
bt: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.

text: Lefatše le fumane filitha e bonolo hoseng.
en: The world got a soft filter this morning.
bt: The earth has found a gentle [?filitha] in the morning.

text: Amazinga akho e-vitamin D ayakubonga.
en: Your vitamin D levels are thanking you.
bt: Your vitamin D levels will thank you.

text: Luhlobo lwemini olwenza uthumele umntu umyalezo ngayo.
en: The kind of day you text someone about.
bt: It is the kind of midday that makes you send someone a message about it.

text: Ibhitshi okanye
en: Beach or braai? Yes.
bt: Beach or

text: Die maan het die berge aangeskakel. Die hitte, egter, nie.
en: The moon switched the mountains on. The heat, however, stays off.
bt: The moon has switched the mountains on. The heat, however, has not.

text: Die stoepkussings het 'n vergadering belê oor verhuising.
en: The stoep cushions have called a meeting about relocating.
bt: The patio cushions called a meeting about relocation.

text: Die ys in jou drankie het presies 30 sekondes gehou.
en: The ice in your drink lasted exactly 30 seconds.
bt: The ice in your drink lasted exactly 30 seconds.

text: Sky's playing kat-en-muis.
en: Sky's playing cat and mouse.
bt: Sky's playing cat-and-mouse.

text: Wind is op die kaarte. Peg die wasgoed vas.
en: Wind's on the cards. Peg the washing down.
bt: Wind is on the cards. Peg the washing down.

text: Jy het tien minute lank verfilm. Jy het dit gemis.
en: You filmed for ten minutes. You missed it.
bt: You filmed for ten minutes. You missed it.

text: Maak jy tee? Skielik wil almal hê.
en: You're making tea? Suddenly everyone needs some.
bt: Are you making tea? Suddenly everyone wants some.

text: Ngisho nama-app ezulu ayaphikisana ngalokhu.
en: Even the weather apps are arguing about this one.
bt: Even the weather apps argue about this.

text: Dors is vervang as die slaaptyd-verskoning.
en: Thirst has been replaced as the bedtime excuse.
bt: Thirst has been replaced as the bedtime excuse.

text: Jou toekomstige self sal jou dankie sê vir daai sonbrandroom.
en: Your future self will thank you for that sunscreen.
bt: Your future self will thank you for that sunscreen.

text: Die sproeier is kamma vir die gras. Kyk wie staan almal in die water.
en: The sprinkler is supposedly for the lawn. Look who's all standing in the water.
bt: The sprinkler is supposedly for the grass. Look who is all standing in the water.

text: Isimo sezulu se-postcard. Wamukelekile.
en: Postcard weather. You're welcome.
bt: Postcard weather. Welcome.

text: Die lug is so helder, selfs die warmlugballonne pronk.
en: A sky this clear, even the hot-air balloons are showing off.
bt: The sky is so clear that even the hot-air balloons are showing off.

text: Hoe blouer die lug, hoe kouer die waarheid.
en: The bluer the sky, the colder the truth.
bt: The bluer the sky, the colder the truth.

text: Die weer het ja gesê. Nou lê dit by jou.
en: The weather said yes. That’s on you now.
bt: The weather said yes. Now it is up to you.

text: Ho utloahala eka naha e maemong a eona a matle.
en: Feels like the country is on its best behaviour.
bt: It sounds as if the land is in its beautiful state.

text: Die lug het sy beste tien minute vir bo-op die klim gehou.
en: The sky saved its best ten minutes for the top of the climb.
bt: The sky kept its best ten minutes for the climb to the top.

text: Ama-layers ayaphuma ngo-11. Ama-layers ayabuya futhi ngo-4. Imikhuba yase-Highveld.
en: Layers off by 11. Layers on by 4. Highveld classic.
bt: Layers come off at 11. Layers come back again at 4. Highveld habits.

text: Die Kaapse Dokter werk deur etenstyd.
en: The Cape Doctor is working straight through lunch.
bt: The Cape Doctor works through lunchtime.

text: Linamafu ngokupheleleyo
en: Overcast
bt: It is completely cloudy.

text: Mofuta oa letsatsi oo o romelang motho molaetsa ka lona.
en: The kind of day you text someone about.
bt: The kind of sun that makes one send a message about it.

text: Die Kaapse Dokter werk nagskof. Die hele straat het 'n afspraak.
en: The Cape Doctor is on night shift. The whole street has an appointment.
bt: The Cape Doctor works the night shift. The whole street has an appointment.

text: Imozulu esimnandi
en: Pleasant
bt: Pleasant weather

text: Die net hanteer muskiete. Die waaier hanteer al die res.
en: The net is handling mosquitoes. The fan is handling everything else.
bt: The net handles mosquitoes. The fan handles all the rest.

text: Hoekom het jy die huis verlaat? Eerlik.
en: Why did you leave the house? Honestly.
bt: Why did you leave the house? Honestly.

text: pudi e ka na
en: Might rain.
bt: [?Goat(s)] might rain / a goat can rain.

text: Ordentlike storm. Nie die mooi soort nie.
en: Proper storm. Not the pretty kind.
bt: Decent storm. Not the pretty kind.

text: Yilokhu. Lapha nje.
en: This is the stuff. Right here.
bt: This is it. Right here.

text: Ubusuku bucacile kancane. Ungathathi lesi sibikezelo sezulu ngokweqiniso kakhulu.
en: Clear-ish night. Don't hold us to the stars.
bt: The night is a bit clear. Don't take this weather forecast too seriously.

text: Boerierol vir ontbyt? Op 'n naweek? Aanvaarbaar.
en: Boerie roll for breakfast? On a weekend? Acceptable.
bt: Boerewors roll for breakfast? On a weekend? Acceptable.

text: Sterre uit, beurtkrag kan dit nie raak nie.
en: Stars out, load shedding can't touch this.
bt: Stars out, load shedding can't touch it.

text: Die kat kan presies sien wat in daardie mis is en kies om niks te sê nie.
en: The cat can see exactly what is in that fog and is choosing not to say.
bt: The cat can see exactly what is in that fog and chooses to say nothing.

text: Ama-hadeda ayalala. Ekugcineni.
en: The hadedas are sleeping. Finally.
bt: The hadedas are sleeping. Finally.

text: Lyk helder-ish. Die modelle en die lug stem nie altyd saam nie.
en: Looks clear-ish. The models and the sky don't always agree.
bt: Looks clear-ish. The models and the sky don't always agree.

text: Die boom het erger Dinsdae gesien en gaan weer erger sien.
en: The tree has seen worse Tuesdays and it will see worse again.
bt: The tree has seen worse Tuesdays and is going to see worse again.

text: Kaapse koue klop nie. Dit kom sommer deur die mure in.
en: Cape cold doesn't knock. It comes in through the walls.
bt: Cape cold doesn't knock. It just comes in through the walls.

text: letsatsi le bapala peek-a-boo
en: Sun's playing peek-a-boo.
bt: The sun is playing peek-a-boo.

text: Die mis gee nie om oor jou skedule nie.
en: The fog doesn't care about your schedule.
bt: The fog doesn't care about your schedule.

text: lithaba li matsatsi a phomolo
en: The mountains are on holiday today.
bt: The mountains are holiday days.

text: Umbani ubeka umbukiso omuhle.
en: The lightning is putting on a proper show.
bt: The lightning puts on a good show.

text: ukosa inyama yikhalenda yentlalo. Yiza uzibonakalise.
en: The braai is the social calendar. Show up.
bt: Braaing meat is a social calendar. Come and show yourself.

text: Selfs die weer kan nie gepla wees vandag nie.
en: Even the weather can't be bothered today.
bt: Even the weather can't be bothered today.

text: Laaste een wat toemaak, los asseblief die liggie aan. Dit lyk mooi.
en: Last one closing up, please leave the light on. It looks lovely.
bt: Last one to close up, please leave the little light on. It looks nice.

text: Ag no, lesela la tafoleng le foka moea
bt: Oh no, the tablecloth blows air/wind.

text: Die windpomp het opgehou draai, en so weet jy die dag is verby.
en: The windpomp has stopped turning, which is how you know the day is over.
bt: The windmill has stopped turning, and that is how you know the day is over.

text: Middagete het buitetoe getrek, want binne is warmer as buite. Niemand kan dit verklaar nie.
en: Lunch moved outside because inside is hotter than outside. Nobody can explain it.
bt: Lunch moved outside, because inside is warmer than outside. Nobody can explain it.

text: Die nek het 'n weighted blanket oor alles kom gooi.
en: The night has thrown a weighted blanket over everything.
bt: The neck/pass [?nek] has thrown a weighted blanket over everything.

text: Ilanga likuhlasela wena buqu.
en: The sun is personally attacking you.
bt: The sun is attacking you personally.

text: Al daardie wolke, en die son het steeds die briewebus onderaan gekry.
en: All that cloud, and the sun still found the letterbox at the bottom.
bt: All those clouds, and the sun still got the mailbox at the bottom.

text: Die berg se tafeldoek is net half op. Dis Maandag, niemand is heeltemal aangetrek nie.
en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
bt: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody is fully dressed.

text: Sondag, en die waterrekening het sy lot reeds stilweg aanvaar.
en: Sunday, and the water bill has already quietly accepted its fate.
bt: Sunday, and the water bill has already quietly accepted its fate.

text: Ithrafikhi inomzwelo.
en: The traffic is emotional.
bt: Traffic has feeling.

text: Nie sleg nie, nie great nie. Soos 'n 6/10 date.
en: Not bad, not great. Like a 6/10 date.
bt: Not bad, not great. Like a 6/10 date.

text: jackets → dijakete
en: Highveld winter: the only place where you wear two jackets to fetch the post.
bt: jackets -> [?dijakete = jackets]
note: glossary note, not a translation of the line

text: Mohodi o monyetleng. Leholimo le ipata.
en: Fog's on the cards. The sky's being coy about it.
bt: The [?mohodi = mist] is in the [?monyetleng = opportunity?]. The sky hides itself.

text: Groot lug-energie. Klein menslike reaksie.
en: Big sky energy. Small human response.
bt: Big sky energy. Small human reaction.

text: Die dag begin op eco-mode. Klim maar in.
en: The day is starting on eco-mode. Hop in anyway.
bt: The day starts in eco-mode. Climb in.

text: Helder sonop, plat see: elke hengelaar in die dorp staan al op die rotse.
en: Clear sunrise, flat sea: every fisherman in town is already on the rocks.
bt: Bright sunrise, flat sea: every angler in town is already standing on the rocks.

text: Die GPS sê jy het opgedaag. Die GPS jok.
en: Your GPS says you have arrived. Your GPS is lying.
bt: The GPS says you have arrived. The GPS is lying.

text: Ho bonahala ho le metsi. Limodele li na le bonnete mohlomong, eseng ka botlalo.
en: Looks wet. The models are fairly sure, not certain.
bt: It looks like there is water. The models have confidence perhaps, but not fully.

text: Ithrafiki inomvakalelo.
en: The traffic is emotional.
bt: Traffic has feeling.

text: Son in, son uit. Maandag warm nog net op.
en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.
bt: Sun in, sun out. Monday is only just warming up.

text: Ngisho nefoni yakho iyashisa.
en: Even your phone's overheating.
bt: Even your phone is getting hot.

text: Voorspelling: vibes neutraal, verwagtinge laer.
en: Forecast: vibes neutral, expectations lower.
bt: Forecast: vibes neutral, expectations lower.

text: Le yimozulu esiziqhayisa ngayo phesheya.
en: This is the weather we brag about overseas.
bt: This is the weather we boast about overseas.

text: Buite is gesluit tot verdere kennisgewing.
en: Outside is closed until further notice.
bt: Outside is closed until further notice.

text: Mhlawumbi imvula. Thatha isambrela.
en: Probably rain. Take the umbrella, settle the argument.
bt: Maybe rain. Take an umbrella.

text: Die halwe grasperk gesny, en nou begin die onderhandeling met die lug.
en: Half a lawn mowed, and now the negotiation with the sky begins.
bt: Half the lawn mowed, and now the negotiation with the sky begins.

text: Jou rustige aand sluit nou 'n oproep na die dakdekker in.
en: Your quiet evening now includes a call to the roofer.
bt: Your quiet evening now includes a call to the roofer.

text: Isimo sezulu esihle sefilimu yesabisayo.
en: Perfect weather for a horror movie.
bt: Good weather for a horror film.

text: Lieta tsa hao tsa suede li khethile kajeno? Sebete.
en: Your suede shoes chose today? Bold.
bt: Your suede shoes chose today? Brave.

text: Ngisho ama-hadeda azwakala ejabule.
en: Even the hadedas sound happy.
bt: Even the hadedas sound happy.

text: Kunamafu
bt: There are clouds

text: Modumo wa leholimo
en: Thunder
bt: Sound of the sky

text: Elke stormwaterrooster in hierdie straat werk nou namens iemand anders.
en: Every drain on this road is now working on somebody else's behalf.
bt: Every storm drain in this street is now working on behalf of someone else.

text: Perfek om absoluut niks te doen nie.
en: Perfect for doing absolutely nothing.
bt: Perfect for doing absolutely nothing.

text: Die spore agter hulle vul reeds toe en hulle het nou net daar geloop.
en: The footprints behind them are already filling in and they only just walked there.
bt: The tracks behind them are already filling in and they only just walked there.

text: Iimodeli zithi kuhle. Inyaniso inelungelo lokwahluka.
en: Models say lovely. Reality reserves the right to differ.
bt: The models say fine. The truth has the right to differ.

text: Mabone a seterata a leka ka hohle.
en: The streetlights are trying their best.
bt: The street lights are trying all over.

text: Kusenokutshiza kancinci. Kungenakuhlupha.
en: Might spit a bit. Might not bother.
bt: It may drizzle a little. It won't be a problem.

text: Jou aandstap het 'n baie kort roete ontwikkel.
en: Your evening walk has developed a very short route.
bt: Your evening walk has developed a very short route.

text: Kunamafu kodwa siza kuphila.
en: Overcast but we'll survive.
bt: There are clouds but we will live.

text: 50/50 ukuba manzi. Njengenhlahla.
en: 50/50 on getting wet. Like a coin toss.
bt: 50/50 to be wet. Like a [?inhlahla = bush].

text: Koffie in die son op die stoep. Die hele rede hoekom ons hier bly.
en: Coffee in the sun on the stoep. The whole reason we live here.
bt: Coffee in the sun on the stoep. The whole reason we stay here.

text: Isizathu esihle sokukhansela izinhlelo.
en: Perfect excuse to cancel plans.
bt: A good reason to cancel plans.

text: Die son en die wolke speel kat en muis vandag.
en: Sun, hide-and-seek champion of the day.
bt: The sun and the clouds are playing cat and mouse today.

text: Koue aand. Selfs die reën huiwer.
en: Cold evening. Even the rain is hesitating.
bt: Cold evening. Even the rain hesitates.

text: Isichotho siyawa — gquma ibhaki.
en: Hail's down — cover the bakkie.
bt: The [?isichotho = cold/frost] is falling, wrap up [?ibhaki = jacket?].
note: hail/bakkie unclear; frost and jacket read instead

text: Ligte uit. Iets het nog baie om te sê.
en: Lights out. Something still has plenty to say.
bt: Lights out. Something still has a lot to say.

text: Vanaand se sonsondergang is 'n binnenshuise geleentheid.
en: Tonight's sunset is an indoors-only event.
bt: Tonight's sunset is an indoor event.

text: Jou familie het al drie video's soos joune gesien.
en: Your family has already seen three videos like yours.
bt: Your family has already seen three videos like yours.

text: Le yimozulu impelaveki eyenzelwe yona.
en: This is the weather the weekend was invented for.
bt: This is weekend weather made for it.

text: Êrens agter daardie mure maak 'n hele straat asof dit slaap.
en: Somewhere behind those walls a whole street is pretending to sleep.
bt: Somewhere behind those walls a whole street pretends to be asleep.

text: Goeienag dan. Dit was glo optimisties.
en: Goodnight, then. Apparently that was optimistic.
bt: Good night then. That was apparently optimistic.

text: Hulle gaan die res van die naweek sout van daardie skoene afkry.
en: They will be getting salt off those shoes for the rest of the weekend.
bt: They are going to be getting salt off those shoes for the rest of the weekend.

text: Clouds akhangeleka erhaneleka nyhani.
en: Clouds looking proper suspicious.
bt: Clouds look [?erhaneleka] really.

text: Die soort dag waaroor jy iemand 'n boodskap stuur.
en: The kind of day you text someone about.
bt: The kind of day you message someone about.

text: Iewers is 'n kriek besig om sy hart uit te sing.
en: Somewhere a cricket is really giving it.
bt: Somewhere a cricket is singing its heart out.

text: Amafu avalile
en: Overcast
bt: The clouds have closed.

text: Skooldrag met 'n langbroek was vandag 'n gok. Sterkte, my kind.
en: Long pants with the uniform was a gamble today. Strength, my child.
bt: School uniform with long trousers was a gamble today. Strength, my child.

text: Nka sekhele ho ba sireletsehile, hey.
en: Take a brolly just in case, hey.
bt: I could [?sekhele] to be safe, hey.

text: Niemand in hierdie huis klim vanaand in daardie bad nie.
en: Nobody in this house is getting into that bath tonight.
bt: Nobody in this house is getting into that bath tonight.

text: Die karre het klaar opgegee. Hulle slaap onder ys.
en: The cars have surrendered. They're sleeping under ice tonight.
bt: The cars have already given up. They sleep under ice.

text: Tekisi e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe tseleng e khethile ho bapala ka bo eona.
en: Every taxi on the road has decided to freestyle.
bt: Every taxi on the road has chosen to play on its own.

text: Izihlalo zemoto ziyaqanda. Yonke into iyaqanda.
en: The car seats are freezing. Everything is freezing.
bt: The car seats are freezing. Everything is freezing.

text: Wind wemzantsi mpuma ufikile. Ungamenywanga njengesiqhelo.
en: The southeaster's arrived. Uninvited, as usual.
bt: Southeast wind has arrived. Uninvited, as usual.

text: Khoeli e etsa ho fetisisa bosiu bona.
en: The moon's doing the most tonight.
bt: The moon is doing the most this night.

text: Kungakhihliza kancane. Kungase kungahluphi.
en: Might spit a bit. Might not bother.
bt: It may drizzle a little. It may not bother.

text: Die lug is nou in beheer.
en: The sky is in charge now.
bt: The sky is now in control.

text: Vergadering klaar. Die onderhandelinge oor 'n lift het pas begin.
en: Meeting done. Lift negotiations have just begun.
bt: Meeting over. The negotiations about a lift have just begun.

text: Nagswem is nie 'n plan nie; dis al wat hierdie weer vir jou oorlaat.
en: Night swimming is not a plan; it is what this weather leaves you.
bt: Night swimming isn't a plan; it's all this weather leaves you.

text: Ukuhamba uye emotweni kubhekwa njengengozi yelanga namuhla.
en: Walking to the car counts as a sun hazard today.
bt: Walking to the car is regarded as a sun hazard today.

text: Aandete is reg. Die kamera kan later eet.
en: Supper's ready. The camera can eat later.
bt: Dinner is ready. The camera can eat later.

text: Maru le lehlakore la mang ea tsotellang.
en: Cloud cover with a side of who-cares.
bt: The clouds and the side of whoever cares.

text: Iemand het vergeet om die wasgoed in te bring. Die wasgoed het nie vergeet nie.
en: Somebody forgot to bring in the washing. The washing has not forgotten.
bt: Someone forgot to bring in the washing. The washing didn't forget.

text: Die huis is tweehonderd meter ver en op die oomblik heeltemal teoreties.
en: Home is two hundred metres away and completely theoretical right now.
bt: The house is two hundred metres away and at the moment entirely theoretical.

text: Vinnige hardloop. Jy het nog nooit een reg getyd nie.
en: Quick dash. You have never timed one correctly.
bt: Quick run. You've never timed one right.

text: Helder genoeg dat selfs die kat die lug nagaan.
en: Clear enough that even the cat is checking the sky.
bt: Clear enough that even the cat checks the sky.

text: Akukho i-alarm. Akukho i-agenda. Ama-vibes kuphela.
en: No alarm. No agenda. Just vibes.
bt: No alarm. No agenda. Only vibes.

text: Lehodimo le fetohile Carte Blanche ka botlalo.
en: The sky just went full Carte Blanche.
bt: The sky has completely become Carte Blanche.

text: Hoë UV
en: High UV
bt: High UV

text: Reën? Moontlik. Sal ik my lewe daar op wed? Nooit.
en: Rain? Possibly. Commitment? Never.
bt: Rain? Possible. Will I [Dutch: 'ik'] bet my life on it? Never.

text: Saterdag, en die wind het sterk menings oor jou planne vir die tuin.
en: Saturday, and the wind has strong opinions about your plans for the garden.
bt: Saturday, and the wind has strong opinions about your garden plans.

text: Vinnige hardloop. Jy het nog nooit een reg gekry nie.
en: Quick dash. You have never timed one correctly.
bt: Quick run. You've never gotten one right.

text: Letsatsi ha le bapale kajeno.
en: The sun's not playing games today.
bt: The sun is not playing today.

text: Amalahle awayi kuzilayita ngokwawo.
en: The coals aren't going to light themselves.
bt: The coals will not go and light themselves.

text: Izimo eziphelele zokulahlekelwa isithunzi.
en: Perfect conditions for losing your dignity.
bt: Perfect conditions for losing dignity.

text: Namhlanje isibhakabhaka asinakuthembeka.
en: Trust issues with the sky today.
bt: Today the sky cannot be trusted.

text: 'Nog vyf minute' is nou al veertig minute lank. Laat hulle.
en: 'Five more minutes' has been going for forty minutes now. Let them.
bt: 'Five more minutes' has now been forty minutes. Let them.

text: Saterdagaand, en die vermaak is verniet en omtrent vier miljard jaar oud.
en: Saturday night, and the entertainment is free and about four billion years old.
bt: Saturday evening, and the entertainment is free and about four billion years old.

text: Niemand ry op 'n dag soos vandag by so 'n stalletjie verby nie.
en: Nobody drives past a stall like that on a day like this.
bt: Nobody drives past a stall like that on a day like today.

text: Vrydag, en die wind doen die helfte van hierdie werk vir haar, gratis.
en: Friday, and the wind is doing half of this job for her, free of charge.
bt: Friday, and the wind does half of this work for her, free.

text: Het die hele span opgedaag, of net die kaptein?
en: Did the whole team arrive, or just the captain?
bt: Did the whole team show up, or just the captain?

text: Niemand klim uit nie. Die water het ons nou eers vergewe.
en: Nobody is getting out. The water has only just forgiven us.
bt: Nobody gets out. The water has only just forgiven us.

text: Modelle sê pragtig. Die werklikheid hou voor om te verskil.
en: Models say lovely. Reality reserves the right to differ.
bt: Models say beautiful. Reality pretends to differ.

text: Isibhakabhaka sithe cwaka, nomgca uthe cwaka. UMvulo akakayifumani ivolyum.
en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.
bt: The sky has gone quiet, and the horizon has gone quiet. Monday hasn't found the volume yet.

text: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle bavumelene ngombala ngale ntsasa. Asingombala onomdla.
en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.
bt: The sky and the sea agree on a colour this morning. It isn't an interesting colour.

text: Nditsho ne-hadeda ithe cwaka. Isibhakabhaka simisele umzekelo.
en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.
bt: Even the hadeda has gone quiet. The sky stands as [?an example].

text: Akukho zithunzi, akukho kukhazimla, akukho zizathu. UMvulo uphantsi kwesiciko seTupperware.
en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
bt: No pictures, no shining, no reasons. Monday is under a Tupperware lid.

text: Ilanga alizukuza kujonga ukukhazimla namhlanje. Imoto ayinangxaki ngaloo nto.
en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
bt: The sun isn't going to come and look at shining today. The car has no problem with that.

text: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. Usompempe akazange azimeze amehlo.
en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
bt: Not even one shadow on the field all day. The referee (whistler) didn't shut his eyes.

text: Isibhakabhaka singwevu, iijezi zinxitywe, isikolo siphumile. Impelaveki ayidingi mvume yelanga.
en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
bt: The sky is grey, jerseys are worn, school is out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.

text: Ithafa lonke ngathi umbala uthotyiwe. Iigusha zibalwa ngendlela efanayo noko.
en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
bt: The whole plateau looks as if the colour has been turned down. The sheep are counted the same way regardless.

text: Isibane seshedi kukutshona kwelanga ngokuhlwanje. Iinkomo zamkela oko.
en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
bt: The shed light is the sunset tonight. The cows accepted that.

text: Isibhakabhaka sisuke kungwevu olukhanyayo saya kungwevu olumnyama. Yayiyiyo yonke imiboniso leyo.
en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
bt: The sky went from bright grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.

text: Isibane sokhuseleko sikhanyise kwangethuba. Ilanga alizange liqale umsebenzi kakuhle.
en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.
bt: The security light came on early. The sun didn't start work well.

text: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka bangwevu ngokufanayo. Zizibane zebhulorho kuphela ezizamileyo.
en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
bt: The sea and the sky are equally grey. Only the bridge lights are trying.

text: Iflegi ixela imozulu phambi kwabadlali bamaza. Ithi: hambani.
en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
bt: The flag announces the weather before the wave riders (surfers). It says: go.

text: Amagqabi eentyatyambo ze-jacaranda nawo akhwele ibhasi. Umoya omncinci uwathengele amatikiti.
en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.
bt: The leaves of the jacaranda flowers have also boarded the bus. The light wind bought them tickets.

text: Umpompo womoya wenza umsebenzi wakusasa. Ingca iyawuphungela nje isandla.
en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.
bt: The windpump does the morning's work. The grass just [?waves a hand at it].

text: Isandla ekepusini, inyathelo ngenyathelo. Umoya omncinci uhamba naye.
en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.
bt: Hand in pocket, step by step. The light wind walks with him.

text: Impahla iza komelela phambi kwekhefu lokuqala. Umoya omncinci uqale umsebenzi kwangethuba.
en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.
bt: The washing will be dry before first break. The light wind started work early.

text: Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asiyityhali nokuyityhala ibhayisekile.
en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
bt: A little storm of dust walks in front of him. It doesn't even push the bicycle.

text: Iinwele zakhe zifike kuqala evenkileni yesonka. Umoya omncinci uneecebo zawo zangeCawa.
en: Her hair got to the bakery first. The breeze has its own Sunday plans.
bt: Her hair arrived first at the bakery. The light wind has its Sunday plans.

text: Lixesha lekhefu, kwaye umoya omncinci ulungisa iinwele zabo bonke. Nootitshala.
en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
bt: It's break time, and the light wind fixes everyone's hair. Teachers too.

text: Umoya omncinci usebenza kwindawo yeziqhamo namhlanje. Ipholisa simahla, akukho mali yongezelelweyo.
en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.
bt: The light wind is working at the fruit place today. [?It pollinates] for free, no extra money.

text: Umoya omncinci wenza wonke umsebenzi. Ikhayithi ifumana lonke udumo.
en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.
bt: The light wind does all the work. The kite gets all the glory.

text: Iflegi yekona ibonisa kanye apho ibhola iza kutyekela khona.
en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.
bt: The corner flag shows exactly where the ball is going to lean.

text: Amashiti sele omile. Ngoku umoya omncinci uzibonakalisa nje kumntwana.
en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.
bt: The sheets are already dry. Now the light wind is just showing off to the child.

text: Umsi ufike eyadini yabamelwane. Ibraai yangoMgqibelo ngoku yeyoluntu lonke.
en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.
bt: Smoke has arrived in the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai now belongs to everyone.

text: Izihlangu kwiikona zengubo. Umoya omncinci wamkelekile, isanti ayamkelekanga.
en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.
bt: Shoes on the corners of the blanket. Light wind is welcome, sand is not welcome.

text: Iiflegi zolulekile, iwayini ibanjwe ngokuqinileyo. Yile ndlela uMvulo ozolileyo ukhangeleka ngayo apha.
en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
bt: The flags are relaxed, the wine is held firmly. This is how a calm Monday looks here.

text: Uthuli lukhazimla ngathi yigolide ekukhanyeni kokutshona kwelanga. Umdlalo uyaqhubeka.
en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.
bt: The dust sparkles like gold in the light of the sunset. The game goes on.

text: Induli ishukuma ngathi ngamaza. Iinkomo zigqibe ekubeni zingaboni nto.
en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.
bt: The dune moves like waves. The cows have decided to see nothing.

text: Umoya omncinci uthutha i-jacaranda iye kwesinye isitrato, intyatyambo ngentyatyambo. Istoep siyavuma.
en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.
bt: The light wind carries the jacaranda to another street, flower by flower. The stoep agrees.

text: Impahla bekufanele ingene kwiiyure ezidlulileyo. Umoya omncinci uvote ukuba ihlale.
en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
bt: The washing should have come in hours ago. The light wind voted that it stay.

text: Iiflegi zisancokola. Izikhephe ziyigqibile iveki.
en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.
bt: The flags are still chatting. The boats have finished the week.

text: Amagqabi asoloko ekhanyisa isibane sokhuseleko. Inja ayisaphakami ngenxa yawo.
en: The leaves keep setting off the security light. The dog's stopped getting up for them.
bt: The leaves keep lighting the security light. The dog no longer gets up because of them.

text: Umntu uyilibele impahla. Umoya omncinci awuyilibalanga, kwaye wenza umsebenzi omhle.
en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.
bt: Someone has forgotten the washing. The light wind hasn't forgotten it, and does a good job.

text: Umoya omncinci usashushu ngeli xesha. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.
en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.
bt: The light wind is still hot at this time. The sea leaves the heater on all night.

text: Umpompo womoya awukholelwa kwixesha lokuphuma emsebenzini. Nenja ayikholelwa.
en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.
bt: The windpump doesn't believe in knocking-off time. The dog doesn't believe in it either.

text: Umoya omncinci uthwala umsi usiwa ezantsi kwesitrato. Isitrato sonke siyazi ukuba kutyiwa ntoni ngokuhlwa.
en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
bt: The light wind carries smoke down the street. The whole street knows what is being eaten in the evening.

text: Zonke izibane ezisentanjeni ziyajiwuzela. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesingqi, kancinci nje.
en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
bt: All the lights on the string are [?jiving]. Saturday night has rhythm, just a little.

text: Isanti iwela indlela ingqanga ngengqanga. Akukho mntu ungxamileyo apha.
en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.
bt: Sand crosses the road grain by grain. Nobody is in a hurry here.

text: Intaba izigqume intloko ngengubo. Kulungile, nguLwesihlanu.
en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.
bt: The mountain has covered its head with a blanket. Fine, it's Friday.

text: Ilanga liyangena, liyaphuma. UMvulo uqala kancinci.
en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.
bt: The sun comes in, it goes out. Monday starts slowly.

text: Amafu alinike ilanga ikhefu ngoLwesibini. Akukho mntu uxelele ubumanzi bomoya.
en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.
bt: The clouds gave the sun a break on Tuesday. Nobody told the dampness of the air.

text: Loo mafu adlula nje. Nditsho nombona uyazi ukuba akufuneki uvuye.
en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.
bt: Those clouds are just passing. Even the maize knows you mustn't rejoice.

text: Isithunzi sihamba imigca ngemigca. Siyahlola.
en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.
bt: The shadow walks in lines. It is inspecting.

text: Mfusa emhlabeni, mhlophe esibhakabhakeni. Imibala kaLwesihlanu yamkelwe.
en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.
bt: [?Pinkish] on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colours are accepted.

text: Amafu ambalwa eze kubukela. Nawo akabaleki.
en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
bt: A few clouds have come to watch. They aren't running away either.

text: Amafu adlula kancinci. YiCawa; avumelekile.
en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.
bt: The clouds pass slowly. It's Sunday; they are allowed.

text: Ilaphu letafile lentaba lingaphezulu ngesiqingatha kuphela. NguMvulo, akukho mntu unxibe ngokupheleleyo.
en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
bt: The tablecloth of the mountain is only over about half. It's Monday, nobody is fully dressed.

text: Izithunzi zamafu ziwela ibala zihamba kancinci. Akukho mntu ukhalazayo.
en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.
bt: Cloud shadows cross the field, moving slowly. Nobody complains.

text: Ilanga, emva koko ilifu, emva koko ilanga. Nditsho neenkawu azikwazi ukwenza icebo.
en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.
bt: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't make a plan.

text: Inja iwufumene kanye umda phakathi kwelanga nesithunzi. Ihlala khona.
en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
bt: The dog has found exactly the border between sun and shadow. It stays there.

text: Iiglasi zelanga ziyanxitywa, ziyakhululwa, ziyanxitywa. Emva kwemini ngoLwesihlanu kukuzilolonga.
en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.
bt: Sunglasses are put on, taken off, put on. Friday afternoon is practice.

text: Ilifu elinye phezu kwentaba asiyiyo imozulu. Umlilo uhlala uvutha.
en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
bt: One cloud over the mountain isn't weather. The fire keeps burning.

text: Ilifu phezu kwentaba, ipotjie phantsi kwelapa. Zombini zisafuna enye iyure.
en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.
bt: A cloud over the mountain, a potjie under the lapa. Both still want another hour.

text: Amafu ahlale kade ngenxa yombala kuphela. UMvulo ebetyala wonke umntu oko.
en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.
bt: The clouds stayed long only for the colour. Monday has been fining everyone for it.

text: Amafu emva kwemini yonke, akukho thontsi. Umbhobho wamanzi ubuyele emsebenzini.
en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.
bt: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The water pipe is back at work.

text: Isibhakabhaka senza umboniso. Iintlanzi, njengesiqhelo, azenzi.
en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.
bt: The sky puts on a show. The fish, as usual, don't.

text: Amafu okutshona kwelanga, izitshizi zeediliya. Ifama izilungiselela eyayo imvula.
en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
bt: Sunset clouds, [?bunches] of grapes. The farm is preparing its own rain.

text: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, kunye nebhalkoni.
en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
bt: The sun has left work. The clouds are still shining, and the balcony too.

text: Amafu abe pinki kanye ngexesha lokupakisha. Akukho mntu upakishileyo.
en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.
bt: The clouds turned pink exactly at packing time. Nobody has packed.

text: Iinkomo zisekhaya phambi kokuba umbala uphele. ICawa iphela ngexesha kanye.
en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
bt: The cows are home before the colour ends. Sunday ends exactly on time.

text: Inyanga ikhanya kancinci ngokuhlwanje. Isibane sokhuseleko asinako oko.
en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.
bt: The moon shines a little tonight. The security light can't do anything about that.

text: Isiqingatha senyanga, isiqingatha selifu, umgqomo ugcwele. NgoLwesibini ebusuku, njengoko kwakuthenjisiwe.
en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.
bt: Half a moon, half a cloud, the bin is full. On Tuesday night, as promised.

text: Inyanga isoloko iphuma ijonga igaraji. Akukho nto yenzekayo.
en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.
bt: The moon always comes out looking at the garage. Nothing is happening.

text: Amafu ayayidlulisana inyanga. Ibhalkoni ivuya ukulinda.
en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
bt: The clouds pass the moon to each other. The balcony rejoices to wait.

text: Inyanga ityelela phakathi kwamafu. Iyayiva ivumba lenyama ukusuka phaya phezulu.
en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.
bt: The moon visits between the clouds. It smells the meat from up there.

text: Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane ezincinci zibathathela indawo.
en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
bt: Half of the stars are behind the clouds. Small lights take their place.

text: Inyanga ingemva kwelifu, inja isestoep. Inkonzo yangeCawa iphelile.
en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
bt: The moon behind a cloud, the dog on the stoep. Sunday service is over.

text: Ngu-6 kusasa, kwaye ifriji sele iyeyona ndawo ithandwayo endlwini.
en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.
bt: It is 6 tomorrow, and the fridge is already the best-loved place in the house.

text: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Inenwele ekuphela kwazo ezenzelwe wona.
en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.
bt: The dog likes this wind. It has hair that is the only kind made for it.

text: Kuyabanda nyhani namhlanje. Yingqele egqobhoza iijezi ezintathu ngathi azikho.
en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
bt: It is truly cold today. It's frost piercing three jerseys as if they weren't there.

text: Nditsho nabo bafunga ukuba akuze kubande ngoku bayavuma.
en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.
bt: Even those who swore it wouldn't get cold now agree.

text: Umphefumlo omnye womoya wemvula, ngequbuliso ilizwe lonke liyimbongi.
en: One breath of rain air and suddenly the whole country is a poet.
bt: One breath of rain wind, and suddenly the whole country is a poet.

text: Imvula efama ayiyiyo imozulu nje. Ngumvuzo owela esibhakabhakeni.
en: Rain on a farm isn't weather. It's a salary falling from the sky.
bt: Farming rain isn't just weather. It's a reward falling from the sky.

text: ITar emanzi ekuphumeni kwelanga. Asilovumba elo, lilifa.
en: Wet tar at sunrise. That's not a smell, that's heritage.
bt: Wet tar at sunrise. That isn't a smell, it's an inheritance.

text: Imvula yaseJoburg inedayari: ngo-2 emva kwemini kanye, idrama eninzi, akukho kuxolisa.
en: Joburg rain keeps a diary: 2pm sharp, maximum drama, no apologies.
bt: Joburg rain has a diary: at 2 right in the afternoon, plenty of drama, no apology.

text: Onke amacebo ngoku afuduselwe 'xa kuthe kwacaca'. Okungasoze kwenzeke. Hayi bo.
en: All plans are officially moved to 'when it clears up'. Which is never. Shame.
bt: All plans are now moved to 'when it clears'. Which will never happen. Oh dear.

text: Imvula yaseHighveld uyayiva ngevumba phambi kokuba uyibone. Yintshayelelo leyo.
en: You smell Highveld rain before you see it. That's the trailer.
bt: Highveld rain you feel by its smell before you see it. That is an introduction.

text: Kumanqanaba amadama! Yonke imvula enkulu sisipho sasimahla.
en: To the dam levels! Every downpour is a round on the house.
bt: [?At the levels] of the dams! All big rain is a free gift.

text: Iindaba ezintsha: amachibi avuliwe ngoku.
en: Breaking news: the puddles are open for business.
bt: News: the [?puddles/pools] are now open.

text: Isekude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amahlanu, kodwa istoep sele sigcwele.
en: It's still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already sold out.
bt: It is still fifty kilometres away, but the stoep is already full.

text: Ungwevu kusasa. Mayihlale nje kancinci, njengeti.
en: Early grey. Like the tea, just let it steep.
bt: It is grey tomorrow. Let it just sit a little, like tea.

text: Ungwevu nawo ngumbala, utsho umama. Namhlanje ndiyamkholelwa.
en: Grey is also a colour, says my ma. Today I believe her.
bt: Grey is also a colour, says mother. Today I believe her.

text: Isibhakabhaka sinxibe isuti yodliwano-ndlebe: ngwevu, icocekile, ayixeli nto.
en: The sky is in its interview suit: grey, neat, giving nothing away.
bt: The sky is wearing an interview suit: grey, clean, says nothing.

text: Ungwevu wempelaveki: imvume esemthethweni yokungenzi nto konke konke.
en: Weekend grey: official permission to do absolutely nothing.
bt: Weekend grey: lawful permission to do nothing at all.

text: Usuku olungwevu lusuku lokubhaka. Ikhitshi lomntu othile sele linuka kamnandi.
en: Grey day equals baking day. Somebody's kitchen already smells amazing.
bt: A grey day is a baking day. Somebody's kitchen already smells good.

text: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini lingavalelisanga. Akukho mbeko, kodwa siyaqonda.
en: The sun clocked out without saying bye. Rude, but relatable.
bt: The sun left work without saying goodbye. No farewell, but we understand.

text: Ukutshona kwelanga kuthe cwaka ngokuhlwanje. Ubusuku bufikile noko.
en: Dusk is on mute tonight. The evening showed up anyway.
bt: The sunset was quiet tonight. Night has come anyway.

text: Isibhakabhaka sizigqumile. Iingubo zakho ziyakulinda. Kuyenzeka nje? Hayi.
en: The sky is under the covers. Yours are waiting. Coincidence? Never.
bt: The sky has covered itself. Your blankets are waiting for you. Does it just happen so? No.

text: UGqirha uhamba ejonga kusasa. Akufuneki kubhukisha, ngelishwa.
en: The Doctor's on morning rounds. No appointment needed, unfortunately.
bt: The Doctor walks looking at tomorrow. No need to book, unfortunately.

text: Ilaphu letafile lu-ayinile kwaye lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.
en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.
bt: The tablecloth of the mountain is ironed and ready for tomorrow's work.

text: Ingqele yaseKapa yingqele emanzi. Ingena emathanjeni akho ize ihlale.
en: Cape cold is wet cold. It moves into your bones and unpacks.
bt: Cape cold is wet cold. It enters your bones and stays.

text: Ubusika baseHighveld: ukutshiswa lilanga nokubanjwa ngumkhenkce kunokwenzeka ngosuku olunye.
en: Highveld winter: sunburn and frostbite achievable on the same day.
bt: Highveld winter: being burnt by the sun and gripped by frost can happen in one day.

text: Kufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ukuncome, kude ngokwaneleyo ukuba ungawuqhwanyazeli. Kugqibelele.
en: Close enough to admire, far enough that you don't have to shovel it. Perfect.
bt: Close enough to smile at, far enough not to [?blink at]. Perfect.

text: Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: lolo hlobo lugqobhoza iingubo ezine nomoya omhle.
en: Wet sea cold: the kind that gets through four layers and a good mood.
bt: Wet sea cold: that kind pierces four blankets even with a good wind.

text: Uyayibona ingqele isiza. Ayizifihli konke konke.
en: You can watch the cold arriving. It's not even being subtle about it.
bt: You see the cold coming. It doesn't hide at all.

text: Sihleli phandle engqeleni kuba ngaphakathi, inyani, kubanda ngakumbi.
en: We're visiting outside in the cold because inside is, honestly, colder.
bt: We sit outside in the cold because inside, truly, it is colder.

text: Amabhadi akanxibi zikhafu kwaye akakhalazi. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.
en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
bt: The [?amabhadi] don't wear scarves and don't complain. We could learn something. We won't learn, but we could.

text: Isiqwengana sokugqibela seenkuni sisigqibo, asiyonto nje ekhoyo.
en: The last log is a decision, not an inventory item.
bt: The last piece of firewood is a decision, not just something that exists.

text: Ndilibale ukuvula ingubo yombane kwangethuba. Qho. Ngobusuku. Bonke.
en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.
bt: I forgot to switch on the electric blanket early. Every. Night. All.

text: Ifronti ihambile. Ingqele yona ifudukele apha ngokusisigxina.
en: The front left. The cold just moved in permanently.
bt: The front has gone. The cold has moved here permanently.

text: Isibhakabhaka sanamhlanje: sisandul' ukuhlanjwa, sayinwa ngumkhenkce.
en: Today's sky: freshly washed, ice-pressed.
bt: Today's sky: just washed, ironed by frost.

text: Lusuku oluhle lokuhlala ngaphakathi.
en: It's a beautiful day to stay indoors.
bt: It is a nice day to stay inside.

text: Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokomisa impahla. Impahla iza kuoma ize ibe ngumkhenkce, ngolo landelelwano.
en: Perfect drying weather. The washing will dry and freeze, in that order.
bt: It is suitable weather for drying clothes. The clothes will dry and then become ice, in that order.

text: Icala elinesithunzi lebala lilizwe lalo ngokwalo.
en: The shady side of the field is a separate climate zone.
bt: The shaded side of the field is a country of its own.

text: Ikofu yepadstal isebenza njengesifudumezi namhlanje.
en: Padstal coffee is functioning as central heating today.
bt: Padstal coffee works as a heater today.

text: Lelona xesha lihle losuku. Kwaye lelona lifutshane. Baleka.
en: Prettiest moment of the day. Also the shortest. Run.
bt: This is the best time of day. And the shortest. Run.

text: Jonga ngokukhawuleza. Kwimizuzu elishumi kuza kuba bubusuku nengqele enkulu.
en: Look quickly. In ten minutes it's night and the North Pole.
bt: Look quickly. In ten minutes it will be night with a big cold.

text: IKaroo ivula uphahla lwayo ebusuku. Nxiba iimpahla ezifudumeleyo kumboniso.
en: The Karoo is opening its roof for the night. Dress warm for the show.
bt: The Karoo opens its roof at night. Wear warm clothes for the show.

text: IRooibos esandleni, ingubo ide ifike ezindlebeni. Sizixhobile.
en: Rooibos in hand, blanket to the ears. Full kit.
bt: Rooibos in the hand, blanket up to the ears. We are armed.

text: Akukho moya, akukho mafu, akukho sizathu sale bhatyi ibhityileyo.
en: No wind, no clouds, no excuse for that thin jacket.
bt: No wind, no clouds, no reason for this thin jacket.

text: Uphefumla ngathi yinamba enomlilo, umbono ngathi liphupha.
en: Breathing like a dragon, view like a dream.
bt: You breathe like a [?fiery number], the view is like a dream.

text: Umoya oshushu wasezintabeni utshintshe ebusuku. Kapa, namhlanje uphantse ube yi-Upington.
en: The berg wind turned overnight. Cape Town, today you're basically Upington.
bt: The hot wind from the mountains changed at night. Cape, today nearly becomes Upington.

text: Ulwandle luziidigri ezili-12. Ngentsimbi yeshumi luza kuziva ngathi yispa.
en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.
bt: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it will feel like a spa.

text: Ababalekayo ngo-5:30 abomelele kunathi. Nje bakrelekrele ngakumbi.
en: The 5:30 runners aren't fitter than us. They're just smarter.
bt: Runners at 5:30 are tougher than us. They are just smarter.

text: Nditsho nenja ijonge imozulu yaza yabuyela ebhedini.
en: Even the dog checked the forecast and went straight back to bed.
bt: Even the dog looked at the weather and went back to bed.

text: Yiza nomkhenkce wakho. Ubuhlobo abubandakanyi umkhenkce.
en: Bring your own ice. The friendship doesn't cover ice.
bt: Come with your ice. Friendship doesn't include ice.

text: Ukuthamba kokuqala emva kosuku lweedigri ezingama-35 bekufanele ukuba kuhlawulelwe irhafu, inyani.
en: The first sip after a 35-degree day should honestly be taxable.
bt: The first swim after a 35-degree day should have been taxed, truly.

text: Asithethi nganamhlanje. Namhlanje kuphelile. Siyazingca.
en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.
bt: We aren't talking about today. Today is finished. We are proud.

text: Umoya omncinci wokuqala wosuku usandul' ukufika. Wuqhwabele izandla.
en: The first breeze of the day has just arrived. Give it a round of applause.
bt: The first light wind of the day has just arrived. Clap hands for it.

text: Ifama isekhona. Sikholelwa nje kwilizwi lomnye nomnye.
en: The farm is still there. We're all just taking each other's word for it.
bt: The farm is still there. We just believe each other's word.

text: Iinkomo ziyazi kanye apho zikhoyo. Ngaphezu koko thina sinokukutsho.
en: The cows know exactly where they are. Which is more than the rest of us can say.
bt: The cows know exactly where they are. More than that, we can say so.

text: Ukubona: akukho. Isimo sengqondo: sizolile, ngokumangalisayo.
en: Visibility: zero. Mood: surprisingly at peace with it.
bt: Visibility: none. Mood: calm, amazingly.

text: Yonke ifestile ekhanyayo ngumntu ogqibe kwelokuba: kwanele namhlanje.
en: Every window switching on is someone deciding: that's enough for today.
bt: Every lit window is a person who has decided: enough for today.

text: Imozulu yeziko ifikile ingakhange icele.
en: Fireplace weather showed up without even asking.
bt: Hearth weather has arrived without being asked.

text: Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokudibana nomntu 'obusoloko uceba ukumtsalela umnxeba'.
en: Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.
bt: It is the right weather to meet someone you always plan to phone.

text: Idolophu yonke izitshintshele kwivolyum yokusebeza.
en: The whole town just switched itself to whisper volume.
bt: The whole town has switched itself to whisper volume.

text: Masithi yimeko entle, singene ngaphakathi.
en: Let's call it atmosphere and go inside.
bt: Let's say it's a nice situation, we go inside.

text: Ulwandle lunyamalele kodwa oomakazi bakhona. Izinto eziphambili.
en: The sea has vanished but the tannies are here. Priorities.
bt: The sea has disappeared but the aunts are there. Priorities.

text: Owokugqibela ukudlula uvala isango. Nokuba akukho mntu ulibonayo.
en: Last one through closes the gate. Even if nobody can see it.
bt: The last one to pass closes the gate. Even if nobody sees it.

text: Inkungu yentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku yenza zonke izitrato zibe ziindawo zokwenza ifilimu.
en: Ten pm fog turns every street into a film set.
bt: Ten o'clock fog at night makes all the streets into film locations.

text: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amathathu, kwaye ngokuhlwanje bakubona kancinci ngakumbi.
en: The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.
bt: Close neighbours are thirty kilometres away, and tonight you see them a little more.
note: 'a little more' vs 'even less': visibility direction reversed

text: Ilanga liqale umsebenzi phambi kokuba i-alamu yakho izame.
en: The sun clocked in before your alarm even tried.
bt: The sun started work before your alarm tried.

text: Akukho mpazamo namhlanje ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. Nesibhakabhaka.
en: Zero mistakes from today so far. Sky included.
bt: No mistake today so far. Even the sky.

text: Iintsasa zaseHighveld: kubanda kakhulu, kuhle, akukho kuxolisa.
en: Highveld mornings: freezing, gorgeous, zero apologies.
bt: Highveld mornings: very cold, beautiful, no apology.

text: Imozulu eziphethe kakuhle kangaka ngokuqinisekileyo iceba into.
en: Weather this well-behaved is definitely up to something.
bt: Weather that behaves so well is surely planning something.

text: Apha nditsho nelanga liyala ukungxama.
en: Out here even the sun refuses to rush.
bt: Here even the sun refuses to hurry.

text: Imozulu entle kangaka yeyokubolekwa. Umoya wasempuma-mzantsi ugcina iirisithi.
en: Weather this perfect is on loan. The southeaster keeps receipts.
bt: Such nice weather is for borrowing. The south-east wind keeps the receipts.

text: Imozulu yenze amacebo. Thina siphendule nje sathi siyeza.
en: The weather made the plans. We just RSVP'd.
bt: The weather made plans. We just answered that we are coming.

text: Isibhakabhaka saseKaroo: luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka olufanayo kwiikhilomitha ezingama-400 ezizayo. Kuqinisekisiwe.
en: Karoo sky: same flawless blue for the next 400 km. Guaranteed.
bt: Karoo sky: the same sky-blue for the next 400 kilometres. Confirmed.

text: Ilanga lithatha ixesha elide lisiya kutshona. Inyani, liyakufanele.
en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.
bt: The sun takes a long time to set. Truly, it deserves it.

text: Xa imozulu iziphethe kakuhle kangaka, nathi siyaziphatha. Phantse.
en: When the weather behaves this well, so do we. Roughly.
bt: When the weather behaves so well, we behave too. Nearly.

text: Yithi inyani — uvule le app ukuze uqinisekise ibraai yangoMgqibelo.
en: Be honest — you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.
bt: Let us say it truly: you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.

text: Usuku oluhle kangangokuba nditsho nexesha lezithuthi ezininzi beliziva ngathi ngumba wokuzikhethela.
en: A day so good even rush hour felt optional.
bt: A day so nice that even rush hour felt like a [?chosen-for-yourself problem].

text: Inkungu yaseMidlands: indlela amaphandle azifihla ngayo.
en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.
bt: Midlands fog: the way the countryside hides.

text: Hamba ngoku okanye ungahambi konke. ILowveld ikunika ixesha de kube yintsimbi yesixhenxe.
en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
bt: Go now or don't go at all. The Lowveld gives you time until seven o'clock.

text: Nditsho neempala zimi emthunzini ziphinda zicinga ngezigqibo zazo.
en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.
bt: Even the impalas standing in the shade rethink their decisions.

text: Ihlobo laseLowveld: awubili, unyibilika ngesidima.
en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.
bt: Lowveld summer: you are not [?two], you melt with a thud.

text: Ihlathi lithe cwaka namhlanje. Wonke umntu. Yonke into.
en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.
bt: The forest is quiet today. Everyone. Everything.

text: Isiselo sokutshona kwelanga asiyonto yobunewunewu eLowveld. Lichiza.
en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.
bt: The sunset drink is not a luxury in the Lowveld. It heals.

text: Gqeberha, siyazi. Siyazi.
en: Gqeberha, we know. We know.
bt: Gqeberha, we know. We know.

text: IDolophu enoBubele ayizange icele ukuba yiDolophu enoMoya, kodwa ke.
en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
bt: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, but anyway.

text: IJeffreys Bay: apho umoya uzilolonga khona phambi komsebenzi wawo eKapa.
en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.
bt: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind exercises before its work in Cape Town.

text: IGqeberha ayilali, ibambelela nje.
en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.
bt: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.

text: Amafu okutshona kwelanga, amanzi okunkcenkceshela iidiliya. Ifama izilungiselela eyayo imvula.
en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
bt: Clouds at sunset, water for sprinkling the grapes. The farm is preparing its own rain.

text: Ngu-6 ngentsasa, kwaye ifriji sele iyeyona ndawo ithandwayo endlwini.
en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.
bt: It is 6 in the morning, and the fridge is already the favourite place in the house.

text: Izilwanyana zasendle azinxibi zikhafu kwaye azikhalazi. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.
en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
bt: Wild animals do not wear scarves and do not complain. We can learn something. We will not learn, but we could learn.

text: Isiselo sokuqala emva kosuku lweedigri ezingama-35 bekufanele ukuba sihlawulelwe irhafu, inyani.
en: The first sip after a 35-degree day should honestly be taxable.
bt: The first drink after a day of 35 degrees should have been taxed, truly.

text: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amathathu, kwaye ngokuhlwanje abakuboni nakancinci.
en: The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.
bt: The neighbours nearby are thirty kilometres away, and tonight you do not see them at all.
note: Seeing direction flipped: you cannot see them, not they cannot see you.
